title: 管道原位固化內襯
summary: 本課聚焦連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。假設厚度由6mm增為6.6mm而參照厚度固定10mm，幾何保留比例由60%增為66%，增加6個百分點；同材料彎曲剛度比為1.1³=1.331，但不能直接宣稱承載力增加33.1%。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Increasing assumed thickness from6mm to6.6mm against a fixed10mm reference raises retention from60% to66%, or6 percentage points. Same-material flexural rigidity changes by1.1³=1.331, but this does not directly establish33.1% more capacity. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剩餘厚度判讀」與「理想薄環屈曲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Remaining thickness interpretation" and "Ideal thin ring buckling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘厚度判讀」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining thickness interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。厚度比例只是幾何指標，承載還取決於材料、缺陷、橢圓度及原管支承狀態。假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘厚度判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. Thickness ratio is a geometric indicator, while capacity also depends on material properties, defects, ovality and host-pipe support. An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining thickness interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘厚度判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Remaining thickness interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剩餘厚度判讀
knowledge.text: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。厚度比例只是幾何指標，承載還取決於材料、缺陷、橢圓度及原管支承狀態。
knowledge.textEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. Thickness ratio is a geometric indicator, while capacity also depends on material properties, defects, ovality and host-pipe support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剩餘厚度判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Remaining thickness interpretation" is correct?
options: 只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。
只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count.
A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘厚度判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining thickness interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剩餘厚度判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Remaining thickness interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 只要厚度立方敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
optionsEn: A nominal result for cubic thickness sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘厚度判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining thickness interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。同時排除以下干擾原因：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接剩餘厚度判讀時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over remaining thickness interpretation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。同時排除以下干擾原因：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
knowledge.textEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接剩餘厚度判讀時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over remaining thickness interpretation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剩餘厚度判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Remaining thickness interpretation"?
options: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剩餘厚度判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Remaining thickness interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘厚度判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining thickness interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.

steps.title: 理想薄環屈曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal thin ring buckling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想薄環屈曲」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。此模型是均勻圓環且無側向拘束的理想彈性上限尺度，實際設計須另考慮長期模數、橢圓及土體互制。假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想薄環屈曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External water pressure can buckle a liner inward. The thin-ring model illustrates cubic sensitivity to thickness ratio for an ideal uniform circular elastic ring without lateral restraint; real design additionally requires long-term modulus, ovality and soil interaction. For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure. Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal thin ring buckling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。同時排除以下干擾原因：初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「理想薄環屈曲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ideal thin ring buckling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results.
quiz.explanation: 初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「內壓環向應力」與「厚度立方敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Internal pressure hoop stress" and "Cubic thickness sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 內壓環向應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal pressure hoop stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「內壓環向應力」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Internal pressure hoop stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受壓供水管內襯與重力污水管的荷載情境不同，不能共用同一個簡化合格判定。薄壁環向拉應力假設內襯獨立承壓，端部、接管與水錘應另列局部及瞬態需求。取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「內壓環向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pressurized water-main liner and a gravity-sewer liner face different load cases. Thin-wall hoop stress assumes independent internal-pressure resistance; ends, laterals and water hammer create additional local and transient demands. For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress. A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Internal pressure hoop stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「內壓環向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Internal pressure hoop stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 內壓環向應力
knowledge.text: 受壓供水管內襯與重力污水管的荷載情境不同，不能共用同一個簡化合格判定。薄壁環向拉應力假設內襯獨立承壓，端部、接管與水錘應另列局部及瞬態需求。
knowledge.textEn: A pressurized water-main liner and a gravity-sewer liner face different load cases. Thin-wall hoop stress assumes independent internal-pressure resistance; ends, laterals and water hammer create additional local and transient demands.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「內壓環向應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal pressure hoop stress" is correct?
options: 受壓供水管內襯與重力污水管的荷載情境不同，不能共用同一個簡化合格判定。
只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要厚度立方敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A pressurized water-main liner and a gravity-sewer liner face different load cases.
A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for cubic thickness sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 受壓供水管內襯與重力污水管的荷載情境不同，不能共用同一個簡化合格判定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pressurized water-main liner and a gravity-sewer liner face different load cases. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內壓環向應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal pressure hoop stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「內壓環向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Internal pressure hoop stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「內壓環向應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal pressure hoop stress", which statement holds?
options: 只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa。
只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa.
A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 內壓環向應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal pressure hoop stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「內壓環向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Internal pressure hoop stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。試驗壓力、隔離及排氣由責任工程師制定，本算例不構成現場加壓程序。同時排除以下干擾原因：只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接內壓環向應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。試驗壓力、隔離及排氣由責任工程師制定，本算例不構成現場加壓程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over internal pressure hoop stress, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。試驗壓力、隔離及排氣由責任工程師制定，本算例不構成現場加壓程序。同時排除以下干擾原因：只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。
knowledge.textEn: Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接內壓環向應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。試驗壓力、隔離及排氣由責任工程師制定，本算例不構成現場加壓程序。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over internal pressure hoop stress, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「內壓環向應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal pressure hoop stress"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan.
quiz.explanation: 比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 內壓環向應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal pressure hoop stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「內壓環向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Internal pressure hoop stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。
knowledge.textEn: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內壓環向應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal pressure hoop stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要厚度立方敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals.

steps.instruction: 固化不是只看表面硬化，樹脂反應可能因溫度分布、時間與材料混合而不同。熱分析估計反應進度是一種材料證據，仍需結合力學試驗與整段製程紀錄。假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「固化反應證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cure cannot be inferred solely from a hard surface. Temperature distribution, duration and mixing affect resin reaction. Thermal analysis provides one measure of reaction progress, which must be combined with mechanical tests and full-process records. For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures. A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Evidence of cure reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要固化反應證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for evidence of cure reaction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「固化反應證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Evidence of cure reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 固化不是只看表面硬化，樹脂反應可能因溫度分布、時間與材料混合而不同。熱分析估計反應進度是一種材料證據，仍需結合力學試驗與整段製程紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Cure cannot be inferred solely from a hard surface. Temperature distribution, duration and mixing affect resin reaction.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要固化反應證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for evidence of cure reaction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「固化反應證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evidence of cure reaction" is correct?
options: 只要固化反應證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
固化不是只看表面硬化，樹脂反應可能因溫度分布、時間與材料混合而不同。
optionsEn: A nominal result for evidence of cure reaction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Cure cannot be inferred solely from a hard surface.
quiz.explanation: 固化不是只看表面硬化，樹脂反應可能因溫度分布、時間與材料混合而不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 固化反應證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evidence of cure reaction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固化反應證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Evidence of cure reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「固化反應證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evidence of cure reaction", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90。
只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90.
A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 固化反應證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evidence of cure reaction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固化反應證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Evidence of cure reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。固化驗收依材料供應與設計核准規格，不採通用百分比。同時排除以下干擾原因：薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Review flexural modulus and glass-transition behaviour as well; cure acceptance follows approved material and design specifications, not a universal percentage. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接固化反應證據時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。固化驗收依材料供應與設計核准規格，不採通用百分比。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over evidence of cure reaction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Review flexural modulus and glass-transition behaviour as well; cure acceptance follows approved material and design specifications, not a universal percentage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。固化驗收依材料供應與設計核准規格，不採通用百分比。同時排除以下干擾原因：薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。
knowledge.textEn: Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Review flexural modulus and glass-transition behaviour as well; cure acceptance follows approved material and design specifications, not a universal percentage. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接固化反應證據時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。固化驗收依材料供應與設計核准規格，不採通用百分比。

Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. quiz.question: 要驗證「固化反應證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evidence of cure reaction"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。
只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation.
A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 固化反應證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evidence of cure reaction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固化反應證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Evidence of cure reaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要固化反應證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for evidence of cure reaction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。
knowledge.textEn: A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「固化反應證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evidence of cure reaction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert.
quiz.explanation: 薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期模數折減：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期模數折減」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long term modulus reduction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聚合物內襯在持續荷載下產生蠕變，短期模數不能無條件延用到長期屈曲評估。折減值受樹脂、溫度、環境及試驗時間控制，須有相符的材料證據。假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期模數折減」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour. Reduction depends on resin, temperature, environment and duration, requiring evidence applicable to the installed material. If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners. Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long term modulus reduction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長期模數折減」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long term modulus reduction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期模數折減
knowledge.text: 聚合物內襯在持續荷載下產生蠕變，短期模數不能無條件延用到長期屈曲評估。折減值受樹脂、溫度、環境及試驗時間控制，須有相符的材料證據。
knowledge.textEn: Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour. Reduction depends on resin, temperature, environment and duration, requiring evidence applicable to the installed material.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期模數折減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long term modulus reduction" is correct?
options: 聚合物內襯在持續荷載下產生蠕變，短期模數不能無條件延用到長期屈曲評估。
只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour.
A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 聚合物內襯在持續荷載下產生蠕變，短期模數不能無條件延用到長期屈曲評估。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期模數折減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期模數折減」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long term modulus reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期模數折減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long term modulus reduction", which statement holds?
options: 只要旁通儲量需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50。
只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for bypass storage demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50.

steps.title: 長期模數折減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期模數折減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long term modulus reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接長期模數折減時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over long term modulus reduction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接長期模數折減時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over long term modulus reduction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期模數折減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long term modulus reduction"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities.
quiz.explanation: 檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期模數折減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期模數折減」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long term modulus reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期模數折減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long term modulus reduction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水理容量比較」與「支管開口幾何」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic capacity comparison" and "Lateral opening geometry": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水理容量比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic capacity comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水理容量比較」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic capacity comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。滿流圓管的曼寧比值只適用坡度相同且均勻流，局部瓶頸、支管及淤積會使實際系統不同。固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水理容量比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter. A full circular-pipe Manning ratio assumes equal slope and uniform flow; bottlenecks, laterals and deposits can make system behaviour different. For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35. Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic capacity comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水理容量比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 支管開口幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral opening geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支管開口幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral opening geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。任何開口修整由合格施工與檢驗人員按核准方法執行，避免依影像猜測盲切。同時排除以下干擾原因：錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral. Qualified personnel follow approved restoration and inspection methods rather than blindly cutting from an uncertain image. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral. Qualified personnel follow approved restoration and inspection methods rather than blindly cutting from an uncertain image.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 支管開口幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral opening geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支管開口幾何」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal. steps.observation: 連結機制：錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支管開口幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要旁通儲量需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for bypass storage demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths.
quiz.explanation: 錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bypass storage demand" and "Material batch traceability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 旁通儲量需求：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「旁通儲量需求」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 施工期間旁通系統需要面對持續入流與設備中斷，儲量與抽送能力不能互相替代。簡單累積量適合辨識停機後果，實際應變仍受尖峰流量、上游容積及允許水位控制。假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旁通儲量需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary bypassing must handle continuing inflow and equipment interruptions. Storage and pumping capacity are not interchangeable. A simple accumulation estimate illustrates outage consequences, while peak flow, upstream volume and permitted levels govern the response plan. For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³. This is accumulated demand, not an allowable shutdown or evacuation time. Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bypass storage demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要旁通儲量需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 由歷史與當期流量建立尖峰情境，核對可用儲量、備援、警報與回應程序。任何切換或隔離須依業主核准方案，並確認排放路徑與周邊環境限制。同時排除以下干擾原因：將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use historical and current flow to define peak scenarios, checking usable storage, backup, alarms and response procedures. Switching or isolation follows the owner's approved plan with verified discharge routes and environmental constraints. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 旁通儲量需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bypass storage demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「旁通儲量需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要旁通儲量需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 材料批次可追溯性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Material batch traceability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料批次可追溯性」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Material batch traceability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內襯交接應連結樹脂批次、施工記錄、取樣位置與試驗結果，讓後續缺陷能回溯到特定區段。可追溯比例只是文件完整性，不能代替材料與水理驗收。假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料批次可追溯性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handover links resin batches, process records, sample positions and test results so later defects can be traced to a specific segment. A traceability fraction measures documentation completeness, not material or hydraulic acceptance. If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements. Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material batch traceability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料批次可追溯性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。 重算時請保留單位。
