steps.title: 材料批次可追溯性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material batch traceability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料批次可追溯性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Material batch traceability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。同時排除以下干擾原因：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接材料批次可追溯性時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over material batch traceability, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 材料批次可追溯性：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「材料批次可追溯性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Material batch traceability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料批次可追溯性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Material batch traceability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch.
A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地下結構陰極防蝕
summary: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 地盤改良與地下維護
subcategoryTitleEn: Ground improvement and underground maintenance

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。假設有效電壓由2V增加10%至2.2V且R固定10Ω，電流由0.20升為0.22A，增加0.02A；現地極化、含水與接觸阻抗可能改變R，故不能據此授權提高電源設定。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. Increasing assumed effective voltage from2V to2.2V by10% at fixed R=10Ω raises current from0.20 to0.22A, a0.02A increase. Field polarization, moisture and contact impedance may alter R, so this does not authorize changing supply settings. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合電流迴路」與「塗層缺陷電流需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closed current circuit" and "Current demand at coating defects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合電流迴路」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closed current circuit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。歐姆模型只說明等效迴路，電極極化與接觸阻抗會使現場偏離常數電阻。假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合電流迴路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. Supply voltage alone does not establish current reaching the protected metal. An Ohmic model describes an equivalent circuit; polarization and contact impedance can make field resistance variable. For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closed current circuit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合電流迴路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closed current circuit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉合電流迴路
knowledge.text: 陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。歐姆模型只說明等效迴路，電極極化與接觸阻抗會使現場偏離常數電阻。
knowledge.textEn: Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. Supply voltage alone does not establish current reaching the protected metal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閉合電流迴路」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closed current circuit" is correct?
options: 只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。
只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit.
A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合電流迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closed current circuit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合電流迴路」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closed current circuit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。同時排除以下干擾原因：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合電流迴路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closed current circuit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。
knowledge.textEn: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閉合電流迴路」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closed current circuit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。
只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current.
A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「塗層缺陷電流需求」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current demand at coating defects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整塗層減少與土壤接觸的面積，保護電流主要流向缺陷及裸露部位。缺陷面積比例與所需電流密度均需有證據，不能只用總金屬面積推估相同的需求。假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「塗層缺陷電流需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces. Both defect fraction and required current density need evidence rather than assuming identical demand over the entire metal surface. For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded. Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current demand at coating defects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「塗層缺陷電流需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Current demand at coating defects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求
knowledge.text: 完整塗層減少與土壤接觸的面積，保護電流主要流向缺陷及裸露部位。缺陷面積比例與所需電流密度均需有證據，不能只用總金屬面積推估相同的需求。
knowledge.textEn: Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces. Both defect fraction and required current density need evidence rather than assuming identical demand over the entire metal surface.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塗層缺陷電流需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Current demand at coating defects" is correct?

optionsEn: A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces.
quiz.explanation: 完整塗層減少與土壤接觸的面積，保護電流主要流向缺陷及裸露部位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塗層缺陷電流需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Current demand at coating defects", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A。
只要整流器輸出功率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要雜散電流電量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A.
A nominal result for rectifier output power removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for stray current charge removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塗層缺陷電流需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current demand at coating defects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。用多測點電位判斷分布，電流總量相符不能代替每個控制位置的驗證。同時排除以下干擾原因：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Multiple potential readings establish distribution; matching total current does not verify every controlling location. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接塗層缺陷電流需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。用多測點電位判斷分布，電流總量相符不能代替每個控制位置的驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over current demand at coating defects, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Multiple potential readings establish distribution; matching total current does not verify every controlling location.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塗層缺陷電流需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current demand at coating defects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塗層缺陷電流需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current demand at coating defects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要土壤視電阻率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output.
quiz.explanation: 剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「土壤視電阻率」與「犧牲陽極壽命」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Apparent soil resistivity" and "Sacrificial anode life": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 土壤視電阻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Apparent soil resistivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「土壤視電阻率」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Apparent soil resistivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土壤電阻率影響電流分布，但與含水、鹽分及分層共同變化，單一數字不能直接換成腐蝕速率。Wenner模型需均質半空間與等間距，測得結果應依幾何稱為視電阻率。等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。地下管線或接地網可改變電流路徑，使視電阻率偏離原狀土壤；若直接用此值決定陽極配置，可能形成不均勻保護而且難以解釋後續量測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「土壤視電阻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil resistivity influences current distribution but varies with moisture, salts and layering, so one value is not a corrosion rate. The Wenner model assumes a homogeneous half-space and equal spacing; field results are apparent resistivity for the measurement geometry. For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction. Buried pipes or grounding grids can distort current paths and apparent resistivity. Designing anode distribution directly from that value may create uneven protection and confusing later measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Apparent soil resistivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要土壤視電阻率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「土壤視電阻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Apparent soil resistivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 土壤電阻率影響電流分布，但與含水、鹽分及分層共同變化，單一數字不能直接換成腐蝕速率。Wenner模型需均質半空間與等間距，測得結果應依幾何稱為視電阻率。
knowledge.textEn: Soil resistivity influences current distribution but varies with moisture, salts and layering, so one value is not a corrosion rate. The Wenner model assumes a homogeneous half-space and equal spacing; field results are apparent resistivity for the measurement geometry.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要土壤視電阻率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 土壤電阻率影響電流分布，但與含水、鹽分及分層共同變化，單一數字不能直接換成腐蝕速率。

quiz.explanationEn: Soil resistivity influences current distribution but varies with moisture, salts and layering, so one value is not a corrosion rate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 土壤視電阻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Apparent soil resistivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「土壤視電阻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Apparent soil resistivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用合適電阻率儀器記錄間距、埋深、地表狀態及附近金屬，改變方向與尺度檢查一致性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record spacing, electrode depth, surface conditions and nearby metal using suitable instrumentation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 犧牲陽極壽命：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sacrificial anode life: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「犧牲陽極壽命」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sacrificial anode life” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 犧牲陽極可提供的總電量受材料質量與有效電容量限制，還要保留不能完全利用的殘餘部分。有效電容量若已包含電化學效率，不可再次乘同一效率而重複折減。假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「犧牲陽極壽命」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Available sacrificial-anode charge depends on mass and effective capacity, with a residual fraction that cannot be fully used. If effective capacity already includes electrochemical efficiency, applying that efficiency again would double count the reduction. With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years. Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sacrificial anode life” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要犧牲陽極壽命符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for sacrificial anode life removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「犧牲陽極壽命」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sacrificial anode life”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 犧牲陽極壽命

knowledge.textEn: Available sacrificial-anode charge depends on mass and effective capacity, with a residual fraction that cannot be fully used. If effective capacity already includes electrochemical efficiency, applying that efficiency again would double count the reduction.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 查驗陽極材質、電容量定義及質量證明，將電流需求的時間變化納入估算。以可追溯的檢查與量測確認消耗趨勢，不能把定電流理想壽命直接作更換保證。同時排除以下干擾原因：若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify material, capacity definition and mass certificates, accounting for demand variation over time. Traceable inspection and measurements should check consumption trends; the constant-current estimate is not a guaranteed replacement interval. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「犧牲陽極壽命」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sacrificial anode life"?
options: 查驗陽極材質、電容量定義及質量證明，將電流需求的時間變化納入估算。

steps.title: 犧牲陽極壽命：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sacrificial anode life: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「犧牲陽極壽命」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sacrificial anode life” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要犧牲陽極壽命符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for sacrificial anode life removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。
knowledge.textEn: Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Calendar-only maintenance misses abnormal current distribution or accelerated consumption.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「犧牲陽極壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sacrificial anode life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。
只要整流器輸出功率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect.
A nominal result for rectifier output power removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ageing coating can raise demand while a failed connection leaves nominal anode mass unable to protect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「整流器輸出功率」與「電阻壓降與極化」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rectifier output power" and "Ohmic drop and polarization": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 整流器輸出功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rectifier output power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「整流器輸出功率」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rectifier output power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外加電流系統的直流輸出功率和市電耗能不同，整流器及線路會有損失。功率是運行記錄之一，保護是否有效仍須看結構電位與電流分布，不能由瓦數判定。假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。輸出下降可能是電源故障，也可能是迴路電阻上升；只把旋鈕調高而未查故障，會掩蓋壞接點並使其發熱，卻不一定改善最遠測點的保護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「整流器輸出功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impressed-current DC output differs from mains energy because rectifiers and cables lose power. Output is useful operational evidence, but protection effectiveness depends on structure potentials and current distribution rather than wattage alone. For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor. Falling output may mean supply failure or rising circuit resistance. Increasing the setting without diagnosis can heat a bad connection while leaving the most remote location insufficiently protected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rectifier output power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要整流器輸出功率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for rectifier output power removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「整流器輸出功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rectifier output power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 整流器輸出功率
knowledge.text: 外加電流系統的直流輸出功率和市電耗能不同，整流器及線路會有損失。功率是運行記錄之一，保護是否有效仍須看結構電位與電流分布，不能由瓦數判定。
knowledge.textEn: Impressed-current DC output differs from mains energy because rectifiers and cables lose power. Output is useful operational evidence, but protection effectiveness depends on structure potentials and current distribution rather than wattage alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要整流器輸出功率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for rectifier output power removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「整流器輸出功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rectifier output power" is correct?
options: 只要整流器輸出功率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要電阻壓降與極化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
外加電流系統的直流輸出功率和市電耗能不同，整流器及線路會有損失。
optionsEn: A nominal result for rectifier output power removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for ohmic drop and polarization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Impressed-current DC output differs from mains energy because rectifiers and cables lose power.
quiz.explanation: 外加電流系統的直流輸出功率和市電耗能不同，整流器及線路會有損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Impressed-current DC output differs from mains energy because rectifiers and cables lose power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 整流器輸出功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rectifier output power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整流器輸出功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rectifier output power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對經校正的輸出電壓與電流，另外量測輸入耗能，保留時間及設定紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check calibrated output voltage and current, measure input energy separately and retain times and settings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「整流器輸出功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rectifier output power", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。
只要絕緣旁路電流符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要年度電量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W.
A nominal result for insulation bypass current removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for annual charge and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 整流器輸出功率：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rectifier output power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對經校正的輸出電壓與電流，另外量測輸入耗能，保留時間及設定紀錄。輸出突然變化應與土壤含水、接線與結構電位一起分析，由防蝕工程師核定調整。同時排除以下干擾原因：輸出下降可能是電源故障，也可能是迴路電阻上升；只把旋鈕調高而未查故障，會掩蓋壞接點並使其發熱，卻不一定改善最遠測點的保護。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check calibrated output voltage and current, measure input energy separately and retain times and settings. Interpret sudden changes alongside soil moisture, wiring and structure potential before a corrosion engineer approves adjustments. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Falling output may mean supply failure or rising circuit resistance. Increasing the setting without diagnosis can heat a bad connection while leaving the most remote location insufficiently protected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 電阻壓降與極化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ohmic drop and polarization: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電阻壓降與極化」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ohmic drop and polarization” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 結構對電解質的量測電位可能包含土壤中的電阻壓降，不能把通電時的讀值直接等同界面極化。參考電極種類、位置與切換時序決定量測意義，須完整記錄。若量測路徑電流I=0.20A、等效土壤路徑R=2Ω，IRdrop=0.40V；此項不是金屬極化電位，也不是可通用扣除的常數。如果參考電極太靠近陽極，局部電位梯度可能讓結果顯得保護充足；把這種讀值當金屬表面狀態，會忽略遠處缺陷處仍有腐蝕的風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電阻壓降與極化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A structure-to-electrolyte reading can include soil Ohmic drop and is not automatically the interfacial polarization. Reference-electrode type, placement and switching timing determine its meaning and must be documented. For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V. This is not metal polarization potential or a universally removable constant. An electrode close to an anode may read a strong local gradient that suggests adequate protection. Interpreting it as the metal-surface condition can miss ongoing corrosion at remote defects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ohmic drop and polarization” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要電阻壓降與極化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「電阻壓降與極化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 雜散電流電量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stray current charge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雜散電流電量」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stray current charge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雜散直流在金屬離開的位置可造成局部腐蝕，其方向與持續時間比單次瞬時值更重要。電量積分描述通過多少電荷，金屬損失還需電化學反應與電流效率。假設同方向雜散電流I=0.10A持續t=3600s，Q=It=360C；正負交替需分方向積分，不可只用帶符號淨值推估局部腐蝕。正負電流平均接近零仍可在不同位置造成金屬溶解；忽略時序會將尖峰干擾當儀器噪聲，直到局部穿孔才發現累積的腐蝕後果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雜散電流電量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stray DC can corrode metal where it leaves the structure. Direction and duration matter beyond an instantaneous reading. Integrating charge quantifies transferred electricity, while metal loss also requires reaction stoichiometry and current efficiency. For same-direction stray current I=0.10A over t=3600s, Q=It=360C. Alternating directions need separate integration; signed net charge alone cannot estimate local corrosion. Near-zero average current can still dissolve metal at different locations. Ignoring timing may dismiss interference peaks as noise until accumulated local corrosion causes perforation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stray current charge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 同步記錄管地電位、電流方向與鄰近牽引或工業運轉時序，辨別重複干擾。由相關設施的防蝕負責人協調測試，保留各方基準而不是單方面改接線。同時排除以下干擾原因：正負電流平均接近零仍可在不同位置造成金屬溶解；忽略時序會將尖峰干擾當儀器噪聲，直到局部穿孔才發現累積的腐蝕後果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for insulation bypass current removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 臨時儀器屏蔽線或支承跨接可讓原本分開的系統重新連通，造成輸出增加及相鄰設施干擾；只查主要接頭會漏掉這些不易看見的旁路。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary instrument shields or supports can reconnect isolated systems, increasing output and interference. Inspecting only the main joint can miss these less visible bypass paths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「絕緣旁路電流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Insulation bypass current" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
臨時儀器屏蔽線或支承跨接可讓原本分開的系統重新連通，造成輸出增加及相鄰設施干擾；只查主要接頭會漏掉這些不易看見的旁路。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Temporary instrument shields or supports can reconnect isolated systems, increasing output and interference.
quiz.explanation: 臨時儀器屏蔽線或支承跨接可讓原本分開的系統重新連通，造成輸出增加及相鄰設施干擾；只查主要接頭會漏掉這些不易看見的旁路。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Temporary instrument shields or supports can reconnect isolated systems, increasing output and interference. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「需求變化趨勢」與「年度電量與交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Current demand trend" and "Annual charge and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 需求變化趨勢：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current demand trend: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「需求變化趨勢」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current demand trend” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維護期電流增加可能來自塗層損傷、土壤變濕或短路，不應直接視為保護更好。趨勢判讀需要相同電位目標與可比較的環境，將需求變化和供電設定分開。假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「需求變化趨勢」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Higher operating current may reflect damaged coating, wetter soil or a short, rather than improved protection. Trend analysis needs comparable potential targets and environmental conditions, separating demand changes from deliberate supply adjustments. If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. This describes demand, not a tripling of protection effectiveness or safety. Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current demand trend” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「需求變化趨勢」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Current demand trend”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 需求變化趨勢
knowledge.text: 維護期電流增加可能來自塗層損傷、土壤變濕或短路，不應直接視為保護更好。趨勢判讀需要相同電位目標與可比較的環境，將需求變化和供電設定分開。
knowledge.textEn: Higher operating current may reflect damaged coating, wetter soil or a short, rather than improved protection. Trend analysis needs comparable potential targets and environmental conditions, separating demand changes from deliberate supply adjustments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「需求變化趨勢」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Current demand trend" is correct?
options: 維護期電流增加可能來自塗層損傷、土壤變濕或短路，不應直接視為保護更好。
只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要年度電量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Higher operating current may reflect damaged coating, wetter soil or a short, rather than improved protection.
A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for annual charge and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 維護期電流增加可能來自塗層損傷、土壤變濕或短路，不應直接視為保護更好。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher operating current may reflect damaged coating, wetter soil or a short, rather than improved protection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 需求變化趨勢：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Current demand trend: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「需求變化趨勢」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Current demand trend” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. This describes demand, not a tripling of protection effectiveness or safety. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. This describes demand, not a tripling of protection effectiveness or safety.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「需求變化趨勢」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Current demand trend", which statement holds?
options: 只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。
只要犧牲陽極壽命符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3.
A nominal result for sacrificial anode life removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 需求變化趨勢：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current demand trend: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「需求變化趨勢」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current demand trend” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。對突然變化建立有責任人的異常單，避免只重設趨勢基線。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Assign responsibility for abrupt changes rather than simply resetting the trend baseline. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接需求變化趨勢時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。對突然變化建立有責任人的異常單，避免只重設趨勢基線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over current demand trend, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Assign responsibility for abrupt changes rather than simply resetting the trend baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。對突然變化建立有責任人的異常單，避免只重設趨勢基線。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。
knowledge.textEn: Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Assign responsibility for abrupt changes rather than simply resetting the trend baseline. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接需求變化趨勢時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。對突然變化建立有責任人的異常單，避免只重設趨勢基線。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over current demand trend, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Assign responsibility for abrupt changes rather than simply resetting the trend baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「需求變化趨勢」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current demand trend"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要電阻壓降與極化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nominal result for ohmic drop and polarization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation.
quiz.explanation: 並排比較輸出、各測點電位、季節土壤狀態與維修事件，再決定是否需要塗層調查或接線檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare output, test-point potentials, seasonal ground conditions and repairs before deciding on coating or wiring investigation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 需求變化趨勢：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current demand trend: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「需求變化趨勢」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current demand trend” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。
knowledge.textEn: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Higher output may also worsen local overprotection, producing acceptable-looking readings while durability declines.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「需求變化趨勢」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current demand trend" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要年度電量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A nominal result for annual charge and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若把每次升流都當作正常老化，塗層大面積破損可能長期不被查明；增加輸出還可能加劇局部過保護，形成表面合格但耐久性下降的情境。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating every increase as normal ageing can leave extensive coating damage unexplained. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 年度電量與交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual charge and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「年度電量與交接」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual charge and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 年度累積電量支援陽極消耗與運轉比較，但缺測、停機及變動電流都會影響積分。電量不能代替有效電位紀錄，交接要連結儀表、位置、維護與異常處理的證據。假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「年度電量與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual accumulated charge supports anode-consumption and operating comparisons, but gaps, outages and changing current affect integration. Charge does not replace valid potential records; handover links instruments, locations, maintenance and resolved anomalies. For constant I=0.20A over a nonleap year of8760h, Qyear=1752Ah. This is accumulated annual charge;1752Ah/year denotes an annual rate instead. Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Annual charge and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For constant I=0.20A over a nonleap year of8760h, Qyear=1752Ah.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要年度電量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「年度電量與交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Annual charge and handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「年度電量與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 年度電量與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual charge and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年度電量與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Annual charge and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For constant I=0.20A over a nonleap year of8760h, Qyear=1752Ah. This is accumulated annual charge;1752Ah/year denotes an annual rate instead. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用原始時間序列分段積分並標記缺測，和陽極質量、有效電容量及定期電位檢測交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate the original time series by intervals and mark gaps, comparing with anode mass, effective capacity and periodic potential surveys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 年度電量與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual charge and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年度電量與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual charge and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用原始時間序列分段積分並標記缺測，和陽極質量、有效電容量及定期電位檢測交叉比較。交接需附校正、參考電極類型及警報責任，缺失由防蝕主管結案。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate the original time series by intervals and mark gaps, comparing with anode mass, effective capacity and periodic potential surveys. Handover includes calibration, electrode type and alarm ownership, with gaps closed by the corrosion lead. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over annual charge and handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate the original time series by intervals and mark gaps, comparing with anode mass, effective capacity and periodic potential surveys. Handover includes calibration, electrode type and alarm ownership, with gaps closed by the corrosion lead.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
