steps.title: 年度電量與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annual charge and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「年度電量與交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Annual charge and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss. One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One annual total cannot distinguish different corrosion risks from prolonged low current and brief high current.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要年度電量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for annual charge and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把全年最大電流乘上總時數會高估消耗，忽略停機卻可能掩蓋保護中斷；單一年度總量無法分辨長時間低電流與短暫高電流的不同腐蝕風險。

quiz.question: 在「年度電量與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

Multiplying peak current by the full year overestimates consumption, while ignoring outages conceals protection loss.

title: 壩體滲流監測
summary: 本課以以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變為主線，先用總水頭與共同基準與達西流量與梯度界定水力與構造條件，再將孔壓響應與延遲、含砂濃度與輸砂連結到基線殘差與不確定度。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence through Total head and common datum and Darcy discharge and gradient, then connects Piezometer response and lag and Suspended concentration and sediment flux to Baseline residual and uncertainty. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查總水頭與共同基準：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m；再獨立檢查達西流量與梯度：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。敏感度：相同幾何與滲透係數下，水頭差由12m增為15m，達西流量由0.0024增為0.0030m3/s，即增加25%；水頭降低仍流量上升才需另查通道變化。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 將比較同季節不同水位的導水指標並核對下游水頭實測作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Total head and common datum: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. Independently examine Darcy discharge and gradient: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. Sensitivity: with unchanged geometry and conductivity, increasing head difference from12 to15m raises Darcy discharge from0.0024 to0.0030m3/s, or25 percent; rising flow despite falling head calls for a separate pathway investigation. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Use the following independent check: Compare conductance across stage bands in one season and verify measured downstream head. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總水頭與共同基準」與「達西流量與梯度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total head and common datum" and "Darcy discharge and gradient": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總水頭與共同基準」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total head and common datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。 驗證時應將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，並辨識以下失效情境：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總水頭與共同基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient. Identify gauge versus absolute pressure and atmospheric compensation, then inspect trapped air and zero offsets; low total head does not necessarily mean low local pore pressure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total head and common datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總水頭與共同基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total head and common datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總水頭與共同基準
knowledge.text: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。
knowledge.textEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「總水頭與共同基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total head and common datum" is correct?
options: 孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比
孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。
流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
optionsEn: Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation
A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage.
Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
quiz.explanation: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總水頭與共同基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total head and common datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總水頭與共同基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total head and common datum", which statement holds?
options: 所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水
季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大
原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。
optionsEn: Every collected drainage flow is groundwater passing through the dam
Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged
Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總水頭與共同基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total head and common datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總水頭與共同基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total head and common datum"?
options: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
整體導水指標就是土樣本身的滲透係數
optionsEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Bulk hydraulic conductance equals the conductivity of a soil specimen
quiz.explanation: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總水頭與共同基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total head and common datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。診斷時應採取以下查核：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。診斷時應採取以下查核：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總水頭與共同基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total head and common datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。
流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series.
Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
quiz.explanation: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「達西流量與梯度」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Darcy discharge and gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。應先建立同水位工況的比較，再檢查非線性及地下邊界。 驗證時應以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，並辨識以下失效情境：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「達西流量與梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion. Changing pathway area or drain interception also changes measured flow; compare like stages before interpreting nonlinearity or subsurface boundaries. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Darcy discharge and gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「達西流量與梯度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Darcy discharge and gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 達西流量與梯度
knowledge.text: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。
knowledge.textEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「達西流量與梯度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Darcy discharge and gradient" is correct?
options: 流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
自由溢流率定可以不管尾水高度直接套用
穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。
optionsEn: Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
A free-flow rating remains valid regardless of tailwater elevation
Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient.
quiz.explanation: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「達西流量與梯度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Darcy discharge and gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「達西流量與梯度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Darcy discharge and gradient", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。
儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢
濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s.
A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly
The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「達西流量與梯度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Darcy discharge and gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「達西流量與梯度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Darcy discharge and gradient"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。
兩支共用電源感測器已經具備獨立備援
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands.
Two sensors sharing one power supply provide independent redundancy
quiz.explanation: 以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「達西流量與梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Darcy discharge and gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Diagnose it by the following check: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Diagnose it by the following check: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「達西流量與梯度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Darcy discharge and gradient" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
自由溢流率定可以不管尾水高度直接套用
把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A free-flow rating remains valid regardless of tailwater elevation
Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三角堰率定水深」與「集水分區水量平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "V-notch weir calibration" and "Zoned drainage water balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三角堰率定水深：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: V-notch weir calibration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「三角堰率定水深」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “V-notch weir calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量水堰藉控制斷面把上游水頭轉成流量，三角堰指數使小水頭誤差被放大。堰尖沉積、未通氣水舌及尾水淹沒都會破壞既有率定；水深必須在適當上游位置量取，不能以貼近堰口的抽降水面代替。 驗證時應以容積計時法抽驗率定曲線並攝錄水舌與尾水高度，並辨識以下失效情境：尾水淹沒時繼續套自由溢流曲線將造成系統流量誤差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三角堰率定水深」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A measuring weir converts upstream head into discharge through a controlled section, and the exponent amplifies small head errors. Deposits at the notch, an unventilated nappe or submerged tailwater invalidate calibration. Measure head at the specified upstream station rather than within the local drawdown beside the notch. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the rating by timed-volume collection and record nappe ventilation and tailwater. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying a free-flow rating during submergence creates systematic discharge error. knowledge.text: 量水堰藉控制斷面把上游水頭轉成流量，三角堰指數使小水頭誤差被放大。堰尖沉積、未通氣水舌及尾水淹沒都會破壞既有率定；水深必須在適當上游位置量取，不能以貼近堰口的抽降水面代替。

steps.title: 集水分區水量平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zoned drainage water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水分區水量平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Zoned drainage water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Steady sump: measured=18 L/s; rainfallRunoff=5 L/s; maintenance=2 L/s; inferredSeepage=18-5-2=11 L/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Steady sump: measured=18 L/s; rainfallRunoff=5 L/s; maintenance=2 L/s; inferredSeepage=18-5-2=11 L/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 集水分區水量平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zoned drainage water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水分區水量平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Zoned drainage water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。診斷時應採取以下查核：獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. Diagnose it by the following check: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every collected drainage flow is groundwater passing through the dam" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。診斷時應採取以下查核：獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水分區水量平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔壓響應與延遲」與「水溫黏度與流量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometer response and lag" and "Temperature viscosity and discharge": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔壓響應與延遲：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometer response and lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。簡化一階響應能解釋量測滯後，但不能把傳感器時間常數當成地層擴散參數。應將儀器試驗與庫水位事件分開分析，避免錯置因果時序。 驗證時應對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗，並辨識以下失效情境：堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓響應與延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic connection between the sensor and ground determines response time; low permeability or a clogged tip increases delay. A first-order response illustrates instrument lag but its time constant is not automatically a ground diffusivity. Separate sensor response testing from reservoir events before assigning a causal order to observed changes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometer response and lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：First-order step: deltaHead=4 m; tau=6 h; elapsed=12 h; observedRise=4*(1-exp(-12/6))=3.45866 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: First-order step: deltaHead=4 m; tau=6 h; elapsed=12 h; observedRise=4*(1-exp(-12/6))=3.45866 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓響應與延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometer response and lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔壓響應與延遲
knowledge.text: 感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。簡化一階響應能解釋量測滯後，但不能把傳感器時間常數當成地層擴散參數。

steps.instruction: 水的動黏度變化會影響同一孔隙結構的水力傳導，季節流量漂移不全代表材料劣化。以固定密度近似時導水率與動力黏度成反比；若介質不飽和、裂隙開度改變或水化反應發生，單一溫度修正不能恢復可比性。 驗證時應同步量測出水溫度並將同水頭的流量按黏度比正規化，並辨識以下失效情境：未補償水溫就提高警戒線可能掩蓋真正導水通道增長。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水溫黏度與流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water viscosity changes hydraulic conductivity even when pore geometry remains unchanged, so seasonal drift need not indicate deterioration. At approximately fixed density, conductivity varies inversely with dynamic viscosity. Temperature normalization cannot restore comparability if saturation, fracture aperture or chemical alteration has also changed; those require separate observations. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure outlet temperature simultaneously and normalize like-head discharge by the viscosity ratio. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Raising triggers without temperature correction can conceal genuine pathway growth. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Temperature viscosity and discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 同步量測出水溫度並將同水頭的流量按黏度比正規化。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「未補償水溫就提高警戒線可能掩蓋真正導水通道增長」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含砂濃度與輸砂」與「水頭正規化導水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Suspended concentration and sediment flux" and "Head-normalized hydraulic conductance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與輸砂：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Suspended concentration and sediment flux: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含砂濃度與輸砂」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspended concentration and sediment flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濁度是光學訊號而不是直接泥砂質量，顆粒粒徑、色澤與氣泡皆會改變率定關係。要估算輸砂需採水樣測懸浮固體濃度，再與同時流量相乘；清澈水也不能排除早期內部沖蝕，因顆粒可能在下游反濾中被攔住。 驗證時應同步採取重量法水樣與濁度訊號並記錄粒徑及流量，並辨識以下失效情境：氣泡提高濁度但沒有增加固體質量會引發錯誤輸砂警報。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含砂濃度與輸砂」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbidity is an optical signal rather than sediment mass; grain size, color and bubbles affect its calibration. Estimate sediment flux from sampled suspended concentration multiplied by simultaneous discharge. Clear water does not exclude early internal erosion because mobilized grains may remain trapped in downstream filters instead of reaching the outlet. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Pair gravimetric water samples with turbidity readings and document grain size and discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Bubbles raise turbidity without adding solid mass and can trigger false sediment alarms. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspended concentration and sediment flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含砂濃度與輸砂」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suspended concentration and sediment flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含砂濃度與輸砂
knowledge.text: 濁度是光學訊號而不是直接泥砂質量，顆粒粒徑、色澤與氣泡皆會改變率定關係。要估算輸砂需採水樣測懸浮固體濃度，再與同時流量相乘；清澈水也不能排除早期內部沖蝕，因顆粒可能在下游反濾中被攔住。
knowledge.textEn: Turbidity is an optical signal rather than sediment mass; grain size, color and bubbles affect its calibration. Estimate sediment flux from sampled suspended concentration multiplied by simultaneous discharge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量

optionsEn: The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre
Turbidity is an optical signal rather than sediment mass; grain size, color and bubbles affect its calibration.
Bulk hydraulic conductance equals the conductivity of a soil specimen
quiz.explanation: 濁度是光學訊號而不是直接泥砂質量，顆粒粒徑、色澤與氣泡皆會改變率定關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步採取重量法水樣與濁度訊號並記錄粒徑及流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair gravimetric water samples with turbidity readings and document grain size and discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head-normalized hydraulic conductance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將出流除以有效水頭差可得到整體導水指標，適合在幾何與邊界相近的工況比較。此量是流路網路的集中表現，不等於單一材料滲透係數；尾水改變、排水孔啟閉與流路重分配都能改變指標，需配合分區孔壓判讀。 驗證時應比較同季節不同水位的導水指標並核對下游水頭實測，並辨識以下失效情境：誤用固定下游水頭會在尾水升高時製造假導水變化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭正規化導水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing outflow by effective head difference gives a bulk conductance indicator for comparable boundaries. It represents a network of pathways, not an individual material conductivity. Tailwater changes, drain operation and pathway redistribution can alter the indicator without changing soil properties, so interpret it alongside zoned pore-pressure measurements. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare conductance across stage bands in one season and verify measured downstream head. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assuming fixed downstream head creates false conductance change when tailwater rises. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head-normalized hydraulic conductance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=0.009 m3/s; upstreamHead=170 m; downstreamHead=140 m; conductance=0.009/(170-140)=0.000300 m2/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.009 m3/s; upstreamHead=170 m; downstreamHead=140 m; conductance=0.009/(170-140)=0.000300 m2/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整體導水指標就是土樣本身的滲透係數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bulk hydraulic conductance equals the conductivity of a soil specimen" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭正規化導水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 水頭正規化導水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized hydraulic conductance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭正規化導水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head-normalized hydraulic conductance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤用固定下游水頭會在尾水升高時製造假導水變化。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較同季節不同水位的導水指標並核對下游水頭實測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming fixed downstream head creates false conductance change when tailwater rises. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare conductance across stage bands in one season and verify measured downstream head. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整體導水指標就是土樣本身的滲透係數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bulk hydraulic conductance equals the conductivity of a soil specimen" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「採樣時距與偵測」與「基線殘差與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling interval and detection" and "Baseline residual and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 採樣時距與偵測：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and detection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「採樣時距與偵測」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling interval and detection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 資料記錄頻率限制最早能看見事件的時間，通訊延遲則在此之外再增加反應時間。等間隔抽樣的平均等待只適用事件發生時相均勻且訊號持續存在；短脈衝可能完全漏記，因此應以失效發展時間與備援記錄規劃監測。 驗證時應以已知時間的測試訊號量測本地記錄到控制室顯示的延遲，並辨識以下失效情境：共同電源失效會使兩套共用電源的感測器同時失去證據。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「採樣時距與偵測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Logging frequency limits the earliest observable change, while communication latency adds further delay. The average wait for periodic sampling assumes a uniformly distributed event phase and a persistent signal. Brief pulses may be missed entirely; choose monitoring intervals using failure-development times and independent backup logging rather than a convenient data volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Inject a timestamped test signal and measure latency from local logging to control-room display. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A shared power failure removes evidence from both nominally redundant sensors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling interval and detection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Persistent event, uniform phase; sampleInterval=30 min; transferDelay=5 min; meanDetectionDelay=30/2+5=20 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Persistent event, uniform phase; sampleInterval=30 min; transferDelay=5 min; meanDetectionDelay=30/2+5=20 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支共用電源感測器已經具備獨立備援」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「採樣時距與偵測」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 採樣時距與偵測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and detection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「採樣時距與偵測」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling interval and detection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Persistent event, uniform phase; sampleInterval=30 min; transferDelay=5 min; meanDetectionDelay=30/2+5=20 min。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Persistent event, uniform phase; sampleInterval=30 min; transferDelay=5 min; meanDetectionDelay=30/2+5=20 min. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知時間的測試訊號量測本地記錄到控制室顯示的延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a timestamped test signal and measure latency from local logging to control-room display.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線殘差與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Baseline residual and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用同一事件重新擬合基線會把新滲流異常吸收到正常模型。
孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Refitting the baseline on the event itself absorbs a new seepage anomaly into normal behavior.
Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation
quiz.explanation: 用同一事件重新擬合基線會把新滲流異常吸收到正常模型。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Refitting the baseline on the event itself absorbs a new seepage anomaly into normal behavior. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 土石壩反濾層設計
summary: 本課以串連留土透水施工與連續性的反濾層設計為主線，先用留土粒徑與土類與透水能力與相容界定水力與構造條件，再將堆置分離與取樣、排水截面與水頭連結到變形相容與連續性。粒徑與水力算例只作篩選；反濾準則取決於被保護土分類、分散性與試驗程序。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops connecting retention permeability placement and continuity in filter design through Retention gradation and soil class and Permeability and compatibility, then connects Stockpile segregation and sampling and Drain area and hydraulic head to Deformation compatibility and continuity. Gradation and hydraulic examples are screening tools; filter criteria depend on base-soil classification dispersivity and test procedures. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查留土粒徑與土類：Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless；再獨立檢查透水能力與相容：D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless。敏感度：示意D15由0.60增至0.90mm時，對d85=0.20mm的比值由3增至4.5；這只顯示留土幾何改變，不能不分土類就以同一固定比值批准材料。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。粒徑與水力算例只作篩選；反濾準則取決於被保護土分類、分散性與試驗程序。 將封閉前拍攝管底與兩側反濾接續並核對實測包絡尺寸作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Retention gradation and soil class: Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless. Independently examine Permeability and compatibility: D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless. Sensitivity: raising illustrative D15 from0.60 to0.90mm changes the ratio to a0.20mm base d85 from3 to4.5; this illustrates retention geometry and does not authorize a universal acceptance ratio for every soil. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Gradation and hydraulic examples are screening tools; filter criteria depend on base-soil classification dispersivity and test procedures. Use the following independent check: Photograph filter continuity below and beside the conduit before closure and survey its envelope. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「留土粒徑與土類」與「透水能力與相容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Retention gradation and soil class" and "Permeability and compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 留土粒徑與土類：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Retention gradation and soil class: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「留土粒徑與土類」如何影響土石壩反濾層設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Retention gradation and soil class” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filter-zone design for embankment dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾顆粒形成的孔隙須阻止被保護土持續遷移，又要讓局部細粒重新排列而不堵死。粒徑比只是土類相關準則的一環，細粒含量與分散性會改變判斷；不可把適用清潔砂的比值直接用在分散黏土，還需考慮基土代表性及侵蝕試驗。 驗證時應核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕，並辨識以下失效情境：用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「留土粒徑與土類」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filter pores must prevent continuing migration of the protected soil while allowing limited particle rearrangement without sealing the drainage path. A grain-size ratio is only part of soil-specific criteria; fines and dispersivity change the interpretation. A criterion for clean sand cannot automatically be transferred to dispersive clay without representative sampling and erosion testing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Retention gradation and soil class” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一粒徑比可以批准所有不同土類反濾」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One grain-size ratio can approve filters for every soil class" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「留土粒徑與土類」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Retention gradation and soil class”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 留土粒徑與土類
knowledge.text: 反濾顆粒形成的孔隙須阻止被保護土持續遷移，又要讓局部細粒重新排列而不堵死。粒徑比只是土類相關準則的一環，細粒含量與分散性會改變判斷；不可把適用清潔砂的比值直接用在分散黏土，還需考慮基土代表性及侵蝕試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Filter pores must prevent continuing migration of the protected soil while allowing limited particle rearrangement without sealing the drainage path. A grain-size ratio is only part of soil-specific criteria; fines and dispersivity change the interpretation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一粒徑比可以批准所有不同土類反濾 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One grain-size ratio can approve filters for every soil class Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「留土粒徑與土類」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Retention gradation and soil class" is correct?
options: 單一粒徑比可以批准所有不同土類反濾
反濾顆粒形成的孔隙須阻止被保護土持續遷移，又要讓局部細粒重新排列而不堵死。
只要反濾材料比較粗就一定能留住基土
optionsEn: One grain-size ratio can approve filters for every soil class
Filter pores must prevent continuing migration of the protected soil while allowing limited particle rearrangement without sealing the drainage path.
A coarser filter always retains the protected base soil
quiz.explanation: 反濾顆粒形成的孔隙須阻止被保護土持續遷移，又要讓局部細粒重新排列而不堵死。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filter pores must prevent continuing migration of the protected soil while allowing limited particle rearrangement without sealing the drainage path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 留土粒徑與土類：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Retention gradation and soil class: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「留土粒徑與土類」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Retention gradation and soil class” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative D15filter=0.60 mm; d85base=0.20 mm; retentionRatio=0.60/0.20=3.00 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「留土粒徑與土類」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Retention gradation and soil class", which statement holds?

steps.title: 留土粒徑與土類：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Retention gradation and soil class: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「留土粒徑與土類」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Retention gradation and soil class” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 留土粒徑與土類：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Retention gradation and soil class: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「留土粒徑與土類」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Retention gradation and soil class” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用平均級配代替最細基土會漏掉局部留土不足。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對基土分組後的級配包絡並以指定反濾試驗檢驗持續侵蝕，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using average gradation instead of the finer base soil overlooks local retention weakness. Diagnose it by the following check: Classify the base soil, compare gradation envelopes and test continuing erosion with the specified filter procedure. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One grain-size ratio can approve filters for every soil class" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 透水能力與相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permeability and compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「透水能力與相容」如何影響土石壩反濾層設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permeability and compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filter-zone design for embankment dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾不只留住土，也須在預期滲流量下維持低水頭；粒徑較粗通常有較高導水能力，但不能犧牲留土與內部穩定性。以小粒徑比比較僅能作初步幾何指標，壓實密度、細粒堵塞與顆粒形狀對實際導水率仍需試驗量化。 驗證時應對設計密度下試體做定水頭或變水頭試驗並量測排水坡降，並辨識以下失效情境：細粒污染降低導水率後上游孔壓可能持續累積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「透水能力與相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A filter must maintain acceptable head while retaining soil. Coarser grains often improve drainage but may compromise retention or internal stability. A small-grain ratio is only a geometric screening indicator; compaction, pore clogging and grain shape influence actual conductivity and require hydraulic testing under representative placement conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Test conductivity at design density and measure the gradient needed for drainage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Fines contamination reduces conductivity and can allow upstream pore pressure to accumulate. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permeability and compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: D15filter=0.60 mm; d15base=0.030 mm; permeabilityScreenRatio=0.60/0.030=20 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要反濾材料比較粗就一定能留住基土」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A coarser filter always retains the protected base soil" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「透水能力與相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Permeability and compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 透水能力與相容

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要反濾材料比較粗就一定能留住基土 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A coarser filter always retains the protected base soil Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「透水能力與相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

界面留土合格就表示反濾自身永遠穩定
反濾不只留住土，也須在預期滲流量下維持低水頭；粒徑較粗通常有較高導水能力，但不能犧牲留土與內部穩定性。
optionsEn: A coarser filter always retains the protected base soil
Successful interface retention proves permanent internal filter stability
A filter must maintain acceptable head while retaining soil.
