steps.title: 快速速度變化與壓升機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rapid velocity change and surge mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速速度變化與壓升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rapid velocity change and surge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=1000 m/s、減速幅度Δv=1.0 m/s，壓升幅度Δp=ρaΔv=1.00 MPa；ΔH=Δp/(ρg)=101.94 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=1000 m/s and deceleration magnitude Δv=1.0 m/s. Surge magnitude Δp=ρaΔv=1.00 MPa and ΔH=Δp/(ρg)=101.94 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在壓力紀錄上標示初始值、波前到時與閥位時間軸，同時以流量資料核對速度變化的方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark initial pressure, wavefront arrival and valve-position timing on pressure records, checking the velocity-change direction against flow measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=1000 m/s、減速幅度Δv=1.0 m/s，壓升幅度Δp=ρaΔv=1.00 MPa；ΔH=Δp/(ρg)=101.94 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=1000 m/s and deceleration magnitude Δv=1.0 m/s. Surge magnitude Δp=ρaΔv=1.00 MPa and ΔH=Δp/(ρg)=101.94 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「快速速度變化與壓升機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rapid velocity change and surge mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rapid velocity change and surge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在壓力紀錄上標示初始值、波前到時與閥位時間軸，同時以流量資料核對速度變化的方向。對每一測點保留儀器頻寬與飽和範圍，確認尖峰未因濾波被削低。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark initial pressure, wavefront arrival and valve-position timing on pressure records, checking the velocity-change direction against flow measurements. Retain instrument bandwidth and saturation limits for every sensor and verify that filtering has not suppressed the recorded peaks. steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一初始水頭分別畫出正負速度擾動的第一波，標出增量與總量。再說明哪些邊界反射必須由瞬變求解器補足，保持教學估算與運轉指令分離。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw the first waves from positive and negative velocity disturbances using one initial head, distinguishing increments from totals. Identify reflections requiring a transient solver and keep the teaching estimate separate from operating instructions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將壓力增量誤當總壓力可能漏掉高初始靜壓；反過來把理想正壓升套到所有位置，又會忽視上游或高點可能出現的負壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the increment as total pressure overlooks a high initial static pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將壓力增量誤當總壓力可能漏掉高初始靜壓；反過來把理想正壓升套到所有位置，又會忽視上游或高點可能出現的負壓。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the increment as total pressure overlooks a high initial static pressure. Applying the ideal positive surge everywhere also misses low-pressure behavior at upstream locations or elevated points.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。

Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「往返時間與邊界反射」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip timing and reflections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。定水頭水庫與封閉端對壓力波具有不同反射條件，分岔還會依阻抗分配波動；把整條管線視為單一長度可能掩蓋支線的較短共振路徑。往返時間只是單一均勻管段的傳播尺度，不是任意管網的完整週期；邊界的動態特性也可能隨閥位與水位改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「往返時間與邊界反射」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back. Length and wave speed establish this round-trip scale. A constant-head reservoir and a closed end reflect pressure differently, while branches divide waves according to impedance. Representing the entire network by one length can conceal shorter resonant paths through branches. Round-trip time describes propagation along one uniform reach rather than a complete period for any network. Boundary dynamics can also change with valve position and water level. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip timing and reflections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻管長L=5000 m、波速a=1000 m/s，往返時間Tr=2L/a=10.0 s；關閥時間Tc=3 s時，Tc/Tr=0.30。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform length L=5000 m and speed a=1000 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「往返時間與邊界反射」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip timing and reflections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。定水頭水庫與封閉端對壓力波具有不同反射條件，分岔還會依阻抗分配波動；把整條管線視為單一長度可能掩蓋支線的較短共振路徑。
knowledge.textEn: The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back. Length and wave speed establish this round-trip scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification" is correct?

閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。
關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。
optionsEn: Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories.
The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back.
Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main.
quiz.explanation: 閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返時間與邊界反射」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip timing and reflections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻管長L=5000 m、波速a=1000 m/s，往返時間Tr=2L/a=10.0 s；關閥時間Tc=3 s時，Tc/Tr=0.30。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform length L=5000 m and speed a=1000 m/s. Round-trip time Tr=2L/a=10.0 s; for closure time Tc=3 s, Tc/Tr=0.30. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實際管段與連通圖建立到時表，核對水庫、盲端及支線位置，再比較多支壓力計的首波和回波。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build an arrival-time table from actual reaches and connectivity, verifying reservoirs, dead ends and branches against first and returning waves at several pressure sensors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「往返時間與邊界反射」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip timing and reflections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用實際管段與連通圖建立到時表，核對水庫、盲端及支線位置，再比較多支壓力計的首波和回波。若回波順序不符，先查閥門連通狀態，不直接調整阻尼掩蓋拓樸錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build an arrival-time table from actual reaches and connectivity, verifying reservoirs, dead ends and branches against first and returning waves at several pressure sensors. If echo ordering disagrees, investigate valve connectivity before adjusting damping to conceal a topology error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作一段水庫至閥門與一段含支線管路的時間距離圖，逐一標明反射邊界。使用到時順序辨認模型結構，再用幅值評估阻抗與損失參數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare time-distance diagrams for a reservoir-to-valve reach and a branched main, labeling every reflecting boundary. Use arrival order to assess model structure before using amplitudes to assess impedance and losses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯把開放水庫端設成封閉端會改變壓力反射符號，回波可能由抵消變成疊加；即使首波幅值正確，後續峰值仍會完全失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Modeling an open reservoir as a closed boundary changes the pressure-reflection sign and can turn cancellation into reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「關閉曲線與慢變近似」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 關閥總時間不能完整描述水錘，因為有效流通面積與閥桿位置通常不是線性關係。末段的小位移可能造成最大的流量變化，因此相同總時間的兩條關閉曲線可能有不同峰值；慢變估式適合分辨慣性尺度，不能代替真實閥特性與管線反射。下式只作簡單水庫至閥門管線、假設近似均勻減速且關閉較慢的量級比較；不保證為實際峰值上限，也不是推薦關閉時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉曲線與慢變近似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total closure duration does not fully describe water hammer because effective flow area is usually nonlinear with stem position. Small movement near closure can produce the largest flow change, giving two schedules with equal duration different peaks. A slow-change estimate helps isolate inertia but cannot replace actual valve characteristics and reflected waves. The expression is a scale comparison for a simple reservoir-to-valve main with approximately uniform deceleration and slow closure. It is not a guaranteed peak bound or a recommended closure time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m；此例Tr=10 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「關閉曲線與慢變近似」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closure shape and slow-change approximation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 關閥總時間不能完整描述水錘，因為有效流通面積與閥桿位置通常不是線性關係。末段的小位移可能造成最大的流量變化，因此相同總時間的兩條關閉曲線可能有不同峰值；慢變估式適合分辨慣性尺度，不能代替真實閥特性與管線反射。
knowledge.textEn: Total closure duration does not fully describe water hammer because effective flow area is usually nonlinear with stem position. Small movement near closure can produce the largest flow change, giving two schedules with equal duration different peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。
初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。
關閥總時間不能完整描述水錘，因為有效流通面積與閥桿位置通常不是線性關係。
optionsEn: Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main.
Initial rotational energy divided by rated power gives exact rundown time.
Total closure duration does not fully describe water hammer because effective flow area is usually nonlinear with stem position.
quiz.explanation: 關閥總時間不能完整描述水錘，因為有效流通面積與閥桿位置通常不是線性關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total closure duration does not fully describe water hammer because effective flow area is usually nonlinear with stem position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「關閉曲線與慢變近似」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m；此例Tr=10 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s². A slow-change comparison gives ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m, with Tr=10 s in this example. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取得製造商閥位與流量係數關係，將實測行程時間轉成有效開度歷程，分別重算前段及末段變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the manufacturer’s position-to-flow-coefficient relationship and convert measured travel timing into effective opening history, examining early and final portions separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m；此例Tr=10 s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s². A slow-change comparison gives ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m, with Tr=10 s in this example.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m。
調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。
每一次應力都低於降伏強度就完全沒有疲勞問題。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s².
Total vessel volume equals usable gas volume at every instant.
Every stress cycle below yield means fatigue is impossible.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m；此例Tr=10 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「關閉曲線與慢變近似」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 取得製造商閥位與流量係數關係，將實測行程時間轉成有效開度歷程，分別重算前段及末段變化。以核准的離線情境比較全線壓力包絡，檢查供水需求及機械行程限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the manufacturer’s position-to-flow-coefficient relationship and convert measured travel timing into effective opening history, examining early and final portions separately. Compare pressure envelopes in approved offline scenarios while checking supply requirements and mechanical travel constraints. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較兩條總時間相同但末段速度不同的假設閥位曲線，說明需加入哪一份流量係數資料才能計算。報告只討論敏感度，不把結果寫成現場閥門設定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare hypothetical schedules with equal duration but different final travel rates, identifying the flow-coefficient data needed for calculation. Report sensitivity without converting the outcome into field valve settings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只將整體關閉時間拉長，卻保留末段突關，仍可能產生強烈壓升；模型若把閥位直接當流量比例，會錯誤預測緩閉措施已奏效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing overall duration while retaining abrupt final closure can still create a strong surge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取得製造商閥位與流量係數關係，將實測行程時間轉成有效開度歷程，分別重算前段及末段變化。以核准的離線情境比較全線壓力包絡，檢查供水需求及機械行程限制。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the manufacturer’s position-to-flow-coefficient relationship and convert measured travel timing into effective opening history, examining early and final portions separately. Compare pressure envelopes in approved offline scenarios while checking supply requirements and mechanical travel constraints.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較兩條總時間相同但末段速度不同的假設閥位曲線，說明需加入哪一份流量係數資料才能計算。報告只討論敏感度，不把結果寫成現場閥門設定。
knowledge.textEn: Compare hypothetical schedules with equal duration but different final travel rates, identifying the flow-coefficient data needed for calculation. Report sensitivity without converting the outcome into field valve settings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
取得製造商閥位與流量係數關係，將實測行程時間轉成有效開度歷程，分別重算前段及末段變化。
水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Obtain the manufacturer’s position-to-flow-coefficient relationship and convert measured travel timing into effective opening history, examining early and final portions separately.
Water-hammer speed always equals water sound speed regardless of the wall.
quiz.explanation: 取得製造商閥位與流量係數關係，將實測行程時間轉成有效開度歷程，分別重算前段及末段變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the manufacturer’s position-to-flow-coefficient relationship and convert measured travel timing into effective opening history, examining early and final portions separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「關閉曲線與慢變近似」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只將整體關閉時間拉長，卻保留末段突關，仍可能產生強烈壓升；模型若把閥位直接當流量比例，會錯誤預測緩閉措施已奏效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing overall duration while retaining abrupt final closure can still create a strong surge. A model that equates valve position with flow fraction may incorrectly predict that a slow-closing measure is effective. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式只作簡單水庫至閥門管線、假設近似均勻減速且關閉較慢的量級比較；不保證為實際峰值上限，也不是推薦關閉時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not a guaranteed peak bound or a recommended closure time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只將整體關閉時間拉長，卻保留末段突關，仍可能產生強烈壓升；模型若把閥位直接當流量比例，會錯誤預測緩閉措施已奏效。
knowledge.textEn: Increasing overall duration while retaining abrupt final closure can still create a strong surge. A model that equates valve position with flow fraction may incorrectly predict that a slow-closing measure is effective.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。
只將整體關閉時間拉長，卻保留末段突關，仍可能產生強烈壓升；模型若把閥位直接當流量比例，會錯誤預測緩閉措施已奏效。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Initial rotational energy divided by rated power gives exact rundown time.
Increasing overall duration while retaining abrupt final closure can still create a strong surge.
quiz.explanation: 只將整體關閉時間拉長，卻保留末段突關，仍可能產生強烈壓升；模型若把閥位直接當流量比例，會錯誤預測緩閉措施已奏效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Increasing overall duration while retaining abrupt final closure can still create a strong surge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停泵慣性與能量尺度」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停電後泵組不會瞬間停止，轉子與液柱慣性共同決定轉速、流量及揚程的變化。泵可能經過零流量甚至逆流區，正常運轉的單一揚程曲線不足以表示全過程；旋轉動能只能提供初步能量尺度，不能以固定功率除法取代轉速相依的動力方程。本例把全部初始轉動能假想轉成固定水力功率，忽略效率、摩擦及揚程變化，只得到比較時間而非實際滑行停機時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停泵慣性與能量尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After power loss a pump does not stop instantaneously. Rotor and liquid-column inertia jointly determine speed, discharge and head. The machine can pass through zero flow and possibly reverse flow, beyond a single normal operating curve. Rotational energy supplies a preliminary scale, but division by fixed hydraulic power cannot replace the speed-dependent dynamic equation. This example hypothetically converts all initial rotational energy into fixed hydraulic power, omitting efficiency, friction and changing head. Its time is a comparison scale, not actual coastdown duration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設I=100 kg·m²、ω=100 rad/s，E=Iω²/2=500 kJ；若比較功率P=100 kW，E/P=5.0 s，非停泵預測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume I=100 kg·m² and ω=100 rad/s: E=Iω²/2=500 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 停電後泵組不會瞬間停止，轉子與液柱慣性共同決定轉速、流量及揚程的變化。泵可能經過零流量甚至逆流區，正常運轉的單一揚程曲線不足以表示全過程；旋轉動能只能提供初步能量尺度，不能以固定功率除法取代轉速相依的動力方程。
knowledge.textEn: After power loss a pump does not stop instantaneously. Rotor and liquid-column inertia jointly determine speed, discharge and head.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Initial rotational energy divided by rated power gives exact rundown time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 停電後泵組不會瞬間停止，轉子與液柱慣性共同決定轉速、流量及揚程的變化。
初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。
只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。
optionsEn: After power loss a pump does not stop instantaneously.
Initial rotational energy divided by rated power gives exact rundown time.
Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed.
quiz.explanation: 停電後泵組不會瞬間停止，轉子與液柱慣性共同決定轉速、流量及揚程的變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After power loss a pump does not stop instantaneously. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停泵慣性與能量尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設I=100 kg·m²、ω=100 rad/s，E=Iω²/2=500 kJ；若比較功率P=100 kW，E/P=5.0 s，非停泵預測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume I=100 kg·m² and ω=100 rad/s: E=Iω²/2=500 kJ. For comparison power P=100 kW, E/P=5.0 s, not a rundown prediction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對馬達、聯軸器與泵的等效轉動慣量，取得可用的四象限性能資料，並同步檢視歷史停泵的轉速、電力與壓力紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check equivalent inertia for the motor, coupling and pump, obtain available four-quadrant performance data, and align historical rundown speed, electrical power and pressure records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停泵慣性與能量尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對馬達、聯軸器與泵的等效轉動慣量，取得可用的四象限性能資料，並同步檢視歷史停泵的轉速、電力與壓力紀錄。量測缺乏逆流資料時，應保留模型區間而非外推正常曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check equivalent inertia for the motor, coupling and pump, obtain available four-quadrant performance data, and align historical rundown speed, electrical power and pressure records. Where reverse-flow observations are absent, retain model ranges rather than extrapolating the normal operating curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：列出停泵模型需要的慣量、性能圖與止回閥資料，指出能量估式缺少的動態耦合。以假設較大慣量比較能量尺度，另行說明為何峰值不必按比例下降。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List inertia, machine characteristics and check-valve data required for rundown modeling, identifying dynamic couplings omitted by the energy estimate. Compare a larger assumed inertia and explain why pressure peaks need not fall proportionally.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵當作停電即零流量的邊界會製造不實急停，反之忽略止回閥關閉又會漏掉逆流截斷衝擊；兩種錯誤可能在單點壓力上互相抵消。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A zero-flow boundary immediately after power loss creates an artificial stop, while omitting check-valve closure misses reverse-flow interruption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: List inertia, machine characteristics and check-valve data required for rundown modeling, identifying dynamic couplings omitted by the energy estimate. Compare a larger assumed inertia and explain why pressure peaks need not fall proportionally.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停泵慣性與能量尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵當作停電即零流量的邊界會製造不實急停，反之忽略止回閥關閉又會漏掉逆流截斷衝擊；兩種錯誤可能在單點壓力上互相抵消。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A zero-flow boundary immediately after power loss creates an artificial stop, while omitting check-valve closure misses reverse-flow interruption. These two errors can misleadingly cancel at one pressure monitoring point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例把全部初始轉動能假想轉成固定水力功率，忽略效率、摩擦及揚程變化，只得到比較時間而非實際滑行停機時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its time is a comparison scale, not actual coastdown duration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泵當作停電即零流量的邊界會製造不實急停，反之忽略止回閥關閉又會漏掉逆流截斷衝擊；兩種錯誤可能在單點壓力上互相抵消。
knowledge.textEn: A zero-flow boundary immediately after power loss creates an artificial stop, while omitting check-valve closure misses reverse-flow interruption. These two errors can misleadingly cancel at one pressure monitoring point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification" and "Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低壓與水柱分離」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low pressure and column separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高點或停泵後的低壓波可能使局部絕對壓力接近蒸氣壓，液體連續柱的單相假設因此失效。空穴形成與再閉合會改變波速、流量連續性及二次壓峰，不能讓數值解無限制下降到負絕對壓；溶解氣體析出又與純蒸氣空穴具有不同時間尺度。比較必須使用同一溫度下的絕對壓力與蒸氣壓；正的差值只代表此瞬間尚有壓力裕度，不證明所有位置都不空化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低壓與水柱分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At elevated points or after pump shutdown, a low-pressure wave can bring absolute pressure near vapor pressure and invalidate a continuous single-phase column. Cavity formation and collapse alter wave speed, continuity and secondary pressure peaks. A numerical solution must not extend without limit into negative absolute pressure, while dissolved-gas release has different time scales from pure vapor cavities. Compare absolute pressure and vapor pressure at the same temperature. A positive difference indicates a margin at that instant only, not absence of cavitation everywhere. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low pressure and column separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設局部絕對壓力pabs=30 kPa、該溫度蒸氣壓pv=2.3 kPa，裕度pabs−pv=27.7 kPa；兩者都不是表壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume local absolute pressure pabs=30 kPa and vapor pressure pv=2.3 kPa at the stated temperature.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低壓與水柱分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low pressure and column separation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證

knowledge.text: 高點或停泵後的低壓波可能使局部絕對壓力接近蒸氣壓，液體連續柱的單相假設因此失效。空穴形成與再閉合會改變波速、流量連續性及二次壓峰，不能讓數值解無限制下降到負絕對壓；溶解氣體析出又與純蒸氣空穴具有不同時間尺度。
knowledge.textEn: At elevated points or after pump shutdown, a low-pressure wave can bring absolute pressure near vapor pressure and invalidate a continuous single-phase column. Cavity formation and collapse alter wave speed, continuity and secondary pressure peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。
高點或停泵後的低壓波可能使局部絕對壓力接近蒸氣壓，液體連續柱的單相假設因此失效。
調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。
optionsEn: Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed.
At elevated points or after pump shutdown, a low-pressure wave can bring absolute pressure near vapor pressure and invalidate a continuous single-phase column.
Total vessel volume equals usable gas volume at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 高點或停泵後的低壓波可能使局部絕對壓力接近蒸氣壓，液體連續柱的單相假設因此失效。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At elevated points or after pump shutdown, a low-pressure wave can bring absolute pressure near vapor pressure and invalidate a continuous single-phase column. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低壓與水柱分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low pressure and column separation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設局部絕對壓力pabs=30 kPa、該溫度蒸氣壓pv=2.3 kPa，裕度pabs−pv=27.7 kPa；兩者都不是表壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume local absolute pressure pabs=30 kPa and vapor pressure pv=2.3 kPa at the stated temperature. The margin pabs−pv=27.7 kPa; neither value is gauge pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將高程、氣壓、液溫及壓力計零點一併整理，確認低壓量測範圍足以涵蓋預測值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assemble elevation, atmospheric pressure, liquid temperature and sensor-zero information, confirming that the instrument range covers predicted lows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低壓與水柱分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low pressure and column separation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將高程、氣壓、液溫及壓力計零點一併整理，確認低壓量測範圍足以涵蓋預測值。比較單相與適當空穴模型的最低壓和再閉合峰值，並檢查時間步長對空穴體積的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assemble elevation, atmospheric pressure, liquid temperature and sensor-zero information, confirming that the instrument range covers predicted lows. Compare minimum pressure and collapse peaks between single-phase and suitable cavity models, and examine time-step sensitivity of cavity volume. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以同一組氣壓與蒸氣壓資料把三個表壓讀值換成絕對壓，標出哪些需要兩相模型。再討論感測器低壓限幅會如何影響空穴診斷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert three gauge readings to absolute pressure using one atmospheric and vapor-pressure dataset, identifying cases needing a two-phase model. Discuss how low-pressure sensor clipping changes cavity diagnosis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以表壓直接與蒸氣壓相比會錯置空化判斷，截掉所有負表壓也會消除真實低壓歷程；錯誤的空穴閉合模型可能低估隨後更高的壓峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing gauge pressure directly with vapor pressure misclassifies cavitation, while clipping all negative gauge pressure erases real low-pressure behavior. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare minimum pressure and collapse peaks between single-phase and suitable cavity models, and examine time-step sensitivity of cavity volume.

knowledge.textEn: Convert three gauge readings to absolute pressure using one atmospheric and vapor-pressure dataset, identifying cases needing a two-phase model. Discuss how low-pressure sensor clipping changes cavity diagnosis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification"?
options: 將高程、氣壓、液溫及壓力計零點一併整理，確認低壓量測範圍足以涵蓋預測值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。
optionsEn: Assemble elevation, atmospheric pressure, liquid temperature and sensor-zero information, confirming that the instrument range covers predicted lows.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories.
quiz.explanation: 將高程、氣壓、液溫及壓力計零點一併整理，確認低壓量測範圍足以涵蓋預測值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assemble elevation, atmospheric pressure, liquid temperature and sensor-zero information, confirming that the instrument range covers predicted lows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低壓與水柱分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low pressure and column separation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以表壓直接與蒸氣壓相比會錯置空化判斷，截掉所有負表壓也會消除真實低壓歷程；錯誤的空穴閉合模型可能低估隨後更高的壓峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing gauge pressure directly with vapor pressure misclassifies cavitation, while clipping all negative gauge pressure erases real low-pressure behavior. An incorrect cavity-collapse model can underestimate the larger peak that follows. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較必須使用同一溫度下的絕對壓力與蒸氣壓；正的差值只代表此瞬間尚有壓力裕度，不證明所有位置都不空化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A positive difference indicates a margin at that instant only, not absence of cavitation everywhere.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以表壓直接與蒸氣壓相比會錯置空化判斷，截掉所有負表壓也會消除真實低壓歷程；錯誤的空穴閉合模型可能低估隨後更高的壓峰。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing gauge pressure directly with vapor pressure misclassifies cavitation, while clipping all negative gauge pressure erases real low-pressure behavior. An incorrect cavity-collapse model can underestimate the larger peak that follows.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以表壓直接與蒸氣壓相比會錯置空化判斷，截掉所有負表壓也會消除真實低壓歷程；錯誤的空穴閉合模型可能低估隨後更高的壓峰。
調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing gauge pressure directly with vapor pressure misclassifies cavitation, while clipping all negative gauge pressure erases real low-pressure behavior.
Total vessel volume equals usable gas volume at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 以表壓直接與蒸氣壓相比會錯置空化判斷，截掉所有負表壓也會消除真實低壓歷程；錯誤的空穴閉合模型可能低估隨後更高的壓峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing gauge pressure directly with vapor pressure misclassifies cavitation, while clipping all negative gauge pressure erases real low-pressure behavior. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「氣室壓縮與調壓容量」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air-vessel compression and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 氣室藉由可壓縮氣體吸收或供應水量，氣體壓力與體積沿熱力路徑變化。快速過程可能較接近絕熱，慢過程可能交換更多熱量，實際指數須依設備與時間尺度選擇；接管損失、預充狀態與水位行程也限制可用調壓量，不能只看容器總容積。多方關係必須使用絕對壓力，且本例假設氣體質量固定；未含氣體溶解、熱交換細節及接管水力損失，不構成容器選型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「氣室壓縮與調壓容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An air vessel absorbs or supplies water through compression of its gas volume. Pressure and volume evolve along a thermodynamic path: rapid events may approach adiabatic behavior, while slow events permit more heat transfer. The exponent depends on equipment and time scale, and connector losses, precharge condition and water travel constrain usable storage beyond the vessel’s gross volume. The polytropic relation uses absolute pressure and assumes constant gas mass here. It omits gas dissolution, detailed heat transfer and connecting-pipe losses and is not a vessel selection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air-vessel compression and storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p1=300 kPa絕對壓、V1=2.0 m³、V2=1.8 m³、n=1.2，p2=p1(V1/V2)^n=340.4 kPa絕對壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p1=300 kPa absolute, V1=2.0 m³, V2=1.8 m³ and n=1.2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total vessel volume equals usable gas volume at every instant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「氣室壓縮與調壓容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p1=300 kPa絕對壓、V1=2.0 m³、V2=1.8 m³、n=1.2，p2=p1(V1/V2)^n=340.4 kPa絕對壓。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p1=300 kPa absolute, V1=2.0 m³, V2=1.8 m³ and n=1.2. Then p2=p1(V1/V2)^n=340.4 kPa absolute.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p1=300 kPa絕對壓、V1=2.0 m³、V2=1.8 m³、n=1.2，p2=p1(V1/V2)^n=340.4 kPa絕對壓。
只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。
焦可夫斯基壓升就是全線的絕對最大壓力。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p1=300 kPa absolute, V1=2.0 m³, V2=1.8 m³ and n=1.2.
Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure.
The Joukowsky increment is the absolute maximum pressure everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p1=300 kPa絕對壓、V1=2.0 m³、V2=1.8 m³、n=1.2，p2=p1(V1/V2)^n=340.4 kPa絕對壓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p1=300 kPa absolute, V1=2.0 m³, V2=1.8 m³ and n=1.2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「氣室壓縮與調壓容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air-vessel compression and storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對氣室壓力、液位與溫度是否同步，查驗氣體有效容積和接管阻力的資料來源。使用不同多方指數及預充偏差重算完整壓力包絡，檢查是否觸及液位行程與設備限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check synchronization of vessel pressure, water level and temperature, verifying the basis for effective gas volume and connector resistance. Recalculate full pressure envelopes for alternative polytropic exponents and precharge deviations, examining liquid travel and equipment limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同體積變化比較等溫與較快壓縮的壓力結果，明列絕對壓力基準。畫出氣體與水各占的容積，說明維護量測如何更新模型初始狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare isothermal and faster-compression pressures for one volume change, stating the absolute-pressure basis. Draw separate gas and water volumes and explain how maintenance measurements update the model’s initial condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把表壓放入多方關係會算錯氣體剛度，未記錄氣體流失則可能高估可用緩衝；容器外形尺寸不變，實際有效氣量仍會逐步減少。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using gauge pressure in the polytropic relation miscalculates gas stiffness, and unrecorded gas loss can overstate buffering capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對氣室壓力、液位與溫度是否同步，查驗氣體有效容積和接管阻力的資料來源。使用不同多方指數及預充偏差重算完整壓力包絡，檢查是否觸及液位行程與設備限制。
knowledge.textEn: Check synchronization of vessel pressure, water level and temperature, verifying the basis for effective gas volume and connector resistance. Recalculate full pressure envelopes for alternative polytropic exponents and precharge deviations, examining liquid travel and equipment limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用相同體積變化比較等溫與較快壓縮的壓力結果，明列絕對壓力基準。畫出氣體與水各占的容積，說明維護量測如何更新模型初始狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Compare isothermal and faster-compression pressures for one volume change, stating the absolute-pressure basis. Draw separate gas and water volumes and explain how maintenance measurements update the model’s initial condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對氣室壓力、液位與溫度是否同步，查驗氣體有效容積和接管阻力的資料來源。
關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check synchronization of vessel pressure, water level and temperature, verifying the basis for effective gas volume and connector resistance.
Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main.
quiz.explanation: 核對氣室壓力、液位與溫度是否同步，查驗氣體有效容積和接管阻力的資料來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check synchronization of vessel pressure, water level and temperature, verifying the basis for effective gas volume and connector resistance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣室壓縮與調壓容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air-vessel compression and storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把表壓放入多方關係會算錯氣體剛度，未記錄氣體流失則可能高估可用緩衝；容器外形尺寸不變，實際有效氣量仍會逐步減少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using gauge pressure in the polytropic relation miscalculates gas stiffness, and unrecorded gas loss can overstate buffering capacity. The vessel’s external dimensions may stay unchanged while its effective gas volume progressively decreases. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多方關係必須使用絕對壓力，且本例假設氣體質量固定；未含氣體溶解、熱交換細節及接管水力損失，不構成容器選型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It omits gas dissolution, detailed heat transfer and connecting-pipe losses and is not a vessel selection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total vessel volume equals usable gas volume at every instant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把表壓放入多方關係會算錯氣體剛度，未記錄氣體流失則可能高估可用緩衝；容器外形尺寸不變，實際有效氣量仍會逐步減少。
knowledge.textEn: Using gauge pressure in the polytropic relation miscalculates gas stiffness, and unrecorded gas loss can overstate buffering capacity. The vessel’s external dimensions may stay unchanged while its effective gas volume progressively decreases.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
計算曲線越平滑就表示模型越準確而且越安全。
把表壓放入多方關係會算錯氣體剛度，未記錄氣體流失則可能高估可用緩衝；容器外形尺寸不變，實際有效氣量仍會逐步減少。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model.
Using gauge pressure in the polytropic relation miscalculates gas stiffness, and unrecorded gas loss can overstate buffering capacity.
quiz.explanation: 把表壓放入多方關係會算錯氣體剛度，未記錄氣體流失則可能高估可用緩衝；容器外形尺寸不變，實際有效氣量仍會逐步減少。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using gauge pressure in the polytropic relation miscalculates gas stiffness, and unrecorded gas loss can overstate buffering capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證」與「循環壓力與管殼疲勞機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Characteristic grids and numerical damping mechanism and verification" and "Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Characteristic grids and numerical damping mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「特徵線網格與數值耗散」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 特徵線方法沿壓力波傳播方向連結水頭與流量，空間和時間步長需與波速相容。為了容納不同管長而插值可能引入數值耗散，造成計算峰值變小且看似穩定；這種人工平滑不能當作物理摩阻的證據，應與實際阻尼和量測頻寬分開評估。本例僅核對單一均勻管段的Courant數；C=1不保證所有非線性邊界或空穴模型都準確，仍需網格收斂與質量守恆檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「特徵線網格與數值耗散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The method of characteristics links head and discharge along wave-propagation directions, requiring compatible spatial and temporal increments. Interpolation used to accommodate different pipe lengths can introduce numerical damping, reducing peaks and making results appear stable. Such artificial smoothing is not evidence of physical friction and must be assessed separately from real damping and measurement bandwidth. The example checks the Courant number for one uniform reach only. C=1 does not guarantee accuracy for nonlinear boundaries or cavity models, so convergence and mass balance remain necessary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.020 s、Δx=20 m，C=aΔt/Δx=1.0；若Δt減半且Δx不變，C=0.50。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a=1000 m/s, Δt=0.020 s and Δx=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「計算曲線越平滑就表示模型越準確而且越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「特徵線網格與數值耗散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Characteristic grids and numerical damping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Characteristic grids and numerical damping mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 特徵線方法沿壓力波傳播方向連結水頭與流量，空間和時間步長需與波速相容。為了容納不同管長而插值可能引入數值耗散，造成計算峰值變小且看似穩定；這種人工平滑不能當作物理摩阻的證據，應與實際阻尼和量測頻寬分開評估。
knowledge.textEn: The method of characteristics links head and discharge along wave-propagation directions, requiring compatible spatial and temporal increments. Interpolation used to accommodate different pipe lengths can introduce numerical damping, reducing peaks and making results appear stable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：計算曲線越平滑就表示模型越準確而且越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Characteristic grids and numerical damping mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 特徵線方法沿壓力波傳播方向連結水頭與流量，空間和時間步長需與波速相容。
計算曲線越平滑就表示模型越準確而且越安全。
每一次應力都低於降伏強度就完全沒有疲勞問題。
optionsEn: The method of characteristics links head and discharge along wave-propagation directions, requiring compatible spatial and temporal increments.
A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model.
Every stress cycle below yield means fatigue is impossible.
quiz.explanation: 特徵線方法沿壓力波傳播方向連結水頭與流量，空間和時間步長需與波速相容。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The method of characteristics links head and discharge along wave-propagation directions, requiring compatible spatial and temporal increments. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Characteristic grids and numerical damping mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「特徵線網格與數值耗散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.020 s、Δx=20 m，C=aΔt/Δx=1.0；若Δt減半且Δx不變，C=0.50。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a=1000 m/s, Δt=0.020 s and Δx=20 m. C=aΔt/Δx=1.0; halving Δt at fixed Δx gives C=0.50. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：至少比較兩組相容的空間時間網格，保留最大最小壓力、首波到時及總水量誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare at least two compatible space-time grids, retaining maximum and minimum pressure, first-wave arrival and total water-volume error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.020 s、Δx=20 m，C=aΔt/Δx=1.0；若Δt減半且Δx不變，C=0.50。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a=1000 m/s, Δt=0.020 s and Δx=20 m. C=aΔt/Δx=1.0; halving Δt at fixed Δx gives C=0.50.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。

steps.title: 特徵線網格與數值耗散機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 至少比較兩組相容的空間時間網格，保留最大最小壓力、首波到時及總水量誤差。若細化後峰值持續變化，先檢查插值與邊界實作，再決定是否需要更細模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare at least two compatible space-time grids, retaining maximum and minimum pressure, first-wave arrival and total water-volume error. If peaks continue changing under refinement, inspect interpolation and boundary implementation before deciding whether further resolution is needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保存同一事件在兩組網格上的壓力包絡及質量帳，以數值差而非圖形平滑度評估收斂。記錄所用插值、波速調整與邊界演算法，讓他人能重算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preserve pressure envelopes and mass ledgers for one event on two grids, judging convergence by numerical differences rather than visual smoothness. Record interpolation, wave-speed adjustment and boundary algorithms so another analyst can reproduce the calculation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：粗網格的人工耗散可能掩蓋短時壓峰，讓保護設備看似足夠；只看求解器沒有發散，不能證明尖峰或水柱分離已被解析。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Artificial damping on a coarse grid can hide short pressure peaks and make protective equipment appear sufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 粗網格的人工耗散可能掩蓋短時壓峰，讓保護設備看似足夠；只看求解器沒有發散，不能證明尖峰或水柱分離已被解析。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Artificial damping on a coarse grid can hide short pressure peaks and make protective equipment appear sufficient. The absence of solver divergence does not prove that peaks or column separation have been resolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例僅核對單一均勻管段的Courant數；C=1不保證所有非線性邊界或空穴模型都準確，仍需網格收斂與質量守恆檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: C=1 does not guarantee accuracy for nonlinear boundaries or cavity models, so convergence and mass balance remain necessary.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計算曲線越平滑就表示模型越準確而且越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 循環壓力與管殼疲勞機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環壓力與管殼疲勞」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單次極大壓力與長期重複壓力範圍控制不同的損傷問題。薄壁圓管可把壓力範圍換成名目環向應力範圍，但焊趾、腐蝕坑及支座附近會產生局部集中；疲勞評估還需循環次數、平均應力及細節分類，不能把低於降伏當作無限壽命。本式假設薄壁均勻圓管與名目膜應力，沒有給定疲勞曲線或應力集中係數，因此只算應力範圍，不預測壽命。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環壓力與管殼疲勞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single extreme pressure and repeated pressure ranges govern different damage mechanisms. A thin circular shell converts pressure range into nominal hoop-stress range, but weld toes, corrosion pits and supports introduce local concentrations. Fatigue assessment also needs cycle counts, mean stress and detail classification; stress below yield does not establish infinite service life. The expression assumes a uniform thin circular shell and nominal membrane stress. No fatigue curve or concentration factor is specified, so it calculates stress range without predicting life. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力範圍Δp=0.40 MPa、D=1.0 m、t=0.010 m，名目環應力範圍Δσ=ΔpD/(2t)=20.0 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pressure range Δp=0.40 MPa, D=1.0 m and t=0.010 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每一次應力都低於降伏強度就完全沒有疲勞問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every stress cycle below yield means fatigue is impossible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環壓力與管殼疲勞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A single extreme pressure and repeated pressure ranges govern different damage mechanisms. A thin circular shell converts pressure range into nominal hoop-stress range, but weld toes, corrosion pits and supports introduce local concentrations.
