steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將足夠取樣頻率的壓力歷程與泵閥事件紀錄對時，再依核定方法作循環計數。結合壁厚、焊接細節及局部缺陷檢查，確認名目應力能否代表疲勞關鍵位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize adequately sampled pressure histories with pump and valve event logs, then count cycles using an approved method. Combine wall thickness, weld detail and local defect inspection to determine whether nominal stress represents the fatigue-critical location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以同一壓力範圍比較原始與減薄管壁的名目應力，再列出仍缺少的疲勞資料。將操作事件頻率與檢查位置連結，避免只按單一最大壓力安排維護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare nominal stress for original and thinned walls at one pressure range, then list missing fatigue information. Link event frequency to inspection locations instead of planning maintenance around a single maximum pressure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將足夠取樣頻率的壓力歷程與泵閥事件紀錄對時，再依核定方法作循環計數。結合壁厚、焊接細節及局部缺陷檢查，確認名目應力能否代表疲勞關鍵位置。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize adequately sampled pressure histories with pump and valve event logs, then count cycles using an approved method. Combine wall thickness, weld detail and local defect inspection to determine whether nominal stress represents the fatigue-critical location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以同一壓力範圍比較原始與減薄管壁的名目應力，再列出仍缺少的疲勞資料。將操作事件頻率與檢查位置連結，避免只按單一最大壓力安排維護。
knowledge.textEn: Compare nominal stress for original and thinned walls at one pressure range, then list missing fatigue information. Link event frequency to inspection locations instead of planning maintenance around a single maximum pressure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「循環壓力與管殼疲勞機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue mechanism and verification"?
options: 將足夠取樣頻率的壓力歷程與泵閥事件紀錄對時，再依核定方法作循環計數。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。
optionsEn: Synchronize adequately sampled pressure histories with pump and valve event logs, then count cycles using an approved method.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed.
quiz.explanation: 將足夠取樣頻率的壓力歷程與泵閥事件紀錄對時，再依核定方法作循環計數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize adequately sampled pressure histories with pump and valve event logs, then count cycles using an approved method. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 循環壓力與管殼疲勞機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環壓力與管殼疲勞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage. Missing frequent smaller events also makes cumulative deterioration appear to be an isolated failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本式假設薄壁均勻圓管與名目膜應力，沒有給定疲勞曲線或應力集中係數，因此只算應力範圍，不預測壽命。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: No fatigue curve or concentration factor is specified, so it calculates stress range without predicting life.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一次應力都低於降伏強度就完全沒有疲勞問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every stress cycle below yield means fatigue is impossible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage. Missing frequent smaller events also makes cumulative deterioration appear to be an isolated failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環壓力與管殼疲勞機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。
只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage.
Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure.
quiz.explanation: 用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 海堤越波模型試驗
summary: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。假設長度比由25增10%為27.5，固定原型週期10s時模型週期由2降為1.9069s，下降約4.65%；不能把時間也直接縮小10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Increasing length ratio from25 to27.5 by10% at fixed prototype period10s changes model period from2 to1.9069s, about4.65% lower; time does not change by10%. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「弗勞德縮尺條件」與「單寬流量換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Froude scaling conditions" and "Unit-discharge conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「弗勞德縮尺條件」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Froude scaling conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。 假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 空氣可壓縮性與液滴破裂對縮尺的反應不同，須分開選擇可外推的觀察量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弗勞德縮尺條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Air compressibility and droplet breakup respond differently to scaling, requiring separate decisions about which observations can be extrapolated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude scaling conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「弗勞德縮尺條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Froude scaling conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件
knowledge.text: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。
knowledge.textEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「弗勞德縮尺條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Froude scaling conditions" is correct?
options: 長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。
單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
optionsEn: Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length.
Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
quiz.explanation: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「弗勞德縮尺條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Froude scaling conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「弗勞德縮尺條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Froude scaling conditions", which statement holds?
options: 最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「弗勞德縮尺條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Froude scaling conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。另列模型最小水深與最大流速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. Accurate geometry cannot eliminate that scale effect, and multiplying the result does not restore the missing physics. steps.title: 單寬流量換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit-discharge conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單寬流量換算」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit-discharge conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。重力相似下它按長度比的二分之三次方縮放，先辨清是否已除試驗寬度，才能避免額外乘一次長度比例造成嚴重誤差。 假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單寬流量換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power. Determine whether the measured quantity has already been divided by width before applying a second width conversion. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit-discharge conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單寬流量換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unit-discharge conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。
optionsEn: Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall.

steps.title: 單寬流量換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit-discharge conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單寬流量換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unit-discharge conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.instructionEn: Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units. Reconstruct total collected-section flow from the unit-width result. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單寬流量換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

quiz.explanation: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 單寬流量換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unit-discharge conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單寬流量換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unit-discharge conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Plausible-looking plots may carry the unit error directly into drainage estimates unless the original dimensions remain visible. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。

A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading.

quiz.explanationEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水控制體積」與「不規則波能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Collection control volume" and "Irregular-wave energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水控制體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Collection control volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水控制體積」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Collection control volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。側漏、濺出、槽內滯留與試驗結束後延遲排水都會破壞收支；控制體積及起訖時刻應先定義，再討論平均越波量。 假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。 計量解析度在低越波情境尤其重要，小讀值可能與容器零點漂移相當。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水控制體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. Side leakage, splash loss, storage and delayed drainage disrupt the balance. Define the control volume and start/end times before interpreting the measurement as mean overtopping discharge. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance. Meter resolution becomes especially important at low overtopping, where the collected increment may resemble tank zero drift. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Collection control volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水控制體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Collection control volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水控制體積

knowledge.textEn: A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. Side leakage, splash loss, storage and delayed drainage disrupt the balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水控制體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Collection control volume" is correct?

最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。

A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.

steps.title: 集水控制體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Collection control volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水控制體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Collection control volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水控制體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水控制體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Collection control volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水控制體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。以另一種流量或重量量測交叉檢查，保留零越波與低於檢出限的區別。用空白試驗量化容器零點漂移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits. Quantify collector zero drift through a blank test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：狹窄收集槽可能漏掉斜向越波，餘水又可能被算到下一組試驗；這兩種偏差可互相抵銷，使平均值看似穩定，卻無法支持不同斷面的可靠比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。頻帶截取、漂移去除和量測位置會改變零階譜矩，需記清處理方法，才能把造波設定與入射波條件對上。 假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。 譜矩是波面變異的積分描述，頻率單位與積分間距必須在程式中一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不規則波能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description. One maximum wave cannot replace a representative height for the sequence. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative crest freeboard” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。比較試驗時必須區分堤頂變化和靜水面變化，兩者在幾何上可能等效，但對前灘水深與破波位置的影響不同。 假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。 有效出水高的分母應使用結構前指定位置的入射波，而非任意遠端設定值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相對出水高度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overtopping responds strongly to crest level relative to still water. Tide, surge and datum bias alter effective freeboard. Crest adjustment and water-level change can produce the same nominal freeboard while changing foreshore depth and breaking location differently, so the complete geometry must be retained. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40. Relative freeboard should use incident waves at the specified structure location rather than an arbitrary distant generator setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Relative crest freeboard” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative crest freeboard” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 相對出水高度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative crest freeboard: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相對出水高度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative crest freeboard” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。列出水位修正前後的前灘水深。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime. List foreshore depths before and after each level correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。

steps.title: 相對出水高度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative crest freeboard: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相對出水高度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative crest freeboard” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. The resulting discharge change may be mistaken for an improved wall geometry, and checking crest dimensions alone will not reveal the cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：有效出水高的分母應使用結構前指定位置的入射波，而非任意遠端設定值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Relative freeboard should use incident waves at the specified structure location rather than an arbitrary distant generator setting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相對出水高度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard.
quiz.explanation: 模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.instructionEn: Reflected and incident waves create spatial interference, so a single gauge may sit near a node or antinode. Appropriate gauge geometry and separation are needed to recover incident conditions. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16. Squaring amplitudes for energy additionally assumes matched propagation medium and group velocity for incident and reflected components. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Incident-reflected wave separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 入射反射分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Incident-reflected wave separation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入射反射分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Incident-reflected wave separation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。用多組距離重算結果並記錄無法可靠分離的頻帶，避免只報一個漂亮係數。對分離後波列重建原始量測訊號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient. Reconstruct measured signals from the separated wave components. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。用多組距離重算結果並記錄無法可靠分離的頻帶，避免只報一個漂亮係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 入射反射分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Incident-reflected wave separation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入射反射分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Incident-reflected wave separation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Normalizing discharge with the resulting wrong incident height compounds the error across two analysis stages, even when both outputs appear smoothly varying. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量比例的平方關係還假設入射和反射有相同的傳播介質與群速。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squaring amplitudes for energy additionally assumes matched propagation medium and group velocity for incident and reflected components.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。
knowledge.textEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Normalizing discharge with the resulting wrong incident height compounds the error across two analysis stages, even when both outputs appear smoothly varying.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
optionsEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
quiz.explanation: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣頻帶配置」與「堤頂水舌流態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling bandwidth selection" and "Crest-flow regime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣頻帶配置：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling bandwidth selection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣頻帶配置」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling bandwidth selection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。取樣前的類比濾波與感測器自身頻率響應同樣重要，事後加密插值只能增加點數，無法回復已混疊或漏掉的訊號。 假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。 感測器的固有頻率和裝置共振同樣限制有效頻帶，不能僅查擷取器規格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣頻帶配置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. Sampling sufficient for the main wave period may miss brief pressure peaks. Analog filtering and sensor response matter before digitization; interpolating afterward increases sample count without recovering aliased or absent information. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks. Sensor natural frequency and rig resonance also limit useful bandwidth, so acquisition specifications alone are insufficient evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling bandwidth selection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣頻帶配置」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling bandwidth selection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 取樣頻帶配置
knowledge.text: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。取樣前的類比濾波與感測器自身頻率響應同樣重要，事後加密插值只能增加點數，無法回復已混疊或漏掉的訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. Sampling sufficient for the main wave period may miss brief pressure peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「取樣頻帶配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sampling bandwidth selection" is correct?
options: 每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。
弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。
optionsEn: Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales.
A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
quiz.explanation: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 取樣頻帶配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling bandwidth selection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣頻帶配置」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling bandwidth selection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「取樣頻帶配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sampling bandwidth selection", which statement holds?

Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。平滑後的波形不等於可信波形，將其當結構設計荷載前仍須確認頻率響應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crest-flow regime” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨堤水舌具有局部水深與速度，平均單寬流量無法唯一決定兩者。弗勞德數可比較慣性與重力尺度，但不含人員失衡、漂浮物及脈動衝擊；同一平均越波量仍可能對應很不同的瞬間流況。 假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。 水舌前緣可能近似乾濕交界，局部水深接近零時此比值會很敏感。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堤頂水舌流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A crest water tongue has local depth and velocity that mean unit discharge cannot uniquely determine. The Froude number compares inertia with gravity but excludes pedestrian instability, debris and impulsive loading. Equal mean overtopping can therefore conceal very different instantaneous flow regimes at the crest. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision. The tongue front approaches a wet-dry boundary, making the ratio highly sensitive when local depth approaches zero. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crest-flow regime” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
