options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。
水深與速度不同步會產生根本未發生的極端組合，含氣又可能讓讀值失真。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
Unsynchronized depth and velocity create extreme combinations that never occurred, while air distorts measurements.
quiz.explanation: 水深與速度不同步會產生根本未發生的極端組合，含氣又可能讓讀值失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized depth and velocity create extreme combinations that never occurred, while air distorts measurements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重複試驗變異」與「局部荷載與平均量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Repeated-test variability" and "Local load versus mean flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複試驗變異」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated-test variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。重複試驗應涵蓋波列變異，而不只是重讀同一段資料；平均值的不確定度也不等於單次事件分散程度。 假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。 獨立性涉及實際波列而非檔案數量，系統校準偏差也不會隨重複次數消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複試驗變異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. Repeats should sample sequence variability rather than reread identical data. Uncertainty of the mean differs from the spread of individual events or test outcomes. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented. Independence concerns the physical realization rather than file count, and shared calibration bias does not vanish through repetition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated-test variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複試驗變異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeated-test variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複試驗變異
knowledge.text: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。重複試驗應涵蓋波列變異，而不只是重讀同一段資料；平均值的不確定度也不等於單次事件分散程度。
knowledge.textEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. Repeats should sample sequence variability rather than reread identical data.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複試驗變異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeated-test variability" is correct?
options: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。
重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。
平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
optionsEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima.
Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
quiz.explanation: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複試驗變異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated-test variability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複試驗變異」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repeated-test variability", which statement holds?
options: 單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
optionsEn: Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複試驗變異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated-test variability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。分開列出隨機變異與共同校準誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty. Separate random variability from shared calibration uncertainty explicitly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。分開列出隨機變異與共同校準誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty. Separate random variability from shared calibration uncertainty explicitly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。
knowledge.textEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複試驗變異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeated-test variability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately.
quiz.explanation: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複試驗變異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated-test variability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Removing a high-discharge realization further distorts the tail behavior that matters for the engineering interpretation of unusually severe events. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：獨立性涉及實際波列而非檔案數量，系統校準偏差也不會隨重複次數消失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Independence concerns the physical realization rather than file count, and shared calibration bias does not vanish through repetition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Removing a high-discharge realization further distorts the tail behavior that matters for the engineering interpretation of unusually severe events.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複試驗變異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repeated-test variability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
optionsEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
quiz.explanation: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部荷載與平均量」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local load versus mean flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。力、壓力和受力面積必須區分，壓力感測器的空間平均也會抹去小範圍峰值；不能由流量合格推論所有附屬構件合格。 假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。 峰值持續時間決定荷載衝量，結構反應也受自身頻率與阻尼控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部荷載與平均量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. Distinguish force, pressure and loaded area; spatial averaging by a pressure sensor also smooths small peaks. Passing a discharge criterion does not qualify every secondary component. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak. Peak duration controls load impulse, while the structural response additionally depends on its natural frequencies and damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local load versus mean flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部荷載與平均量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local load versus mean flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部荷載與平均量
knowledge.text: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。力、壓力和受力面積必須區分，壓力感測器的空間平均也會抹去小範圍峰值；不能由流量合格推論所有附屬構件合格。
knowledge.textEn: Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. Distinguish force, pressure and loaded area; spatial averaging by a pressure sensor also smooths small peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部荷載與平均量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local load versus mean flow" is correct?
options: 平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。
長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
optionsEn: Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact.
Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
quiz.explanation: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部荷載與平均量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local load versus mean flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「局部荷載與平均量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local load versus mean flow", which statement holds?
options: 收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部荷載與平均量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local load versus mean flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。另外積分時間歷程取得荷載衝量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions. Integrate the force history separately to obtain impulse. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。另外積分時間歷程取得荷載衝量。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions. Integrate the force history separately to obtain impulse.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部荷載與平均量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local load versus mean flow"?
options: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
optionsEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
quiz.explanation: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部荷載與平均量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local load versus mean flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。若只存最大數字而不存時間歷程，便無法分辨水力作用與儀器反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Retaining only a maximum value prevents separation of the hydraulic event from the instrument response that followed it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：峰值持續時間決定荷載衝量，結構反應也受自身頻率與阻尼控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Peak duration controls load impulse, while the structural response additionally depends on its natural frequencies and damping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。若只存最大數字而不存時間歷程，便無法分辨水力作用與儀器反應。
knowledge.textEn: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Retaining only a maximum value prevents separation of the hydraulic event from the instrument response that followed it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部荷載與平均量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local load versus mean flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。
長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks.
Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
quiz.explanation: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 拋石防波堤施工
summary: 連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。假設排水體積由2增10%至2.2m³、兩種密度固定，水下有效重量由31.8825增至35.07075kN；此線性增加不代表波浪穩定能力必定增加10%，因形狀與接觸可能改變。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Increasing displaced volume from2 to2.2m³ by10% at fixed densities changes effective weight from31.8825 to35.07075kN. Wave stability does not necessarily improve by10%, because shape and contact can change. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水下有效重量」與「無因次穩定指標」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Submerged effective weight" and "Dimensionless stability indicator": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水下有效重量」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Submerged effective weight” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。 假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 體積量測應明確說明是否包含可進水開口孔隙，否則排水體積與材料密度不相容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水下有效重量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Volume measurement must state whether water-accessible pores are included; otherwise displaced volume and the selected material density are inconsistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Submerged effective weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

knowledge.title: 水下有效重量
knowledge.text: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。
knowledge.textEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水下有效重量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Submerged effective weight" is correct?
options: 同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
optionsEn: Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水下有效重量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水下有效重量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Submerged effective weight", which statement holds?

標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水下有效重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submerged effective weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。分別核對實體、外包與堆積體積定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average. Check solid, envelope and stockpile volume definitions separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水下有效重量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Submerged effective weight"?
options: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。

steps.title: 水下有效重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水下有效重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Submerged effective weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A plausible average can conceal weak porous pieces and systematically overestimate underwater resistance throughout the placed layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「水下有效重量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.instruction: 護面與堤心孔隙影響水流穿透、壓力釋放與能量耗散，孔隙率卻不是越大越好。級配、形狀和安放方式決定連通性；相同總孔隙體積可能形成截然不同的通道與局部流速。 假設堆體100m³內石料實體60m³，孔隙率n=(100−60)/100=0.40；孔隙比e=40/60=0.667，兩者不同。 層間細料遷移可改變連通孔隙而不顯著改變總孔隙率，需看內部壓力反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堆積孔隙與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Migration between layers can change connected voids without much change in total porosity, requiring attention to internal pressure response. steps.title: 坡面幾何放樣：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「坡面幾何放樣」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slope geometry setting-out” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下坡面放樣要區分垂直高度、水平投影與斜面長度，測深資料還需回到共同高程基準。邊坡外形控制材料量和護面連續性，名義坡比正確不表示坡腳與轉折位置都已符合實際斷面。 假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。 斜面護面面積與水平投影面積不同，材料覆蓋密度的分母需跟著定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡面幾何放樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underwater setting-out distinguishes vertical height, horizontal run and slope length while referencing soundings to one datum. Profile geometry controls material quantity and armour continuity; the nominal slope ratio alone does not confirm toe or transition locations. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. Horizontal run is20m and slope length√(10²+20²)=22.36m, not20m. Armoured slope area differs from its horizontal projection, and the denominator used for coverage density must follow that definition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slope geometry setting-out” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡面幾何放樣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slope geometry setting-out”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.explanation: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡面幾何放樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slope geometry setting-out: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡面幾何放樣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slope geometry setting-out” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Excess material higher up can hide a deficient toe, so equal average cross-sectional area does not prove continuous local support. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斜面護面面積與水平投影面積不同，材料覆蓋密度的分母需跟著定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Armoured slope area differs from its horizontal projection, and the denominator used for coverage density must follow that definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Excess material higher up can hide a deficient toe, so equal average cross-sectional area does not prove continuous local support.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡面幾何放樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slope geometry setting-out" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。
任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement.
A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
quiz.explanation: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反濾相容判讀」與「標稱石徑與形狀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Filter compatibility interpretation" and "Nominal diameter and shape": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反濾相容判讀」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter compatibility interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。粒徑比只是選用準則中的一部分，基土是否分散、級配是否間斷以及波浪反向流都會影響可用性。 假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。 土工織物還涉及接縫與穿刺，不能套用顆粒反濾的尺寸比便宣告等效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反濾相容判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. Grain-size ratios are only part of a selected criterion; dispersive soil, gap grading and reversing wave flow can change applicability substantially. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion. Geotextiles introduce seam and puncture behavior and cannot be declared equivalent merely by applying a granular-filter size ratio. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter compatibility interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反濾相容判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter compatibility interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反濾相容判讀
knowledge.text: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。粒徑比只是選用準則中的一部分，基土是否分散、級配是否間斷以及波浪反向流都會影響可用性。
knowledge.textEn: Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. Grain-size ratios are only part of a selected criterion; dispersive soil, gap grading and reversing wave flow can change applicability substantially.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反濾相容判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filter compatibility interpretation" is correct?
options: 任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。
optionsEn: A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives.
quiz.explanation: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反濾相容判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter compatibility interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反濾相容判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter compatibility interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。
無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反濾相容判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter compatibility interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。分別標示顆粒層與織物介面缺陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition. Map granular-layer and geotextile-interface defects separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只挑一個粒徑比合格會漏掉基土被沖走或排水受阻的另一端風險；施工分離造成局部級配改變時，料場檢驗合格也不能證明現地整層有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Passing one grain-size ratio can miss either base-material loss or blocked drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「反濾相容判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.explanation: 只挑一個粒徑比合格會漏掉基土被沖走或排水受阻的另一端風險；施工分離造成局部級配改變時，料場檢驗合格也不能證明現地整層有效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Passing one grain-size ratio can miss either base-material loss or blocked drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 標稱石徑與形狀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal diameter and shape: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「標稱石徑與形狀」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal diameter and shape” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 標稱石徑是由石塊體積換算的立方體尺度，不是最長邊或篩孔尺寸。扁長石可能有相同質量卻較容易受力翻轉，故尺寸換算需和形狀、裂隙及安放接觸一起判讀。 假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。 以立方體代表尺寸保留體積而不保留所有投影面，受力仍需實際幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「標稱石徑與形狀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal diameter is the cube-root volume scale, not the longest axis or sieve opening. Slender stones of equal mass may rotate differently under loading, so conversion must be interpreted with shape, fractures and contact arrangement rather than as a complete stability description. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension. The equivalent cube preserves volume without preserving every projected face, so load assessment still requires the actual exposed geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal diameter and shape” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「標稱石徑與形狀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal diameter and shape”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 標稱石徑與形狀
knowledge.text: 標稱石徑是由石塊體積換算的立方體尺度，不是最長邊或篩孔尺寸。扁長石可能有相同質量卻較容易受力翻轉，故尺寸換算需和形狀、裂隙及安放接觸一起判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal diameter is the cube-root volume scale, not the longest axis or sieve opening. Slender stones of equal mass may rotate differently under loading, so conversion must be interpreted with shape, fractures and contact arrangement rather than as a complete stability description.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「標稱石徑與形狀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nominal diameter and shape" is correct?
options: 標稱石徑是由石塊體積換算的立方體尺度，不是最長邊或篩孔尺寸。
標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Nominal diameter is the cube-root volume scale, not the longest axis or sieve opening.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.
quiz.explanation: 標稱石徑是由石塊體積換算的立方體尺度，不是最長邊或篩孔尺寸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 標稱石徑與形狀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal diameter and shape: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「標稱石徑與形狀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal diameter and shape” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure representative mass, three axes and fractures together, retaining shape data after converting nominal diameter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「標稱石徑與形狀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal diameter and shape", which statement holds?
options: 兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.

steps.title: 標稱石徑與形狀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nominal diameter and shape: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「標稱石徑與形狀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nominal diameter and shape” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。比較合格級配內的扁長比例，並檢查安放後接觸是否符合設計假設。核對最長與最短主軸的比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure representative mass, three axes and fractures together, retaining shape data after converting nominal diameter. Compare slenderness within the accepted grading and check whether installed contacts match the intended arrangement. Check the ratio of longest to shortest principal dimensions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。比較合格級配內的扁長比例，並檢查安放後接觸是否符合設計假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure representative mass, three axes and fractures together, retaining shape data after converting nominal diameter. Compare slenderness within the accepted grading and check whether installed contacts match the intended arrangement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按噸數驗收可能把扁薄裂石當成等效方塊，吊運和波浪作用下的破碎風險因而被忽略；石塊破裂後級配與孔隙也會一併改變而影響內部排水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mass-only acceptance can treat thin fractured pieces as equivalent cubes and overlook breakage during lifting or waves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Compare slenderness within the accepted grading and check whether installed contacts match the intended arrangement. Check the ratio of longest to shortest principal dimensions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「標稱石徑與形狀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Nominal diameter and shape"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。

Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
Measure representative mass, three axes and fractures together, retaining shape data after converting nominal diameter.

steps.title: 標稱石徑與形狀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nominal diameter and shape: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「標稱石徑與形狀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nominal diameter and shape” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按噸數驗收可能把扁薄裂石當成等效方塊，吊運和波浪作用下的破碎風險因而被忽略；石塊破裂後級配與孔隙也會一併改變而影響內部排水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mass-only acceptance can treat thin fractured pieces as equivalent cubes and overlook breakage during lifting or waves. Fragmentation then changes grading and voids as well as the original external armour geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以立方體代表尺寸保留體積而不保留所有投影面，受力仍需實際幾何。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The equivalent cube preserves volume without preserving every projected face, so load assessment still requires the actual exposed geometry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按噸數驗收可能把扁薄裂石當成等效方塊，吊運和波浪作用下的破碎風險因而被忽略；石塊破裂後級配與孔隙也會一併改變而影響內部排水。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「標稱石徑與形狀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Mass-only acceptance can treat thin fractured pieces as equivalent cubes and overlook breakage during lifting or waves.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「流速造成阻力」與「基床沉陷與層厚」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Current-induced drag" and "Foundation settlement and thickness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 流速造成阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current-induced drag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「流速造成阻力」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current-induced drag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波浪軌道流與潮流會對外露石塊產生阻力，受力取決於瞬時相對速度及投影面積。簡化定常阻力式不含加速度慣性、遮蔽與紊流尖峰，不能把單一算值直接當作石塊的完整設計荷載。 假設ρ=1025kg/m³、Cd=1、投影A=2m²、定常v=2m/s，F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN。 流向反轉會改變有效投影與接觸受力，波浪往復作用不能等同單向定常流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流速造成阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave orbital motion and currents impose drag according to instantaneous relative velocity and projected area. A steady drag estimate omits acceleration forces, sheltering and turbulent peaks, so one calculated value is not the complete design action on an exposed stone. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN. Flow reversal changes exposed projection and contact loading, so oscillatory waves cannot be represented as one steady unidirectional current. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current-induced drag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流速造成阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Current-induced drag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 流速造成阻力
knowledge.text: 波浪軌道流與潮流會對外露石塊產生阻力，受力取決於瞬時相對速度及投影面積。簡化定常阻力式不含加速度慣性、遮蔽與紊流尖峰，不能把單一算值直接當作石塊的完整設計荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Wave orbital motion and currents impose drag according to instantaneous relative velocity and projected area. A steady drag estimate omits acceleration forces, sheltering and turbulent peaks, so one calculated value is not the complete design action on an exposed stone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「流速造成阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Current-induced drag" is correct?
options: 流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。
波浪軌道流與潮流會對外露石塊產生阻力，受力取決於瞬時相對速度及投影面積。
堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。
optionsEn: A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.
Wave orbital motion and currents impose drag according to instantaneous relative velocity and projected area.
Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
quiz.explanation: 波浪軌道流與潮流會對外露石塊產生阻力，受力取決於瞬時相對速度及投影面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wave orbital motion and currents impose drag according to instantaneous relative velocity and projected area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 流速造成阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Current-induced drag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流速造成阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Current-induced drag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設ρ=1025kg/m³、Cd=1、投影A=2m²、定常v=2m/s，F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「流速造成阻力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Current-induced drag", which statement holds?
options: 無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 流速造成阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current-induced drag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流速造成阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current-induced drag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。用局部速度量測或水工模型檢查遮蔽差異，保留峰值和平均值的分別。對兩個主要流向分別畫投影面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term. Check sheltering through local velocity measurements or hydraulic models and keep peak and mean values distinct. Draw projected areas separately for both principal flow directions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。用局部速度量測或水工模型檢查遮蔽差異，保留峰值和平均值的分別。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term. Check sheltering through local velocity measurements or hydraulic models and keep peak and mean values distinct.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：速度若用平均值代替瞬間峰值，平方關係會放大低估；石塊移動後暴露面積又可能增大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing instantaneous speed with its mean can strongly understate squared-velocity loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term. Check sheltering through local velocity measurements or hydraulic models and keep peak and mean values distinct. Draw projected areas separately for both principal flow directions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。用局部速度量測或水工模型檢查遮蔽差異，保留峰值和平均值的分別。
