quiz.question: 要驗證「流速造成阻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current-induced drag"?
options: 定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。
optionsEn: Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 流速造成阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current-induced drag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流速造成阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current-induced drag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 速度若用平均值代替瞬間峰值，平方關係會放大低估；石塊移動後暴露面積又可能增大。固定幾何的簡式因而無法描述持續移動與鄰石失穩的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing instantaneous speed with its mean can strongly understate squared-velocity loading. Movement may expose additional area, so a fixed-geometry estimate cannot represent progressive displacement and the resulting loss of neighboring support. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：流向反轉會改變有效投影與接觸受力，波浪往復作用不能等同單向定常流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Flow reversal changes exposed projection and contact loading, so oscillatory waves cannot be represented as one steady unidirectional current.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 速度若用平均值代替瞬間峰值，平方關係會放大低估；石塊移動後暴露面積又可能增大。固定幾何的簡式因而無法描述持續移動與鄰石失穩的連鎖反應。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing instantaneous speed with its mean can strongly understate squared-velocity loading. Movement may expose additional area, so a fixed-geometry estimate cannot represent progressive displacement and the resulting loss of neighboring support.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「流速造成阻力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current-induced drag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
速度若用平均值代替瞬間峰值，平方關係會放大低估；石塊移動後暴露面積又可能增大。
堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Replacing instantaneous speed with its mean can strongly understate squared-velocity loading.
Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
quiz.explanation: 速度若用平均值代替瞬間峰值，平方關係會放大低估；石塊移動後暴露面積又可能增大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing instantaneous speed with its mean can strongly understate squared-velocity loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基床沉陷與層厚：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Foundation settlement and thickness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基床沉陷與層厚」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foundation settlement and thickness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋石堤的基床變形會改變坡腳與堤頂高程，也會重新分配護面接觸。平均壓縮應變可估量沉陷，但不能代表差異沉陷或循環孔壓引起的軟化，施工分期與海床土性必須一起記錄。 假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。 沉陷還可能改變有效堤頂出水高，進而影響原先估計的越波和堤後排水需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基床沉陷與層厚」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Foundation deformation changes toe and crest elevations and redistributes armour contacts. Average compression strain estimates settlement but does not represent differential movement or cyclic pore-pressure softening. Construction stages must therefore be interpreted together with seabed conditions and their evolution. Assume a3m layer with uniform vertical strain0.02. Settlement s=εH=0.060m excludes other layers and differential movement. Settlement can also reduce effective crest freeboard, altering the overtopping and rear-drainage demand originally estimated for the completed structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foundation settlement and thickness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基床沉陷與層厚」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Foundation settlement and thickness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.

steps.title: 基床沉陷與層厚：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foundation settlement and thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基床沉陷與層厚」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Foundation settlement and thickness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。核對壓縮層厚度及地下水條件，避免把石堆重排和地基壓縮混成同一機制。把沉陷量換算成有效出水高變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verify compressible-layer thickness and groundwater conditions, distinguishing stone rearrangement from deformation of the underlying foundation. Translate settlement into the corresponding effective-freeboard change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verify compressible-layer thickness and groundwater conditions, distinguishing stone rearrangement from deformation of the underlying foundation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 基床沉陷與層厚：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation settlement and thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基床沉陷與層厚」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation settlement and thickness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. Fine material may escape beneath an intact-looking surface, and average crest movement can miss the area most in need of intervention. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉陷還可能改變有效堤頂出水高，進而影響原先估計的越波和堤後排水需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Settlement can also reduce effective crest freeboard, altering the overtopping and rear-drainage demand originally estimated for the completed structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基床沉陷與層厚」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Foundation settlement and thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible.
quiz.explanation: 基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊索角度與受力」與「損傷斷面與追蹤」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sling angle and force" and "Damage profiles and tracking": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊索角度與受力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sling angle and force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊索角度與受力」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sling angle and force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。索向與垂直方向的角度會改變張力，重心偏移、動態加速度及吊點強度仍需由核准吊裝方案處理。 假設靜態重量100kN由兩索對稱承擔，各與垂直夾30°，T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN；不含動載。 此處張力是索的軸向力，不能把垂直分量誤當成吊索本身所承受的力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊索角度與受力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. Angle from the vertical changes tension, while center-of-gravity offset, dynamic acceleration and attachment capacity still require an approved lifting analysis. Assume static100kN shared symmetrically by two slings each30° from vertical. T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN, excluding dynamic loading. Sling tension is axial force; its vertical component must not be mistaken for the force carried by the sling itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sling angle and force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吊索角度與受力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sling angle and force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊索角度與受力
knowledge.text: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。索向與垂直方向的角度會改變張力，重心偏移、動態加速度及吊點強度仍需由核准吊裝方案處理。
knowledge.textEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. Angle from the vertical changes tension, while center-of-gravity offset, dynamic acceleration and attachment capacity still require an approved lifting analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊索角度與受力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sling angle and force" is correct?
options: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。
兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
optionsEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count.
Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
quiz.explanation: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊索角度與受力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sling angle and force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊索角度與受力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sling angle and force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設靜態重量100kN由兩索對稱承擔，各與垂直夾30°，T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN；不含動載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume static100kN shared symmetrically by two slings each30° from vertical. T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN, excluding dynamic loading. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。另列吊具能力、重心與動載條件，讓教學靜力值不被誤用為現場吊裝設定。以兩索分力總和重新核對平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Separately document rig capacity, center of gravity and dynamic conditions so the teaching equilibrium result cannot become a field lifting setting. Recheck equilibrium using the sum of both sling components.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。另列吊具能力、重心與動載條件，讓教學靜力值不被誤用為現場吊裝設定。
knowledge.textEn: Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Separately document rig capacity, center of gravity and dynamic conditions so the teaching equilibrium result cannot become a field lifting setting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊索角度與受力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sling angle and force"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components.
quiz.explanation: 在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊索角度與受力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sling angle and force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊索角度與受力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sling angle and force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. Checking total weight without sling and attachment forces can leave the weakest interface unrecognized until it governs failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此處張力是索的軸向力，不能把垂直分量誤當成吊索本身所承受的力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sling tension is axial force; its vertical component must not be mistaken for the force carried by the sling itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. Checking total weight without sling and attachment forces can leave the weakest interface unrecognized until it governs failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊索角度與受力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sling angle and force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
optionsEn: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
quiz.explanation: 角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Damage profiles and tracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「損傷斷面與追蹤」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damage profiles and tracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。損傷面積可以組織觀測，但需要搭配位置和時序，避免把移位後仍在斷面內的石塊誤算成完全流失。 假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。 同一損傷數的風險仍受位置控制，堤頭或過渡區不能以堤身平均表現代替。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「損傷斷面與追蹤」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-storm armour movement needs fixed survey areas and datums. Surface depressions, toe accumulation and actual material loss differ. A damage-area measure organizes observations only when location and chronology remain available, preventing displaced stones still within the section from being counted as entirely lost. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage. The significance of a damage number still depends on location; head or transition damage cannot be replaced by average trunk performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Damage profiles and tracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「損傷斷面與追蹤」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Damage profiles and tracking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤
knowledge.text: 暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。損傷面積可以組織觀測，但需要搭配位置和時序，避免把移位後仍在斷面內的石塊誤算成完全流失。
knowledge.textEn: Post-storm armour movement needs fixed survey areas and datums. Surface depressions, toe accumulation and actual material loss differ.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「損傷斷面與追蹤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Damage profiles and tracking" is correct?
options: 無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。
同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
optionsEn: A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
Post-storm armour movement needs fixed survey areas and datums.
Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
quiz.explanation: 暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-storm armour movement needs fixed survey areas and datums. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damage profiles and tracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「損傷斷面與追蹤」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damage profiles and tracking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「損傷斷面與追蹤」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Damage profiles and tracking", which statement holds?
options: 孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Damage profiles and tracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「損傷斷面與追蹤」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damage profiles and tracking” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。將石塊位移、破碎與反濾外露分開記錄，再與設計採用的損傷定義比較。將坡腳及轉折區另列損傷圖層。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery. Record displacement, breakage and exposed filter separately before comparing with the design's chosen damage definition. Map toe and transition damage as separate survey layers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。將石塊位移、破碎與反濾外露分開記錄，再與設計採用的損傷定義比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery. Record displacement, breakage and exposed filter separately before comparing with the design's chosen damage definition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.observation: 連結機制：同一損傷數的風險仍受位置控制，堤頭或過渡區不能以堤身平均表現代替。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The significance of a damage number still depends on location; head or transition damage cannot be replaced by average trunk performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。
knowledge.textEn: Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. Local filter exposure may also disappear in section-wide averaging, delaying recognition of the starting point for further material loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「損傷斷面與追蹤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Damage profiles and tracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。
同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands.
Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
quiz.explanation: 若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大古力水壩
summary: 大古力案例將發電與灌溉抽水放入同一能量和水量帳，並追蹤前池水位、管路阻力與機組停機如何相互影響。課程接續混凝土分塊、基礎排水與量測基準，再以灌溉回歸流及更新後效率驗證收束；學員須解釋不同時間尺度的資料為何不能直接相減。
summaryEn: The Grand Coulee case places generation and irrigation pumping in one water and energy account and follows interactions among forebay level, pipe resistance and outages. Concrete blocks, foundation drainage and survey reference control lead into irrigation return flows and post-renewal efficiency verification. Learners explain why observations from different time scales cannot simply be subtracted.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「灌溉抽水能量帳」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「發電抽水淨交換」及「前池水位緩衝」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW；第二組為 Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Irrigation pumping energy account, then compare the controlling variables in Generation pumping net exchange and Forebay level buffering. The first calculation is rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW; the second is Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「灌溉抽水能量帳」與「發電抽水淨交換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Irrigation pumping energy account" and "Generation pumping net exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Irrigation pumping energy account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「灌溉抽水能量帳」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Irrigation pumping energy account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電廠與抽水站共用水資源時，抽水所需能量不能從發電流量直接相減。抽水揚程包含上下游能量高程差與管路損失，電端輸入還需除以泵及馬達效率。先把取水量、提高的位能與耗電分列，才能比較不同灌溉時程的水能代價。 若以每立方米耗電比較方案，應將功率除流量並正確換算能量單位，才能消除單純抽水規模不同的影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「灌溉抽水能量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When generation and irrigation pumping share a water resource, pumping energy cannot be subtracted directly from generating discharge. Pump head includes the difference in energy elevations and conveyance losses, while electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump and motor efficiency. Separate water volume, gained potential energy and electricity before comparing irrigation schedules. Comparing energy per cubic metre requires dividing power by flow with consistent energy units, separating scale of pumping from the underlying hydraulic and efficiency effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Irrigation pumping energy account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「灌溉抽水能量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Irrigation pumping energy account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳
knowledge.text: 發電廠與抽水站共用水資源時，抽水所需能量不能從發電流量直接相減。抽水揚程包含上下游能量高程差與管路損失，電端輸入還需除以泵及馬達效率。
knowledge.textEn: When generation and irrigation pumping share a water resource, pumping energy cannot be subtracted directly from generating discharge. Pump head includes the difference in energy elevations and conveyance losses, while electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump and motor efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「灌溉抽水能量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Irrigation pumping energy account" is correct?
options: 抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率
發電廠與抽水站共用水資源時，抽水所需能量不能從發電流量直接相減。
淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降
optionsEn: Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
When generation and irrigation pumping share a water resource, pumping energy cannot be subtracted directly from generating discharge.
Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 發電廠與抽水站共用水資源時，抽水所需能量不能從發電流量直接相減。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When generation and irrigation pumping share a water resource, pumping energy cannot be subtracted directly from generating discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Irrigation pumping energy account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌溉抽水能量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Irrigation pumping energy account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW。模型邊界：揚程含全部假定水力損失，效率為電端至水力總效率；穩態計算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW. Model boundary: head includes assumed hydraulic losses and efficiency is overall electrical-to-hydraulic efficiency; steady operation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW。模型邊界：揚程含全部假定水力損失，效率為電端至水力總效率；穩態計算。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW. Model boundary: head includes assumed hydraulic losses and efficiency is overall electrical-to-hydraulic efficiency; steady operation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「灌溉抽水能量帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Irrigation pumping energy account", which statement holds?
options: 不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換
兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度

steps.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Irrigation pumping energy account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌溉抽水能量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Irrigation pumping energy account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。將實測耗電按每立方米水量表示，若隨水位降低而升高，須區分靜揚程增加與設備效率下降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference. Express consumption per cubic metre. If it rises as the source level falls, distinguish increased static lift from deterioration of equipment efficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定輸送體積，分別比較高水位短時抽水與低水位長時抽水的總耗電，列出效率及管路阻力資料，避免只用尖峰功率選方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For a fixed delivered volume, compare short pumping at a high source level with longer pumping at a low level. List efficiency and resistance data needed before choosing a schedule from peak power alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。將實測耗電按每立方米水量表示，若隨水位降低而升高，須區分靜揚程增加與設備效率下降。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference. Express consumption per cubic metre. If it rises as the source level falls, distinguish increased static lift from deterioration of equipment efficiency.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 固定輸送體積，分別比較高水位短時抽水與低水位長時抽水的總耗電，列出效率及管路阻力資料，避免只用尖峰功率選方案。
knowledge.textEn: For a fixed delivered volume, compare short pumping at a high source level with longer pumping at a low level. List efficiency and resistance data needed before choosing a schedule from peak power alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌溉抽水能量帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Irrigation pumping energy account"?
options: 同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載
optionsEn: Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Irrigation pumping energy account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌溉抽水能量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Irrigation pumping energy account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. Different meter integration windows can also create a false efficiency change and must be checked before diagnosing the pump. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若以每立方米耗電比較方案，應將功率除流量並正確換算能量單位，才能消除單純抽水規模不同的影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing energy per cubic metre requires dividing power by flow with consistent energy units, separating scale of pumping from the underlying hydraulic and efficiency effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。
knowledge.textEn: An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. Different meter integration windows can also create a false efficiency change and must be checked before diagnosing the pump.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「灌溉抽水能量帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Irrigation pumping energy account" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。
淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge.
Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 發電抽水淨交換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Generation pumping net exchange: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「發電抽水淨交換」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Generation pumping net exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。不同設備的電表可能位於變壓器前後，必須統一計量邊界再作加減。水量帳也需另列，因取水到灌區的時間延遲不等於電力交換時段。 輔機可能由外部電網供電而非機組母線供電，淨外送與自用電帳必須依實際接線拓撲定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電抽水淨交換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. Meters may sit on different sides of transformers, requiring a common boundary. Maintain a separate water account because delivery time to irrigation areas differs from the electrical exchange interval. Auxiliaries may draw from an external grid rather than the generating bus, so net export and internal consumption depend on the actual electrical connection topology. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Generation pumping net exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「發電抽水淨交換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Generation pumping net exchange”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發電抽水淨交換
knowledge.text: 電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。不同設備的電表可能位於變壓器前後，必須統一計量邊界再作加減。
knowledge.textEn: Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. Meters may sit on different sides of transformers, requiring a common boundary.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發電抽水淨交換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Generation pumping net exchange" is correct?
options: 淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降
單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量
電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。
optionsEn: Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.
One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage.
Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 發電抽水淨交換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Generation pumping net exchange: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「發電抽水淨交換」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Generation pumping net exchange” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。模型邊界：所有功率同一時間與電端邊界，不另重扣已含於電表的損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Model boundary: all powers use the same interval and electrical boundary; losses already included in readings are not deducted again. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出每只電表相對母線及變壓器的位置，逐項核對輔機是否已含於淨電表，再比較各分表積分與外送總表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map each meter relative to buses and transformers, check whether auxiliaries are already included, and compare integrated submeters with export metering.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。模型邊界：所有功率同一時間與電端邊界，不另重扣已含於電表的損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Model boundary: all powers use the same interval and electrical boundary; losses already included in readings are not deducted again.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「發電抽水淨交換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Generation pumping net exchange", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。
水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量
排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW.
Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use.
A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 發電抽水淨交換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Generation pumping net exchange: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「發電抽水淨交換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Generation pumping net exchange” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出每只電表相對母線及變壓器的位置，逐項核對輔機是否已含於淨電表，再比較各分表積分與外送總表。若殘差隨抽水啟停改變，應追查漏列負載或不同量測邊界，不先假設發電機效率跳變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map each meter relative to buses and transformers, check whether auxiliaries are already included, and compare integrated submeters with export metering. A residual that changes with pump switching suggests a missing load or inconsistent boundary before it suggests a sudden generator-efficiency change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為三種抽水時程計算日淨外送電量，並讓總抽水量相同，說明電價時序、灌溉需求與設備效率各需何種附加資料才能比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate daily net export for three pumping schedules with equal delivered water. Explain the additional price timing, irrigation-demand and equipment-efficiency information needed to compare their practical consequences.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把抽水耗電同時列為輔機與獨立項目會重複扣除，造成虛假的低外送；若時間平均方式不同，短時啟動尖峰也可能被錯配到另一設備的時段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting pump demand both as an auxiliary and a separate item double-deducts energy and understates export. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發電抽水淨交換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Generation pumping net exchange"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
畫出每只電表相對母線及變壓器的位置，逐項核對輔機是否已含於淨電表，再比較各分表積分與外送總表。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.

Counting pump demand both as an auxiliary and a separate item double-deducts energy and understates export.
quiz.explanation: 把抽水耗電同時列為輔機與獨立項目會重複扣除，造成虛假的低外送；若時間平均方式不同，短時啟動尖峰也可能被錯配到另一設備的時段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting pump demand both as an auxiliary and a separate item double-deducts energy and understates export. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「前池水位緩衝」與「輸水管摩阻尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Forebay level buffering" and "Conveyance friction scaling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 前池水位緩衝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Forebay level buffering: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「前池水位緩衝」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Forebay level buffering” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。矩形水池的面積模型適合建立短時反應尺度；若池形變化大、波浪明顯或連接渠道長，則需把儲存與傳播分開，不能把所有測點當成同時同高。 渠道水面振盪能使局部水位先升後降而總儲量近乎不變，多站平均與流量積分提供不同但互補的資訊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「前池水位緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions. A constant-area model establishes a short-term response scale. Strongly varying geometry, waves or long connecting canals require separate treatment of storage and propagation instead of assuming every gauge changes simultaneously. Surface oscillation can raise and lower a local level with little total storage change; multi-gauge averages and flow integration provide distinct complementary information. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Forebay level buffering” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「前池水位緩衝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Forebay level buffering”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 前池水位緩衝
knowledge.text: 前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。矩形水池的面積模型適合建立短時反應尺度；若池形變化大、波浪明顯或連接渠道長，則需把儲存與傳播分開，不能把所有測點當成同時同高。
knowledge.textEn: A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions. A constant-area model establishes a short-term response scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「前池水位緩衝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Forebay level buffering" is correct?
options: 前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。
單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量
不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換
optionsEn: A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions.
One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage.
Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly.
quiz.explanation: 前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 前池水位緩衝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forebay level buffering: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前池水位緩衝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Forebay level buffering” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m。模型邊界：面積固定且忽略波浪與側向取水；負號表示水位下降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m. Model boundary: constant surface area, no waves or lateral withdrawals; negative sign denotes falling level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同時段入出流積分預測水位，再比較多站平均水位與單點波動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate inflow and outflow to predict level, then compare the average of several gauges with local fluctuations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m。模型邊界：面積固定且忽略波浪與側向取水；負號表示水位下降。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「前池水位緩衝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Forebay level buffering", which statement holds?
options: 兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度

steps.title: 前池水位緩衝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forebay level buffering: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「前池水位緩衝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Forebay level buffering” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同時段入出流積分預測水位，再比較多站平均水位與單點波動。若單點振盪而平均儲量變化符合帳本，應研究水面振盪；若所有站都偏離，先檢查流量偏差與實際面積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate inflow and outflow to predict level, then compare the average of several gauges with local fluctuations. Oscillation at one station with a closing storage balance suggests surface motion. Coherent disagreement across stations instead calls for checking discharge bias and actual surface area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將緩衝面積減半並改成兩段出流，逐段計算水位，畫出泵啟動前後的測站佈置，指出何時常面積模型不再足夠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve the buffering area and use two successive outflows. Compute the level segment by segment, locate gauges around pump starting, and identify observations that would invalidate the constant-area model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同時段入出流積分預測水位，再比較多站平均水位與單點波動。若單點振盪而平均儲量變化符合帳本，應研究水面振盪；若所有站都偏離，先檢查流量偏差與實際面積。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate inflow and outflow to predict level, then compare the average of several gauges with local fluctuations. Oscillation at one station with a closing storage balance suggests surface motion. Coherent disagreement across stations instead calls for checking discharge bias and actual surface area.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將緩衝面積減半並改成兩段出流，逐段計算水位，畫出泵啟動前後的測站佈置，指出何時常面積模型不再足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Halve the buffering area and use two successive outflows. Compute the level segment by segment, locate gauges around pump starting, and identify observations that would invalidate the constant-area model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「前池水位緩衝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Forebay level buffering"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高
以同時段入出流積分預測水位，再比較多站平均水位與單點波動。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
Integrate inflow and outflow to predict level, then compare the average of several gauges with local fluctuations.
quiz.explanation: 以同時段入出流積分預測水位，再比較多站平均水位與單點波動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate inflow and outflow to predict level, then compare the average of several gauges with local fluctuations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 前池水位緩衝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Forebay level buffering: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前池水位緩衝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Forebay level buffering” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence. A sensor in a high-velocity zone can also mistake local dynamic effects for a loss of storage throughout the forebay. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：渠道水面振盪能使局部水位先升後降而總儲量近乎不變，多站平均與流量積分提供不同但互補的資訊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface oscillation can raise and lower a local level with little total storage change; multi-gauge averages and flow integration provide distinct complementary information.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence. A sensor in a high-velocity zone can also mistake local dynamic effects for a loss of storage throughout the forebay.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「前池水位緩衝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Forebay level buffering" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換
optionsEn: Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly.
quiz.explanation: 前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輸水管摩阻尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction scaling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輸水管摩阻尺度」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conveyance friction scaling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌溉輸水損失隨流速增大而快速上升，達西摩阻式把管長、直徑與粗糙影響放在同一能量帳。摩阻因子並非固定材料常數，會受雷諾數及相對粗糙度控制。教材固定因子只為隔離流速效應，實際比較前必須核對流況與局部構件。 截面直徑改變也會改變速度水頭，壓力差不全是耗散，必須先扣除可逆的動能與高程變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輸水管摩阻尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conveyance loss rises rapidly with velocity, and Darcy-Weisbach places length, diameter and roughness effects in one energy account. The friction factor is not a fixed material property; Reynolds number and relative roughness matter. Holding it constant isolates velocity effects for teaching, while field comparisons require flow-regime and fitting checks. A diameter change also changes velocity head, so pressure difference is not entirely dissipation; first account for reversible kinetic and elevation-energy changes between sections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conveyance friction scaling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=0.018 (dimensionless); L=900 m; D=4 m; v=3 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f*(L/D)*v*v/(2*g)=1.857798165 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=0.018 (dimensionless); L=900 m; D=4 m; v=3 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f*(L/D)*v*v/(2*g)=1.857798165 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輸水管摩阻尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 輸水管摩阻尺度：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conveyance friction scaling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測兩斷面壓力並補正高程及速度水頭，再把剩餘能量差與摩阻式比較。改變流量時查看損失與流速平方是否一致；若僅某閥位下突增，應分列局部損失而非把全部效應塞進管壁粗糙度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure at two sections and correct elevation and velocity heads before comparing energy loss. Vary discharge to examine velocity-squared behavior. A jump associated with one valve position should be treated as local loss rather than absorbed entirely into inferred wall roughness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把流量提高兩成，在直徑不變下重算流速與摩阻，再增加一個已知局部損失係數，分別列出兩種損失對總揚程的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase flow by twenty percent at unchanged diameter and recalculate velocity and friction. Add one known local-loss coefficient and separately account for each contribution to the total pumping head.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Irrigation return flow accounting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌溉回歸流水帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Irrigation return flow accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將渠道進出流、土壤含水與作物蒸散估計對齊到同一天，另核對回歸水在下游的延遲。若日帳不閉合而多日累計閉合，可能是地下儲存及到達時間問題，不宜直接指認未計量取水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align canal flows, soil-water observations and evapotranspiration estimates to the same day, checking downstream return-flow delay separately. Daily imbalance that closes over several days may reflect subsurface storage and travel time rather than an unmetered withdrawal from the irrigation system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一日延遲的回歸流，建立連續三日水量表，再比較單日與三日淨消耗，提出一項能檢查地下儲存變化的現地觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a one-day delay to return flow and construct a three-day balance. Compare daily and cumulative consumption, then propose a field observation that can test the inferred change in subsurface storage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將深層滲漏一律稱為浪費，可能忽略可回收地下水；但把所有滲漏都視為可利用回歸流也會高估供水，因水質、流向與時間均可能不符合需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling all deep percolation waste can ignore recoverable groundwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
