steps.titleEn: Irrigation return flow accounting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌溉回歸流水帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Irrigation return flow accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將深層滲漏一律稱為浪費，可能忽略可回收地下水；但把所有滲漏都視為可利用回歸流也會高估供水，因水質、流向與時間均可能不符合需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling all deep percolation waste can ignore recoverable groundwater. Treating it all as usable return flow can equally overstate supply because water quality, direction and arrival time may fail to match the downstream demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：回歸水若跨越原先劃定邊界，需改列外部輸出而非區內儲存，控制體選擇會改變各項名稱但不改守恆。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Return water crossing the chosen boundary is an external output rather than internal storage; control-volume choice changes labels while preserving the conservation requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 混凝土分塊溫差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete block temperature mismatch: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土分塊溫差」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete block temperature mismatch” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰壩塊不同的溫度歷程會造成相容變形差，而不是每塊都在相同溫度下同步收縮。教材比較兩塊的自由熱應變差，作為接縫運動的來源之一；澆置齡期、徐變與約束會改變實際應力，因此應變差不能直接乘一個彈性模數就宣告開裂。 兩塊混凝土即使最終溫度相同，也可能因不同齡期的約束與徐變而留下不同殘餘應力，不能只比較終值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土分塊溫差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neighboring blocks can have different thermal histories and therefore different free strains rather than cooling together. Their free thermal-strain difference is one source of joint movement. Placement age, creep and restraint alter actual stress, so multiplying this difference by one elastic modulus does not by itself establish cracking. Two blocks reaching the same final temperature may retain different stresses because restraint and creep developed at different ages; matching endpoints does not establish equivalent histories. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete block temperature mismatch” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 混凝土分塊溫差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete block temperature mismatch: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土分塊溫差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete block temperature mismatch” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。若應變差預測與接縫方向相反，先核對正負號、感測軸向及塊體約束，再研究材料異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct core temperature histories from embedded sensors and pair them with joint gauges and placement dates. If predicted strain difference has the opposite sign to joint movement, check sign conventions, sensor orientation and block restraint before investigating an unusual material response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變兩塊溫度歷程使最終溫度相同但降溫速率不同，畫出自由應變差隨時間的變化，指出徐變試驗及約束模型需要補充的資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give two blocks the same final temperature but different cooling rates. Plot their free-strain difference over time and identify the creep-test and restraint-model information needed to assess the consequences.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。若應變差預測與接縫方向相反，先核對正負號、感測軸向及塊體約束，再研究材料異常。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct core temperature histories from embedded sensors and pair them with joint gauges and placement dates. If predicted strain difference has the opposite sign to joint movement, check sign conventions, sensor orientation and block restraint before investigating an unusual material response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 改變兩塊溫度歷程使最終溫度相同但降溫速率不同，畫出自由應變差隨時間的變化，指出徐變試驗及約束模型需要補充的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Give two blocks the same final temperature but different cooling rates. Plot their free-strain difference over time and identify the creep-test and restraint-model information needed to assess the consequences.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混凝土分塊溫差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concrete block temperature mismatch"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量
以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage.
Reconstruct core temperature histories from embedded sensors and pair them with joint gauges and placement dates.
quiz.explanation: 以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct core temperature histories from embedded sensors and pair them with joint gauges and placement dates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混凝土分塊溫差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete block temperature mismatch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土分塊溫差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete block temperature mismatch” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. A sensor too close to a cooling pipe can also represent a local temperature rather than the block average and distort the inferred compatibility difference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩塊混凝土即使最終溫度相同，也可能因不同齡期的約束與徐變而留下不同殘餘應力，不能只比較終值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Two blocks reaching the same final temperature may retain different stresses because restraint and creep developed at different ages; matching endpoints does not establish equivalent histories.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The free-strain difference of two blocks equals the joint crack width." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. A sensor too close to a cooling pipe can also represent a local temperature rather than the block average and distort the inferred compatibility difference.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土分塊溫差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete block temperature mismatch" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善
optionsEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
quiz.explanation: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基礎排水阻力」與「停機容量與水量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Foundation drainage resistance" and "Outage capacity and water allocation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基礎排水阻力」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foundation drainage resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。簡化的導水率乘水頭差模型可描述一段線性滲流路徑，但岩體裂隙網絡可能隨壓力改變。壓力與流量必須成對觀察，才可區分堵塞及新增滲流。 導水率的單位是面積每時間，與材料滲透係數的長度每時間不同，兩者還差流路幾何因子。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基礎排水阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. Conductance times head difference describes one linear seepage path, while a fractured-rock network may change with pressure. Pressure and flow must be observed together to distinguish blockage from newly connected seepage. Hydraulic conductance has area-per-time units, unlike conductivity in length per time; a flow-path geometry factor is required before one can be converted into the other. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foundation drainage resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基礎排水阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Foundation drainage resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基礎排水阻力
knowledge.text: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。簡化的導水率乘水頭差模型可描述一段線性滲流路徑，但岩體裂隙網絡可能隨壓力改變。
knowledge.textEn: Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. Conductance times head difference describes one linear seepage path, while a fractured-rock network may change with pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基礎排水阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Foundation drainage resistance" is correct?
options: 排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善
排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。
可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載
optionsEn: A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief.
Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation.
quiz.explanation: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基礎排水阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foundation drainage resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。模型邊界：線性等效導水率且水頭差固定，並非單孔允許流量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Model boundary: linear equivalent hydraulic conductance at fixed head difference, not an allowable drain discharge. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。模型邊界：線性等效導水率且水頭差固定，並非單孔允許流量。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Model boundary: linear equivalent hydraulic conductance at fixed head difference, not an allowable drain discharge.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基礎排水阻力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Foundation drainage resistance", which statement holds?
options: 更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高
淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。
optionsEn: Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基礎排水阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Foundation drainage resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。若清孔後流量增加而孔壓下降，與恢復排水一致；若孔壓同升，須追查上游連通變化，不把所有增流都稱為維修成功。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Increased flow with lower pressure supports restored drainage. If pressure also rises, investigate changed upstream connectivity rather than describing every increase in discharge as a successful repair. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對清孔前後兩組水頭和流量反算導水率，加入一組上游水位改變的資料，說明如何避免把水頭變化誤作排水能力改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Infer conductance from two pressure-flow pairs before and after cleaning, then add a pair with changed reservoir level. Explain how to avoid confusing changed driving head with changed drainage capability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。若清孔後流量增加而孔壓下降，與恢復排水一致；若孔壓同升，須追查上游連通變化，不把所有增流都稱為維修成功。
knowledge.textEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Increased flow with lower pressure supports restored drainage. If pressure also rises, investigate changed upstream connectivity rather than describing every increase in discharge as a successful repair.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對清孔前後兩組水頭和流量反算導水率，加入一組上游水位改變的資料，說明如何避免把水頭變化誤作排水能力改變。
knowledge.textEn: Infer conductance from two pressure-flow pairs before and after cleaning, then add a pair with changed reservoir level. Explain how to avoid confusing changed driving head with changed drainage capability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基礎排水阻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Foundation drainage resistance"?
options: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換
optionsEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly.
quiz.explanation: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基礎排水阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation drainage resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. Blockage in the measuring tube instead produces a delayed response and needs an independent response test to identify. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導水率的單位是面積每時間，與材料滲透係數的長度每時間不同，兩者還差流路幾何因子。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic conductance has area-per-time units, unlike conductivity in length per time; a flow-path geometry factor is required before one can be converted into the other.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness.
Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation.

steps.title: 停機容量與水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage capacity and water allocation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機容量與水量」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outage capacity and water allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型機組檢修會降低可用發電通道，但不一定同比例降低河道總出流，因其他機組及放流設施可能分擔水量。教材先用可用機組數乘假定單機出力估算容量，再把水頭、流量與共同輸電限制另列。設備容量是上限條件之一，不能單獨預測實際電量。 未被發電利用的水可能仍履行必要河道放流，因此旁通量應記入水量帳，而非自動視為可避免的浪費。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機容量與水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A major-unit outage reduces available generating paths without necessarily reducing total river release proportionally, because other units and outlets may carry water. Count available units at an assumed unit output first, then consider head, discharge and shared transmission constraints. Equipment capacity is only one limit and cannot independently predict energy production. Water bypassing turbines may still satisfy required river release; account for its volume without automatically treating all bypass as an avoidable operational waste. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outage capacity and water allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停機容量與水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Outage capacity and water allocation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A major-unit outage reduces available generating paths without necessarily reducing total river release proportionally, because other units and outlets may carry water. Count available units at an assumed unit output first, then consider head, discharge and shared transmission constraints.

knowledge.text: 誤解：可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「停機容量與水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable.

steps.title: 停機容量與水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage capacity and water allocation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停機容量與水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outage capacity and water allocation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW。模型邊界：所有剩餘機組相同出力且無共同限制，只算假想機組容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW. Model boundary: equal output for remaining units and no shared constraints; hypothetical unit capacity only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將停機時程與水頭、可用流量和輸電限制放在同一張表，核對未停機機組是否真的可同時滿載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine outage timing with head, available discharge and transmission limits, checking whether the remaining units can actually reach full output simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW。模型邊界：所有剩餘機組相同出力且無共同限制，只算假想機組容量。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW. Model boundary: equal output for remaining units and no shared constraints; hypothetical unit capacity only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停機容量與水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW.
Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage.

steps.title: 停機容量與水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage capacity and water allocation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停機容量與水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outage capacity and water allocation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將停機時程與水頭、可用流量和輸電限制放在同一張表，核對未停機機組是否真的可同時滿載。比較實際放流與發電流量，若差額經旁通排放，應在能量帳列明而非把它視為流量量測錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine outage timing with head, available discharge and transmission limits, checking whether the remaining units can actually reach full output simultaneously. Compare total release with turbine flow and account explicitly for bypassed water instead of treating the difference as a metering error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：排列兩種檢修重疊方案，加入一項共同變壓器容量限制，逐時求可用容量並比較旁通水量，說明選擇方案還需哪些河道限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Arrange two overlapping-maintenance schedules, add a shared transformer limit and calculate hourly available capacity. Compare bypassed water and explain the downstream constraints still needed before selecting a maintenance plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同時檢修共用變壓器可能讓更多機組失去外送能力，機組台數法因而高估容量；洪水時可用水量增加也不會解除電氣或機械共同限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maintenance of a shared transformer may remove export capability from additional units, making unit counting overstate capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「停機容量與水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage capacity and water allocation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定
同時檢修共用變壓器可能讓更多機組失去外送能力，機組台數法因而高估容量；洪水時可用水量增加也不會解除電氣或機械共同限制。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable.
Maintenance of a shared transformer may remove export capability from additional units, making unit counting overstate capacity.

quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance of a shared transformer may remove export capability from additional units, making unit counting overstate capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水準基準閉合」與「更新效率比較」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Level reference closure" and "Post renewal efficiency comparison": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水準基準閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level reference closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水準基準閉合」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level reference closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體沉陷、庫水位與設備高程若使用不同基準，量測之間會出現看似物理的差異。水準閉合差用來檢查測線一致性，卻不能證明所有基準點都穩定；整組點共同移動時，內部閉合仍可能良好，因此必須連到獨立且可追溯的控制點。 觀測線長度與視距不平衡會影響誤差來源，配賦方式應依量測品質而非僅按測段數平均處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水準基準閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dam settlement, reservoir level and equipment elevation can appear inconsistent when different reference datums are used. Level-loop closure tests internal consistency but cannot establish that every benchmark is stable. A group of points moving together can still close well, so an independent traceable control point is needed to interpret movement. Line length and unequal sight distances affect survey errors; adjustment weights should reflect observation quality rather than distributing every closure equally by number of legs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level reference closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水準基準閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level reference closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水準基準閉合
knowledge.text: 壩體沉陷、庫水位與設備高程若使用不同基準，量測之間會出現看似物理的差異。水準閉合差用來檢查測線一致性，卻不能證明所有基準點都穩定；整組點共同移動時，內部閉合仍可能良好，因此必須連到獨立且可追溯的控制點。
knowledge.textEn: Dam settlement, reservoir level and equipment elevation can appear inconsistent when different reference datums are used. Level-loop closure tests internal consistency but cannot establish that every benchmark is stable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水準基準閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Level reference closure" is correct?
options: 壩體沉陷、庫水位與設備高程若使用不同基準，量測之間會出現看似物理的差異。
水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定
更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高
optionsEn: Dam settlement, reservoir level and equipment elevation can appear inconsistent when different reference datums are used.
Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable.
Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
quiz.explanation: 壩體沉陷、庫水位與設備高程若使用不同基準，量測之間會出現看似物理的差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dam settlement, reservoir level and equipment elevation can appear inconsistent when different reference datums are used. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水準基準閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Level reference closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水準基準閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level reference closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm。模型邊界：三段封閉測線的高差和，未給合格限值或誤差配賦規則。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm. Model boundary: sum of height differences around a three-leg closed loop, without an acceptance limit or adjustment rule. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm。模型邊界：三段封閉測線的高差和，未給合格限值或誤差配賦規則。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm. Model boundary: sum of height differences around a three-leg closed loop, without an acceptance limit or adjustment rule.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水準基準閉合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Level reference closure", which statement holds?
options: 淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm。
不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換
optionsEn: Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.

Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly.

steps.title: 水準基準閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level reference closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水準基準閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level reference closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。將閉合差與外部穩定點連測結果分開呈現；若內部閉合良好但外部連測變動，應研究共同基準移動而非強行歸零。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks. Remeasure an anomalous leg before adjustment. Present loop closure separately from the external-control tie; good internal closure with a changing external tie calls for investigating common benchmark movement rather than forcing zero displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作一組單段粗差及一組所有基準共同移動的觀測，分別計算閉合差，說明哪一組需外部控制才能發現，並設計復測路線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create observations with a single-leg blunder and another set with common benchmark movement. Compute closure for each, identify which requires external control to detect, and design the confirming survey route.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。將閉合差與外部穩定點連測結果分開呈現；若內部閉合良好但外部連測變動，應研究共同基準移動而非強行歸零。
knowledge.textEn: Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks. Remeasure an anomalous leg before adjustment. Present loop closure separately from the external-control tie; good internal closure with a changing external tie calls for investigating common benchmark movement rather than forcing zero displacement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 製作一組單段粗差及一組所有基準共同移動的觀測，分別計算閉合差，說明哪一組需外部控制才能發現，並設計復測路線。
knowledge.textEn: Create observations with a single-leg blunder and another set with common benchmark movement. Compute closure for each, identify which requires external control to detect, and design the confirming survey route.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水準基準閉合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level reference closure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度
保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The free-strain difference of two blocks equals the joint crack width.
Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks.
quiz.explanation: 保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水準基準閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level reference closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水準基準閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level reference closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. If the reference benchmark itself responds to reservoir loading, all relative elevations can shift together while remaining internally consistent and apparently precise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：觀測線長度與視距不平衡會影響誤差來源，配賦方式應依量測品質而非僅按測段數平均處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Line length and unequal sight distances affect survey errors; adjustment weights should reflect observation quality rather than distributing every closure equally by number of legs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。
knowledge.textEn: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. If the reference benchmark itself responds to reservoir loading, all relative elevations can shift together while remaining internally consistent and apparently precise.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水準基準閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level reference closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高
optionsEn: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
quiz.explanation: 自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 更新效率比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「更新效率比較」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post renewal efficiency comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。先以同一水力輸入估算效率增加帶來的功率差，再討論不確定度與測試重複性。額定出力提高與日常效率提高是不同主張，需要不同驗證資料。 全年收益需以各工況停留時間加權，單一最佳效率點的改善不能代表全年不同水頭流量下的平均成效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「更新效率比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement. Estimate the power difference for one hydraulic input, then examine uncertainty and repeatability. Increased rated output and improved routine efficiency are distinct claims requiring different supporting observations. Annual benefit requires weighting operating points by their duration; improvement at one best-efficiency point does not represent average performance across a year of varying conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post renewal efficiency comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Post renewal efficiency comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 更新效率比較
knowledge.text: 機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。先以同一水力輸入估算效率增加帶來的功率差，再討論不確定度與測試重複性。
knowledge.textEn: A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement. Estimate the power difference for one hydraulic input, then examine uncertainty and repeatability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「更新效率比較」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post renewal efficiency comparison" is correct?
options: 更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高
機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。
抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率
optionsEn: Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement.
Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 更新效率比較：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「更新效率比較」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post renewal efficiency comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW。模型邊界：同一淨水頭流量的效率差，未含可用率與全年水文分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW. Model boundary: efficiency difference at identical net head and discharge; excludes availability and annual hydrologic distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Model boundary: efficiency difference at identical net head and discharge; excludes availability and annual hydrologic distribution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post renewal efficiency comparison", which statement holds?

steps.title: 更新效率比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「更新效率比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post renewal efficiency comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。若差值小於量測解析能力，應報告未能辨識改善，而非把四捨五入後的正值當成確定收益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements. Report uncertainty beside the efficiency difference. If the difference is below measurement resolution, state that improvement was not resolved rather than presenting a rounded positive value as a demonstrated gain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以三組水頭流量建立更新前後比較表，先計算同工況功率差，再加入流量偏差，討論何種精度才能辨識假定的效率增益。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build before-and-after comparisons at three head-flow combinations. Calculate matched-condition power differences, then introduce flow bias and determine what measurement precision is needed to resolve the assumed efficiency gain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。若差值小於量測解析能力，應報告未能辨識改善，而非把四捨五入後的正值當成確定收益。
knowledge.textEn: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements. Report uncertainty beside the efficiency difference. If the difference is below measurement resolution, state that improvement was not resolved rather than presenting a rounded positive value as a demonstrated gain.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以三組水頭流量建立更新前後比較表，先計算同工況功率差，再加入流量偏差，討論何種精度才能辨識假定的效率增益。
knowledge.textEn: Build before-and-after comparisons at three head-flow combinations. Calculate matched-condition power differences, then introduce flow bias and determine what measurement precision is needed to resolve the assumed efficiency gain.

quiz.question: 要驗證「更新效率比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post renewal efficiency comparison"?
options: 在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善
optionsEn: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
quiz.explanation: 在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 更新效率比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「更新效率比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post renewal efficiency comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Recalibrating a flow meter can also change calculated efficiency, so original calibration records and a consistent comparison boundary are needed to avoid crediting measurement changes to the equipment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：全年收益需以各工況停留時間加權，單一最佳效率點的改善不能代表全年不同水頭流量下的平均成效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual benefit requires weighting operating points by their duration; improvement at one best-efficiency point does not represent average performance across a year of varying conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。
knowledge.textEn: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Recalibrating a flow meter can also change calculated efficiency, so original calibration records and a consistent comparison boundary are needed to avoid crediting measurement changes to the equipment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「更新效率比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post renewal efficiency comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。
抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain.
Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 伊泰普水壩
summary: 伊泰普提供同一水力系統連結不同電網頻率的案例。學員從同步轉速、換流損失及無功容量出發，再追蹤尾水耦合、洩洪動量、冷卻與振動，最後建立跨時區資料帳。課程把電力份額與水量分配分開處理，避免將制度安排誤認為固定物理分流比例。
summaryEn: Itaipu illustrates one hydraulic development linked to grids with different frequencies. Learners examine synchronous speed, converter loss and reactive capacity before tailwater coupling, spillway momentum, cooling, vibration and time-aligned records. Electrical allocation and water distribution are handled separately, preventing institutional arrangements from being mistaken for a fixed physical flow split.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「頻率極數與轉速」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「異頻換流能量」及「無功與視在容量」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm；第二組為 Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Frequency poles and speed, then compare the controlling variables in Asynchronous conversion energy and Reactive power and apparent capacity. The first calculation is f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm; the second is Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頻率極數與轉速」與「異頻換流能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Frequency poles and speed" and "Asynchronous conversion energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: mechanism and system paths

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。模型邊界：理想同步轉速，極數為總磁極數；不是伊泰普實際機組銘牌。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm. Model boundary: ideal synchronous speed using total magnetic poles, not an Itaipu machine nameplate. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency poles and speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。若頻率正確但顯示轉速倍增，先查極對數與脈衝換算，不要由儀表顯示直接推定水輪機發生超速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer. If frequency is correct but displayed speed doubles, investigate pole-pair conventions and pulse conversion before interpreting the display as physical turbine overspeed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同總極數計算另一頻率的轉速，並畫出轉速與頻率關係，再說明若維持原轉速，所需極數為何必須是可製造的整數配置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate speed at another frequency using the same total poles. Plot the relationship and explain why retaining the original speed requires an integer pole arrangement that can actually be constructed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。教材以輸入電量乘總效率求接收電量，只描述能量帳，不把它當成電壓穩定或故障穿越分析。每個效率都要附邊界，避免把線路損失同時算入兩次。 換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「異頻換流能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Each efficiency needs a boundary so that line losses are not included twice in the same transfer estimate. Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons. quiz.question: 關於「異頻換流能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asynchronous conversion energy" is correct?
options: 不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失
兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦
不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。
optionsEn: Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss.
An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating.
Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints.
quiz.explanation: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「異頻換流能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asynchronous conversion energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。模型邊界：固定輸入及總傳輸效率，未計動態限制與停機。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Model boundary: constant input and overall transfer efficiency, excluding dynamic limits and outages. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「異頻換流能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asynchronous conversion energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。把損失與功率、環境溫度及設備狀態作圖，若差額只在切換時段出現，應先查積分時間與計量路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Plot loss against power, ambient temperature and equipment state. A discrepancy confined to switching intervals calls for checking integration windows and meter paths before assigning a physical efficiency change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持送端電量相同，設定兩種負載效率曲線比較受端電量，再列出換流站與線路應分設哪些電表才能驗證各項損失。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold sending energy fixed and compare received energy under two load-dependent efficiency curves. Identify the converter and line meters needed to verify the individual loss components rather than only the final balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A discrepancy confined to switching intervals calls for checking integration windows and meter paths before assigning a physical efficiency change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「異頻換流能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asynchronous conversion energy"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。
可用台時減少一定等比例減少發電量
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries.
Reduced available unit-hours always reduce generation by the same proportion.
quiz.explanation: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「異頻換流能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asynchronous conversion energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. These accounting errors can cancel, so agreement in the final total still requires checking the physical boundary of every metered term. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. These accounting errors can cancel, so agreement in the final total still requires checking the physical boundary of every metered term.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「異頻換流能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asynchronous conversion energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦
漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating.
Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it.
quiz.explanation: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無功與視在容量」與「尾水抬升耦合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reactive power and apparent capacity" and "Tailwater rise coupling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無功與視在容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reactive power and apparent capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無功與視在容量」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reactive power and apparent capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電機與變壓器的電流負擔同時受實功與無功影響，因此兆伏安額定值不能直接改寫成兆瓦。功率三角形可在平衡正弦穩態下關聯三者，但熱限制與勵磁限制形成的實際能力曲線更複雜。教材先分清量綱，再討論何者是真正限制。 視在功率描述電壓電流乘積，實功才對應平均能量轉移，無功方向則需明示供應或吸收的符號慣例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無功與視在容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generator and transformer current loading depends on both active and reactive power, so an MVA rating cannot simply be relabeled as MW. The power triangle connects the quantities for balanced sinusoidal steady operation, while thermal and excitation limits make the actual capability curve more complex. Identify quantities before deciding which limit controls. Apparent power describes the voltage-current product, active power represents mean energy transfer, and reactive direction needs an explicit convention for supply versus absorption. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reactive power and apparent capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無功與視在容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reactive power and apparent capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無功與視在容量

knowledge.textEn: Generator and transformer current loading depends on both active and reactive power, so an MVA rating cannot simply be relabeled as MW. The power triangle connects the quantities for balanced sinusoidal steady operation, while thermal and excitation limits make the actual capability curve more complex.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無功與視在容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reactive power and apparent capacity" is correct?
options: 發電機與變壓器的電流負擔同時受實功與無功影響，因此兆伏安額定值不能直接改寫成兆瓦。
