steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reactive power and apparent capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時讀取三相電壓電流、實功與無功，核對功率因數是否依同一基波定義。若總電流增加而實功不變，應查無功及諧波，不立即把它解讀成水輪機提供更多有用機械功率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read three-phase voltage, current, active and reactive power together, checking the definition of power factor. If current increases without greater active power, investigate reactive flow and harmonics rather than assuming that the turbine is delivering additional useful mechanical power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定視在容量計算三種功率因數下的實功與無功，畫功率三角形，再標明哪些設備限制不能由這張三角形推知。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At fixed apparent capacity, calculate active and reactive power for three power factors. Draw their power triangles and identify equipment limits that cannot be inferred from the triangles alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將視在額定值全部當實功，會忽略供應無功時的電流負擔；即使實功低於名目值，過勵磁或冷卻不足仍可能形成限制，需要核對能力曲線與溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the apparent rating entirely as active power ignores current loading while supplying reactive power. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 將視在額定值全部當實功，會忽略供應無功時的電流負擔；即使實功低於名目值，過勵磁或冷卻不足仍可能形成限制，需要核對能力曲線與溫度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the apparent rating entirely as active power ignores current loading while supplying reactive power. Overexcitation or inadequate cooling can constrain operation even below nominal active output, requiring checks of the capability curve and temperatures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 尾水抬升耦合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tailwater rise coupling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「尾水抬升耦合」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tailwater rise coupling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多台機組向共同尾水河段排放時，增加總流量可能抬高尾水並降低每台機組淨水頭。單機功率因此不一定能線性相加到任意總流量。教材以量測的局部尾水敏感度估算水頭損失，提醒學員同一河段的各機組不是完全獨立的水力設備。 共同尾水河段形成水力耦合，即使電氣母線分開仍會互相影響；模型拓撲應同時保留水路與電路的差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尾水抬升耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Units releasing into a common tailwater reach can raise its level as total discharge increases, reducing net head for each machine. Individual outputs therefore cannot be added linearly at arbitrary aggregate flow. A measured local tailwater sensitivity estimates the head effect and illustrates why machines sharing a reach are not hydraulically independent. A shared tailwater creates hydraulic coupling even with separate electrical buses; model topology should preserve the different connections of the water and electrical systems. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tailwater rise coupling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每台機組出力永遠與其他機組無關」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Each unit output is always independent of the other units." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「尾水抬升耦合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m。模型邊界：局部線性尾水評價，係數僅為假設且不含洪水回水遲滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Model boundary: local linear tailwater relation with an assumed coefficient, excluding flood backwater hysteresis. steps.instruction: 以同步總出流與尾水位建立上升及下降兩條散點路徑，並檢查下游來水是否另有影響。若同流量出現不同尾水，應保留遲滯或邊界條件，不以一條平均直線宣稱機組效率異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot rising and falling total-flow paths against synchronized tailwater level and check downstream influences. steps.failure: 注意干擾：洪水期間下游控制抬升可能主導尾水，原先低流量線性係數就不再有效；若仍沿用該係數，會高估可用水頭並誤排機組負載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: During flooding, downstream control can dominate tailwater and invalidate a coefficient fitted at low discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同步總出流與尾水位建立上升及下降兩條散點路徑，並檢查下游來水是否另有影響。若同流量出現不同尾水，應保留遲滯或邊界條件，不以一條平均直線宣稱機組效率異常。
knowledge.textEn: Plot rising and falling total-flow paths against synchronized tailwater level and check downstream influences. Different levels at the same discharge require retaining hysteresis or boundary conditions rather than forcing one mean line and interpreting the residual as a turbine-efficiency fault.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以兩種尾水敏感度比較增加機組後的總功率，指出為何加機組的邊際收益可能下降，再列出需要河道模型處理的情境。
knowledge.textEn: Compare aggregate power after adding units under two tailwater sensitivities. Explain diminishing marginal benefit and identify conditions where a river model is required instead of a local linear relation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「尾水抬升耦合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tailwater rise coupling"?
options: 以同步總出流與尾水位建立上升及下降兩條散點路徑，並檢查下游來水是否另有影響。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯

Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency.

quiz.explanationEn: Plot rising and falling total-flow paths against synchronized tailwater level and check downstream influences. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 尾水抬升耦合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tailwater rise coupling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「尾水抬升耦合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tailwater rise coupling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 洪水期間下游控制抬升可能主導尾水，原先低流量線性係數就不再有效；若仍沿用該係數，會高估可用水頭並誤排機組負載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: During flooding, downstream control can dominate tailwater and invalidate a coefficient fitted at low discharge. Continuing to use that coefficient overstates available head and can lead to an inappropriate allocation of generating load among units. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共同尾水河段形成水力耦合，即使電氣母線分開仍會互相影響；模型拓撲應同時保留水路與電路的差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A shared tailwater creates hydraulic coupling even with separate electrical buses; model topology should preserve the different connections of the water and electrical systems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每台機組出力永遠與其他機組無關」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Each unit output is always independent of the other units." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 洪水期間下游控制抬升可能主導尾水，原先低流量線性係數就不再有效；若仍沿用該係數，會高估可用水頭並誤排機組負載。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

洪水期間下游控制抬升可能主導尾水，原先低流量線性係數就不再有效；若仍沿用該係數，會高估可用水頭並誤排機組負載。
水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
During flooding, downstream control can dominate tailwater and invalidate a coefficient fitted at low discharge.
The numerical jet kinetic energy can directly be used as structural reaction force.
quiz.explanation: 洪水期間下游控制抬升可能主導尾水，原先低流量線性係數就不再有效；若仍沿用該係數，會高估可用水頭並誤排機組負載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: During flooding, downstream control can dominate tailwater and invalidate a coefficient fitted at low discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溢洪水舌動量」與「機組冷卻水熱升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spillway jet momentum" and "Unit cooling water temperature rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溢洪水舌動量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spillway jet momentum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溢洪水舌動量」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spillway jet momentum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洩洪水舌轉向時，其動量改變需要由導流構造與水體承受反力。教材只取一個水平分量，以質量流率乘速度差建立尺度；實際衝擊力還受壓力、重力及含氣影響。把動量通量與水舌動能分開，才能避免用能量單位直接當載重。 控制體出口角度決定速度分量，速度大小相同而方向改變仍有動量差，應先做向量解析再計算反力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溢洪水舌動量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turning a spillway jet requires a reaction associated with momentum change. One horizontal component is estimated from mass flow times velocity difference, while real impact also involves pressure, gravity and entrained air. Distinguish momentum flux from kinetic energy so that energy units are not incorrectly treated as structural force. Outlet direction determines velocity components; unchanged speed with a changed direction still produces momentum change, requiring vector resolution before calculating the associated reaction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spillway jet momentum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The numerical jet kinetic energy can directly be used as structural reaction force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溢洪水舌動量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spillway jet momentum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Turning a spillway jet requires a reaction associated with momentum change. One horizontal component is estimated from mass flow times velocity difference, while real impact also involves pressure, gravity and entrained air.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The numerical jet kinetic energy can directly be used as structural reaction force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Turning a spillway jet requires a reaction associated with momentum change.

steps.title: 溢洪水舌動量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spillway jet momentum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溢洪水舌動量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spillway jet momentum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN。模型邊界：穩態單一水平動量分量，控制面壓力另假設抵消；非完整消能池載重。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN. Model boundary: steady single horizontal momentum component with boundary pressures assumed to cancel; not a complete stilling-basin load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫控制體標出流入流出方向，量測斷面平均速度而非表面最高速度，再比較壓力與水位所帶來的額外作用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the control volume and flow directions, use section-average rather than peak surface velocity, and assess additional pressure and level forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN。模型邊界：穩態單一水平動量分量，控制面壓力另假設抵消；非完整消能池載重。

Model boundary: steady single horizontal momentum component with boundary pressures assumed to cancel; not a complete stilling-basin load.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.instruction: 先畫控制體標出流入流出方向，量測斷面平均速度而非表面最高速度，再比較壓力與水位所帶來的額外作用。若動量估算與支承反力不同，先檢查遺漏的壓力項，不直接調整流量使兩者吻合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

quiz.explanation: 換熱管結垢可能提高設備溫度卻不明顯改變總水量，僅監看流量會漏報；溫度感測器安裝在旁通流也會顯示偏低溫升，掩蓋實際熱負荷。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 轉子激振頻率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「轉子激振頻率」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor excitation frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉子每轉出現的週期作用會在頻譜形成轉速的整數倍，葉片通過與電磁作用可能具有不同階次。辨識激振頻率先把每分鐘轉數換成每秒，再乘作用次數；頻率接近結構模態只是需要調查的條件，振幅仍取決於激振強度、阻尼及量測方向。 階次追蹤應使用同步轉速訊號，轉速掃描時固定頻率分析窗可能把峰值展寬，造成誤判阻尼增加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉子激振頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Periodic forces per rotor revolution appear at integer orders of rotational frequency, with blade passage and electromagnetic forces having different orders. Convert revolutions per minute to per second before multiplying by events per turn. Proximity to a structural mode warrants investigation, while amplitude still depends on forcing, damping and measurement direction. Order tracking needs a synchronized speed reference; during a speed sweep, a fixed-frequency analysis window can smear a peak and falsely suggest greater damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotor excitation frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻率接近就足以證明發生共振」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Frequency proximity alone is enough to prove resonance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉子激振頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 轉子激振頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotor excitation frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉子激振頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotor excitation frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz。模型邊界：理想等距葉片通過頻率，不宣稱該頻率必定共振。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz. Model boundary: ideal equally spaced blade-passing frequency, not a claim that resonance necessarily occurs. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步取得轉速訊號與多方向振動，製作階次圖以區分隨轉速移動的峰值及固定結構頻率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acquire speed and multidirectional vibration together and create an order map separating speed-dependent peaks from fixed structural frequencies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 轉子激振頻率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotor excitation frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉子激振頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotor excitation frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步取得轉速訊號與多方向振動，製作階次圖以區分隨轉速移動的峰值及固定結構頻率。若峰值只在特定水頭增強，應結合壓力脈動判讀，不能單憑頻率相等就確定是機械失衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acquire speed and multidirectional vibration together and create an order map separating speed-dependent peaks from fixed structural frequencies. A peak strengthening only at certain heads calls for pressure-pulsation evidence, rather than identifying mechanical imbalance solely from a frequency match. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩種轉速計算葉片通過頻率，畫出與固定模態交會的位置，再設定足夠取樣率，說明尚需哪些振幅與相位證據判斷共振。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate blade-passing frequency at two speeds and mark crossings with a fixed mode. Select a sufficient sampling rate and identify amplitude and phase evidence still needed to diagnose resonance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測取樣率不足會把高頻折返成低頻峰，導致錯誤維修方向；只有單軸量測也可能漏掉主要模態，因此需先核對防混疊與測點方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient sampling can alias a high frequency into a low-frequency peak and misdirect maintenance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 感測取樣率不足會把高頻折返成低頻峰，導致錯誤維修方向；只有單軸量測也可能漏掉主要模態，因此需先核對防混疊與測點方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient sampling can alias a high frequency into a low-frequency peak and misdirect maintenance. A single measurement axis may miss the dominant mode, so anti-alias filtering and sensor orientation must be checked before interpreting the spectrum. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 跨機構水文與電力資料若使用不同時間基準，兩邊各自正確的曲線仍可能在合併後不守恆。對齊時必須辨認時間戳代表區間起點、終點或平均中心，並保存原始時區資訊。教材以固定流量乘時間錯移估計可能被錯配的體積，凸顯資料語義也是工程介面。 區間平均與瞬時樣本不可混用積分規則，時間戳相同仍可能代表不同觀測語義，必須保留欄位定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨境資料時間對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross border data time alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=2500 m3/s; dt=15 min; Vmis=Q*dt*60=2250000 m3。模型邊界：固定流量下的時段錯配體積，不是實際漏水或永久庫容損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=2500 m3/s; dt=15 min; Vmis=Q*dt*60=2250000 m3. Model boundary: volume assigned to the wrong interval at constant flow, not physical leakage or permanent storage loss. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 跨境資料時間對齊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cross border data time alignment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨境資料時間對齊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cross border data time alignment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一測站的原始記錄和匯總記錄核對時間戳定義，使用明確時區轉成統一時間後再積分。把尖峰事件作為對齊檢查，若總日量相同但時段殘差很大，先查時間位移而非創造額外水源項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check timestamp definitions against raw and aggregated records from one station, convert explicit time zones to a common basis, and then integrate. Use identifiable peaks for alignment. Equal daily totals with large interval residuals suggest a time shift before an additional physical water source. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立一條洪水尖峰曲線並將另一份資料錯移十五分鐘，比較日量與時段殘差，再寫出可重現的時間欄位規格與缺測旗標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a flood-peak series and shift a second copy by fifteen minutes. Compare daily volume and interval residuals, then specify reproducible timestamp fields and flags for missing or reconstructed values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：系統自動套用錯誤夏令時間規則會讓資料跳一小時，且日總量可能仍看似合理；缺測補值若未加旗標，也會讓跨境比較誤判為真實調度差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect automatic daylight-saving rule can shift data by an hour while daily totals still look plausible. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 跨境資料時間對齊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cross border data time alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨境資料時間對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cross border data time alignment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 系統自動套用錯誤夏令時間規則會讓資料跳一小時，且日總量可能仍看似合理；缺測補值若未加旗標，也會讓跨境比較誤判為真實調度差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect automatic daylight-saving rule can shift data by an hour while daily totals still look plausible. Unflagged imputation can likewise make a cross-border comparison mistake reconstructed values for a real difference in dispatch behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：區間平均與瞬時樣本不可混用積分規則，時間戳相同仍可能代表不同觀測語義，必須保留欄位定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Interval averages and instantaneous samples require different integration treatment; matching timestamps can still represent different observation meanings, so field definitions must accompany the data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「日總量吻合就保證每小時資料對齊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching daily totals guarantees that hourly records are aligned." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit rotation available hours” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定期檢修以台時表示能區分停機數量與時間，卻不能直接等同失去的發電量。機組輪替可能在水量不足期間安排，部分停機因而不減少實際出力；相反地，共同設備停機可能影響所有機組。先算可用台時，再與逐時可用水量和輸電能力配對。 計畫停機與強迫停機可有不同管理目的，但在某時段都會限制可用設備；比較前應把分類與物理狀態分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「機組輪替可用時數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unit-hours distinguish outage count from duration but do not directly equal lost energy. steps.instruction: 用事件紀錄核對每部機組停機開始與恢復時間，區分計畫檢修、故障及外部限制。再與逐時發電和來水比較，若可用台時減少而能量不變，需檢查原本是否受水量限制，而非假定紀錄錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instructionEn: Treating idle standby as equipment failure understates availability, while mechanical readiness alone overlooks electrical export restrictions. steps.instruction: 閘門驅動需要克服水力作用、門重及摩擦，但水流通過閘孔的水力功率並不全由啟閉機提供。教材使用已知提升力與速度估算電端需求，並把啟動峰值、制動和結構反力另列。力的取得應來自明確載重組合，不能由總洩洪量任意換算。 提升力可能隨門位改變，完整動作能量需沿行程積分力，固定力乘行程只適用於明示的簡化情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閘門驅動功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 同步比較啟閉電流、位移速度與兩側吊點力，檢查門體是否偏斜及摩擦是否隨方向改變。若功率高而位移低，應查卡阻與制動未釋放；不能只靠額定馬達容量推定閘門能正常動作。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare drive current, movement speed and forces at both lifting points, checking skew and direction-dependent friction. High power with little movement suggests binding or an unreleased brake; nameplate motor capacity alone does not establish that the gate can perform its intended movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把提升速度減半而力保持不變，重算功率與動作時間，再加入不對稱吊點荷載，說明總功率計算為何不能驗證門體抗扭能力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve lifting speed at unchanged force and recalculate power and travel time. Add unequal lifting-point loads and explain why the total power calculation cannot verify the gate resistance to twisting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

High power with little movement suggests binding or an unreleased brake; nameplate motor capacity alone does not establish that the gate can perform its intended movement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閘門驅動功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gate drive power requirement"?
options: 同步比較啟閉電流、位移速度與兩側吊點力，檢查門體是否偏斜及摩擦是否隨方向改變。

steps.title: 閘門驅動功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gate drive power requirement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閘門驅動功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gate drive power requirement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. Lubrication cannot correct geometric misalignment, so the source of unequal loading must be identified before choosing a maintenance response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：提升力可能隨門位改變，完整動作能量需沿行程積分力，固定力乘行程只適用於明示的簡化情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lifting force can vary with position, so complete travel energy integrates force along displacement; constant force times travel applies only to the declared simplified case.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「啟閉機需提供通過閘孔的全部水力功率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The gate drive must supply all hydraulic power flowing through the opening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. Lubrication cannot correct geometric misalignment, so the source of unequal loading must be identified before choosing a maintenance response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閘門驅動功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gate drive power requirement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。
只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force.
Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency.
quiz.explanation: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 黑部水壩
summary: 由黑部峽谷的拱壩背景出發，把融雪集水、岩盤承載、混凝土溫度、輸水損失與下游流量變化連成同一個守恆問題。學員比較靜水、穩流及瞬變三種時間尺度，辨識簡化模型所能回答的問題。所有參數為分開標明的假想教材，不能當成實際設備設定。
summaryEn: Starting from the Kurobe mountain setting, this course connects snowmelt collection, rock support, concrete temperature, conduit losses and downstream flow changes through conservation and compatibility. Learners distinguish static, steady and transient time scales and identify what each reduced model can actually answer. Every numerical parameter is separately identified as hypothetical teaching data rather than an equipment setting.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想融雪流入為每秒二十立方公尺、放流每秒十二立方公尺，六小時內增加十七萬二千八百立方公尺蓄量；這只是水量帳，尚未求出水位。另一假想拱圈以壓力零點八兆帕、半徑一百二十公尺、厚度十公尺求得平均膜壓應力九點六兆帕，不能取代三維壩體分析。把厚度增加百分之二十至十二公尺，應力降至八兆帕；比較結果時仍需考慮岩盤變形與溫度拘束。 核驗：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed snowmelt inflow of 20 m3/s and release of 12 m3/s, six hours adds 172800 m3 of storage; a storage curve is still needed to infer water level. A separate ideal arch strip with pressure 0.8 MPa, radius 120 m and thickness 10 m has mean membrane compression of 9.6 MPa. Increasing thickness by twenty percent to 12 m gives 8 MPa. This sensitivity does not replace three dimensional dam analysis, because foundation movement, bending and thermal restraint remain outside the strip model. Verification: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」與「理想拱圈膜壓應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Snowmelt pulses and storage" and "Ideal arch membrane compression": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snowmelt pulses and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。黑部背景的水量帳必須將庫區當作控制體，分別列出入流、放流與時段，蓄量增加後還需面積高程曲線才能換成水位。 融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. A reservoir control volume separates inflow, release and duration; storage change still needs an area-elevation relationship before it becomes a level change. Snow water equivalent and temporary soil storage also control melt runoff. Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Snowmelt pulses and storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Snowmelt pulses and storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳
knowledge.text: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。黑部背景的水量帳必須將庫區當作控制體，分別列出入流、放流與時段，蓄量增加後還需面積高程曲線才能換成水位。
knowledge.textEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. A reservoir control volume separates inflow, release and duration; storage change still needs an area-elevation relationship before it becomes a level change.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Snowmelt pulses and storage" is correct?
options: 蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升
高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。
只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
optionsEn: Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion
Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain.
Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
quiz.explanation: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snowmelt pulses and storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。適用邊界：假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Applicable boundary: Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。適用邊界：假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Applicable boundary: Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Snowmelt pulses and storage", which statement holds?
options: 每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snowmelt pulses and storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將入流峰值改成前兩小時三十、後四小時十五立方公尺每秒，分段求蓄量並與平均法比較，說明兩者何時相同、何時因出口變化而不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Replace constant inflow with thirty cubic metres per second for two hours and fifteen for four hours. Integrate segments and explain when averaging preserves volume and when a varying outlet invalidates the comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snowmelt pulses and storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Even an apparently correct daily volume can conceal the short-term level maximum that matters to storage checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Even an apparently correct daily volume can conceal the short-term level maximum that matters to storage checks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Snowmelt pulses and storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。
只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration.
Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
quiz.explanation: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想拱圈膜壓應力」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal arch membrane compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。把一條水平窄帶理想化為等厚圓環，只保留膜作用，可從局部力平衡看見半徑與厚度如何改變平均壓應力；實際雙曲率壩仍有懸臂及彎曲。 薄膜模型的壓力乘半徑是每單位高度的環向內力，再除厚度才成為平均應力；這兩個量的單位與用途應分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想拱圈膜壓應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. An ideal constant-thickness circular strip retains membrane action and reveals radius and thickness sensitivity, while the real double-curvature body also carries cantilever and bending effects. Pressure times radius is circumferential force per unit height; division by thickness converts it to mean stress. Distinguishing force resultant from stress makes the approximation and its units explicit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal arch membrane compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ideal arch membrane compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力
knowledge.text: 曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。把一條水平窄帶理想化為等厚圓環，只保留膜作用，可從局部力平衡看見半徑與厚度如何改變平均壓應力；實際雙曲率壩仍有懸臂及彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. An ideal constant-thickness circular strip retains membrane action and reveals radius and thickness sensitivity, while the real double-curvature body also carries cantilever and bending effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理想拱圈膜壓應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ideal arch membrane compression" is correct?
options: 只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度
曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。
optionsEn: Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides.
quiz.explanation: 曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ideal arch membrane compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Uniform normal pressure on a continuous ideal arch strip; joints, foundation compliance and three-dimensional bending are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Uniform normal pressure on a continuous ideal arch strip; joints, foundation compliance and three-dimensional bending are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想拱圈膜壓應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal arch membrane compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。再改變厚度與曲率而保持水壓不變，確認所得應力趨勢合理，並列出必須由三維模型補回的支承條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium. Change thickness and radius separately at fixed pressure, check the trends and identify support conditions that must return in a three-dimensional model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持水壓與半徑不變，將厚度增加到十二公尺後重算，畫出厚度與應力的反比曲線，並說明為何材料用量與整體變形不會只由此曲線決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase thickness to twelve metres at fixed pressure and radius, recalculate and plot the inverse relationship. Explain why this curve alone cannot determine material quantity, foundation response or the complete deformation field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。再改變厚度與曲率而保持水壓不變，確認所得應力趨勢合理，並列出必須由三維模型補回的支承條件。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium. Change thickness and radius separately at fixed pressure, check the trends and identify support conditions that must return in a three-dimensional model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持水壓與半徑不變，將厚度增加到十二公尺後重算，畫出厚度與應力的反比曲線，並說明為何材料用量與整體變形不會只由此曲線決定。
knowledge.textEn: Increase thickness to twelve metres at fixed pressure and radius, recalculate and plot the inverse relationship. Explain why this curve alone cannot determine material quantity, foundation response or the complete deformation field.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想拱圈膜壓應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ideal arch membrane compression"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。
監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium.
A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety
quiz.explanation: 在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ideal arch membrane compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A low average cannot establish that local tensile cracking is absent. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄膜模型的壓力乘半徑是每單位高度的環向內力，再除厚度才成為平均應力；這兩個量的單位與用途應分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguishing force resultant from stress makes the approximation and its units explicit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。
knowledge.textEn: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A low average cannot establish that local tensile cracking is absent.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「理想拱圈膜壓應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ideal arch membrane compression" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度
將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions.
quiz.explanation: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩盤順應與推力位移」與「混凝土受拘束溫降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abutment compliance under thrust" and "Restrained concrete cooling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩盤順應與推力位移」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment compliance under thrust” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。以一個等效彈簧表示局部岩盤，可把推力與位移連起來，但剛度應包含受力範圍，不能只拿完整岩芯彈性模數直接代入。 同一模數配上不同受力面積或岩盤有效深度，會形成不同支承剛度，因而需要先說明彈簧代表的幾何尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩盤順應與推力位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. A local equivalent spring relates force to displacement, but its stiffness includes geometry and cannot simply be replaced by the elastic modulus of an intact core sample. The same modulus combined with different loaded areas or effective rock depths produces different support stiffnesses. The equivalent spring therefore needs a declared geometric scale before its displacement has physical meaning. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment compliance under thrust” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩盤順應與推力位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Abutment compliance under thrust”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移
knowledge.text: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。以一個等效彈簧表示局部岩盤，可把推力與位移連起來，但剛度應包含受力範圍，不能只拿完整岩芯彈性模數直接代入。
knowledge.textEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. A local equivalent spring relates force to displacement, but its stiffness includes geometry and cannot simply be replaced by the elastic modulus of an intact core sample.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩盤順應與推力位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abutment compliance under thrust" is correct?
options: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。
岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度
每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變
optionsEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement.
Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
quiz.explanation: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩盤順應與推力位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abutment compliance under thrust” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。適用邊界：單一線彈性反力方向，剛度屬假想整體支承，不表示岩盤試驗值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Applicable boundary: One linear reaction direction; stiffness represents a hypothetical support assembly rather than a measured rock property. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。適用邊界：單一線彈性反力方向，剛度屬假想整體支承，不表示岩盤試驗值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Applicable boundary: One linear reaction direction; stiffness represents a hypothetical support assembly rather than a measured rock property.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩盤順應與推力位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abutment compliance under thrust", which statement holds?
options: 機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。
抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率
optionsEn: Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m.
Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩盤順應與推力位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Abutment compliance under thrust” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。使用載入與卸載兩段斜率比較等效剛度，若回程無法閉合，應另外檢查節理滑移與儀器基座變動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Estimate stiffness from both loading and unloading slopes. If the loop does not close, investigate joint slip and movement of the instrument base separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：另設左岸剛度為一萬二千兆牛頓每公尺，在相同反力下比較兩岸位移，討論差異位移可能如何改變拱圈變形，並指出仍缺少哪些三維平衡條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign the left support a stiffness of twelve thousand meganewtons per metre and compare movements under equal reactions. Discuss possible arch distortion and identify the missing equilibrium conditions needed before predicting redistribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。使用載入與卸載兩段斜率比較等效剛度，若回程無法閉合，應另外檢查節理滑移與儀器基座變動。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Estimate stiffness from both loading and unloading slopes. If the loop does not close, investigate joint slip and movement of the instrument base separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 另設左岸剛度為一萬二千兆牛頓每公尺，在相同反力下比較兩岸位移，討論差異位移可能如何改變拱圈變形，並指出仍缺少哪些三維平衡條件。
knowledge.textEn: Assign the left support a stiffness of twelve thousand meganewtons per metre and compare movements under equal reactions. Discuss possible arch distortion and identify the missing equilibrium conditions needed before predicting redistribution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩盤順應與推力位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Abutment compliance under thrust"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量
把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch
Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone.
quiz.explanation: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩盤順應與推力位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Abutment compliance under thrust” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. steps.instruction: 混凝土冷卻本來會縮短，但岩盤或相鄰塊體若限制收縮，就可能產生拉應力。高山環境的季節溫度與壩內溫度不會同步，完全拘束模型只能用來辨識熱應變的量級，不能忽略徐變及接縫開合。 熱應變本身沒有力的單位，只有與彈性模數及拘束條件結合才形成應力；自由收縮與完全拘束提供兩個理想端點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土受拘束溫降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling concrete tends to contract, while restraint by rock or adjoining blocks can create tension. Mountain air and internal concrete temperatures respond on different schedules, so full restraint indicates a thermal strain scale without representing creep or joint opening. Thermal strain has no force unit. Stress emerges only when stiffness and restraint are supplied, making free contraction and full restraint distinct ideal endpoints for interpreting a temperature change. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa。適用邊界：完全軸向拘束、線彈性且忽略徐變；正值表示冷卻所致拉應力量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Full axial restraint, linear elasticity and no creep; the positive value is the tensile stress scale from cooling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較表面與內部溫度計的相位差，先決定哪個溫度代表受拘束體積。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
