quiz.explanation: 直接以每日氣溫降幅代替整塊混凝土溫降，通常誇大深部瞬時應力；若忽略長期徐變的鬆弛，也可能把彈性上限誤讀成持續存在的實際應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using daily air cooling as the temperature change of an entire block exaggerates immediate interior response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長引水管的沿程損失」與「高水頭水能轉換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Friction in a long conduit" and "High head energy conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Friction in a long conduit: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長引水管的沿程損失」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Friction in a long conduit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高水頭發電的毛落差不會全部到達機組，長輸水通道把部分機械能耗散成熱。達西摩擦式將長徑比與速度平方連結，黑部背景下可用來比較增大管徑與增加流量的代價，但粗糙度與局部損失仍需另計。 能量線沿流向下降，而壓力線還受高程和速度影響；把兩者分開可避免看到局部低壓便誤判全部水頭耗失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長引水管的沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gross mountain head does not all reach a generating unit because a long waterway dissipates mechanical energy. Darcy friction connects length-to-diameter ratio with velocity squared, allowing comparison of diameter and discharge choices while roughness and local losses remain separate inputs. The energy line falls along the conduit, while the pressure line also depends on elevation and velocity. Separating them prevents local low pressure from being mistaken for total head dissipation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Friction in a long conduit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長引水管的沿程損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Friction in a long conduit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長引水管的沿程損失
knowledge.text: 高水頭發電的毛落差不會全部到達機組，長輸水通道把部分機械能耗散成熱。達西摩擦式將長徑比與速度平方連結，黑部背景下可用來比較增大管徑與增加流量的代價，但粗糙度與局部損失仍需另計。
knowledge.textEn: Gross mountain head does not all reach a generating unit because a long waterway dissipates mechanical energy. Darcy friction connects length-to-diameter ratio with velocity squared, allowing comparison of diameter and discharge choices while roughness and local losses remain separate inputs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長引水管的沿程損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Friction in a long conduit" is correct?
options: 沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例
機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
高水頭發電的毛落差不會全部到達機組，長輸水通道把部分機械能耗散成熱。
optionsEn: Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity
Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Gross mountain head does not all reach a generating unit because a long waterway dissipates mechanical energy.
quiz.explanation: 高水頭發電的毛落差不會全部到達機組，長輸水通道把部分機械能耗散成熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gross mountain head does not all reach a generating unit because a long waterway dissipates mechanical energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Friction in a long conduit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長引水管的沿程損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Friction in a long conduit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m。適用邊界：滿管穩流且使用達西摩擦因子，不是范寧因子；未計彎頭與入口。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m. Applicable boundary: Steady full-pipe flow using the Darcy friction factor, not the Fanning factor; bends and entrance losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m。適用邊界：滿管穩流且使用達西摩擦因子，不是范寧因子；未計彎頭與入口。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m. Applicable boundary: Steady full-pipe flow using the Darcy friction factor, not the Fanning factor; bends and entrance losses are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長引水管的沿程損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Friction in a long conduit", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m。
抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率
每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m.
Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency
Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Friction in a long conduit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長引水管的沿程損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Friction in a long conduit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。選取穩定流量時段擬合摩擦因子，再檢查不同流量是否維持合理趨勢，避免把閥件損失全塞入沿程係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge. Fit the friction factor during steady periods and examine its trend across flows rather than absorbing every valve loss into distributed friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持管徑與粗糙度不變，把速度提高百分之二十，重算水頭損失及增加比例，再列出摩擦因子可能隨雷諾數改變而使簡化比較失準的情況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise velocity by twenty percent at fixed diameter and roughness, recalculate head loss and its percentage increase, then identify circumstances where a changing Reynolds number alters the friction factor and weakens the simple comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。選取穩定流量時段擬合摩擦因子，再檢查不同流量是否維持合理趨勢，避免把閥件損失全塞入沿程係數。
knowledge.textEn: Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge. Fit the friction factor during steady periods and examine its trend across flows rather than absorbing every valve loss into distributed friction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持管徑與粗糙度不變，把速度提高百分之二十，重算水頭損失及增加比例，再列出摩擦因子可能隨雷諾數改變而使簡化比較失準的情況。
knowledge.textEn: Raise velocity by twenty percent at fixed diameter and roughness, recalculate head loss and its percentage increase, then identify circumstances where a changing Reynolds number alters the friction factor and weakens the simple comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長引水管的沿程損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Friction in a long conduit"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。
只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge.
Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
quiz.explanation: 用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Friction in a long conduit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長引水管的沿程損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Friction in a long conduit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Ignoring the velocity-squared term because gross head is large understates added losses at higher flow and miscalculates the net head available to equipment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量線沿流向下降，而壓力線還受高程和速度影響；把兩者分開可避免看到局部低壓便誤判全部水頭耗失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separating them prevents local low pressure from being mistaken for total head dissipation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Ignoring the velocity-squared term because gross head is large understates added losses at higher flow and miscalculates the net head available to equipment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長引水管的沿程損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Friction in a long conduit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error.
quiz.explanation: 把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高水頭水能轉換」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High head energy conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。黑部案例應先把水路損失從毛水頭扣掉，再談電功率，否則同一耗能會被遺漏或重複扣除。 控制體邊界必須說明是否包含發電機、變壓器與輔機用電，否則兩個看似相同效率可能其實分母分子範圍不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高水頭水能轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. In a high-head case, waterway losses must be separated from gross head before applying an efficiency boundary that clearly identifies which equipment is included. The conversion boundary must identify whether generator, transformer and auxiliary consumption are included. Otherwise two apparently comparable efficiencies can refer to different energy inputs and different reported electrical outputs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High head energy conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High head energy conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高水頭水能轉換
knowledge.text: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。黑部案例應先把水路損失從毛水頭扣掉，再談電功率，否則同一耗能會被遺漏或重複扣除。
knowledge.textEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. In a high-head case, waterway losses must be separated from gross head before applying an efficiency boundary that clearly identifies which equipment is included.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高水頭水能轉換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High head energy conversion" is correct?
options: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。
機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力
optionsEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output.
Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location
quiz.explanation: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高水頭水能轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High head energy conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW。適用邊界：穩定水頭與流量，效率包含假想機電轉換但不含已扣除的水路損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW. Applicable boundary: Constant head and discharge; assumed electromechanical efficiency excludes waterway losses already removed from net head. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高水頭水能轉換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High head energy conversion", which statement holds?

原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW。
蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升

Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3.
Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高水頭水能轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High head energy conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。若估算效率超過一，先查毛淨水頭混淆及千瓦兆瓦換算，再比較壓力與流量儀表的校正紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow. An efficiency above unity requires checking gross versus net head and power-unit conversions before investigating calibration of pressure and discharge instruments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用六小時等功率運行求兆瓦小時，再把淨水頭降低十公尺重算差值，註明效率保持不變是敏感度假設，不是實際機組效率曲線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate megawatt-hours for six hours at constant output, then reduce net head by ten metres and compare energy. State explicitly that unchanged efficiency is a sensitivity assumption rather than a measured turbine performance curve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。若估算效率超過一，先查毛淨水頭混淆及千瓦兆瓦換算，再比較壓力與流量儀表的校正紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow. An efficiency above unity requires checking gross versus net head and power-unit conversions before investigating calibration of pressure and discharge instruments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用六小時等功率運行求兆瓦小時，再把淨水頭降低十公尺重算差值，註明效率保持不變是敏感度假設，不是實際機組效率曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate megawatt-hours for six hours at constant output, then reduce net head by ten metres and compare energy. State explicitly that unchanged efficiency is a sensitivity assumption rather than a measured turbine performance curve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高水頭水能轉換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High head energy conversion"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度
分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow.
quiz.explanation: 分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高水頭水能轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High head energy conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. An efficiency that already includes waterway losses, followed by another friction deduction, counts the same energy loss twice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：控制體邊界必須說明是否包含發電機、變壓器與輔機用電，否則兩個看似相同效率可能其實分母分子範圍不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Otherwise two apparently comparable efficiencies can refer to different energy inputs and different reported electrical outputs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。
knowledge.textEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. An efficiency that already includes waterway losses, followed by another friction deduction, counts the same energy loss twice.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高水頭水能轉換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High head energy conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力
optionsEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location

quiz.explanationEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快速流速變化與水錘」與「施工湧水的抽排功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rapid velocity change and water hammer" and "Pumping energy for tunnel inflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快速流速變化與水錘：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rapid velocity change and water hammer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快速流速變化與水錘」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。焦科夫斯基關係給出理想快速變化的壓力尺度，與穩流摩擦屬不同物理過程，必須先比較變化時間與波的往返時間。 波速由水與管壁的合成可壓縮性決定，並非水流平均速度；壓力訊息能快速往返，而水體本身位移相對較小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速流速變化與水錘」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly. The Joukowsky relation gives an ideal rapid-change pressure scale, which differs from steady friction and requires comparison of change duration with the wave round-trip time. Wave speed reflects the combined compressibility of water and wall, not mean flow velocity. A pressure signal can travel rapidly back and forth while the water itself moves a comparatively short distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快速流速變化與水錘」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

options: 一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa。適用邊界：單相滿管、快速變化且不發生液柱分離；不是實際閥門操作指令。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 快速流速變化與水錘：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快速流速變化與水錘」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知管長與波速估算壓力波往返時間，再確認壓力記錄取樣足以解析波峰。對照上下游波形的到達時間與反射極性，並檢查感測器量程是否把峰值截平而低估瞬變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate round-trip travel time from pipe length and wave speed, then confirm that pressure sampling resolves the peak. Compare arrival times and reflection signs at different locations and check whether sensor saturation clips the recorded maximum. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在紙上比較波速七百與一千公尺每秒的壓力增量，說明管壁柔度如何影響結果，再列出需要瞬變模擬才能回答的反射與負壓問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare pressure increments for wave speeds of seven hundred and one thousand metres per second. Explain the role of wall flexibility and identify reflection and sub-atmospheric-pressure questions that require a transient model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若局部壓力降到汽化條件，液柱分離及再結合可能改變峰值，簡單線性式不再完整；只把平均壓力加上算得增量也會忽略反射與高程分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If local pressure reaches vapor conditions, column separation and rejoining can alter peaks beyond the simple linear model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速流速變化與水錘」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若局部壓力降到汽化條件，液柱分離及再結合可能改變峰值，簡單線性式不再完整；只把平均壓力加上算得增量也會忽略反射與高程分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If local pressure reaches vapor conditions, column separation and rejoining can alter peaks beyond the simple linear model. Adding one increment to an average pressure also neglects reflections and the elevation-dependent pressure distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波速由水與管壁的合成可壓縮性決定，並非水流平均速度；壓力訊息能快速往返，而水體本身位移相對較小。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A pressure signal can travel rapidly back and forth while the water itself moves a comparatively short distance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency

steps.instruction: 黑四施工歷史中的地下水困難提醒工程師，排水是水量、揚程與能源的聯合問題。假想隧道集水坑把來水提升到出口時，所需電功率須除以泵組效率；進水量估計不能只靠某一次乾天觀察。 總揚程包含出口與集水坑的位能差及流動損失，泵的工作點由供能曲線與管路需求曲線交會決定而非單看銘牌。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工湧水的抽排功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The historical groundwater difficulty highlights dewatering as a coupled flow, lift and energy problem. A hypothetical tunnel sump must lift inflow to an outlet, so electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump efficiency rather than multiplying by it. Total head contains elevation difference and flow losses. The operating point follows the intersection of pump supply and system demand curves, rather than being fixed by the nameplate flow alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy for tunnel inflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工湧水的抽排功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。以多個來水時段建立範圍，並檢查集水坑儲量變化，避免把坑內暫存水誤當穩定地下水補注。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge. Examine several inflow periods and sump storage changes so temporarily stored water is not mistaken for sustained groundwater recharge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把效率降到零點五五，計算相同排水量所需輸入功率，再另列水位上升時總揚程改變的方向，說明不能只用電費判斷抽排能力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce efficiency to zero point five five and recalculate input power at the same flow. Separately determine how changing sump level alters head and explain why electricity consumption alone cannot demonstrate dewatering capacity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工湧水的抽排功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy for tunnel inflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工湧水的抽排功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. Abrasion or blockage can reduce efficiency, so rising electrical current may accompany falling water delivery and a continuing increase in sump level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總揚程包含出口與集水坑的位能差及流動損失，泵的工作點由供能曲線與管路需求曲線交會決定而非單看銘牌。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The operating point follows the intersection of pump supply and system demand curves, rather than being fixed by the nameplate flow alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工湧水的抽排功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping energy for tunnel inflow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全
把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety
Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head.
quiz.explanation: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水位溫度與位移殘差」與「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Level temperature and displacement residuals" and "Downstream buffer storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位溫度與位移殘差」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level temperature and displacement residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩位移常同時回應庫水壓與季節溫度，因此單看位移大小可能混淆可逆變形與異常。假想回歸模型先用水位及內部溫度預測位移，再看觀測殘差，但殘差只能提示進一步檢查，不能自行判定損傷。 係數描述既有資料中的統計關聯，不保證每一項都是獨立因果；水位與季節高度相關時，係數可變得難以辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位溫度與位移殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch displacement can respond to both reservoir loading and seasonal temperature. A hypothetical regression predicts movement from level and internal temperature before examining residuals, separating explanatory variables while leaving damage diagnosis to additional evidence and appropriate model validation. Coefficients describe associations in the calibration record rather than independent causal mechanisms. Strong correlation between reservoir level and season can make individual parameter estimates difficult to identify even when overall fit is good. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level temperature and displacement residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位溫度與位移殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level temperature and displacement residuals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A hypothetical regression predicts movement from level and internal temperature before examining residuals, separating explanatory variables while leaving damage diagnosis to additional evidence and appropriate model validation.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位溫度與位移殘差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level temperature and displacement residuals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。適用邊界：線性係數是假想校準值，變量範圍限於訓練資料，未計時間延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm. Applicable boundary: Coefficients are hypothetical calibrations restricted to the training range, with time lag omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位溫度與位移殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level temperature and displacement residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。對同時段的獨立儀器及基準點做交叉比對，若殘差突然跳變，先查換機、零點重設與缺值插補紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level. Cross-check independent instruments and references over matching periods, investigating replacement, zero resets and interpolation records before interpreting an abrupt residual jump. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一個一毫米的儀器零點偏移後重新求殘差，說明如何用鄰近儀器區分共同結構位移與單一測點故障，並列出不能只靠回歸辨識的因素。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a one-millimetre zero shift and recalculate the residual. Explain how nearby instruments could distinguish common structural movement from a single-point fault and identify causes that regression alone cannot resolve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以同一組資料擬合又驗證會掩蓋過度擬合；把未曾出現的高水位輸入線性模型，可能得到看似精確卻無外推根據的預測，延誤必要的人工判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fitting and validating on identical records conceals overfitting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位溫度與位移殘差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level temperature and displacement residuals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以同一組資料擬合又驗證會掩蓋過度擬合；把未曾出現的高水位輸入線性模型，可能得到看似精確卻無外推根據的預測，延誤必要的人工判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fitting and validating on identical records conceals overfitting. Feeding an unprecedented high level into a linear model can produce a precise-looking prediction without extrapolation support and distract from the need for expert interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：係數描述既有資料中的統計關聯，不保證每一項都是獨立因果；水位與季節高度相關時，係數可變得難以辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Strong correlation between reservoir level and season can make individual parameter estimates difficult to identify even when overall fit is good.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以同一組資料擬合又驗證會掩蓋過度擬合；把未曾出現的高水位輸入線性模型，可能得到看似精確卻無外推根據的預測，延誤必要的人工判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Fitting and validating on identical records conceals overfitting. Feeding an unprecedented high level into a linear model can produce a precise-looking prediction without extrapolation support and distract from the need for expert interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanationEn: Fitting and validating on identical records conceals overfitting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Downstream buffer storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downstream buffer storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電放流可能在短時間變動，而下游希望較平順的水量。假想緩衝池以暫時蓄水吸收入出流差額，所需容積由整個時段積分決定，不能只用最大流量相減而忽略持續時間與初始水位。 緩衝所需容積是累積差額曲線的最大與最小之差，若脈衝並非矩形，必須先積分完整歷線才能辨認容量需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generating releases can change faster than desired downstream delivery. A hypothetical buffer stores the time integral of the inlet-outlet difference; required volume depends on duration and initial storage, not merely the difference between two peak discharge values. For a repeating cycle, required active storage is the range of the cumulative imbalance curve. Nonrectangular pulses require integration of the complete hydrograph before the relevant volume can be identified. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downstream buffer storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Downstream buffer storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量
knowledge.text: 發電放流可能在短時間變動，而下游希望較平順的水量。假想緩衝池以暫時蓄水吸收入出流差額，所需容積由整個時段積分決定，不能只用最大流量相減而忽略持續時間與初始水位。
knowledge.textEn: Generating releases can change faster than desired downstream delivery. A hypothetical buffer stores the time integral of the inlet-outlet difference; required volume depends on duration and initial storage, not merely the difference between two peak discharge values.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Downstream buffer storage" is correct?
options: 每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量
發電放流可能在短時間變動，而下游希望較平順的水量。
蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升
optionsEn: Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch
Generating releases can change faster than desired downstream delivery.
Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion
quiz.explanation: 發電放流可能在短時間變動，而下游希望較平順的水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Generating releases can change faster than desired downstream delivery. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Downstream buffer storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Downstream buffer storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3。適用邊界：半小時矩形入流脈衝、出口固定且無溢流，未指定實際下游運用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3. Applicable boundary: A thirty-minute rectangular inflow pulse with fixed outlet and no overflow, without specifying real downstream operation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3。適用邊界：半小時矩形入流脈衝、出口固定且無溢流，未指定實際下游運用。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3. Applicable boundary: A thirty-minute rectangular inflow pulse with fixed outlet and no overflow, without specifying real downstream operation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。加入可用庫容上限時，要同時保留初始蓄量，不可從零開始假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them. Check whether subsequent flow differences restore the initial state, retaining initial storage explicitly when comparing against an available-volume limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設第二個相同脈衝在一小時後到達，安排中間假想出流大於入流的時段，計算恢復所需時間並說明若恢復不足會如何累積庫水。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Downstream buffer storage"?
options: 將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力
optionsEn: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location
quiz.explanation: 將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Downstream buffer storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Downstream buffer storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. Checking a single pulse while ignoring the repeated cycle can falsely suggest that one fixed buffer volume will always accommodate the upstream release pattern. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩衝所需容積是累積差額曲線的最大與最小之差，若脈衝並非矩形，必須先積分完整歷線才能辨認容量需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nonrectangular pulses require integration of the complete hydrograph before the relevant volume can be identified.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. Checking a single pulse while ignoring the repeated cycle can falsely suggest that one fixed buffer volume will always accommodate the upstream release pattern.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Downstream buffer storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。
蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage.
Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion
quiz.explanation: 緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 翡翠水庫大壩
summary: 翡翠案例結合拱壩的水平傳力與垂直懸臂、基岩層面有效應力、溫度接縫和水庫分層取水。課程將防洪蓄量、溢流消能及原水混合分開建模，避免把水位、濁度和結構安全視為同一指標。每個推導均要求確認幾何、量測基準與不能外推的條件。
summaryEn: The Feitsui case combines horizontal arch transfer and vertical cantilever response with bedding-plane effective stress, thermal joints and stratified withdrawal. Flood storage, spillway dissipation and raw-water mixing are modeled separately so that level, turbidity and structural response are not confused. Each derivation requires explicit geometry, measurement references and limits on extrapolation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想有效水量二千萬立方公尺、平均取水每秒四立方公尺，以體積除流量得名目停留時間五百萬秒，約五十七點八七日；實際水齡仍受密度流與短路影響。另設水平拱剛度三千、垂直懸臂剛度二千兆牛頓每公尺，在總力五十兆牛頓下，拱分擔三十兆牛頓。若拱剛度下降百分之二十，拱分力成二十七點二七三兆牛頓。這是共同位移的雙彈簧模型，不應拿分力直接宣布壩體安全。 核驗：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 million m3 of active water and mean withdrawal of 4 m3/s. Volume divided by flow gives a nominal residence time of five million seconds, or 57.87 days; actual water age still depends on density currents and short circuiting. Separately, arch and cantilever stiffnesses of 3000 and 2000 MN/m share a 50 MN force, giving the arch 30 MN. Reducing arch stiffness by twenty percent changes that share to 27.273 MN. This common-displacement spring analogy identifies redistribution, not a verified stress field or a dam safety conclusion. Verification: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「名目停留時間與水齡」與「曲面水平投影的水推力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nominal residence and water age" and "Hydrostatic horizontal projected force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「名目停留時間與水齡」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal residence and water age” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。翡翠背景下的真實水齡還取決於密度分層、入流短路及死水區，所以這個商不能代表每滴水都在庫內停留相同天數。 名目時間只包含一個平均流率，若入流沿某深度快速通過，水庫可同時存在很年輕的水團與多年未交換的深層水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「名目停留時間與水齡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. Actual water age also depends on stratification, short-circuit inflows and stagnant zones, so the quotient does not describe the travel time of every parcel. A nominal time contains only one averaged flow. Rapid passage along one depth can coexist with young water parcels and deep water that exchanges much more slowly, creating a broad age distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal residence and water age” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「名目停留時間與水齡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal residence and water age”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 名目停留時間與水齡
knowledge.text: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。翡翠背景下的真實水齡還取決於密度分層、入流短路及死水區，所以這個商不能代表每滴水都在庫內停留相同天數。
knowledge.textEn: Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. Actual water age also depends on stratification, short-circuit inflows and stagnant zones, so the quotient does not describe the travel time of every parcel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「名目停留時間與水齡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nominal residence and water age" is correct?
options: 名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡
供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。
曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積
optionsEn: Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel
Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand.
Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area
quiz.explanation: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「名目停留時間與水齡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal residence and water age” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。適用邊界：穩態體積與平均流量的尺度估算，沒有假設真實水庫完全混合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day. Applicable boundary: A steady-volume and mean-flow scale estimate, without asserting complete mixing in the actual reservoir. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。適用邊界：穩態體積與平均流量的尺度估算，沒有假設真實水庫完全混合。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day. Applicable boundary: A steady-volume and mean-flow scale estimate, without asserting complete mixing in the actual reservoir.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「名目停留時間與水齡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal residence and water age", which statement holds?
options: 不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。
optionsEn: Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「名目停留時間與水齡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nominal residence and water age” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將有效交換體積減為原值七成，計算名目停留時間，再畫完全混合與短路兩種概念流路，說明單一平均數無法分辨何者。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce the actively exchanging volume to seventy percent, recalculate turnover and sketch complete mixing and short-circuit pathways. Explain why the same nominal mean cannot distinguish their very different age distributions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以整座水庫體積計算後宣稱污染會在該天數全部消失，忽略長尾水齡與沉積再釋出；短路可能讓部分新入流水更早抵達取水口，兩種偏差可同時存在。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Claiming that contamination disappears after one nominal residence time ignores long age tails and sediment release. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「名目停留時間與水齡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「名目停留時間與水齡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nominal residence and water age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以整座水庫體積計算後宣稱污染會在該天數全部消失，忽略長尾水齡與沉積再釋出；短路可能讓部分新入流水更早抵達取水口，兩種偏差可同時存在。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming that contamination disappears after one nominal residence time ignores long age tails and sediment release. Short circuiting can simultaneously deliver some newly arrived water much earlier to the intake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：名目時間只包含一個平均流率，若入流沿某深度快速通過，水庫可同時存在很年輕的水團與多年未交換的深層水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rapid passage along one depth can coexist with young water parcels and deep water that exchanges much more slowly, creating a broad age distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 曲面水平投影的水推力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic horizontal projected force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面水平投影的水推力」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲面上的水壓始終沿表面法線，水平分力可用垂直投影面積積分取得。翡翠拱壩背景的示範只計一塊假想投影條帶，不把合力直接當作壩基剪力，也不忽略曲面另外可能承受的垂直分量。 積分可用水平分力逐點相加，也可先投影再積分，兩種路徑在靜水條件下應一致，這提供幾何模型的獨立檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面水平投影的水推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure acts normally to a curved surface, while its horizontal component follows integration over the vertical projection. This exercise treats a hypothetical projected strip rather than equating the result to foundation shear or discarding other force components on the curved body. The horizontal force may be integrated from local components or calculated after projection. Under hydrostatic conditions these routes must agree, providing an independent geometric check without assuming a structural load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面水平投影的水推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

This exercise treats a hypothetical projected strip rather than equating the result to foundation shear or discarding other force components on the curved body.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面水平投影的水推力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area
Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged
Pressure acts normally to a curved surface, while its horizontal component follows integration over the vertical projection.
