steps.title: 曲面水平投影的水推力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic horizontal projected force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面水平投影的水推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN。適用邊界：頂端位於自由液面的垂直矩形投影，靜水且尾水壓未計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN. Applicable boundary: A vertical rectangular projection starting at the free surface, with hydrostatic water and no downstream pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出隨深度線性增加的壓力三角形，用底壓乘面積再除二重算合力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the triangular pressure distribution and independently recover force from half the base pressure times projected area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN。適用邊界：頂端位於自由液面的垂直矩形投影，靜水且尾水壓未計。

Applicable boundary: A vertical rectangular projection starting at the free surface, with hydrostatic water and no downstream pressure.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 曲面水平投影的水推力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic horizontal projected force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲面水平投影的水推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出隨深度線性增加的壓力三角形，用底壓乘面積再除二重算合力。核對作用點在水深下方三分之二位置，並列出曲面法線方向與水平投影之間的轉換，避免面積重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the triangular pressure distribution and independently recover force from half the base pressure times projected area. Check that the resultant acts two thirds of the depth below the surface, then distinguish actual curved area from its horizontal-force projection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水深從四十公尺增至四十八公尺，計算合力倍率並比較壓力倍率，解釋為何總推力增加快於底壓，以及投影寬度假設有何影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase depth from forty to forty-eight metres, compare force and bottom-pressure multipliers, and explain why resultant force grows faster. State how the assumed projected width limits the interpretation of the comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把平均水壓誤設為底部最大水壓會使合力加倍；又若把投影條帶的合力直接均分給所有拱圈，便忽略深度變化與三維承載分配，產生錯誤應力圖。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把平均水壓誤設為底部最大水壓會使合力加倍；又若把投影條帶的合力直接均分給所有拱圈，便忽略深度變化與三維承載分配，產生錯誤應力圖。
knowledge.textEn: Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant. Distributing the projected-strip force equally among every arch ring then ignores depth variation and three-dimensional load sharing, producing a misleading stress picture.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曲面水平投影的水推力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydrostatic horizontal projected force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged
Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant.
quiz.explanation: 把平均水壓誤設為底部最大水壓會使合力加倍；又若把投影條帶的合力直接均分給所有拱圈，便忽略深度變化與三維承載分配，產生錯誤應力圖。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拱與懸臂剛度分力」與「岩盤層面有效正向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arch and cantilever load sharing" and "Effective force on rock bedding": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱與懸臂剛度分力」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch and cantilever load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。用同位移的兩個並聯彈簧表示這兩條力路，可看出較硬路徑分擔更多荷載，但這只是相容變形概念，不能把兩彈簧視為互不影響的真實壩塊。 總剛度相加來自同位移條件，與串聯彈簧的同力條件不同；分力比恰為剛度比，只在這個線性並聯模型成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱與懸臂剛度分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. Parallel springs with a common displacement illustrate why the stiffer load path attracts more force, while remaining an analogy rather than two independent physical blocks of a real double-curvature dam. Adding stiffnesses follows from common displacement, unlike the common force of series springs. The force ratio equals the stiffness ratio only within this linear parallel model, not as a universal dam property. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch and cantilever load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch and cantilever load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力
knowledge.text: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。用同位移的兩個並聯彈簧表示這兩條力路，可看出較硬路徑分擔更多荷載，但這只是相容變形概念，不能把兩彈簧視為互不影響的真實壩塊。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. Parallel springs with a common displacement illustrate why the stiffer load path attracts more force, while remaining an analogy rather than two independent physical blocks of a real double-curvature dam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱與懸臂剛度分力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch and cantilever load sharing" is correct?
options: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。
一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力
不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
optionsEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure.
Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged
Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
quiz.explanation: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。適用邊界：線性並聯與共同位移，只示範力路分配，不提供局部應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Applicable boundary: Linear parallel paths with shared displacement illustrate force distribution without predicting local stresses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。適用邊界：線性並聯與共同位移，只示範力路分配，不提供局部應力。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Applicable boundary: Linear parallel paths with shared displacement illustrate force distribution without predicting local stresses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch and cantilever load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。
水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變
optionsEn: Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN.
A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱與懸臂剛度分力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch and cantilever load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。改變其中一條路徑剛度時，同時記錄另一條分力如何增加，並說明真實壩體需要何種接縫及基礎資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Change one path stiffness while tracking the other force, then identify joint and foundation information required to move beyond this simple compatibility analogy. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把拱剛度降至二千四百兆牛頓每公尺，重新求兩條分力及共同位移，畫出荷載轉移方向，指出這項結果仍不能判定局部裂縫是否擴展。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce arch stiffness to twenty-four hundred meganewtons per metre, recalculate both forces and displacement, and draw redistribution. Explain why these results alone cannot determine whether a local crack will propagate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。改變其中一條路徑剛度時，同時記錄另一條分力如何增加，並說明真實壩體需要何種接縫及基礎資料。
knowledge.textEn: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Change one path stiffness while tracking the other force, then identify joint and foundation information required to move beyond this simple compatibility analogy.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把拱剛度降至二千四百兆牛頓每公尺，重新求兩條分力及共同位移，畫出荷載轉移方向，指出這項結果仍不能判定局部裂縫是否擴展。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce arch stiffness to twenty-four hundred meganewtons per metre, recalculate both forces and displacement, and draw redistribution. Explain why these results alone cannot determine whether a local crack will propagate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱與懸臂剛度分力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arch and cantilever load sharing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均

Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium.
quiz.explanation: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. Keeping old force shares with new stiffnesses creates incompatible displacements and violates the model's central assumption. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總剛度相加來自同位移條件，與串聯彈簧的同力條件不同；分力比恰為剛度比，只在這個線性並聯模型成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.questionEn: When "Arch and cantilever load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。

steps.instruction: 拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。假想單一平面模型把水壓作用面積明列出來，讓學員看見排水如何改變有效力，而不是把總壓力全部當成可用摩擦來源。 孔壓作用的方向垂直層面，水壓與總正向力使用相同符號約定才能相減；孔壓上升不是直接增加摩擦的壓緊力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩盤層面有效正向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thrust entering bedded rock mobilizes friction according to normal force remaining after water pressure is deducted. A single-plane model explicitly includes pressurized area, showing how drainage changes effective force rather than treating total compression as entirely available for friction. Pore pressure acts normal to the bedding plane, so it must use a compatible sign convention with total normal force. Increasing water pressure is not additional clamping force available to mobilize friction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective force on rock bedding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 關於「岩盤層面有效正向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective force on rock bedding" is correct?
options: 不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective force on rock bedding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩盤層面有效正向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective force on rock bedding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN。適用邊界：不計黏聚與側向約束，孔壓均勻；只算摩擦抗力不是安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN. Applicable boundary: No cohesion or lateral confinement, with uniform pore pressure; the result is frictional resistance, not a safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先核對兆帕乘平方公尺等於兆牛頓，再以測壓管代表範圍估算壓力分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify that megapascals times square metres produce meganewtons, then examine how piezometers represent the pressure field.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective force on rock bedding: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩盤層面有效正向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective force on rock bedding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對兆帕乘平方公尺等於兆牛頓，再以測壓管代表範圍估算壓力分布。比較排水前後孔壓與位移趨勢，注意單一測點不能代表整條層面，並另列未知的剪力需求與力矩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify that megapascals times square metres produce meganewtons, then examine how piezometers represent the pressure field. Compare pressure and movement before and after drainage, noting that one point cannot characterize the entire plane and that shear demand remains unspecified. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把均勻孔壓提高到零點四兆帕，重算摩擦抗力並畫孔壓與抗力關係，再討論何時有效正向力趨近零會使簡化接觸假設失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise uniform pore pressure to zero point four megapascals, recalculate resistance and plot its pressure dependence. Discuss why the contact assumption breaks down as effective normal force approaches zero.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective force on rock bedding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩盤層面有效正向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective force on rock bedding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A sensor beside a local drain may miss a remote high-pressure zone, so an apparently reasonable average can conceal reduced effective contact force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔壓作用的方向垂直層面，水壓與總正向力使用相同符號約定才能相減；孔壓上升不是直接增加摩擦的壓緊力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increasing water pressure is not additional clamping force available to mobilize friction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A sensor beside a local drain may miss a remote high-pressure zone, so an apparently reasonable average can conceal reduced effective contact force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩盤層面有效正向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective force on rock bedding" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。
單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance.
Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening
quiz.explanation: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal movement and joint gap" and "Stratification and withdrawal inertia": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度變形與接縫開度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and joint gap: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度變形與接縫開度」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal movement and joint gap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩接縫的相對開合會受到塊體溫度、拘束及水壓共同影響。自由熱伸縮長度可以當作幾何尺度，但不能直接等同實際縫寬；縫面接觸後可能傳力，張開後傳力條件又會改變，形成非線性問題。 若接縫兩側都朝縫面伸長，相對閉合量可能大於單塊伸長；若一起平移則縫寬不變，顯示絕對與相對位移不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度變形與接縫開度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relative joint movement responds to block temperature, restraint and hydraulic loading. Free thermal movement provides a geometric scale rather than the actual gap, because contact can transmit force while opening changes the load path and introduces nonlinearity. When both blocks expand toward a joint, relative closure can exceed one block expansion. Common translation leaves gap unchanged, demonstrating why absolute movement and relative aperture are different observables. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal movement and joint gap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=24 m; dT=15 K; dL=alpha L dT*1000=3.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=24 m; dT=15 K; dL=alpha L dT*1000=3.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度變形與接縫開度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 溫度變形與接縫開度
knowledge.text: 拱壩接縫的相對開合會受到塊體溫度、拘束及水壓共同影響。自由熱伸縮長度可以當作幾何尺度，但不能直接等同實際縫寬；縫面接觸後可能傳力，張開後傳力條件又會改變，形成非線性問題。
knowledge.textEn: Relative joint movement responds to block temperature, restraint and hydraulic loading. Free thermal movement provides a geometric scale rather than the actual gap, because contact can transmit force while opening changes the load path and introduces nonlinearity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening
Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes
Relative joint movement responds to block temperature, restraint and hydraulic loading.
quiz.explanation: 拱壩接縫的相對開合會受到塊體溫度、拘束及水壓共同影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫度變形與接縫開度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal movement and joint gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把自由伸長全數加到縫寬而不考慮方向，可能把閉合預測成張開；若縫面已接觸仍用同一直線關係外推，就會忽略接觸壓力與剛度突然改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs. Continuing the same linear relation after contact ignores the resulting contact pressure and abrupt change in stiffness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若接縫兩側都朝縫面伸長，相對閉合量可能大於單塊伸長；若一起平移則縫寬不變，顯示絕對與相對位移不同。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 水庫冷暖水層的密度差提供恢復浮力，取水流速則會拉動界面。以約化重力及密度福祿數比較慣性與浮力，可討論選擇性取水是否容易擾動水層，但實際取水形狀、界面厚度與三維流場仍不可省略。 約化重力只保留密度差造成的浮力尺度，不能用完整重力取代；其平方根與水深共同形成可與流速比較的特徵速度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度分層與取水慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Density contrast between warm and cool layers supplies restoring buoyancy while withdrawal velocity disturbs the interface. Reduced gravity and a densimetric Froude number compare inertia with buoyancy, without resolving intake geometry, interface thickness or the three-dimensional withdrawal field. Reduced gravity retains the buoyancy associated with density difference and cannot be replaced by full gravitational acceleration. Combined with depth under a square root, it produces a characteristic velocity comparable with withdrawal speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 密度分層與取水慣性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stratification and withdrawal inertia: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度分層與取水慣性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿深度量測溫度與密度，確認界面存在並記錄測點時間，再用流量與有效進水面積估算局部速度。比較不同取水時段的剖面變化，留意風混合也可能造成界面移動而非全部由取水引起。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure depth profiles of temperature and density to establish an interface and record sampling times. Estimate local velocity from flow and effective intake area, then compare profiles across withdrawal periods while accounting for wind-driven mixing as an alternative cause. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將密度差減半而保持速度不變，重算無因次數並描述浮力恢復變弱的意義，再列出需用水槽或數值模型確認的取水口幾何效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve the density difference at unchanged velocity, recalculate the dimensionless number and explain weaker buoyant restoration. Identify intake-geometry effects requiring physical experiments or a resolved flow model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全庫平均流速代替取水口附近速度可能嚴重低估慣性；直接把無因次數當成固定允許值，也會忽略幾何、分層厚度與入流條件，使比較失去物理依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reservoir-wide mean velocity can greatly understate inertia near an intake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 密度分層與取水慣性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stratification and withdrawal inertia: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度分層與取水慣性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全庫平均流速代替取水口附近速度可能嚴重低估慣性；直接把無因次數當成固定允許值，也會忽略幾何、分層厚度與入流條件，使比較失去物理依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir-wide mean velocity can greatly understate inertia near an intake. Treating the dimensionless number as a universal permitted value ignores geometry, interface thickness and inflow conditions that control its interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：約化重力只保留密度差造成的浮力尺度，不能用完整重力取代；其平方根與水深共同形成可與流速比較的特徵速度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combined with depth under a square root, it produces a characteristic velocity comparable with withdrawal speed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「密度分層與取水慣性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只知道水位增量就能判斷剩餘蓄洪空間

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「颱風入流與短時水位」與「水躍共軛水深」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storm inflow and short term level" and "Hydraulic jump conjugate depths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 颱風入流與短時水位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storm inflow and short term level: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「颱風入流與短時水位」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storm inflow and short term level” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 颱風期間水量累積取決於入流減放流的時程，水面積把蓄量差轉成水位差。以局部固定面積作近似可快速估計量級，但翡翠的真實地形曲線與隨水位變動的出口能力會使線性估算偏離實況。 局部面積就是庫容對水位的導數，因此固定面積近似只適合變動不大的一段高程；跨越地形突變時應分段處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「颱風入流與短時水位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During a storm, storage accumulates from the time history of inflow minus release. Local water area converts volume change into level change as a first approximation, while real geometry and level-dependent outlet behavior can depart from that linear estimate. Local surface area is the derivative of storage with respect to elevation. Constant area is therefore a local approximation, and a level change spanning abrupt topographic variation should be integrated in segments. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Storm inflow and short term level” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只知道水位增量就能判斷剩餘蓄洪空間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Knowing only level increment establishes remaining flood-storage capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「颱風入流與短時水位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Storm inflow and short term level”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 只用暴雨峰值流量乘整場歷時會放大蓄量；反之以日平均淹沒短時洪峰，可能低估最大水位。沒有初始水位的增加量無法判斷剩餘空間是否足夠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying a storm peak by the whole event overstates volume, while daily averaging can suppress the maximum level. A level increment without the initial elevation cannot establish how much storage space remains. steps.title: 水躍共軛水深：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic jump conjugate depths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水躍共軛水深」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic jump conjugate depths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溢流後的高速淺水若轉成低速深水，可透過水躍耗散能量。矩形渠道的動量平衡給出上下游共軛水深，這不代表任意尾水都能穩住水躍；實際消能池還受床面、空氣摻混及側向流動影響。 躍前與躍後流量相同但速度與水深改變，動量函數相等不代表比能相等，兩斷面的比能差才是耗散的量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水躍共軛水深」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hydraulic jump converts fast shallow flow into slower deeper flow while dissipating energy. Rectangular-channel momentum gives conjugate depths, but arbitrary tailwater will not necessarily hold the jump in place, and actual basins involve aeration, bed details and lateral effects. Discharge is conserved across the jump while depth and velocity change. Equal momentum functions do not imply equal specific energies; their specific-energy difference quantifies the mechanical energy dissipated in the transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic jump conjugate depths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：y1=1 m; v1=8 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr1=v1/sqrt(g y1); y2=y1(sqrt(1+8Fr1^2)-1)/2=3.14663 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: y1=1 m; v1=8 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr1=v1/sqrt(g y1); y2=y1(sqrt(1+8Fr1^2)-1)/2=3.14663 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水躍共軛水深」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Rectangular-channel momentum gives conjugate depths, but arbitrary tailwater will not necessarily hold the jump in place, and actual basins involve aeration, bed details and lateral effects.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先用連續方程求下游平均速度，再核對兩斷面的動量函數接近相等，最後比較比能以確認能量下降。水槽觀察應記錄水躍位置與尾水變化，不能只量一張照片中的水深。
knowledge.textEn: Use continuity to recover downstream velocity, check equality of momentum functions and compare specific energy to confirm dissipation. In a flume, record jump location as tailwater changes rather than relying on depths captured in a single photograph.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將入口速度改為六公尺每秒，重新求共軛水深和出口速度，說明為何水躍高度改變，並列出需要尾水曲線才能判斷的定位問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce inlet velocity to six metres per second, recalculate conjugate depth and downstream velocity, and explain the height change. Identify jump-location questions that require a tailwater relationship.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水躍共軛水深」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic jump conjugate depths"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先用連續方程求下游平均速度，再核對兩斷面的動量函數接近相等，最後比較比能以確認能量下降。
單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use continuity to recover downstream velocity, check equality of momentum functions and compare specific energy to confirm dissipation.
Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening
quiz.explanation: 先用連續方程求下游平均速度，再核對兩斷面的動量函數接近相等，最後比較比能以確認能量下降。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use continuity to recover downstream velocity, check equality of momentum functions and compare specific energy to confirm dissipation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水躍共軛水深：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic jump conjugate depths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水躍共軛水深」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic jump conjugate depths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Treating dissipated energy as local pressure also obscures distinct mechanisms of fluctuating loads, cavitation and scour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：躍前與躍後流量相同但速度與水深改變，動量函數相等不代表比能相等，兩斷面的比能差才是耗散的量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal momentum functions do not imply equal specific energies; their specific-energy difference quantifies the mechanical energy dissipated in the transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。
knowledge.textEn: A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Treating dissipated energy as local pressure also obscures distinct mechanisms of fluctuating loads, cavitation and scour.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水躍共軛水深」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic jump conjugate depths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數
把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre
A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur.
quiz.explanation: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含砂濃度與固體負荷」與「原水保守溶質混合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sediment concentration and mass load" and "Conservative raw water mixing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含砂濃度與固體負荷」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment concentration and mass load” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。濁度是光學反應而非質量濃度，翡翠背景的教學不能不經現地校準就把濁度單位直接乘流量。 質量率積分得到的是運輸量，轉成沉積體積還要知道留下比例與乾容重，因而輸砂與庫容測量應分開設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含砂濃度與固體負荷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. Turbidity is an optical response rather than mass concentration, so it cannot be multiplied directly by flow without a site-specific conversion and its uncertainty. Integrating mass flux gives transported solids. Conversion to deposited volume additionally requires retention and dry bulk density, so sediment transport measurements and reservoir-capacity surveys address related but distinct quantities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment concentration and mass load” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含砂濃度與固體負荷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment concentration and mass load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷
knowledge.text: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。濁度是光學反應而非質量濃度，翡翠背景的教學不能不經現地校準就把濁度單位直接乘流量。
knowledge.textEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. Turbidity is an optical response rather than mass concentration, so it cannot be multiplied directly by flow without a site-specific conversion and its uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含砂濃度與固體負荷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sediment concentration and mass load" is correct?
options: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。
濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數
兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均
optionsEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage.
A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre
Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ
quiz.explanation: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含砂濃度與固體負荷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment concentration and mass load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。適用邊界：兩小時代表濃度與流量固定，僅懸浮輸砂，不含推移質與庫內沉降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Applicable boundary: Constant representative concentration and flow for two hours; suspended load only, excluding bed load and reservoir deposition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。適用邊界：兩小時代表濃度與流量固定，僅懸浮輸砂，不含推移質與庫內沉降。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Applicable boundary: Constant representative concentration and flow for two hours; suspended load only, excluding bed load and reservoir deposition.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含砂濃度與固體負荷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sediment concentration and mass load", which statement holds?
options: 曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。
不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
optionsEn: Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg.
Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含砂濃度與固體負荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sediment concentration and mass load” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。檢查洪峰前後是否有遲滯，避免只採清水期而漏掉主要固體負荷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Check rising and falling limbs for hysteresis so clear-water sampling does not miss the dominant solids load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設濃度在第一小時加倍而第二小時減半，分段求質量並比較原值，再說明若流量同步變動，使用兩個平均值相乘會有何偏差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double concentration in the first hour and halve it in the second, integrate mass and compare with the original case. Explain the bias from multiplying separate averages when discharge varies simultaneously.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以單一岸邊樣本代表全斷面會漏掉垂向與橫向濃度梯度；把輸入固體全當作永久沉積，也會忽略排出、再懸浮與密度壓密，使庫容損失估算偏離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One bank sample may miss vertical and lateral gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。檢查洪峰前後是否有遲滯，避免只採清水期而漏掉主要固體負荷。
knowledge.textEn: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Check rising and falling limbs for hysteresis so clear-water sampling does not miss the dominant solids load.

knowledge.text: 假設濃度在第一小時加倍而第二小時減半，分段求質量並比較原值，再說明若流量同步變動，使用兩個平均值相乘會有何偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Double concentration in the first hour and halve it in the second, integrate mass and compare with the original case. Explain the bias from multiplying separate averages when discharge varies simultaneously.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含砂濃度與固體負荷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sediment concentration and mass load"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conservative raw water mixing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原水保守溶質混合」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conservative raw water mixing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。這個概念能教導取水來源比例的重要性，但濁度、藻類與會反應的物質不一定線性混合，不能把保守示蹤物公式套到所有水質指標。 質量守恆以溶質通量為基礎，濃度本身不能直接相加；每股流量權重的總和必須等於一，混合濃度應介於兩來源之間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原水保守溶質混合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions. Turbidity, algae and reactive substances need not mix linearly, so the tracer equation is not a universal relationship for every water-quality indicator. Mass conservation applies to solute flux rather than concentration alone. Flow weights must sum to unity, and a conservative two-source blend should lie between the source concentrations when both flows are positive. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conservative raw water mixing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原水保守溶質混合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Turbidity, algae and reactive substances need not mix linearly, so the tracer equation is not a universal relationship for every water-quality indicator.

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conservative raw water mixing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原水保守溶質混合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conservative raw water mixing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。適用邊界：充分混合、無反應的假想溶質，不表示濁度或飲用水合格限值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L. Applicable boundary: Complete mixing of a hypothetical nonreactive solute, not turbidity or a drinking-water acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use simultaneous source flows and concentrations to calculate input mass rate and confirm that the outlet sample follows sufficient mixing distance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Applicable boundary: Complete mixing of a hypothetical nonreactive solute, not turbidity or a drinking-water acceptance limit.

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原水保守溶質混合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conservative raw water mixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。將預測值與出口樣本比較時，先補上停留時間，避免把不同水團的濃度直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use simultaneous source flows and concentrations to calculate input mass rate and confirm that the outlet sample follows sufficient mixing distance. Account for travel time before comparing predicted and measured concentrations so different water parcels are not subtracted as if simultaneous. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維持總流量五立方公尺每秒，把較高濃度來源減至一立方公尺每秒，重算混合濃度並畫比例曲線，註明這只是保守溶質的教材。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep total flow at five cubic metres per second, reduce the higher-concentration source to one and recalculate the blend. Plot concentration against source fraction and label the conservative-solute assumption explicitly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拿濁度直接做保守濃度混合可能因顆粒絮凝而失準；若取樣位置尚未混勻，單點量值會偏向某股來源，即使整體質量守恆正確仍看似不符合公式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying conservative mixing to turbidity can fail because particles flocculate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: When "Conservative raw water mixing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
拿濁度直接做保守濃度混合可能因顆粒絮凝而失準；若取樣位置尚未混勻，單點量值會偏向某股來源，即使整體質量守恆正確仍看似不符合公式。
名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Applying conservative mixing to turbidity can fail because particles flocculate.
Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel
quiz.explanation: 拿濁度直接做保守濃度混合可能因顆粒絮凝而失準；若取樣位置尚未混勻，單點量值會偏向某股來源，即使整體質量守恆正確仍看似不符合公式。 需以量測區分可能原因。

title: 石門水庫大壩
summary: 石門課程從中央心層、濾層、壓實與孔隙水壓開始，再把排砂、分層取水及後池調節納入水量與固體質量帳。學生練習區分土的乾密度與濕密度、濁度與含砂質量濃度，以及排水量上升與內部侵蝕證據。假想地震水平力只用於理解受力，不能替代滑動面或動力分析。
summaryEn: The Shihmen course begins with core zoning, filters, compaction and pore pressure, then brings sediment outlets, selective withdrawal and afterbay buffering into water and solids balances. Learners separate dry from wet density, turbidity from sediment mass concentration, and rising drainage from evidence of erosion. Hypothetical seismic inertia illustrates force bookkeeping without replacing slip-surface or dynamic analysis.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想兩層心層厚度各十公尺，滲透係數分別為一乘十的負七次方及五乘十的負八次方公尺每秒，串聯等效係數為六點六六七乘十的負八次方公尺每秒。水頭差三十公尺、截面一千平方公尺時，流量為零點零零零一立方公尺每秒；若低滲透層係數加倍，流量增至零點零零零一五。另以濕密度每立方公尺二千一百公斤及含水率百分之十二得乾密度一千八百七十五公斤每立方公尺，兩個計算不能替代現地壓實曲線與排水觀測。 核驗：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two core layers, each 10 m thick, with permeability values of 1e-7 and 5e-8 m/s. Series resistance gives an equivalent permeability of 6.667e-8 m/s. Across 30 m of head and 1000 m2 of area, flow is 0.0001 m3/s. Doubling the less permeable layer value raises flow to 0.00015 m3/s. Separately, wet density 2100 kg/m3 and gravimetric water content 0.12 imply dry density 1875 kg/m3. These results illustrate different material properties and cannot replace a compaction curve, zoning checks or drainage observations. Verification: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層心層的串聯滲流」與「濾層粒徑比例篩查」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Series seepage through core layers" and "Filter gradation ratio screening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層心層的串聯滲流」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Series seepage through core layers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層心層的串聯滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability. The least permeable layer can dominate resistance. This differs from parallel-path averaging and does not describe a crack carrying concentrated flow, because that feature changes both geometry and the effective flow area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Series seepage through core layers” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層心層的串聯滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Series seepage through core layers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流

knowledge.textEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層心層的串聯滲流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Series seepage through core layers" is correct?
options: 沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均
中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。
只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格
optionsEn: Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically
A central core limits flow with low-permeability material.
A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
