quiz.explanationEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層心層的串聯滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Series seepage through core layers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分層心層的串聯滲流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Series seepage through core layers", which statement holds?
options: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
optionsEn: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Series seepage through core layers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
knowledge.textEn: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Series seepage through core layers"?
options: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多
optionsEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass
quiz.explanation: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層心層的串聯滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Series seepage through core layers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. Conversely, retaining an intact-material model after cracking can understate concentrated flow, so the two modeling errors do not share the same direction. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter gradation ratio screening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。適用邊界：粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Applicable boundary: Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水率與壓實乾密度」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water content and compacted density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。以水重除乾土重定義的含水率可將濕密度換成乾密度，才便於比較固體骨架壓實程度。相同乾密度也不代表相同滲透性，因為土的組成、含水狀態、壓實能量與顆粒排列仍可能不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水率與壓實乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. Gravimetric water content, defined relative to dry solids, converts wet density to dry density for comparing the solid skeleton. Even equal dry density does not ensure equal permeability, since composition, moisture condition, compactive effort and particle arrangement may still differ substantially between specimens or placed layers. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water content and compacted density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含水率與壓實乾密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water content and compacted density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度
knowledge.text: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。以水重除乾土重定義的含水率可將濕密度換成乾密度，才便於比較固體骨架壓實程度。
knowledge.textEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. Gravimetric water content, defined relative to dry solids, converts wet density to dry density for comparing the solid skeleton.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含水率與壓實乾密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water content and compacted density" is correct?
options: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。
含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式
庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
optionsEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water.
Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion
Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
quiz.explanation: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含水率與壓實乾密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water content and compacted density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。適用邊界：含水率以乾土質量為分母，體積為原濕試體體積，無超粒徑修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3. Applicable boundary: Water content uses dry-solid mass and density uses the original wet specimen volume, without oversize correction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。適用邊界：含水率以乾土質量為分母，體積為原濕試體體積，無超粒徑修正。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含水率與壓實乾密度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water content and compacted density", which statement holds?
options: 入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。
只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多
optionsEn: All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3.
A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含水率與壓實乾密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water content and compacted density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。以重複試體檢查體積量測偏差，並把現地乾密度與相同材料、相同試驗能量的壓實曲線比較，避免跨材料誤比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Use replicate specimens to assess volume error and compare field dry density with a compaction curve for the same material and test effort rather than a different soil. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定濕密度，分別用含水率百分之八與十六計算乾密度，畫出關係並說明這條換算曲線為何不是實際材料的壓實最佳含水率曲線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At fixed wet density, calculate dry density for eight and sixteen percent water contents. Plot the conversion and explain why it is not the material's experimental optimum-moisture compaction curve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。以重複試體檢查體積量測偏差，並把現地乾密度與相同材料、相同試驗能量的壓實曲線比較，避免跨材料誤比。
knowledge.textEn: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Use replicate specimens to assess volume error and compare field dry density with a compaction curve for the same material and test effort rather than a different soil.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 固定濕密度，分別用含水率百分之八與十六計算乾密度，畫出關係並說明這條換算曲線為何不是實際材料的壓實最佳含水率曲線。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed wet density, calculate dry density for eight and sixteen percent water contents. Plot the conversion and explain why it is not the material's experimental optimum-moisture compaction curve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含水率與壓實乾密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water content and compacted density"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降
核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk
Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation.
quiz.explanation: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水率與壓實乾密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water content and compacted density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. Using wet mass as the water-content denominator while retaining this equation creates a systematic definition error in otherwise precise-looking records. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相同乾密度也不代表相同滲透性，因為土的組成、含水狀態、壓實能量與顆粒排列仍可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even equal dry density does not ensure equal permeability, since composition, moisture condition, compactive effort and particle arrangement may still differ substantially between specimens or placed layers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. Using wet mass as the water-content denominator while retaining this equation creates a systematic definition error in otherwise precise-looking records.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水率與壓實乾密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water content and compacted density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanation: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。有效正向力計算能展示孔壓滯後對摩擦來源的影響；真正快速降水位問題還需土體不排水強度、滲流時程及滑動幾何，不能僅用一個力值定安全。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. Effective normal force illustrates how retained pressure changes the source of friction. A true rapid-drawdown assessment also requires drainage timescale, appropriate soil strength and slip geometry; a single force calculation cannot establish stability or represent the entire upstream slope during rapidly changing hydraulic and drainage conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drawdown and pore pressure lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. Effective normal force illustrates how retained pressure changes the source of friction.

knowledge.text: 誤解：庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drawdown and pore pressure lag" is correct?
options: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。
等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
optionsEn: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly.
Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
quiz.explanation: 水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。適用邊界：假想單一面上總法向力與均勻孔壓，未計滑動面需求或外水力矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。適用邊界：假想單一面上總法向力與均勻孔壓，未計滑動面需求或外水力矩。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drawdown and pore pressure lag", which statement holds?
options: 孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係
每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。
optionsEn: Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root
Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。量測點須標明高程和濾管位置，再將多點孔壓分布沿假想面積積分，檢查均勻孔壓近似是否掩蓋局部高壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing. Identify sensor elevations and screen positions, then integrate multiple pressures over the hypothetical plane to test whether a uniform approximation hides locally retained pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：另設孔壓只降低十千帕，重算有效力並比較完全排水的極端，指出還需要哪些強度試驗與時程資料，才能把受力示範延伸到坡面穩定分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce pore pressure by only ten kilopascals, recalculate effective force and compare with a fully drained extreme. Identify strength tests and time-history data needed before extending the illustration into slope stability analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。量測點須標明高程和濾管位置，再將多點孔壓分布沿假想面積積分，檢查均勻孔壓近似是否掩蓋局部高壓。
knowledge.textEn: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing. Identify sensor elevations and screen positions, then integrate multiple pressures over the hypothetical plane to test whether a uniform approximation hides locally retained pressure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 另設孔壓只降低十千帕，重算有效力並比較完全排水的極端，指出還需要哪些強度試驗與時程資料，才能把受力示範延伸到坡面穩定分析。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce pore pressure by only ten kilopascals, recalculate effective force and compare with a fully drained extreme. Identify strength tests and time-history data needed before extending the illustration into slope stability analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drawdown and pore pressure lag"?
options: 同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均
optionsEn: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically
quiz.explanation: 同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. When the reservoir has fallen but soil pressure remains high, this substitution overstates effective force and hides an adverse transient condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：有效正向力計算能展示孔壓滯後對摩擦來源的影響；真正快速降水位問題還需土體不排水強度、滲流時程及滑動幾何，不能僅用一個力值定安全。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A true rapid-drawdown assessment also requires drainage timescale, appropriate soil strength and slip geometry; a single force calculation cannot establish stability or represent the entire upstream slope during rapidly changing hydraulic and drainage conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. When the reservoir has fallen but soil pressure remains high, this substitution overstates effective force and hides an adverse transient condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drawdown and pore pressure lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。
等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage.
Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
quiz.explanation: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震慣性力的受力帳」與「泥砂收支與占容轉換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic inertia force bookkeeping" and "Sediment budget and occupied storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震慣性力的受力帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic inertia force bookkeeping: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震慣性力的受力帳」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic inertia force bookkeeping” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震加速度使壩體質量產生慣性力，簡化水平係數乘重量可建立靜力等效的受力帳。這個係數無因次，不應與以公尺每秒平方表示的加速度混用。土石壩實際反應還包括動態放大、孔壓增加、永久位移及材料非線性，所以等效力只是受力討論的初步起點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震慣性力的受力帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass. A dimensionless horizontal coefficient times weight gives a static-equivalent force for bookkeeping and must not be confused with acceleration in metres per second squared. Actual response also involves amplification, pore-pressure generation, permanent displacement and nonlinear soil behavior, making this equivalent force a starting point rather than a complete site-specific seismic performance assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic inertia force bookkeeping” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震慣性力的受力帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seismic inertia force bookkeeping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震慣性力的受力帳
knowledge.text: 地震加速度使壩體質量產生慣性力，簡化水平係數乘重量可建立靜力等效的受力帳。這個係數無因次，不應與以公尺每秒平方表示的加速度混用。
knowledge.textEn: Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass. A dimensionless horizontal coefficient times weight gives a static-equivalent force for bookkeeping and must not be confused with acceleration in metres per second squared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震慣性力的受力帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic inertia force bookkeeping" is correct?
options: 等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
地震加速度使壩體質量產生慣性力，簡化水平係數乘重量可建立靜力等效的受力帳。
optionsEn: Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass.
quiz.explanation: 地震加速度使壩體質量產生慣性力，簡化水平係數乘重量可建立靜力等效的受力帳。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震慣性力的受力帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN。適用邊界：無因次係數為假想值，只求等效水平慣性力，未選定設計地震。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Applicable boundary: The coefficient is hypothetical and dimensionless; only equivalent horizontal inertia is calculated, without selecting a design earthquake. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify weight from mass times gravity, then independently recover inertia using acceleration equal to the coefficient times gravity.

steps.instructionEn: Verify weight from mass times gravity, then independently recover inertia using acceleration equal to the coefficient times gravity. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying weight by gravity again introduces an extra gravity factor. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instructionEn: Multiplying weight by gravity again introduces an extra gravity factor. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment budget and occupied storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫庫容損失來自留下的固體與孔隙空間，而非單純入庫濃度。先用輸入減輸出得到淨沉積質量，再除以沉積乾容重才能估算占容。乾容重會隨顆粒組成、壓密與時間改變，因此每年相同固體質量不必占據相同體積，庫容測量仍是重要獨立證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥砂收支與占容轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir capacity loss depends on retained solids and their pore space rather than inlet concentration alone. steps.title: 泥砂收支與占容轉換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sediment budget and occupied storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥砂收支與占容轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sediment budget and occupied storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把濕泥密度當乾容重會低估固體對應占容；若排砂輸出與入流統計期間不同，又可能出現虛假的負沉積，誤認庫容已恢復而其實只是資料不同步。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using wet-mud density as dry bulk density understates occupied volume. Mismatched inlet and outlet accounting periods can create false negative deposition, suggesting recovered capacity when the records are merely asynchronous. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：乾容重會隨顆粒組成、壓密與時間改變，因此每年相同固體質量不必占據相同體積，庫容測量仍是重要獨立證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bulk density changes with grading, consolidation and age, so equal annual solid masses need not occupy equal volumes; bathymetric capacity surveys remain an important independent line of evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 取水孔口的局部流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local intake orifice discharge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取水孔口的局部流量」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local intake orifice discharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同高程取水口能選擇不同水層，但流量仍受水頭、孔口面積及收縮損失影響。理想速度由能量式產生，再以流量係數修正局部三維流動。係數與開口形狀、邊緣及上下游條件有關，不能把另一設備的係數直接搬來代表石門現地真實取水口的校準結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取水孔口的局部流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Withdrawal elevation selects a water layer, while flow still depends on head, opening area and contraction losses. An energy-based ideal velocity is corrected by a discharge coefficient representing local three-dimensional effects. That coefficient depends on edge shape, geometry and upstream and downstream conditions, so a value assumed here cannot be transferred directly to a real Shihmen intake or another differently shaped installed structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local intake orifice discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Cd=0.62; A=1.5 m2; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=6 m; Q=Cd A sqrt(2g dh)=10.09039 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Cd=0.62; A=1.5 m2; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=6 m; Q=Cd A sqrt(2g dh)=10.09039 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取水孔口的局部流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local intake orifice discharge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Withdrawal elevation selects a water layer, while flow still depends on head, opening area and contraction losses. An energy-based ideal velocity is corrected by a discharge coefficient representing local three-dimensional effects.

steps.title: 取水孔口的局部流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local intake orifice discharge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取水孔口的局部流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local intake orifice discharge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Cd=0.62; A=1.5 m2; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=6 m; Q=Cd A sqrt(2g dh)=10.09039 m3/s。適用邊界：自由出流的假想孔口，水頭取孔口中心且不計下游淹沒。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Cd=0.62; A=1.5 m2; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=6 m; Q=Cd A sqrt(2g dh)=10.09039 m3/s. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical freely discharging orifice with head referenced to its center and no downstream submergence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量水槽或校準流量計求實際流量，再對多個水頭反算係數，檢查是否維持穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual discharge using a calibrated device, infer the coefficient over several heads and test its consistency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Applicable boundary: A hypothetical freely discharging orifice with head referenced to its center and no downstream submergence.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local intake orifice discharge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以量水槽或校準流量計求實際流量，再對多個水頭反算係數，檢查是否維持穩定。記錄孔口中心高程與下游水位，若變成淹沒出流，應重新定義壓差而不是沿用自由出流水頭。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual discharge using a calibrated device, infer the coefficient over several heads and test its consistency. Record opening-center elevation and downstream level; if submerged, redefine the pressure difference instead of retaining the free-discharge head. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Referencing head to the opening bottom instead of its center introduces geometric bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 把水面到孔口底部的距離當中心水頭會造成幾何偏差；出口被尾水淹沒後仍用單側水深，則高估可用壓差，導致流量與質量平衡同時失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Referencing head to the opening bottom instead of its center introduces geometric bias. After submergence, using upstream depth alone overstates the available pressure difference and corrupts both discharge and mass balance. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That coefficient depends on edge shape, geometry and upstream and downstream conditions, so a value assumed here cannot be transferred directly to a real Shihmen intake or another differently shaped installed structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solids export during sluicing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排砂效果需要同時知道水量及攜帶固體濃度，只有閘門開度或水流聲音無法衡量輸出。以乾固體質量率積分可比較排砂時段，並與用水量分開記錄。高濃度時顆粒交互作用可能改變流變，簡單稀薄懸浮假設及採樣代表性與乾重定義都需要仔細檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排砂時段的固體輸出」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment export requires both water discharge and carried solids concentration; gate position or visible turbulence alone cannot measure it. steps.title: 排砂時段的固體輸出：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排砂時段的固體輸出」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Solids export during sluicing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=9 m3/s; C=8 kg/m3; dt=2400 s; M=Q C dt/1000=172.8 tonne。適用邊界：流量與代表濃度固定四十分鐘，質量為乾固體，不宣稱沉積全被移除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=9 m3/s; C=8 kg/m3; dt=2400 s; M=Q C dt/1000=172.8 tonne. Applicable boundary: Constant representative discharge and concentration for forty minutes; mass is dry solids, without claiming complete deposit removal. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：採樣與流量計必須共用時間區間，對洪砂脈衝增加取樣密度，並標示截面代表方式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize sampling and discharge intervals, increase sampling density during pulses and state cross-section representation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Synchronize sampling and discharge intervals, increase sampling density during pulses and state cross-section representation. Report exported mass alongside water volume and compare with before-and-after bed surveys rather than equating transported material with complete bed clearance. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying a brief concentration peak by the entire release duration exaggerates export. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

濃度峰值若只維持短時間卻被乘整段放流歷時，會誇大排砂量；取樣管堵塞則可能反向低估粗粒部分，讓看似穩定的濃度紀錄缺少主要固體。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity
Multiplying a brief concentration peak by the entire release duration exaggerates export.
quiz.explanation: 濃度峰值若只維持短時間卻被乘整段放流歷時，會誇大排砂量；取樣管堵塞則可能反向低估粗粒部分，讓看似穩定的濃度紀錄缺少主要固體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying a brief concentration peak by the entire release duration exaggerates export. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「後池吸收放流變化」與「排水量的水頭正規化」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Afterbay absorption of release changes" and "Head-normalized drainage conductance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 後池吸收放流變化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Afterbay absorption of release changes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「後池吸收放流變化」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Afterbay absorption of release changes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 後池可暫存上游放流與下游需求之間的差額，降低短時流量波動傳遞。它不是增加總水量的來源，所有暫存都必須在後續時段釋放或保留成庫存。比較容量時應使用可用水位範圍對應的容積，而非整座後池總容量，並明確保留時段開始時的初始蓄量位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「後池吸收放流變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An afterbay temporarily stores the difference between upstream release and downstream demand, reducing transmission of short-term fluctuations. It creates no additional water; stored volume must later be released or remain as inventory. Capacity comparison must use the volume available within the relevant level range rather than gross basin capacity, while retaining the initial storage position and the duration of subsequent recovery periods. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Afterbay absorption of release changes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「後池吸收放流變化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Afterbay absorption of release changes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 後池吸收放流變化
knowledge.text: 後池可暫存上游放流與下游需求之間的差額，降低短時流量波動傳遞。它不是增加總水量的來源，所有暫存都必須在後續時段釋放或保留成庫存。
knowledge.textEn: An afterbay temporarily stores the difference between upstream release and downstream demand, reducing transmission of short-term fluctuations. It creates no additional water; stored volume must later be released or remain as inventory.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「後池吸收放流變化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Afterbay absorption of release changes" is correct?
options: 後池可暫存上游放流與下游需求之間的差額，降低短時流量波動傳遞。
每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量
排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降
optionsEn: An afterbay temporarily stores the difference between upstream release and downstream demand, reducing transmission of short-term fluctuations.
Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity
Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk
quiz.explanation: 後池可暫存上游放流與下游需求之間的差額，降低短時流量波動傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An afterbay temporarily stores the difference between upstream release and downstream demand, reducing transmission of short-term fluctuations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 後池吸收放流變化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Afterbay absorption of release changes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「後池吸收放流變化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Afterbay absorption of release changes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3。適用邊界：四十五分鐘恒定差額、無其他入流與蒸發，未指定實際後池容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3. Applicable boundary: Constant imbalance for forty-five minutes with other inflows and evaporation omitted, without specifying actual afterbay capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3。適用邊界：四十五分鐘恒定差額、無其他入流與蒸發，未指定實際後池容量。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3. Applicable boundary: Constant imbalance for forty-five minutes with other inflows and evaporation omitted, without specifying actual afterbay capacity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「後池吸收放流變化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Afterbay absorption of release changes", which statement holds?
options: 只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3。
庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
optionsEn: A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3.
Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level

steps.title: 後池吸收放流變化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Afterbay absorption of release changes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「後池吸收放流變化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Afterbay absorption of release changes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。把下一時段回復所需的出入流差也畫上圖，確認緩衝不是靠不斷累積水量維持。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects. Plot the subsequent imbalance needed for recovery to confirm that buffering does not depend on indefinitely accumulating water. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設定可用空間只有兩萬立方公尺，計算一次脈衝後剩餘空間，再增加第二次脈衝並求中間必須恢復的水量，將初始狀態畫入水量帳。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set available space to twenty thousand cubic metres, calculate the remainder after one pulse and add a second pulse. Determine the intervening recovery volume and include the initial state explicitly in the account.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。把下一時段回復所需的出入流差也畫上圖，確認緩衝不是靠不斷累積水量維持。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects. Plot the subsequent imbalance needed for recovery to confirm that buffering does not depend on indefinitely accumulating water.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設定可用空間只有兩萬立方公尺，計算一次脈衝後剩餘空間，再增加第二次脈衝並求中間必須恢復的水量，將初始狀態畫入水量帳。
knowledge.textEn: Set available space to twenty thousand cubic metres, calculate the remainder after one pulse and add a second pulse. Determine the intervening recovery volume and include the initial state explicitly in the account.

quiz.question: 要驗證「後池吸收放流變化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Afterbay absorption of release changes"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects.
quiz.explanation: 由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 後池吸收放流變化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Afterbay absorption of release changes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「後池吸收放流變化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Afterbay absorption of release changes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints. Repeated pulses without recovery progressively consume buffering capacity even when every individual pulse is smaller than the gross basin volume. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較容量時應使用可用水位範圍對應的容積，而非整座後池總容量，並明確保留時段開始時的初始蓄量位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Capacity comparison must use the volume available within the relevant level range rather than gross basin capacity, while retaining the initial storage position and the duration of subsequent recovery periods.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。
knowledge.textEn: Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints. Repeated pulses without recovery progressively consume buffering capacity even when every individual pulse is smaller than the gross basin volume.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「後池吸收放流變化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Afterbay absorption of release changes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降
optionsEn: Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk

quiz.explanationEn: Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水量的水頭正規化」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head-normalized drainage conductance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水量隨庫水頭變化並不必然表示滲流通道劣化，先以水頭差正規化可比較近似達西條件下的導水能力。這個比值仍受降雨入滲、溫度黏度及出口堵塞影響；用石門土石壩背景討論趨勢時，應把量測位置、時滯與水頭定義清楚保留在完整趨勢圖上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水量的水頭正規化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage increasing with reservoir head does not necessarily indicate deterioration. Dividing flow by head difference compares apparent conductance under roughly Darcy conditions. The ratio remains sensitive to rainfall infiltration, temperature-dependent viscosity and outlet blockage, so trend interpretation must retain measurement location, lag and the definition of hydraulic head rather than presenting one normalized value as a direct measure of erosion or structural condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head-normalized drainage conductance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水量的水頭正規化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head-normalized drainage conductance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水量的水頭正規化
knowledge.text: 排水量隨庫水頭變化並不必然表示滲流通道劣化，先以水頭差正規化可比較近似達西條件下的導水能力。這個比值仍受降雨入滲、溫度黏度及出口堵塞影響；用石門土石壩背景討論趨勢時，應把量測位置、時滯與水頭定義清楚保留在完整趨勢圖上。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage increasing with reservoir head does not necessarily indicate deterioration. Dividing flow by head difference compares apparent conductance under roughly Darcy conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水量的水頭正規化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水量的水頭正規化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head-normalized drainage conductance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s。適用邊界：單一路徑近似穩態，排除降雨脈衝與出口回水；不是滲透係數本身。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s. Applicable boundary: One approximately steady path excluding rainfall pulses and outlet backwater; conductance is not permeability itself. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s。適用邊界：單一路徑近似穩態，排除降雨脈衝與出口回水；不是滲透係數本身。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水量的水頭正規化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head-normalized drainage conductance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。以水溫修正黏度影響時保留修正前曲線，並同步檢查排水濁度與細粒是否出現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals. Retain uncorrected curves when adjusting for viscosity and examine turbidity and any transported fine particles alongside apparent conductance changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設水頭增至二十五公尺而導水能力不變，預測流量，再加入固定雨水流入求表觀比值，展示如何用乾雨時段分組避免錯誤判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase head to twenty-five metres at unchanged conductance and predict flow, then add a fixed rainfall contribution and compute apparent conductance. Demonstrate how separating dry and wet periods prevents a misleading trend interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。以水溫修正黏度影響時保留修正前曲線，並同步檢查排水濁度與細粒是否出現。
knowledge.textEn: Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals. Retain uncorrected curves when adjusting for viscosity and examine turbidity and any transported fine particles alongside apparent conductance changes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設水頭增至二十五公尺而導水能力不變，預測流量，再加入固定雨水流入求表觀比值，展示如何用乾雨時段分組避免錯誤判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Increase head to twenty-five metres at unchanged conductance and predict flow, then add a fixed rainfall contribution and compute apparent conductance. Demonstrate how separating dry and wet periods prevents a misleading trend interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水量的水頭正規化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head-normalized drainage conductance"?
options: 將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。

孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係
