quiz.explanationEn: Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水量的水頭正規化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head-normalized drainage conductance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. Rainwater entering a drain can raise apparent conductance without creating a new path through the core. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個比值仍受降雨入滲、溫度黏度及出口堵塞影響；用石門土石壩背景討論趨勢時，應把量測位置、時滯與水頭定義清楚保留在完整趨勢圖上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio remains sensitive to rainfall infiltration, temperature-dependent viscosity and outlet blockage, so trend interpretation must retain measurement location, lag and the definition of hydraulic head rather than presenting one normalized value as a direct measure of erosion or structural condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。
knowledge.textEn: Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. Rainwater entering a drain can raise apparent conductance without creating a new path through the core.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水量的水頭正規化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head-normalized drainage conductance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。
沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement.
Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically
quiz.explanation: 出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
summary: 本課以荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘為入口，深入潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開口流速與收縮」與「潮稜體與生態交換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Opening velocity and contraction" and "Tidal prism and ecological exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開口流速與收縮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Opening velocity and contraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開口流速與收縮」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Opening velocity and contraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留潮汐交換需要流通面積，但墩柱壓縮通道使局部速度上升。斷面平均速度不是閘緣噴流速度，動壓與紊流剪應力又隨速度平方變化。比較同一流量的不同開口，才能看見縮窄後的海床代價。 假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。 局部高速帶若穿過未保護接縫，平均流速正常仍可能淘空床層。潮向翻轉會把危險區換邊，因此只有單向測線無法確認完整保護範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開口流速與收縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preserving tidal exchange requires flow area, while piers contract the channels and accelerate local currents. Section-mean velocity differs from the gate-edge jet. Dynamic pressure and turbulent stresses depend on velocity squared, so comparing openings at fixed discharge reveals the seabed consequences of contraction. Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. A narrow fast jet crossing an unprotected joint may erode the bed despite an acceptable average velocity. Tidal reversal moves the vulnerable side, so one-direction transects cannot establish the full protection footprint. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Opening velocity and contraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 把聲學流速剖面按同一潮相積分，核對斷面流量與上下游水位差；另取閘緣測線，避免以河道中央的單點值代表整個收縮流場。以收縮前後斷面重複量測檢查連續方程的閉合，量化遺漏側向流的大小。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 潮稜體與生態交換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and ecological exchange: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮稜體與生態交換」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal prism and ecological exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮稜體衡量一個漲潮期間進出的水量，不能直接當成全部水體換新。港灣分支與渦流會保留舊水，同時影響鹽度與棲地。把幾何儲水量和示蹤交換效率分開，可避免以流量總和誤判生態效果。 假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。 只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮稜體與生態交換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The tidal prism measures water exchanged during a flood tide, but does not mean every parcel is renewed. Branches and recirculation retain older water and influence salinity and habitats. Separating geometric storage from tracer exchange prevents cumulative flow from being mistaken for ecological renewal. Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers. A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. Counting recirculated seawater repeatedly as new inflow underestimates contaminant residence and can conceal localized oxygen depletion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal prism and ecological exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮稜體與生態交換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tidal prism and ecological exchange”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮稜體與生態交換
knowledge.text: 潮稜體衡量一個漲潮期間進出的水量，不能直接當成全部水體換新。港灣分支與渦流會保留舊水，同時影響鹽度與棲地。
knowledge.textEn: The tidal prism measures water exchanged during a flood tide, but does not mean every parcel is renewed. Branches and recirculation retain older water and influence salinity and habitats.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮稜體與生態交換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tidal prism and ecological exchange" is correct?
options: 潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。
兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。
潮稜體衡量一個漲潮期間進出的水量，不能直接當成全部水體換新。
optionsEn: A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner.
Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet.
The tidal prism measures water exchanged during a flood tide, but does not mean every parcel is renewed.
quiz.explanation: 潮稜體衡量一個漲潮期間進出的水量，不能直接當成全部水體換新。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The tidal prism measures water exchanged during a flood tide, but does not mean every parcel is renewed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮稜體與生態交換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and ecological exchange: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮稜體與生態交換」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tidal prism and ecological exchange” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊潮位基準、濕潤面積曲線與鹽度剖面；比較漲落潮的示蹤訊號是否返回，並以多個分支測站判斷完全混合假設在哪些區域失效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮稜體與生態交換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tidal prism and ecological exchange", which statement holds?

只要護床石塊沒有移動，下方基土就一定沒有流失。

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³.
Stationary armor guarantees that underlying soil has not been lost.
Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide.

steps.title: 潮稜體與生態交換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and ecological exchange: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮稜體與生態交換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tidal prism and ecological exchange” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊潮位基準、濕潤面積曲線與鹽度剖面；比較漲落潮的示蹤訊號是否返回，並以多個分支測站判斷完全混合假設在哪些區域失效。以退潮示蹤回返比例估算再循環，將實際更新率與純幾何潮稜體分開報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles. Compare tracer returns between flood and ebb, using stations in several branches to identify where the complete-mixing assumption fails. Estimate recirculation from returning ebb tracers and report actual renewal separately from the geometric tidal prism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tidal prism and ecological exchange, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles. Compare tracer returns between flood and ebb, using stations in several branches to identify where the complete-mixing assumption fails.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮稜體與生態交換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal prism and ecological exchange"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對齊潮位基準、濕潤面積曲線與鹽度剖面；比較漲落潮的示蹤訊號是否返回，並以多個分支測站判斷完全混合假設在哪些區域失效。
平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles.
Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm.

quiz.explanationEn: Align tidal datum, wetted-area curves and salinity profiles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮稜體與生態交換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and ecological exchange: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮稜體與生態交換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal prism and ecological exchange” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. Counting recirculated seawater repeatedly as new inflow underestimates contaminant residence and can conceal localized oxygen depletion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Counting recirculated seawater repeatedly as new inflow underestimates contaminant residence and can conceal localized oxygen depletion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. Counting recirculated seawater repeatedly as new inflow underestimates contaminant residence and can conceal localized oxygen depletion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潮稜體與生態交換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal prism and ecological exchange" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。
只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet.
A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats.
quiz.explanation: 只用固定面積乘潮差可能漏掉潮灘乾濕變化；把同一團回流海水重複計為新水，也會低估污染物停留時間，掩蓋局部缺氧風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed area times tidal range misses wetting and drying of tidal flats. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙側水壓合力」與「反濾層顆粒保持」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential hydrostatic gate force" and "Filter particle retention": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙側水壓合力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential hydrostatic gate force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙側水壓合力」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential hydrostatic gate force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘門承受兩側壓力之差，兩邊都濕潤時不能只畫上游三角形。合力大小與作用點分別決定傳遞到支承的剪力及彎矩；潮位反轉時也必須檢查相反方向的接觸與止水。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設直立矩形板寬10 m，兩側水深6及4 m，同密度淡水且靜止；F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN，不含波浪或海水密度差。 測站基準差會造成虛假淨水頭，導致支承反力估計偏移。若忽略波浪瞬時吸力或門體變形，靜水合力相符仍不能證明焊縫與導輪安全。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙側水壓合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet. Resultant magnitude and elevation determine support shear and moment. Reversing the tide also reverses contact and seal demands. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume a vertical rectangular plate ten metres wide, still fresh water depths 6 and 4 m: F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN, excluding waves and seawater density differences. A gauge datum mismatch creates false net head and shifts inferred reactions. Ignoring transient wave suction or gate deformation means agreement with hydrostatic force cannot demonstrate weld or guide-wheel adequacy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential hydrostatic gate force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet. Resultant magnitude and elevation determine support shear and moment.

steps.title: 雙側水壓合力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential hydrostatic gate force: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential hydrostatic gate force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設直立矩形板寬10 m，兩側水深6及4 m，同密度淡水且靜止；F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN，不含波浪或海水密度差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume a vertical rectangular plate ten metres wide, still fresh water depths 6 and 4 m: F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN, excluding waves and seawater density differences. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別繪出兩側壓力圖後相減，再對底部積分求彎矩；將水位計的共同基準與閘門幾何測量交叉核對，不能用壓差單值猜合力作用點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot both pressure diagrams, subtract them and integrate moments about the base.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 測站基準差會造成虛假淨水頭，導致支承反力估計偏移。若忽略波浪瞬時吸力或門體變形，靜水合力相符仍不能證明焊縫與導輪安全。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gauge datum mismatch creates false net head and shifts inferred reactions. Ignoring transient wave suction or gate deformation means agreement with hydrostatic force cannot demonstrate weld or guide-wheel adequacy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 反濾層顆粒保持：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter particle retention: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反濾層顆粒保持」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 護床石下方的細土不能被水流穿過大孔隙帶走，反濾層須同時保持基土並讓水排出。單一粒徑比例只是初步篩選；廣級配、分散性與流向反轉需要材料試驗，不能靠增厚大石代替細部相容。 假設基土d85=0.5 mm、反濾料D15=1.8 mm，保持比D15/d85=3.6；只作粒徑比較，不宣稱適用所有土類的驗收門檻。 粗料看似排水良好卻可能放走細土，過細反濾層則會堵塞並增加上浮水壓。若只檢查料場樣品，現場離析形成的薄弱帶可能完全漏判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反濾層顆粒保持」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fine foundation soil must not migrate through voids beneath armor. Filters must retain the base soil while allowing drainage. A grain-size ratio is only screening evidence; broad grading, dispersivity and flow reversal require material testing rather than simply placing thicker large rock. Assume base-soil d85=0.5 mm and filter D15=1.8 mm. Their retention ratio is 3.6, a grading comparison rather than an acceptance limit applicable to every soil. Coarse material may drain freely while losing soil; an overly fine filter can clog and raise uplift. Stockpile-only testing can entirely miss weak bands produced by segregation during placement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter particle retention” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.5 mm、反濾料D15=1.8 mm，保持比D15/d85=3.6；只作粒徑比較，不宣稱適用所有土類的驗收門檻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base-soil d85=0.5 mm and filter D15=1.8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反濾料越粗越厚就一定越能阻止基土流失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coarser and thicker filter material always prevents more base-soil loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反濾層顆粒保持」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 護床起動與尺度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「護床起動與尺度」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Armor mobility and scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 床粒起動受流體剪應力與顆粒有效重量競爭控制。Shields參數把尺寸和密度納入同一比值，但局部亂流、坡度及石塊咬合會改變實際起動。它適合比較候選護床，不直接決定完整海床保護設計。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設床剪應力30 Pa、石密度2650、水密度1000 kg/m³、粒徑0.1 m；θ=30/((2650−1000)9.81×0.1)=0.01853，非通用臨界值。 邊緣保護長度不足會產生淘刷坑，再向墩底倒退侵蝕。即使石塊本身未被搬走，下面的反濾料被抽出仍可能使護床整片下沉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「護床起動與尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Particle motion reflects competition between fluid shear and submerged particle weight. The Shields parameter includes size and density, but local turbulence, slope and interlocking alter actual initiation. It compares candidate protection materials without determining a complete seabed protection design. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume shear stress 30 Pa, rock and water densities 2650 and 1000 kg/m³, diameter 0.1 m: θ=30/((2650−1000)9.81×0.1)=0.01853. This is not a universal critical value. Insufficient edge protection creates a scour hole that can migrate back toward the pier. Even immobile armor can subside as a sheet when underlying filter material is removed through its voids. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Armor mobility and scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².

steps.title: 墩底接觸偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric pier bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「墩底接觸偏心」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric pier bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 巨型墩底將門體水平荷載轉成基礎壓力分布，偏心越大越可能出現局部脫離。線性接觸模型只有在全底面受壓時適用；海床不平、局部沖刷與土體壓縮會使剛體假設改變。 假設每延米底寬12 m、豎力2400 kN/m、偏心1 m，全壓線性模型q=V/B(1±6e/B)，得到300及100 kPa；未考慮上浮。 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。若線性式算出拉應力仍保留全接觸面積，後續承載力分析會系統性低估局部集中。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墩底接觸偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A large pier converts gate horizontal loading into foundation pressure. Increasing eccentricity can cause partial separation. Linear contact stress applies only with full compression; uneven seabed, local scour and compressible ground can invalidate the assumed rigid-base behavior. Assume base width 12 m, vertical force 2400 kN/m and eccentricity 1 m. Full-contact linear q=V/B(1±6e/B) gives 300 and 100 kPa, before uplift is considered. Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading. Keeping a full contact area after the linear solution predicts tension systematically understates local stress concentration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric pier bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每延米底寬12 m、豎力2400 kN/m、偏心1 m，全壓線性模型q=V/B(1±6e/B)，得到300及100 kPa；未考慮上浮。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base width 12 m, vertical force 2400 kN/m and eccentricity 1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基底算出拉力時仍可直接沿用全接觸線性壓力式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Full-contact linear base-pressure equations remain valid after predicting tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「墩底接觸偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric pier bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 把傾斜、沉降與底部孔壓的時間序列同步，先扣除潮汐彈性反應，再查反覆荷載後是否留下殘餘位移；重算淨豎力和接觸面積。分別計算扣除孔壓前後的合力位置，檢查最小接觸應力是否仍保持受壓。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize tilt, settlement and foundation pore-pressure histories. Separate reversible tidal response from residual displacement after loading, then recalculate net vertical force and actual contact area. Calculate resultant locations before and after uplift subtraction and confirm the minimum contact stress remains compressive.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以墩底接觸偏心編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把傾斜、沉降與底部孔壓的時間序列同步，先扣除潮汐彈性反應，再查反覆荷載後是否留下殘餘位移；重算淨豎力和接觸面積。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for eccentric pier bearing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Synchronize tilt, settlement and foundation pore-pressure histories. Separate reversible tidal response from residual displacement after loading, then recalculate net vertical force and actual contact area.

quiz.question: 要驗證「墩底接觸偏心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Eccentric pier bearing"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。
把傾斜、沉降與底部孔壓的時間序列同步，先扣除潮汐彈性反應，再查反覆荷載後是否留下殘餘位移；重算淨豎力和接觸面積。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet.
Synchronize tilt, settlement and foundation pore-pressure histories.
quiz.explanation: 把傾斜、沉降與底部孔壓的時間序列同步，先扣除潮汐彈性反應，再查反覆荷載後是否留下殘餘位移；重算淨豎力和接觸面積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize tilt, settlement and foundation pore-pressure histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 墩底接觸偏心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric pier bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩底接觸偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eccentric pier bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。若線性式算出拉應力仍保留全接觸面積，後續承載力分析會系統性低估局部集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading. Keeping a full contact area after the linear solution predicts tension systematically understates local stress concentration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若線性式算出拉應力仍保留全接觸面積，後續承載力分析會系統性低估局部集中。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keeping a full contact area after the linear solution predicts tension systematically understates local stress concentration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基底算出拉力時仍可直接沿用全接觸線性壓力式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Full-contact linear base-pressure equations remain valid after predicting tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。若線性式算出拉應力仍保留全接觸面積，後續承載力分析會系統性低估局部集中。
knowledge.textEn: Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading. Keeping a full contact area after the linear solution predicts tension systematically understates local stress concentration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「墩底接觸偏心」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric pier bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
外海達到低潮時，基底孔壓必定同時達到最低。
optionsEn: Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide.
quiz.explanation: 把總重量直接當有效正向力會高估抗滑與接觸壓力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating gross weight as effective normal force overestimates sliding resistance and contact loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮位滯後與上浮」與「弗勞德縮尺相似」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tidal lag and uplift" and "Froude model similarity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潮位滯後與上浮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal lag and uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮位滯後與上浮」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal lag and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮水變化傳入地基孔隙需要時間，因此外部低潮不保證墩底孔壓也低。排水路徑與滲透率決定壓力滯後，必須用同時刻的外水位與基底壓力計算有效重量。靜態最高水位包絡未必捕捉最差組合。 假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。 排水堵塞可能先表現為退潮後孔壓消散變慢，而不是最大讀數突然增高。只看每日峰值會錯過有效重量最低的短暫階段，掩蓋滑動敏感期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮位滯後與上浮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tidal changes take time to propagate through foundation pores, so low external water does not ensure low pressure beneath a pier. Drainage paths and permeability control lag. Effective weight requires simultaneous external and basal pressures, not unrelated maximum-level envelopes. Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Additional uplift U=ΔuA=5000 kN. Uniform pressure is assumed, excluding phase differences across the base. Drainage blockage may first appear as slower dissipation after ebb rather than a higher peak reading. Daily maxima alone miss brief minimum-effective-weight periods and conceal increased sliding sensitivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal lag and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外海達到低潮時，基底孔壓必定同時達到最低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮位滯後與上浮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tidal lag and uplift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮位滯後與上浮
knowledge.text: 潮水變化傳入地基孔隙需要時間，因此外部低潮不保證墩底孔壓也低。排水路徑與滲透率決定壓力滯後，必須用同時刻的外水位與基底壓力計算有效重量。
knowledge.textEn: Tidal changes take time to propagate through foundation pores, so low external water does not ensure low pressure beneath a pier. Drainage paths and permeability control lag.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外海達到低潮時，基底孔壓必定同時達到最低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮位滯後與上浮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tidal lag and uplift" is correct?
options: 外海達到低潮時，基底孔壓必定同時達到最低。
潮水變化傳入地基孔隙需要時間，因此外部低潮不保證墩底孔壓也低。
模型水面符合弗勞德相似，顆粒運動就必然正確縮尺。
optionsEn: Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide.
Tidal changes take time to propagate through foundation pores, so low external water does not ensure low pressure beneath a pier.
Froude-similar water surfaces guarantee correctly scaled sediment movement.
quiz.explanation: 潮水變化傳入地基孔隙需要時間，因此外部低潮不保證墩底孔壓也低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tidal changes take time to propagate through foundation pores, so low external water does not ensure low pressure beneath a pier. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮位滯後與上浮：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tidal lag and uplift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮位滯後與上浮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tidal lag and uplift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Additional uplift U=ΔuA=5000 kN. Uniform pressure is assumed, excluding phase differences across the base. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Additional uplift U=ΔuA=5000 kN. Uniform pressure is assumed, excluding phase differences across the base.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮位滯後與上浮」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tidal lag and uplift", which statement holds?
options: 只要板件餘厚足夠，焊縫就不可能存在疲勞裂紋。
潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。
optionsEn: Adequate remaining plate thickness rules out fatigue cracks at welds.
A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潮位滯後與上浮：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tidal lag and uplift: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮位滯後與上浮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tidal lag and uplift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。計算外水位與孔壓的交叉相關延遲，確認滯後可在多個完整潮週期重現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Compare integrated uplift with the timing of observed pier tilting. Calculate the cross-correlation lag between external level and pore pressure and confirm repeatability across complete tidal cycles. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以潮位滯後與上浮編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tidal lag and uplift, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Compare integrated uplift with the timing of observed pier tilting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水堵塞可能先表現為退潮後孔壓消散變慢，而不是最大讀數突然增高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drainage blockage may first appear as slower dissipation after ebb rather than a higher peak reading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。計算外水位與孔壓的交叉相關延遲，確認滯後可在多個完整潮週期重現。
knowledge.textEn: Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Compare integrated uplift with the timing of observed pier tilting. Calculate the cross-correlation lag between external level and pore pressure and confirm repeatability across complete tidal cycles.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以潮位滯後與上浮編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tidal lag and uplift, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Compare integrated uplift with the timing of observed pier tilting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮位滯後與上浮」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal lag and uplift"?
options: 以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
反濾料越粗越厚就一定越能阻止基土流失。
optionsEn: Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Coarser and thicker filter material always prevents more base-soil loss.
quiz.explanation: 以不同深度孔壓計追蹤漲退潮的相位與幅度，並確認儀器氣泡、零點漂移和資料延遲；將孔壓積分的上浮結果與傾斜事件時間對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track phase and amplitude using piezometers at several depths, checking trapped air, zero drift and logging delay. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮位滯後與上浮：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮位滯後與上浮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal lag and uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水堵塞可能先表現為退潮後孔壓消散變慢，而不是最大讀數突然增高。只看每日峰值會錯過有效重量最低的短暫階段，掩蓋滑動敏感期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage blockage may first appear as slower dissipation after ebb rather than a higher peak reading. Daily maxima alone miss brief minimum-effective-weight periods and conceal increased sliding sensitivity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外海達到低潮時，基底孔壓必定同時達到最低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Foundation pore pressure necessarily reaches its minimum at external low tide." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺相似：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude model similarity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「弗勞德縮尺相似」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Froude model similarity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力主導自由水面的試驗需保持弗勞德數，速度和時間按長度平方根縮放。黏性與表面張力通常不能同時滿足相似，所以模型中的薄水層與小顆粒運動可能失真，量測結果必須附尺度限制。 假設原型與模型長度比25:1，模型流速0.4 m/s；原型速度為0.4√25=2 m/s，模型60 s對應原型300 s；僅適用重力相似。 把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。即使水面曲線相似，沖刷深度仍可能受到顆粒尺度效應支配，不能只靠影片判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弗勞德縮尺相似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests preserve Froude number, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity and surface tension generally cannot also be matched, so thin flows and small particle motions may distort and require explicit scale qualifications. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio 25:1 and model velocity 0.4 m/s. Prototype velocity is 0.4√25=2 m/s; model 60 s represents 300 s, under gravity similarity only. Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism. Even similar water-surface curves may accompany scale-dependent scour depths, so visual similarity alone is not adequate validation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude model similarity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Froude-similar water surfaces guarantee correctly scaled sediment movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「弗勞德縮尺相似」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原型與模型長度比25:1，模型流速0.4 m/s；原型速度為0.4√25=2 m/s，模型60 s對應原型300 s；僅適用重力相似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume prototype-to-model length ratio 25:1 and model velocity 0.4 m/s. Prototype velocity is 0.4√25=2 m/s; model 60 s represents 300 s, under gravity similarity only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。即使水面曲線相似，沖刷深度仍可能受到顆粒尺度效應支配，不能只靠影片判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism. Even similar water-surface curves may accompany scale-dependent scour depths, so visual similarity alone is not adequate validation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「弗勞德縮尺相似」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Froude model similarity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。
把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm.
Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預報偏差與時間裕度」與「腐蝕餘厚與疲勞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Forecast bias and time margin" and "Corrosion allowance and fatigue": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預報偏差與時間裕度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Forecast bias and time margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預報偏差與時間裕度」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Forecast bias and time margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防潮決策必須在危險水位抵達前完成資訊、判斷與機械動作。預報水位誤差和到達時間誤差是不同量，海象快速惡化時不能互相替代。課堂只分析時間預算，不重建任何設施的實際關閘規則。 假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。 通訊中斷、供電擾動與人員確認可能同受一場風暴影響，直接相加獨立平均值會高估裕度。時間戳不一致也可能把資料延遲誤認為機械遲緩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預報偏差與時間裕度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A protective decision must accommodate information, assessment and mechanical response before hazardous water arrives. Water-level error differs from arrival-time error and cannot substitute for it during rapid change. The classroom model examines a time budget without reproducing operational closure rules. Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min. Remaining margin is 40 min; all are assumed and exclude correlated delays and forecast uncertainty. Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Forecast bias and time margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預報偏差與時間裕度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Forecast bias and time margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預報偏差與時間裕度
knowledge.text: 防潮決策必須在危險水位抵達前完成資訊、判斷與機械動作。預報水位誤差和到達時間誤差是不同量，海象快速惡化時不能互相替代。
knowledge.textEn: A protective decision must accommodate information, assessment and mechanical response before hazardous water arrives. Water-level error differs from arrival-time error and cannot substitute for it during rapid change.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預報偏差與時間裕度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Forecast bias and time margin" is correct?
options: 防潮決策必須在危險水位抵達前完成資訊、判斷與機械動作。
平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。
只要板件餘厚足夠，焊縫就不可能存在疲勞裂紋。
optionsEn: A protective decision must accommodate information, assessment and mechanical response before hazardous water arrives.
Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm.
Adequate remaining plate thickness rules out fatigue cracks at welds.
quiz.explanation: 防潮決策必須在危險水位抵達前完成資訊、判斷與機械動作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A protective decision must accommodate information, assessment and mechanical response before hazardous water arrives. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預報偏差與時間裕度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forecast bias and time margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預報偏差與時間裕度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Forecast bias and time margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min. Remaining margin is 40 min; all are assumed and exclude correlated delays and forecast uncertainty. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在歷次演練資料標註預報發行、接收、確認與完成時間，以同一時鐘計算分布；另列漏報與假警報，不能只報平均完成時間來評價決策品質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Timestamp forecast issue, receipt, confirmation and completion in exercise records using one clock.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min. Remaining margin is 40 min; all are assumed and exclude correlated delays and forecast uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預報偏差與時間裕度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Forecast bias and time margin", which statement holds?
options: 潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min。
反濾料越粗越厚就一定越能阻止基土流失。
optionsEn: A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min.
Coarser and thicker filter material always prevents more base-soil loss.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設預警提前150 min、判讀20 min、準備15 min、動作75 min，剩餘裕度40 min；各值皆假設，未含相關延遲與預報不確定度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume warning lead 150 min, assessment 20 min, preparation 15 min and movement 75 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預報偏差與時間裕度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forecast bias and time margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預報偏差與時間裕度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Forecast bias and time margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在歷次演練資料標註預報發行、接收、確認與完成時間，以同一時鐘計算分布；另列漏報與假警報，不能只報平均完成時間來評價決策品質。以最慢實測階段重建時間預算，檢查不確定度同時放大時是否仍有足夠裕度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Timestamp forecast issue, receipt, confirmation and completion in exercise records using one clock. Evaluate missed events and false alarms separately instead of judging decisions solely by average completion time. Rebuild the budget using slow observed stages and assess remaining margin when several uncertainties increase together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以預報偏差與時間裕度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在歷次演練資料標註預報發行、接收、確認與完成時間，以同一時鐘計算分布；另列漏報與假警報，不能只報平均完成時間來評價決策品質。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for forecast bias and time margin, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Timestamp forecast issue, receipt, confirmation and completion in exercise records using one clock. Evaluate missed events and false alarms separately instead of judging decisions solely by average completion time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：通訊中斷、供電擾動與人員確認可能同受一場風暴影響，直接相加獨立平均值會高估裕度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在歷次演練資料標註預報發行、接收、確認與完成時間，以同一時鐘計算分布；另列漏報與假警報，不能只報平均完成時間來評價決策品質。以最慢實測階段重建時間預算，檢查不確定度同時放大時是否仍有足夠裕度。

quiz.question: 要驗證「預報偏差與時間裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Forecast bias and time margin"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Full-contact linear base-pressure equations remain valid after predicting tension.
Timestamp forecast issue, receipt, confirmation and completion in exercise records using one clock.

steps.title: 腐蝕餘厚與疲勞：機制與系統路徑

title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
summary: 本課以荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘為入口，深入浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Maeslant storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
