workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 單參數敏感度：固定水線面積1200 m²及外水密度1025 kg/m³，只把新增質量由600 t降至300 t。ΔT=m/(ρA)由0.4878 m降至0.2439 m，恰為一半；此比例限小吃水變化與固定水線面積，不適用浸沒後水線形狀明顯改變的狀態。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For a one-parameter sensitivity comparison, hold waterplane area at 1200 m² and external density at 1025 kg/m³, reducing only added mass from 600 t to 300 t. ΔT=m/(ρA) falls from 0.4878 m to 0.2439 m, exactly half. This scaling assumes small draft changes and a constant waterplane, not substantially changed submerged geometry.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮運吃水與壓載」與「球鉸支臂力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Floating draft and ballast" and "Spherical-joint arm moment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮運吃水與壓載」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floating draft and ballast” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。 假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮運吃水與壓載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height. Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Floating draft and ballast” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「浮運吃水與壓載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Floating draft and ballast”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮運吃水與壓載
knowledge.text: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。
knowledge.textEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮運吃水與壓載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Floating draft and ballast" is correct?
options: 浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。
球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
optionsEn: Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy.
A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
quiz.explanation: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮運吃水與壓載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floating draft and ballast” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮運吃水與壓載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Floating draft and ballast", which statement holds?
options: 曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³。
optionsEn: Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浮運吃水與壓載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floating draft and ballast” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。利用各艙液位推算重心移動，核對觀測傾斜方向是否符合新增壓載的位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately. Infer center-of-gravity movement from individual tank levels and check that observed heel matches the added ballast location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以浮運吃水與壓載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for floating draft and ballast, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。利用各艙液位推算重心移動，核對觀測傾斜方向是否符合新增壓載的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately. Infer center-of-gravity movement from individual tank levels and check that observed heel matches the added ballast location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以浮運吃水與壓載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for floating draft and ballast, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮運吃水與壓載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Floating draft and ballast"?
options: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。
optionsEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Doubling equipment automatically squares the complete system failure probability.
quiz.explanation: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮運吃水與壓載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floating draft and ballast” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。
knowledge.textEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮運吃水與壓載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Floating draft and ballast" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。
球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight.
A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
quiz.explanation: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「球鉸支臂力矩」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spherical-joint arm moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。支臂幾何控制力矩和軸力分配，轉動自由不代表沒有反力。 假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「球鉸支臂力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces. Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spherical-joint arm moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「球鉸支臂力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spherical-joint arm moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 球鉸支臂力矩
knowledge.text: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。支臂幾何控制力矩和軸力分配，轉動自由不代表沒有反力。
knowledge.textEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「球鉸支臂力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spherical-joint arm moment" is correct?
options: 球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。
球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。
optionsEn: A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations.
quiz.explanation: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「球鉸支臂力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spherical-joint arm moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「球鉸支臂力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spherical-joint arm moment", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。
壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m.
A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「球鉸支臂力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spherical-joint arm moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。將支臂內力重組為基礎合力，檢查向量和與外部門體水壓是否閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length. Reassemble arm forces into foundation resultants and check vector closure against the externally applied gate pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以球鉸支臂力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for spherical-joint arm moment, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spherical-joint arm moment"?

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球鉸支臂力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spherical-joint arm moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支臂壓桿穩定」與「曲面門水壓分解」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arm compression-member stability" and "Resolving pressure on curved gates": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支臂壓桿穩定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arm compression-member stability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支臂壓桿穩定」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arm compression-member stability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細長支臂桿件可能先失穩再達材料降伏，端部拘束決定有效長度。理想歐拉式只說明幾何敏感性，實際彎曲與殘餘應力需另外處理。 假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。若只檢查材料強度，便可能漏掉受壓桿件突然出現的側向失穩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支臂壓桿穩定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slender arm member can buckle before yielding, and end restraint sets effective length. Euler theory illustrates geometric sensitivity but leaves initial curvature and residual stresses to separate assessment. Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions. Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arm compression-member stability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instructionEn: Pressure acts normal to a curved surface. Its horizontal component follows the vertical projection, while its vertical component relates to an imaginary overlying water volume; surface area times maximum pressure is inappropriate. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate. Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant. steps.instruction: 分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。以相同水位的獨立積分重算垂直分量，確認水平投影沒有被當成全部濕潤面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Revise wetted boundaries whenever water overtops the gate or occupies both sides. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 曲面門水壓分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resolving pressure on curved gates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲面門水壓分解」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Resolving pressure on curved gates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曲面門水壓分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolving pressure on curved gates" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。
壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact.
A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
quiz.explanation: 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由液面穩定修正」與「沉放前底隙流量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-surface stability correction" and "Under-gate flow before seating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由液面穩定修正：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-surface stability correction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由液面穩定修正」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-surface stability correction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。相同水量分裝在窄艙或集中於寬艙，穩定效果可以不同。 假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由液面穩定修正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability. Equal water volumes distributed among narrow tanks or one wide tank can have different effects. Assume tank-liquid density 1000 kg/m³, free-surface second moment 8000 m⁴ and displacement mass 20 million kg. Virtual center-of-gravity rise ρI/m=0.4 m, for small heel. An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-surface stability correction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tank-liquid density 1000 kg/m³, free-surface second moment 8000 m⁴ and displacement mass 20 million kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由液面穩定修正」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free-surface stability correction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由液面穩定修正
knowledge.text: 未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。相同水量分裝在窄艙或集中於寬艙，穩定效果可以不同。
knowledge.textEn: Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability. Equal water volumes distributed among narrow tanks or one wide tank can have different effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由液面穩定修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free-surface stability correction" is correct?
options: 壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。
optionsEn: A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.
Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability.
quiz.explanation: 未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free-surface stability correction", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。

steps.title: 自由液面穩定修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free-surface stability correction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由液面穩定修正」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-surface stability correction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以艙形與液位算自由液面慣性矩，核對隔板是否真正限制橫向流動；將傾角資料對應每個充水階段，而非只看最初和最終狀態。在圖面標出每個可連通液面，依真正連通寬度重算慣性矩而不是依名義隔間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate free-surface moments from tank shape and level, checking whether baffles actually restrict transverse flow. Relate heel measurements to each filling stage rather than only initial and final conditions. Mark communicating liquid surfaces on drawings and recalculate their moments using actual connected widths rather than nominal subdivisions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for free-surface stability correction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calculate free-surface moments from tank shape and level, checking whether baffles actually restrict transverse flow. Relate heel measurements to each filling stage rather than only initial and final conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 自由液面穩定修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free-surface stability correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由液面穩定修正」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-surface stability correction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由液面穩定修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free-surface stability correction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.
An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks.
quiz.explanation: 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沉放前底隙流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Under-gate flow before seating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉放前底隙流量」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Under-gate flow before seating” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘門接近底床時，剩餘狹縫承受水位差並形成高速流。縮小間隙可能降低總流量卻提高局部梯度，對沉積物與門體振動產生不同作用。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設狹縫寬30 m、高0.2 m、壓差水頭1 m、Cd=0.65；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s，僅為穩定孔口近似。 底床殘留砂石會使間隙不均，形成集中噴流與不對稱支承。若把單一水位差當作整條狹縫的條件，可能漏判局部氣蝕或振動區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉放前底隙流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: As a gate approaches the sill, the remaining slot carries the head difference and forms a jet. A smaller gap may reduce discharge while increasing local gradients, affecting sediment and vibration differently. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume slot width 30 m, height 0.2 m, head difference 1 m and Cd=0.65. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s, a steady-orifice approximation only. Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. Assigning one head difference uniformly along the slot may miss localized cavitation or vibration zones near changing sill geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Under-gate flow before seating” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉放前底隙流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Under-gate flow before seating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉放前底隙流量
knowledge.text: 閘門接近底床時，剩餘狹縫承受水位差並形成高速流。縮小間隙可能降低總流量卻提高局部梯度，對沉積物與門體振動產生不同作用。
knowledge.textEn: As a gate approaches the sill, the remaining slot carries the head difference and forms a jet. A smaller gap may reduce discharge while increasing local gradients, affecting sediment and vibration differently.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉放前底隙流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Under-gate flow before seating" is correct?
options: 閘門接近底床時，剩餘狹縫承受水位差並形成高速流。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。
optionsEn: As a gate approaches the sill, the remaining slot carries the head difference and forms a jet.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.
Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.
quiz.explanation: 閘門接近底床時，剩餘狹縫承受水位差並形成高速流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: As a gate approaches the sill, the remaining slot carries the head difference and forms a jet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉放前底隙流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Under-gate flow before seating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉放前底隙流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Under-gate flow before seating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設狹縫寬30 m、高0.2 m、壓差水頭1 m、Cd=0.65；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s，僅為穩定孔口近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume slot width 30 m, height 0.2 m, head difference 1 m and Cd=0.65. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s, a steady-orifice approximation only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照底隙幾何、上下游水位與局部聲學流速，檢查孔口係數是否隨門位改變；把渦動頻率與門體振動頻譜比較而非只看流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare gap geometry, head and local acoustic velocities, checking how the discharge coefficient varies with position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume slot width 30 m, height 0.2 m, head difference 1 m and Cd=0.65. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s, a steady-orifice approximation only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉放前底隙流量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Under-gate flow before seating", which statement holds?
options: 多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。

optionsEn: Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.

quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 止水縫漏流診斷：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 止水縫的漏流同時受縫寬、壓差和變形控制，漏水量增大不一定是橡膠老化。以同水頭比較流量，可先排除水位改變造成的表面趨勢。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設長10 m、縫寬2 mm、Cd=0.6、Δh=3 m；Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s，均勻縫且無黏性修正。 小縫中的黏性流可能不遵守孔口平方根關係，不能把正規化曲線偏移全歸於磨耗。雜物卡縫與門體歪斜也會產生相似漏水訊號。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水縫漏流診斷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seal leakage depends on gap, head and deformation, so increased flow does not necessarily indicate rubber ageing. Comparing at equal head first removes water-level changes that can imitate deterioration. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume length 10 m, gap 2 mm, Cd=0.6 and head 3 m. Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s, for a uniform slot without viscous correction. Viscous flow through a very narrow gap may not follow the orifice square-root law. Debris and gate misalignment can imitate wear, so normalized curve changes do not uniquely identify material deterioration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal leakage diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 共同原因與備援：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Common cause and redundancy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共同原因與備援」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Common cause and redundancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩套備援設備若共用電源、機房或感測來源，就不是完全獨立。風暴可能同時破壞多條功能鏈，可靠度計算必須把共同原因與單機失效分開。 假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同原因與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Redundant equipment sharing power, rooms or sensing is not fully independent. One storm may damage several functional chains, requiring common-cause events to be separated from individual equipment failures. Assume independent unit-failure probabilities 0.02 and common-cause probability 0.005. Simplified total q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398, not a measured site reliability. Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Common cause and redundancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 共同原因與備援

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling equipment automatically squares the complete system failure probability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共同原因與備援」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.

steps.title: 共同原因與備援：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共同原因與備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Common cause and redundancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent unit-failure probabilities 0.02 and common-cause probability 0.005. Simplified total q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398, not a measured site reliability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.

steps.titleEn: Common cause and redundancy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共同原因與備援」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Common cause and redundancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。追查演練中兩套設備同時失去功能的事件，確認共同原因沒有被拆成兩件獨立故障。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Use exercise events to verify actual separation and document the justification for each independence assumption in the fault tree. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「資料延遲與判斷鏈」與「荷載循環與疲勞累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Data latency in decisions" and "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資料延遲與判斷鏈」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Data latency in decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。將取樣延遲和運算時間分開，才能定位錯誤。 假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資料延遲與判斷鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. A plausible displayed water level may be stale, so sampling latency must be separated from computation time to diagnose the chain. Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast. Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Data latency in decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Data latency in decisions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈
knowledge.text: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。將取樣延遲和運算時間分開，才能定位錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. A plausible displayed water level may be stale, so sampling latency must be separated from computation time to diagnose the chain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資料延遲與判斷鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Data latency in decisions" is correct?
options: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。
多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。
累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。
optionsEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags.
Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.
A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
quiz.explanation: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Data latency in decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Data latency in decisions", which statement holds?
options: 球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。
曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
optionsEn: A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min.
Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資料延遲與判斷鏈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Data latency in decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。以原始量測時間重排事件，核對資料更新旗標能否辨識通訊恢復後抵達的過期讀數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors. Reorder events by measurement time and verify that freshness flags identify stale readings arriving after communications recover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以資料延遲與判斷鏈編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for data latency in decisions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。以原始量測時間重排事件，核對資料更新旗標能否辨識通訊恢復後抵達的過期讀數。
knowledge.textEn: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors. Reorder events by measurement time and verify that freshness flags identify stale readings arriving after communications recover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以資料延遲與判斷鏈編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for data latency in decisions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資料延遲與判斷鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Data latency in decisions"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.
In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records.
quiz.explanation: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Data latency in decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。
knowledge.textEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資料延遲與判斷鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Data latency in decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。
optionsEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
quiz.explanation: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「荷載循環與疲勞累積」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。疲勞累積依應力範圍分組，小幅循環數量多也可能有影響，但線性損傷和忽略序列只是近似。 假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「荷載循環與疲勞累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. Fatigue accumulation groups stress ranges; many smaller cycles may matter, but linear damage and sequence independence remain approximations. Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life. A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積
knowledge.text: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。疲勞累積依應力範圍分組，小幅循環數量多也可能有影響，但線性損傷和忽略序列只是近似。
knowledge.textEn: Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. Fatigue accumulation groups stress ranges; many smaller cycles may matter, but linear damage and sequence independence remain approximations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷載循環與疲勞累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation" is correct?
options: 累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。
大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。
浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
optionsEn: A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms.
Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
quiz.explanation: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「荷載循環與疲勞累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。以局部應變循環重新分箱計數，將雨流計數所得範圍與所用疲勞細節曲線一致對應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail. Rebin local strain cycles and consistently match rainflow stress ranges to the selected fatigue-detail curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以荷載循環與疲勞累積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for load cycles and fatigue accumulation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
