quiz.question: 要驗證「荷載循環與疲勞累積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation"?
options: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。
optionsEn: Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.
quiz.explanation: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。
knowledge.textEn: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷載循環與疲勞累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。
浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life.
Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
quiz.explanation: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 泰晤士河防洪閘
summary: 本課以泰晤士河防洪閘為入口，深入旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Thames Barrier as its entry point, this course examines rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 另作固定姿態的敏感度比較：力臂維持1.5 m、淨重量與浮力矩−2 MN·m、摩擦矩0.5 MN·m，只把水壓合力4 MN改為5 MN。需求轉矩F×1.5−2+0.5由4.5增至6.0 MN·m，增加33.33%；這是獨立力擾動，不把它當作水位變動時力臂也固定的真實閘門預測。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. At the same posture, keep the lever arm at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment at −2 MN·m and friction moment at 0.5 MN·m, changing only water resultant from 4 MN to 5 MN. Required torque F×1.5−2+0.5 rises from 4.5 to 6.0 MN·m, or 33.33%. This isolated force perturbation does not predict a real stage change, which may also shift the lever arm.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rotating-gate drive torque" and "Surge phase and tidal superposition": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋轉門體驅動力矩」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotating-gate drive torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。各力臂隨角度改變，最大水壓不一定對應最大驅動需求。 假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋轉門體驅動力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque. At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotating-gate drive torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rotating-gate drive torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩

knowledge.textEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旋轉門體驅動力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rotating-gate drive torque" is correct?
options: 最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。
兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。
optionsEn: Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction.
Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
quiz.explanation: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotating-gate drive torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旋轉門體驅動力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotating-gate drive torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。比較起轉前後扭矩殘差，確認峰值是外載改變還是靜摩擦釋放造成的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level. Compare torque residuals before and after breakaway to separate changed external load from the release of static friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rotating-gate drive torque, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 暴潮相位與潮汐疊加：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Surge phase and tidal superposition: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surge phase and tidal superposition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 天文潮與氣象暴潮的峰值可能不同時到達。簡單線性相加可說明相位重要性，真實河口中摩擦與水深又使交互作用非線性。 假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Astronomical tide and meteorological surge can peak at different times. Linear addition illustrates phase effects, while friction and changing depth make real estuarine interaction nonlinear. Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions. steps.instruction: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。可用庫容取決於沿岸高程與支流，不能只看閘前水位。 假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉期間河水蓄積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.titleEn: River storage during closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「關閉期間河水蓄積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “River storage during closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關閉期間河水蓄積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通航窗口與排程」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Navigation windows and scheduling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。平均船舶到達率無法描述尖峰排隊與關閉後的復原時間。 假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通航窗口與排程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure. Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear. If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Navigation windows and scheduling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通航窗口與排程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Navigation windows and scheduling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。

options: 主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels。
optionsEn: Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通航窗口與排程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Navigation windows and scheduling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。從累積到達與離開曲線的垂直距離求隊列，並核對復原斜率是否真正大於到達率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput. Derive queue size from cumulative arrival-departure separation and verify that recovery service genuinely exceeds arrivals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以通航窗口與排程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for navigation windows and scheduling, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。從累積到達與離開曲線的垂直距離求隊列，並核對復原斜率是否真正大於到達率。
knowledge.textEn: Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput. Derive queue size from cumulative arrival-departure separation and verify that recovery service genuinely exceeds arrivals.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以通航窗口與排程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for navigation windows and scheduling, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通航窗口與排程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Navigation windows and scheduling"?
options: 用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
optionsEn: Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
quiz.explanation: 用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通航窗口與排程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Navigation windows and scheduling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通航窗口與排程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Navigation windows and scheduling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。
清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears.
Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
quiz.explanation: 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「門槽沉積與淨空」與「液壓功率與效率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gate-recess sediment and clearance" and "Hydraulic power and efficiency": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門槽沉積與淨空」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。平均淤積厚度不能代表單個硬物或高點，幾何檢查必須覆蓋整段掃掠體積。 假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門槽沉積與淨空」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A recessed gate requires a defined swept space. Sediment changes clearance and local flow, while average deposit thickness cannot represent isolated hard objects or high spots across that volume. Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force. Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「門槽沉積與淨空」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gate-recess sediment and clearance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 門槽沉積與淨空
knowledge.text: 下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。平均淤積厚度不能代表單個硬物或高點，幾何檢查必須覆蓋整段掃掠體積。
knowledge.textEn: A recessed gate requires a defined swept space. Sediment changes clearance and local flow, while average deposit thickness cannot represent isolated hard objects or high spots across that volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「門槽沉積與淨空」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gate-recess sediment and clearance" is correct?
options: 清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。
油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。
optionsEn: Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
A recessed gate requires a defined swept space.
quiz.explanation: 下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A recessed gate requires a defined swept space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門槽沉積與淨空」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「門槽沉積與淨空」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gate-recess sediment and clearance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³。
一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。
長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³.
One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「門槽沉積與淨空」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。逐格比較測深不確定度與門體幾何裕度，對最接近掃掠包絡的高點安排獨立複測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris. Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes. Compare sounding uncertainty with geometric allowance cell by cell and independently resurvey high spots nearest the swept envelope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic power and efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。相同壓力下流量不足會降低速度，不能只憑壓力表判斷動作能力。 假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「液壓功率與效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses. Insufficient flow reduces speed even at normal pressure, so a gauge alone cannot establish movement capability. Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients. Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic power and efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 要驗證「液壓功率與效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic power and efficiency"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「液壓功率與效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic power and efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。
knowledge.textEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「液壓功率與效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic power and efficiency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
optionsEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
quiz.explanation: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防線接續高程」與「波浪脈衝與反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Continuous defence elevations" and "Wave impulse and reaction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防線接續高程」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous defence elevations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。 假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防線接續高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height. Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Continuous defence elevations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「防線接續高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Continuous defence elevations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防線接續高程
knowledge.text: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。
knowledge.textEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防線接續高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous defence elevations" is correct?
options: 主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。
一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。
optionsEn: Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line.
One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
quiz.explanation: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防線接續高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Continuous defence elevations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防線接續高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Continuous defence elevations", which statement holds?
options: 長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。
optionsEn: Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防線接續高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous defence elevations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。對最低接續點進行反向水準複測，將量測閉合差納入幾何超高的不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys. Repeat leveling in reverse at the lowest connection and include survey closure error in the freeboard uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以防線接續高程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for continuous defence elevations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。對最低接續點進行反向水準複測，將量測閉合差納入幾何超高的不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys. Repeat leveling in reverse at the lowest connection and include survey closure error in the freeboard uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以防線接續高程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for continuous defence elevations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防線接續高程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Continuous defence elevations"?
options: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。

只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。

Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.

steps.title: 波浪脈衝與反力：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 波浪撞擊的峰值和持續時間共同決定脈衝，短脈衝對柔性構件的作用不同於同峰值的長載重。靜水壓力不能替代瞬態結構反應。 假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波浪脈衝與反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave impact depends on both peak and duration. A short impulse affects a flexible member differently from a sustained load of equal peak, so hydrostatics cannot substitute for transient structural response. Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s. Impulse J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s; displacement and fatigue are not obtained from this alone. Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave impulse and reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。

One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
