steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢測覆蓋與可用度」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test coverage and availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。 假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢測覆蓋與可用度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. Test interval influences latent unavailability, but constant independent failure rate is only a basic model. Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection. Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Test coverage and availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Test coverage and availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度
knowledge.text: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。
knowledge.textEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. Test interval influences latent unavailability, but constant independent failure rate is only a basic model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢測覆蓋與可用度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Test coverage and availability" is correct?
options: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。
一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
optionsEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
quiz.explanation: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test coverage and availability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test coverage and availability", which statement holds?
options: 兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003。
只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。
optionsEn: Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢測覆蓋與可用度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test coverage and availability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。將未覆蓋的故障模式逐一對應替代證據，確認停機維修時間沒有從可用度分母中刪除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately. Map uncovered failure modes to alternative evidence and verify that maintenance downtime remains in the availability denominator. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以檢測覆蓋與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for test coverage and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。將未覆蓋的故障模式逐一對應替代證據，確認停機維修時間沒有從可用度分母中刪除。
knowledge.textEn: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately. Map uncovered failure modes to alternative evidence and verify that maintenance downtime remains in the availability denominator.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以檢測覆蓋與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for test coverage and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢測覆蓋與可用度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test coverage and availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment.
quiz.explanation: 列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test coverage and availability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢測覆蓋與可用度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test coverage and availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
optionsEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
quiz.explanation: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「海平面情境與調適」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。情境外推用來比較方案，並非保證未來趨勢。 假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「海平面情境與調適」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. Scenario extrapolation compares options rather than guaranteeing a future trend. Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m. One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「海平面情境與調適」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 海平面情境與調適
knowledge.text: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。情境外推用來比較方案，並非保證未來趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. Scenario extrapolation compares options rather than guaranteeing a future trend.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「海平面情境與調適」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation" is correct?
options: 長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
optionsEn: Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
quiz.explanation: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海平面情境與調適」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「海平面情境與調適」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation", which statement holds?
options: 關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m。
optionsEn: Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海平面情境與調適」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。比較各情境對排水窗口與關閉循環的影響，明列哪些變化先觸發功能重新評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios. Compare scenario effects on drainage windows and closure cycles, stating which changes first trigger reassessment of system function. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以海平面情境與調適編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sea-level scenarios and adaptation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。比較各情境對排水窗口與關閉循環的影響，明列哪些變化先觸發功能重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios. Compare scenario effects on drainage windows and closure cycles, stating which changes first trigger reassessment of system function.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以海平面情境與調適編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sea-level scenarios and adaptation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海平面情境與調適」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation"?
options: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
optionsEn: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
quiz.explanation: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「海平面情境與調適」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。
knowledge.textEn: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「海平面情境與調適」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
quiz.explanation: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統
summary: 本課以威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統為入口，深入浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Venice MOSE flood barriers as its entry point, this course examines coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 靜水壓敏感度固定ρ=1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及大氣壓101.3 kPa，只將水深8 m增為10 m。表壓ρgh由80.442增至100.5525 kPa，增加25%；絕壓則由181.742增至201.8525 kPa，其增幅不是25%。比較只包含靜水柱，不推定送氣管損、閘門浮力或動態壓力同步變化。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For hydrostatic sensitivity, hold ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa fixed, increasing only depth from 8 m to 10 m. Gauge pressure ρgh rises from 80.442 to 100.5525 kPa, or 25%; absolute pressure rises from 181.742 to 201.8525 kPa, not by 25%. This column calculation does not infer pipe losses, gate buoyancy or dynamic pressures.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮力翻轉與重心」與「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Buoyant rotation and centroids" and "Air pressure and absolute pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮力翻轉與重心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Buoyant rotation and centroids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮力翻轉與重心」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Buoyant rotation and centroids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.titleEn: Air pressure and absolute pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air pressure and absolute pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水用空氣必須克服水深造成的外壓，壓縮氣體的狀態方程則使用絕對壓力。把表壓帶入氣體體積換算，會造成系統性的質量估算錯誤。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Displacement air must overcome external water pressure, while gas state relations require absolute pressure. Inserting gauge pressure into volume conversion systematically miscalculates air mass. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air pressure and absolute pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.text: 排水用空氣必須克服水深造成的外壓，壓縮氣體的狀態方程則使用絕對壓力。把表壓帶入氣體體積換算，會造成系統性的質量估算錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Displacement air must overcome external water pressure, while gas state relations require absolute pressure. Inserting gauge pressure into volume conversion systematically miscalculates air mass.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Air pressure and absolute pressure" is correct?
options: 氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。
供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。
排水用空氣必須克服水深造成的外壓，壓縮氣體的狀態方程則使用絕對壓力。
optionsEn: Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure.
Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume.
Displacement air must overcome external water pressure, while gas state relations require absolute pressure.
quiz.explanation: 排水用空氣必須克服水深造成的外壓，壓縮氣體的狀態方程則使用絕對壓力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Displacement air must overcome external water pressure, while gas state relations require absolute pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Air pressure and absolute pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Air pressure and absolute pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Air pressure and absolute pressure", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。
海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period.
Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Air pressure and absolute pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air pressure and absolute pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。用靜止水柱核驗表壓轉換，檢查導壓管高差是否被正確加回水深推估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Cross-check the water-column height inferred from air pressure against independent level measurements. Verify gauge conversion with a stationary water column and check that impulse-line elevation is correctly included in depth inference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以氣壓水深與絕對壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air pressure and absolute pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Cross-check the water-column height inferred from air pressure against independent level measurements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air pressure and absolute pressure"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。
壓力感測器讀數一致就證明共同取壓管沒有問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure.
Matching pressure readings prove the shared impulse connection has no defect.

steps.title: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air pressure and absolute pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air pressure and absolute pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。
knowledge.textEn: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air pressure and absolute pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。
導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume.
Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air.
quiz.explanation: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型

steps.title: 空氣供應與壓縮功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Air supply and compression work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空氣供應與壓縮功」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air supply and compression work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓縮機功率取決於壓比、流量、熱交換和效率，注入體積不是同壓力下的自由空氣體積。理想等溫模型提供能耗下界，不能代表真實機組效率。 假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。 壓縮熱若未散去，等溫假設會低估功率；漏氣又使供氣量不等於有效排水量。把氣量和門體位移直接一對一換算，會漏掉可壓縮儲能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空氣供應與壓縮功」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compressor power depends on pressure ratio, flow, heat exchange and efficiency. Delivered volume is not free-air volume at the same pressure. Ideal isothermal work is a lower-bound model, not an actual machine rating. Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa. Ideal isothermal power p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW, excluding mechanical and thermal losses. Incomplete heat rejection makes the isothermal estimate optimistic, and leakage separates supplied air from effective displacement. Equating air volume directly with gate movement ignores compressible energy stored in the system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air supply and compression work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空氣供應與壓縮功」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Air supply and compression work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Equating air volume directly with gate movement ignores compressible energy stored in the system. steps.instruction: 多鉸座承受門體合力時，構件剛度與安裝高差控制分配，均分只適用對稱理想情況。局部接觸與變形會讓一個鉸座先承載。 假設兩鉸座間距8 m、合力6 MN偏心1 m，靜力反力R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN、R2=2.25 MN；限剛性門體與平面荷載。 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鉸座荷載分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When several hinges share a gate resultant, stiffness and installation offsets govern distribution. Equal sharing is an ideal symmetric case; local contact and deformation may load one support first. Assume hinge spacing 8 m and resultant 6 MN offset 1 m. Reactions are R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN and R2=2.25 MN, for a rigid gate under planar loading. Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hinge reaction distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 鉸座荷載分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hinge reaction distribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鉸座荷載分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hinge reaction distribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把鉸座幾何、軸承間隙和應變訊號一起核對，確認反力和等於外載且力矩平衡；不同門角分別作圖，找出接觸改變的轉折。將左右反力差與外載偏心量對照，檢查殘差是否跟門角或軸承接觸變化一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare hinge geometry, bearing clearance and strain, checking that reactions sum to applied load and balance its moment. Plot separate gate angles to identify changes in contact. Compare reaction difference with load eccentricity and test whether residuals track gate angle or changes in bearing contact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以鉸座荷載分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把鉸座幾何、軸承間隙和應變訊號一起核對，確認反力和等於外載且力矩平衡；不同門角分別作圖，找出接觸改變的轉折。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hinge reaction distribution, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare hinge geometry, bearing clearance and strain, checking that reactions sum to applied load and balance its moment. Plot separate gate angles to identify changes in contact.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鉸座荷載分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hinge reaction distribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鉸座荷載分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hinge reaction distribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有兩座鉸鏈，每座就永遠承受一半荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With two hinges each always carries exactly half the applied load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鉸座荷載分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。
浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load.
A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波浪激振與自振」與「相鄰門片相對位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wave excitation and natural period" and "Relative motion between gates": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波浪激振與自振：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wave excitation and natural period: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波浪激振與自振」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave excitation and natural period” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮動門體具有轉動慣性、復原剛度與水體附加慣性，波浪頻率接近自振時可能放大運動。乾態模態不能直接替代濕態動力特性。 假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。 大角度運動會改變浮力剛度，破壞線性週期假設；相鄰門片的流體耦合也會產生集體模態。以單片門的小振幅結果代表整列，可能漏掉相對運動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波浪激振與自振」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A buoyant gate has rotational inertia, restoring stiffness and added hydrodynamic inertia. Excitation near its natural frequency can amplify motion, so dry structural modes cannot replace wet dynamic properties. Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances. Large angles alter restoring stiffness and invalidate a linear period. Hydrodynamic coupling produces collective modes, so a single-gate small-motion result can miss relative movement across the full barrier. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave excitation and natural period” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波浪激振與自振」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wave excitation and natural period”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波浪激振與自振
knowledge.text: 浮動門體具有轉動慣性、復原剛度與水體附加慣性，波浪頻率接近自振時可能放大運動。乾態模態不能直接替代濕態動力特性。
knowledge.textEn: A buoyant gate has rotational inertia, restoring stiffness and added hydrodynamic inertia. Excitation near its natural frequency can amplify motion, so dry structural modes cannot replace wet dynamic properties.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波浪激振與自振」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wave excitation and natural period" is correct?
options: 浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。
兩片門振幅相同就表示它們沒有相對運動。
浮動門體具有轉動慣性、復原剛度與水體附加慣性，波浪頻率接近自振時可能放大運動。
optionsEn: A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period.
Two gates with equal amplitudes have no relative motion between them.
A buoyant gate has rotational inertia, restoring stiffness and added hydrodynamic inertia.
quiz.explanation: 浮動門體具有轉動慣性、復原剛度與水體附加慣性，波浪頻率接近自振時可能放大運動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A buoyant gate has rotational inertia, restoring stiffness and added hydrodynamic inertia. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波浪激振與自振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wave excitation and natural period: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波浪激振與自振」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wave excitation and natural period” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較門角和波面頻譜，辨認相位及阻尼而非只找相同頻率；在不同水深重估附加慣性，確認觀測峰值不是感測器安裝共振。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare angle and wave spectra, examining phase and damping rather than frequency coincidence alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波浪激振與自振」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wave excitation and natural period", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s。

Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.
A starting standby compressor guarantees sufficient air delivery at terminal valves.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波浪激振與自振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wave excitation and natural period: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波浪激振與自振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wave excitation and natural period” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較門角和波面頻譜，辨認相位及阻尼而非只找相同頻率；在不同水深重估附加慣性，確認觀測峰值不是感測器安裝共振。以相位跨越與衰減包絡交叉確認共振，而非只用頻譜上單一尖峰作判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare angle and wave spectra, examining phase and damping rather than frequency coincidence alone. Reassess added inertia at different depths and rule out resonance of sensor mountings. quiz.explanation: 同步量測相鄰門角並換算同一高度的邊緣位移，保留相位資訊；把靜態公差、熱變形與動態間隙分列，檢查時間同步誤差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize adjacent gate angles and convert them to edge displacement at one elevation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 相鄰門片相對位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative motion between gates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相鄰門片相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative motion between gates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩套感測器若時鐘不一致，可能製造假的反相訊號。反之只存最大振幅會丟失相位，無法判定是否同時接近，造成不必要或不足的碰撞評估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized clocks can create a false out-of-phase response. Saving only maximum amplitudes loses phase, preventing determination of simultaneous approach and producing either excessive or insufficient collision assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：反之只存最大振幅會丟失相位，無法判定是否同時接近，造成不必要或不足的碰撞評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Saving only maximum amplitudes loses phase, preventing determination of simultaneous approach and producing either excessive or insufficient collision assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩片門振幅相同就表示它們沒有相對運動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two gates with equal amplitudes have no relative motion between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「關閉潟湖降雨收支」與「鹽分混合與交換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon" and "Salinity mixing and exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「關閉潟湖降雨收支」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。水面面積使水位對體積敏感度不同，內部風致增水又會打破均勻水位假設。 假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉潟湖降雨收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon. Surface area controls stage sensitivity to volume, while wind setup can invalidate a uniform water level assumption. Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage. Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「關閉潟湖降雨收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon

knowledge.textEn: Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon. Surface area controls stage sensitivity to volume, while wind setup can invalidate a uniform water level assumption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「關閉潟湖降雨收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon" is correct?
options: 海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。
防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。
平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。
optionsEn: Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant.
Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon.
Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。將潟湖不同岸邊水位相減辨識風致坡度，再以全域平均驗算降雨增加的總庫容。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.text: 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關閉潟湖降雨收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。
平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed.
Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鹽分混合與交換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Salinity mixing and exchange: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鹽分混合與交換」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Salinity mixing and exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽分守恆可追蹤海水與淡水比例，但潟湖並非瞬間完全混合。底層密度流和局部滯水會讓平均鹽度掩蓋生態差異。 假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。 底層高鹽水可在表面變淡時仍滯留，造成密度分層並限制氧氣交換。把所有鹽度變化都歸因於門片動作，會漏掉河流、風和蒸發影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鹽分混合與交換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Salt conservation tracks seawater and freshwater fractions, but a lagoon does not mix instantly. Bottom density currents and stagnant regions allow a mean salinity to conceal ecological variation. Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing. New salinity is 30×100/105=28.571 g/kg, without evaporation. Saline bottom water can remain after surface freshening, maintaining stratification and limiting oxygen exchange. Attributing every salinity change to gate movement overlooks river, wind and evaporation effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Salinity mixing and exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鹽分混合與交換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Salinity mixing and exchange”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鹽分混合與交換
knowledge.text: 鹽分守恆可追蹤海水與淡水比例，但潟湖並非瞬間完全混合。底層密度流和局部滯水會讓平均鹽度掩蓋生態差異。
knowledge.textEn: Salt conservation tracks seawater and freshwater fractions, but a lagoon does not mix instantly. Bottom density currents and stagnant regions allow a mean salinity to conceal ecological variation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鹽分混合與交換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

壓力感測器讀數一致就證明共同取壓管沒有問題。
鹽分守恆可追蹤海水與淡水比例，但潟湖並非瞬間完全混合。
optionsEn: Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.
Matching pressure readings prove the shared impulse connection has no defect.
Salt conservation tracks seawater and freshwater fractions, but a lagoon does not mix instantly.

steps.title: 鹽分混合與交換：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing. New salinity is 30×100/105=28.571 g/kg, without evaporation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 採集表中底層鹽溫剖面，核對混合前後水量與導電度校正；對照潮相與支流入流，判斷單一平均值是否足以描述鹽分分布。以各層水量加權鹽度重建總鹽質量，檢查表面淡化是否只是分層而非整體排鹽。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
