optionsEn: An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 攔污柵損失與堵塞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and blockage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「攔污柵損失與堵塞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Screen losses and blockage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較柵前後水位、流量與可見堵塞比例，建立清潔基線；檢查差壓管是否也被泥沙堵住，並將異常與雨後漂流物來源對照。將差壓除以速度平方建立清潔與堵塞曲線，確認量測差異不是單純流量增加。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline. Check pressure connections for sediment blockage and relate anomalies to storm-driven debris sources. Normalize differential head by velocity squared and compare clean and blocked curves to exclude a simple increase in flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for screen losses and blockage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline. Check pressure connections for sediment blockage and relate anomalies to storm-driven debris sources.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「攔污柵損失與堵塞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Screen losses and blockage"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
沒有明顯噪音就足以證明吸水條件有足夠餘裕。
同步比較柵前後水位、流量與可見堵塞比例，建立清潔基線；檢查差壓管是否也被泥沙堵住，並將異常與雨後漂流物來源對照。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Absence of obvious noise proves sufficient suction-head margin.
Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 攔污柵損失與堵塞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and blockage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「攔污柵損失與堵塞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screen losses and blockage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。差壓增加也可能來自流量增大，因此未正規化的趨勢不能直接當作堵塞程度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. Increased differential head can also reflect increased flow, so an unnormalized trend does not directly measure blockage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「差壓增加只可能來自攔污柵堵塞，與流量無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher screen differential head only indicates blockage and is unrelated to flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「攔污柵損失與堵塞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking.

steps.objective: 說明「複合事件與失效組合」如何影響新加坡濱海堤壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compound events and failure combinations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marina Barrage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴雨、高海潮與電力限制可能同時發生，聯合機率取決於相關性。把各事件單獨罕見當成組合必定極罕見，會忽略共同氣象原因。 假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合事件與失效組合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heavy rain, high tide and power constraints can coincide, with joint probability depending on dependence. Individually rare events do not necessarily make their combination extremely rare when weather drives several conditions together. Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01. Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compound events and failure combinations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「複合事件與失效組合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compound events and failure combinations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「複合事件與失效組合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compound events and failure combinations", which statement holds?
options: 平均庫位高於海面就保證所有瞬間都向海排水。
並聯兩台相同泵的總流量必定是單台的兩倍。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。
optionsEn: A higher mean reservoir level guarantees outward flow at every instant.
Two identical parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 複合事件與失效組合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compound events and failure combinations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「複合事件與失效組合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compound events and failure combinations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。用相同事件時間窗口重算條件機率，並報告小樣本區間及相關性假設的敏感度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix. Recalculate conditional probabilities with a consistent event window and report small-sample ranges and sensitivity to dependence assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以複合事件與失效組合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compound events and failure combinations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。用相同事件時間窗口重算條件機率，並報告小樣本區間及相關性假設的敏感度。
knowledge.textEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix. Recalculate conditional probabilities with a consistent event window and report small-sample ranges and sensitivity to dependence assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以複合事件與失效組合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compound events and failure combinations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix.

quiz.question: 要驗證「複合事件與失效組合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compound events and failure combinations"?
options: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
平均鹽度很低就表示所有深度的水質完全相同。
optionsEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Low mean salinity means water quality is identical at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 複合事件與失效組合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compound events and failure combinations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「複合事件與失效組合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compound events and failure combinations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。
knowledge.textEn: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「複合事件與失效組合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compound events and failure combinations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。
各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions.
Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing.
quiz.explanation: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 水庫邊坡穩定監測
summary: 本課以整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡為主線，先用有效應力與孔壓與無限邊坡力學示意界定水力與構造條件，再將衛星定位共同誤差、位移速率與加速度連結到監測不確定與應變。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement through Effective stress and pore pressure and Infinite slope force illustration, then connects GNSS common-mode errors and Displacement rate and acceleration to Monitoring uncertainty and response. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查有效應力與孔壓：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa；再獨立檢查無限邊坡力學示意：Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348。敏感度：相同總正應力150kPa下，孔壓由60增為90kPa，有效正應力由90降為60kPa；固定摩擦角30度時摩擦抗力由51.96降為34.64kPa，減少三分之一。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 將對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Effective stress and pore pressure: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa. Independently examine Infinite slope force illustration: Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348. Sensitivity: at total normal stress150kPa, raising pore pressure from60 to90kPa reduces effective normal stress from90 to60kPa. With a fixed30-degree friction angle, frictional resistance decreases from51.96 to34.64kPa, a one-third reduction. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. Use the following independent check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力與孔壓」與「無限邊坡力學示意」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress and pore pressure" and "Infinite slope force illustration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力與孔壓」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫邊坡的抗剪能力受滑面有效正應力控制，外部水位下降可能移除坡腳水壓支撐，內部孔壓卻尚未消散。必須將坡內孔壓與滑面總應力分開估計，不能只用庫水位替代；簡化摩擦式也忽略了吸力、軟化與漸進破壞。 驗證時應將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較，並辨識以下失效情境：孔壓消散慢於外水位下降可降低有效抗剪能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力與孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slope resistance depends on effective normal stress. Falling reservoir stage may remove external support before internal pressure dissipates. Estimate total stress and slip-surface pore pressure separately rather than replacing internal head with reservoir level; the simple friction law also omits suction, softening and progressive failure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Pore pressure lagging external drawdown can reduce available shear resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力與孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力與孔壓

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "GNSS common-mode errors" and "Radar line-of-sight projection": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 衛星定位共同誤差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「衛星定位共同誤差」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “GNSS common-mode errors” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 衛星定位能量測表面三維位移，但參考站漂移與共同大氣誤差會投影到所有測點。相對位移有助辨認坡體內部變形，卻可能消去真實共同平移；應同時保留絕對與相對解，並以坡外穩定點驗證參考框架。 驗證時應將坡外基準站與坡內測點的共同訊號和相對變形分別繪圖，並辨識以下失效情境：移動的參考站會使整坡出現假性反向位移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衛星定位共同誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: GNSS provides three-dimensional surface displacement, but reference-station drift and shared atmospheric errors affect many points together. Relative motion helps reveal internal deformation yet can remove genuine common translation. Preserve absolute and relative solutions and test the reference frame using stable off-slope monuments. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Plot shared signals and relative deformation separately using off-slope reference stations. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A moving reference station creates an apparent opposite movement across the slope. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “GNSS common-mode errors” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 位移速率與加速度：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 差分位移可以揭露速率變化，卻同時放大量測雜訊；採樣間隔改變也會造成表觀加速。應使用相同時間窗與誤差模型，不把短期兩點差分外推成失穩日期；若降雨、溫度或施工改變，需分段解釋驅動條件。 驗證時應以相同時間窗重算速度並確認加速也出現在獨立測點，並辨識以下失效情境：不等間隔差分未除以時間會產生假的加速度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位移速率與加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Differencing displacement reveals rate changes but also amplifies noise. Changing observation intervals can create apparent acceleration. Use consistent windows and an uncertainty model rather than extrapolating two points into a failure date; interpret separate periods when rainfall, temperature or construction alters the driving conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Recalculate rates over common windows and confirm acceleration at independent points. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unequal-interval differences without time normalization generate false acceleration. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Displacement rate and acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Successive daily rates=2 and5 mm/day; elapsed=3 days; meanAcceleration=(5-2)/3=1 mm/day2.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Successive daily rates=2 and5 mm/day; elapsed=3 days; meanAcceleration=(5-2)/3=1 mm/day2。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Successive daily rates=2 and5 mm/day; elapsed=3 days; meanAcceleration=(5-2)/3=1 mm/day2. steps.instruction: 水庫調降速度與坡體排水速度不匹配時，外部支撐及內部有效應力會同時改變。以平均日降幅描述調度不代表孔壓已達平衡；需要把停降段與持續降段分開，並比較滑面附近與坡腳測點的不同反應。 驗證時應對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散，並辨識以下失效情境：把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位降速與內水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When drawdown outpaces slope drainage, external support and internal effective stress change differently. Mean daily drawdown does not establish pressure equilibrium. Separate holding periods from continued lowering and compare observations near the potential slip surface with those at the toe to identify spatially different responses. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drawdown rate and internal head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: ReservoirFalls=6 m in4 days; internalHeadFalls=2 m in4 days; additionalHeadLag=6-2=4 m.

steps.title: 水位降速與內水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawdown rate and internal head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位降速與內水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown rate and internal head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：ReservoirFalls=6 m in4 days; internalHeadFalls=2 m in4 days; additionalHeadLag=6-2=4 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: ReservoirFalls=6 m in4 days; internalHeadFalls=2 m in4 days; additionalHeadLag=6-2=4 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：ReservoirFalls=6 m in4 days; internalHeadFalls=2 m in4 days; additionalHeadLag=6-2=4 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: ReservoirFalls=6 m in4 days; internalHeadFalls=2 m in4 days; additionalHeadLag=6-2=4 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

steps.title: 水位降速與內水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawdown rate and internal head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位降速與內水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drawdown rate and internal head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.title: 水位降速與內水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown rate and internal head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位降速與內水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown rate and internal head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均洩降速率就是每一土層的排水速率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean reservoir drawdown rate equals drainage rate in every layer" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水位降速與內水頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潛在滑體與影響範圍」與「監測不確定與應變」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Potential slide volume and consequences" and "Monitoring uncertainty and response": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潛在滑體與影響範圍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Potential slide volume and consequences: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潛在滑體與影響範圍」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Potential slide volume and consequences” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滑體幾何是後果分析的起點，但體積本身不能決定湧浪高度；入水速度、深度、滑體形狀與水庫幾何也重要。用簡化稜柱估體積應清楚標示平均厚度假設，再以地質界面、地形與鑽探檢驗範圍，避免把包絡體積當精確崩塌量。 驗證時應用鑽孔與地表裂縫約束滑面深度並對厚度範圍做敏感度，並辨識以下失效情境：把最大厚度套用整個面積會系統高估稜柱體積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潛在滑體與影響範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slide geometry begins consequence assessment, but volume alone does not determine wave height. Entry velocity, depth, shape and reservoir geometry also matter. A prism estimate must state its average-thickness assumption and be checked against geology, terrain and boreholes rather than presented as an exact failure volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Constrain slip depth with boreholes and surface cracks and vary the thickness range. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying maximum thickness over the entire area systematically overestimates prism volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Potential slide volume and consequences” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 監測不確定與應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測不確定與應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring uncertainty and response” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「監測不確定與應變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Small relative motion proves that the whole slope has not translated
Original teaching assumptions: Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 監測不確定與應變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測不確定與應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring uncertainty and response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「監測不確定與應變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring uncertainty and response"?
options: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。

optionsEn: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation.

Short-term acceleration determines the exact time of slope failure
quiz.explanation: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監測不確定與應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測不確定與應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring uncertainty and response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。診斷時應採取以下查核：將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Diagnose it by the following check: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升量測精密度就不需要工程應變程序」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher measurement precision removes the need for response procedures" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。診斷時應採取以下查核：將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Diagnose it by the following check: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測不確定與應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring uncertainty and response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。
庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action.
Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction
quiz.explanation: 沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 溢洪道消能池
summary: 本課以由水躍共軛水深連結尾水底板與消能驗證為主線，先用單寬流量與入流與福祿數與流態界定水力與構造條件，再將尾水餘量與跳躍、墩塊動量作用連結到模型比例與尺度。只採矩形明渠及局部穩態示意；消能池型式與尺寸須依完整水理及結構試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops connecting hydraulic-jump depths tailwater slabs and energy-dissipation verification through Unit discharge and approach flow and Froude number and regime, then connects Tailwater margin and jump position and Baffle-block momentum action to Model ratios and scale effects. Rectangular-channel and locally steady examples do not select basin type or replace hydraulic and structural testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查單寬流量與入流：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s；再獨立檢查福祿數與流態：V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless。敏感度：流速由12增為15m/s且入流水深維持1m，福祿數由3.831增為4.789，共軛水深由4.941增為6.291m；尾水需求不隨速度線性增加。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。只採矩形明渠及局部穩態示意；消能池型式與尺寸須依完整水理及結構試驗。 將核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Unit discharge and approach flow: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s. Independently examine Froude number and regime: V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless. Sensitivity: increasing velocity from12 to15m/s at1m incoming depth changes Froude number from3.831 to4.789 and conjugate depth from4.941 to6.291m. Tailwater demand therefore does not scale linearly with velocity. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Rectangular-channel and locally steady examples do not select basin type or replace hydraulic and structural testing. Use the following independent check: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單寬流量與入流」與「福祿數與流態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Unit discharge and approach flow" and "Froude number and regime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單寬流量與入流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit discharge and approach flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單寬流量與入流」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit discharge and approach flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。槽末彎道、墩柱與收縮會讓局部速度高於平均，進而改變水躍位置與底板壓力。先核對有效過水寬及水深定義，再把全寬分布與整體流量相互核算。 驗證時應以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單寬流量與入流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure. Bends, piers and contraction can create local velocities above the mean and shift the jump and slab pressures. Check effective width and depth definitions, then reconcile cross-sectional distributions with total discharge. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit discharge and approach flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單寬流量與入流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unit discharge and approach flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單寬流量與入流
knowledge.text: 消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。槽末彎道、墩柱與收縮會讓局部速度高於平均，進而改變水躍位置與底板壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure. Bends, piers and contraction can create local velocities above the mean and shift the jump and slab pressures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單寬流量與入流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unit discharge and approach flow" is correct?
options: 平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速
消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。
福祿數相同就保證全部局部壓力相同
optionsEn: Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin
Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure.
Equal Froude numbers guarantee equal local pressures everywhere
quiz.explanation: 消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單寬流量與入流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit discharge and approach flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單寬流量與入流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unit discharge and approach flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單寬流量與入流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Unit discharge and approach flow", which statement holds?
options: 消散的機械能會自動變成可利用電力
平均揚壓合格就排除了瞬時掀板風險

Acceptable mean uplift eliminates transient slab-lifting risk

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單寬流量與入流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit discharge and approach flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「單寬流量與入流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unit discharge and approach flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單寬流量與入流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unit discharge and approach flow"?
options: 以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力
optionsEn: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Root-mean-square pressure equals the maximum slab design pressure
quiz.explanation: 以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單寬流量與入流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unit discharge and approach flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單寬流量與入流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unit discharge and approach flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。診斷時應採取以下查核：以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. Diagnose it by the following check: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。診斷時應採取以下查核：以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. Diagnose it by the following check: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單寬流量與入流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unit discharge and approach flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。
福祿數相同就保證全部局部壓力相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading.
Equal Froude numbers guarantee equal local pressures everywhere
quiz.explanation: 忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 福祿數與流態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude number and regime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「福祿數與流態」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Froude number and regime” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 福祿數比較慣性與重力作用，矩形斷面以水深作水力深度。超臨界入流需要透過水躍或其他機制轉換，但福祿數本身不能選定消能池完整構造；相同數值下，入流水層厚度、含氣量與尾水變動仍可能產生不同壓力波動。 驗證時應比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀，並辨識以下失效情境：非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「福祿數與流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Froude number compares inertia with gravity, using water depth as hydraulic depth in a rectangular section. Supercritical flow requires a transition mechanism, but the number alone does not select a complete basin design. Incoming layer thickness, aeration and tailwater variation can produce different pressure fluctuations at the same value. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude number and regime” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「福祿數相同就保證全部局部壓力相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal Froude numbers guarantee equal local pressures everywhere" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「福祿數與流態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Froude number and regime”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「福祿數與流態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Froude number and regime", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless。
最大洪水必定是水躍位置最不利工況
總動量平均分攤就代表每個墩塊受力相同
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless.
The largest flood is always the worst jump-location condition
Averaging total momentum proves equal force on every baffle
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 福祿數與流態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Froude number and regime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「福祿數與流態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Froude number and regime” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「福祿數與流態」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Froude number and regime"?

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.

Little retained sediment means abrasion can be ignored
