steps.title: 福祿數與流態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Froude number and regime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「福祿數與流態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Froude number and regime” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「福祿數相同就保證全部局部壓力相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal Froude numbers guarantee equal local pressures everywhere" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「福祿數與流態」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Froude number and regime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深
非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump
Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth.
quiz.explanation: 非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共軛水深與動量」與「水躍能量損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conjugate depth and momentum" and "Hydraulic jump energy loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共軛水深與動量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conjugate depth and momentum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共軛水深與動量」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conjugate depth and momentum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。這不是能量守恆問題，因渦流會耗散機械能；若有強烈坡度、墩塊或淹沒效應，需將外力與邊界納入，而不能硬套水平矩形公式。 驗證時應在滾流區外量測上下游水深並核對尾水是否控制跳躍，並辨識以下失效情境：在紊亂滾流內取水深會破壞靜水壓斷面的假設。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共軛水深與動量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected. Mechanical energy is dissipated, so energy conservation cannot replace momentum. Strong slope, appurtenance forces or submergence require additional boundary terms instead of unconditional use of the horizontal rectangular formula. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure depths outside the roller and check whether tailwater controls jump position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Sampling depth inside the turbulent roller violates the hydrostatic-section assumption. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conjugate depth and momentum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共軛水深與動量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conjugate depth and momentum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共軛水深與動量
knowledge.text: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。這不是能量守恆問題，因渦流會耗散機械能；若有強烈坡度、墩塊或淹沒效應，需將外力與邊界納入，而不能硬套水平矩形公式。
knowledge.textEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected. Mechanical energy is dissipated, so energy conservation cannot replace momentum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共軛水深與動量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conjugate depth and momentum" is correct?
options: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。
水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深

optionsEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected.
Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump

quiz.explanation: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共軛水深與動量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conjugate depth and momentum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共軛水深與動量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conjugate depth and momentum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在滾流區外量測上下游水深並核對尾水是否控制跳躍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure depths outside the roller and check whether tailwater controls jump position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 矩形水躍的能量損失取決於共軛水深差，能量主要進入大渦、紊流與含氣混合，而不是全部變成可回收功。用每單位重量的水頭損失描述，才能與上游速度水頭一致比較；不應將水頭數字直接當作功率。 驗證時應比較上下游比能與流量並確認斷面遠離滾流區，並辨識以下失效情境：把量測壓力波動當靜水深可能造成假能量增益。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水躍能量損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy loss in a rectangular jump depends on the conjugate-depth difference and feeds large eddies, turbulence and air mixing. stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「墩塊動量作用」與「脈動壓力與頻譜」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Baffle-block momentum action" and "Fluctuating pressure and spectrum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 墩塊動量作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Baffle-block momentum action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「墩塊動量作用」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Baffle-block momentum action” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 墩塊以改變水流方向和速度承受動量作用，同時產生局部壓力脈動與渦流。集中動量估算只描述給定流束的平均作用，實際分配受旁通與三維流影響；墩塊基部、錨定與磨耗應按相同水力工況共同檢驗。 驗證時應用力計與高速水面影像核對受流範圍及作用方向，並辨識以下失效情境：流束偏移可能使單一墩塊承受遠高於平均的負荷。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墩塊動量作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Baffles redirect flow and absorb momentum while generating local pressure fluctuations and vortices. A concentrated-stream estimate describes mean action for a prescribed stream, but bypass and three-dimensional flow alter distribution. Check block bases, anchorage and abrasion under consistent hydraulic conditions rather than treating force alone as sufficient. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use force measurements and high-speed surface images to confirm intercepted flow and force direction. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A displaced jet can load one baffle far above the average. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Baffle-block momentum action” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：CapturedQ=8 m3/s; velocityChange=7 m/s; rho=1000 kg/m3; meanForce=1000*8*7/1000=56 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: CapturedQ=8 m3/s; velocityChange=7 m/s; rho=1000 kg/m3; meanForce=1000*8*7/1000=56 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總動量平均分攤就代表每個墩塊受力相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「墩塊動量作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Baffle-block momentum action”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 墩塊動量作用

knowledge.textEn: Baffles redirect flow and absorb momentum while generating local pressure fluctuations and vortices. A concentrated-stream estimate describes mean action for a prescribed stream, but bypass and three-dimensional flow alter distribution.

steps.title: 墩塊動量作用：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：CapturedQ=8 m3/s; velocityChange=7 m/s; rho=1000 kg/m3; meanForce=1000*8*7/1000=56 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: CapturedQ=8 m3/s; velocityChange=7 m/s; rho=1000 kg/m3; meanForce=1000*8*7/1000=56 kN. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Baffle-block momentum action” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用力計與高速水面影像核對受流範圍及作用方向。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「流束偏移可能使單一墩塊承受遠高於平均的負荷」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 流束偏移可能使單一墩塊承受遠高於平均的負荷。診斷時應採取以下查核：用力計與高速水面影像核對受流範圍及作用方向，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 脈動壓力與頻譜：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fluctuating pressure and spectrum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「脈動壓力與頻譜」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fluctuating pressure and spectrum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 紊流壓力的均方根反映波動強度，但極值與持續時間還依頻譜、空間相關與採樣率而異。單點量測不能直接代表整塊底板合力；應建立多點同步紀錄，分辨結構共振附近的頻率與一般寬頻湍流。 驗證時應核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性，並辨識以下失效情境：採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「脈動壓力與頻譜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure RMS describes fluctuation intensity, while extremes and duration depend on spectrum, spatial correlation and sampling. One sensor does not define the resultant on a whole slab. Use synchronized arrays to distinguish excitation near structural resonance from broader turbulence and preserve the observation duration used for statistics. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fluctuating pressure and spectrum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 脈動壓力與頻譜
knowledge.text: 紊流壓力的均方根反映波動強度，但極值與持續時間還依頻譜、空間相關與採樣率而異。單點量測不能直接代表整塊底板合力；應建立多點同步紀錄，分辨結構共振附近的頻率與一般寬頻湍流。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure RMS describes fluctuation intensity, while extremes and duration depend on spectrum, spatial correlation and sampling. One sensor does not define the resultant on a whole slab.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Root-mean-square pressure equals the maximum slab design pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 模型比例與尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model ratios and scale effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模型比例與尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Model ratios and scale effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對模型雷諾數與表面張力影響並以不同尺度重複關鍵工況。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「過小模型可能壓低含氣量並扭曲壓力波動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check model Reynolds and surface-tension effects and repeat critical cases at another scale. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An excessively small model can suppress aeration and distort pressure fluctuations. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對模型雷諾數與表面張力影響並以不同尺度重複關鍵工況作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對過小模型可能壓低含氣量並扭曲壓力波動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check model Reynolds and surface-tension effects and repeat critical cases at another scale. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An excessively small model can suppress aeration and distort pressure fluctuations. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過小模型可能壓低含氣量並扭曲壓力波動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An excessively small model can suppress aeration and distort pressure fluctuations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 模型比例與尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model ratios and scale effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型比例與尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model ratios and scale effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過小模型可能壓低含氣量並扭曲壓力波動。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對模型雷諾數與表面張力影響並以不同尺度重複關鍵工況，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An excessively small model can suppress aeration and distort pressure fluctuations. Diagnose it by the following check: Check model Reynolds and surface-tension effects and repeat critical cases at another scale. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「福祿相似保證所有物理效應完全相似」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Froude similarity guarantees similarity of every physical effect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 滑雪跳台式消能工
summary: 本課以追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界為主線，先用挑流彈道與落點與落差與飛行時間界定水力與構造條件，再將射流功率與承受區、入水動量與方向連結到福祿尺度與表面張力。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries through Jet trajectory and landing point and Drop height and flight time, then connects Jet power and receiving zone and Impact momentum and direction to Froude scaling and surface tension. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查挑流彈道與落點：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m；再獨立檢查落差與飛行時間：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。敏感度：同高起落且挑角30度時，出口速度由20增至25m/s，理想射程由35.31增至55.17m，增加56.25%；射程隨速度平方變化但不代表沖刷深度同倍增加。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 將以多點同步壓力量測比較面積平均與局部峰值作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Jet trajectory and landing point: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m. Independently examine Drop height and flight time: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s. Sensitivity: at equal launch and landing elevation and a30-degree angle, increasing exit velocity from20 to25m/s raises ideal range from35.31 to55.17m, a56.25 percent increase. Range scales with velocity squared, whereas scour depth does not follow the same rule. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Use the following independent check: Compare spatially averaged pressure with local peaks using synchronized pressure arrays. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「挑流彈道與落點」與「落差與飛行時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet trajectory and landing point" and "Drop height and flight time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「挑流彈道與落點」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet trajectory and landing point” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。忽略阻力的質點彈道只估中心線，實際水舌會展寬、破碎與含氣；必須確認使用的是水舌離坎速度而非上游平均速度，且不能把單一落點當成整個沖擊區。 驗證時應由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程，並辨識以下失效情境：把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「挑流彈道與落點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. Velocity, angle and elevation difference determine the ideal trajectory. A drag-free particle model estimates a centerline, while real jets spread, fragment and aerate; use launch velocity and distinguish the landing point from the entire impact footprint. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet trajectory and landing point” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「挑流彈道與落點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet trajectory and landing point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 挑流彈道與落點
knowledge.text: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。忽略阻力的質點彈道只估中心線，實際水舌會展寬、破碎與含氣；必須確認使用的是水舌離坎速度而非上游平均速度，且不能把單一落點當成整個沖擊區。
knowledge.textEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. Velocity, angle and elevation difference determine the ideal trajectory.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「挑流彈道與落點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Jet trajectory and landing point" is correct?
options: 理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍
挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。
有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式
optionsEn: The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint
A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool.
A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula
quiz.explanation: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「挑流彈道與落點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jet trajectory and landing point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.

steps.instruction: 水舌由較高出口落入低處水面時，垂直運動包含初始向上速度與重力加速，應取二次方程的正時間根。以同高公式代替會低估射程；水位波動與射流破碎使接觸面並非固定平面，仍需量測與模型確認。 驗證時應以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程，並辨識以下失效情境：選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落差與飛行時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a jet launched above the pool, vertical motion includes initial upward velocity and gravity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop height and flight time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鼻坎曲率與壓力」與「速度水頭與能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bucket curvature and pressure" and "Velocity head and jet energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鼻坎曲率與壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bucket curvature and pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鼻坎曲率與壓力」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bucket curvature and pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲面使水流向上轉彎，需要向心加速度，底部壓力因此不只由靜水深決定。薄層近似可估曲率附加壓力，但水深與速度沿坎面並不一定均勻；過渡曲率突變還可能造成局部分離，須檢查沿程壓力而非只有出口角度。 驗證時應沿曲面布設壓力孔並將低壓區與曲率過渡位置對照，並辨識以下失效情境：曲率接續不平順可能引發分離與局部氣蝕。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鼻坎曲率與壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turning flow upward requires centripetal acceleration, so bucket pressure is not purely hydrostatic. A thin-layer approximation estimates added curvature pressure, but depth and velocity vary along the surface. Abrupt curvature transitions can produce separation; examine the pressure distribution instead of checking only the launch angle. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures along the bucket and compare low-pressure regions with curvature transitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Abrupt curvature transitions can cause separation and local cavitation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bucket curvature and pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; V=22 m/s; flowDepth=0.8 m; radius=18 m; curvaturePressure=rho*V**2*flowDepth/radius/1000=21.5111 kPa (SI pressure in Pa divided by1000)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; V=22 m/s; flowDepth=0.8 m; radius=18 m; curvaturePressure=rho*V**2*flowDepth/radius/1000=21.5111 kPa (SI pressure in Pa divided by1000).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鼻坎壓力只要用靜水深就能完整計算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydrostatic depth alone completely determines bucket pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鼻坎曲率與壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bucket curvature and pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Turning flow upward requires centripetal acceleration, so bucket pressure is not purely hydrostatic. A thin-layer approximation estimates added curvature pressure, but depth and velocity vary along the surface.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hydrostatic depth alone completely determines bucket pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 速度水頭與能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity head and jet energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度水頭與能量」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity head and jet energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離坎水流的速度水頭代表每單位重量所帶動能，挑流只是把能量移到下游空間消散，並未在鼻坎自動消除。出口高程、沿程損失與速度分布共同決定可用能量；要區分水頭、能量與功率，避免量綱混淆。 驗證時應核對入口至離坎的能量線並分別列出高程與速度水頭，並辨識以下失效情境：將射流離開混凝土視為已完全消能會漏掉下游沖擊。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度水頭與能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity head represents kinetic energy per unit weight. A flip bucket relocates dissipation downstream rather than eliminating energy at the lip. Elevation, approach losses and velocity distribution determine available energy; distinguish head from energy and power so that apparent dissipation is not a dimensional bookkeeping mistake. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the energy line to the lip and list elevation and velocity heads separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating departure from concrete as complete dissipation ignores downstream impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity head and jet energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=24 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; velocityHead=24**2/(2*9.81)=29.3578 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=24 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; velocityHead=24**2/(2*9.81)=29.3578 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水舌一離開鼻坎就已經失去全部動能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A jet loses all kinetic energy as soon as it leaves the bucket" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度水頭與能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity head and jet energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 要驗證「速度水頭與能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Velocity head and jet energy"?

steps.title: 速度水頭與能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Velocity head and jet energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度水頭與能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Velocity head and jet energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將射流離開混凝土視為已完全消能會漏掉下游沖擊。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對入口至離坎的能量線並分別列出高程與速度水頭，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating departure from concrete as complete dissipation ignores downstream impact. Diagnose it by the following check: Check the energy line to the lip and list elevation and velocity heads separately. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水舌一離開鼻坎就已經失去全部動能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A jet loses all kinetic energy as soon as it leaves the bucket" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Diagnose it by the following check: Check the energy line to the lip and list elevation and velocity heads separately. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「速度水頭與能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Velocity head and jet energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將射流離開混凝土視為已完全消能會漏掉下游沖擊。
總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating departure from concrete as complete dissipation ignores downstream impact.
Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「射流功率與承受區」與「含氣展寬與截面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet power and receiving zone" and "Aeration spreading and jet area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 射流功率與承受區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet power and receiving zone: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「射流功率與承受區」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet power and receiving zone” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。相同功率可由不同流量與速度組合造成，而沖擊、含氣與岩塊拔出機制不同；因此功率只能作系統尺度指標，不能單獨轉成固定的水墊深度。 驗證時應以流量量測與能量線核對功率並繪製沖擊區分布，並辨識以下失效情境：把總功率均勻攤到全河床會低估集中沖擊強度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「射流功率與承受區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic power combines discharge and dissipatable head into an energy rate. Equal power can arise from different discharge and velocity combinations with different impact, aeration and rock-block removal behavior. Use power as a system-level indicator rather than converting it directly into a prescribed pool depth. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Verify power from measured discharge and energy head and map the receiving footprint. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Spreading total power uniformly over the whole bed understates concentrated impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet power and receiving zone” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「射流功率與承受區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet power and receiving zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 射流功率與承受區
knowledge.text: 水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。相同功率可由不同流量與速度組合造成，而沖擊、含氣與岩塊拔出機制不同；因此功率只能作系統尺度指標，不能單獨轉成固定的水墊深度。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic power combines discharge and dissipatable head into an energy rate. Equal power can arise from different discharge and velocity combinations with different impact, aeration and rock-block removal behavior.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「射流功率與承受區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Jet power and receiving zone" is correct?
options: 總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度
水舌外觀變厚就保證液態流量已增加
水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。
optionsEn: Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth
A thicker visible jet guarantees increased liquid discharge
Hydraulic power combines discharge and dissipatable head into an energy rate.
quiz.explanation: 水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic power combines discharge and dissipatable head into an energy rate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 射流功率與承受區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Jet power and receiving zone: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「射流功率與承受區」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jet power and receiving zone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以流量量測與能量線核對功率並繪製沖擊區分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify power from measured discharge and energy head and map the receiving footprint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「射流功率與承受區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Jet power and receiving zone", which statement holds?
options: 平均壓力低就保證局部岩塊不會被拔起
彈道相似就代表破碎與含氣完全相似
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW.
Low mean pressure guarantees that no local rock block lifts
Similar trajectories guarantee similar breakup and aeration
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 以流量量測與能量線核對功率並繪製沖擊區分布。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把總功率均勻攤到全河床會低估集中沖擊強度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify power from measured discharge and energy head and map the receiving footprint. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Spreading total power uniformly over the whole bed understates concentrated impact. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總功率均勻攤到全河床會低估集中沖擊強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spreading total power uniformly over the whole bed understates concentrated impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 含氣展寬與截面：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「含氣展寬與截面」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aeration spreading and jet area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 空氣捲入會增加水舌混合體積並改變外觀厚度，水量守恆應採液相體積而非混合總體積。均勻含氣率的示意只表達相分率，實際氣泡有滑移與非均勻分布；應同時量測水相流量、混合速度與含氣剖面。 驗證時應以含氣探針與影像量測展寬並核對液相流量守恆，並辨識以下失效情境：將混合截面全當水會高估液相質量與動量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含氣展寬與截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Entrained air expands the apparent jet thickness. Liquid continuity uses water volume, not total mixture volume. A uniform void-fraction model illustrates phase accounting, while real bubbles slip and concentrations vary across the jet. Measure liquid flow, mixture velocity and air profiles together before interpreting the visible envelope. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure spreading with air probes and imaging and check liquid-phase continuity. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating the entire mixture area as water overstates liquid mass and momentum. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aeration spreading and jet area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: LiquidQ=40 m3/s; uniformAirVoidFraction=0.20; equal phase velocity=20 m/s; mixtureArea=40/((1-0.20)*20)=2.50 m2.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: LiquidQ=40 m3/s; uniformAirVoidFraction=0.20; equal phase velocity=20 m/s; mixtureArea=40/((1-0.20)*20)=2.50 m2. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 在「含氣展寬與截面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aeration spreading and jet area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將混合截面全當水會高估液相質量與動量。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要流速大小相同沖擊方向也相同
optionsEn: Treating the entire mixture area as water overstates liquid mass and momentum.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Equal speed guarantees the same direction of impact
quiz.explanation: 將混合截面全當水會高估液相質量與動量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the entire mixture area as water overstates liquid mass and momentum. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「入水動量與方向」與「衝擊面積與平均壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Impact momentum and direction" and "Impact area and average pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 入水動量與方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Impact momentum and direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入水動量與方向」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impact momentum and direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射流入水時的作用取決於速度向量變化，垂直與水平分量對池底與側壁的影響不同。只估完全消除一個分量的平均動量力，不含壓力回授與脈動放大；實際射流可能在水墊中轉向而保留部分動量。 驗證時應以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入水動量與方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impact depends on vector velocity change, with vertical and horizontal components loading the pool bed and walls differently. A mean force for arresting one component omits pressure feedback and dynamic amplification. A real jet may turn within the pool and retain momentum rather than stopping completely. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impact momentum and direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要流速大小相同沖擊方向也相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal speed guarantees the same direction of impact" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入水動量與方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Impact momentum and direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入水動量與方向
knowledge.text: 射流入水時的作用取決於速度向量變化，垂直與水平分量對池底與側壁的影響不同。只估完全消除一個分量的平均動量力，不含壓力回授與脈動放大；實際射流可能在水墊中轉向而保留部分動量。
knowledge.textEn: Impact depends on vector velocity change, with vertical and horizontal components loading the pool bed and walls differently. A mean force for arresting one component omits pressure feedback and dynamic amplification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要流速大小相同沖擊方向也相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal speed guarantees the same direction of impact Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入水動量與方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Impact momentum and direction" is correct?
options: 只要流速大小相同沖擊方向也相同
射流入水時的作用取決於速度向量變化，垂直與水平分量對池底與側壁的影響不同。
平均壓力低就保證局部岩塊不會被拔起
optionsEn: Equal speed guarantees the same direction of impact
Impact depends on vector velocity change, with vertical and horizontal components loading the pool bed and walls differently.
Low mean pressure guarantees that no local rock block lifts
quiz.explanation: 射流入水時的作用取決於速度向量變化，垂直與水平分量對池底與側壁的影響不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Impact depends on vector velocity change, with vertical and horizontal components loading the pool bed and walls differently. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入水動量與方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Impact momentum and direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入水動量與方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Impact momentum and direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula

steps.title: 入水動量與方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Impact momentum and direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入水動量與方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Impact momentum and direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 入水動量與方向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Impact momentum and direction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入水動量與方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Impact momentum and direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向。診斷時應採取以下查核：以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. Diagnose it by the following check: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 衝擊面積與平均壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Impact area and average pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「衝擊面積與平均壓力」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impact area and average pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水墊使射流動量擴散至更大面積，但平均壓力與局部瞬時峰值差異很大。把已知合力除以指定作用面積可示範平均量，不能反推真實壓力分布；池底地形、含氣與射流擺動都可能形成偏心集中區。 驗證時應以多點同步壓力量測比較面積平均與局部峰值，並辨識以下失效情境：用全池面積平均會掩蓋水舌落點下的高壓區。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衝擊面積與平均壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pool spreads jet momentum over an area, but mean pressure differs greatly from local instantaneous peaks. Dividing a prescribed force by a specified area illustrates only an average and cannot recover the distribution. Bed geometry, aeration and jet oscillation may create eccentric concentrated loading. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare spatially averaged pressure with local peaks using synchronized pressure arrays. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Averaging over the whole pool hides high pressure beneath the jet footprint. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impact area and average pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 衝擊面積與平均壓力
knowledge.text: 水墊使射流動量擴散至更大面積，但平均壓力與局部瞬時峰值差異很大。把已知合力除以指定作用面積可示範平均量，不能反推真實壓力分布；池底地形、含氣與射流擺動都可能形成偏心集中區。
knowledge.textEn: A pool spreads jet momentum over an area, but mean pressure differs greatly from local instantaneous peaks. Dividing a prescribed force by a specified area illustrates only an average and cannot recover the distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Averaging over the whole pool hides high pressure beneath the jet footprint. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.title: 衝擊面積與平均壓力：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「衝擊面積與平均壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Impact area and average pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用全池面積平均會掩蓋水舌落點下的高壓區。診斷時應採取以下查核：以多點同步壓力量測比較面積平均與局部峰值，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging over the whole pool hides high pressure beneath the jet footprint. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. steps.title: 岩節理揚力與抗力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「岩節理揚力與抗力」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint uplift and rock resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射流脈壓可沿節理傳入岩塊底面，使岩塊自重、浮力與節理抗力之間的平衡改變。簡化水下自重只提供一項抗力，不包含咬合與剪阻；需調查節理連通、開口與塊體尺寸，不能僅用完整岩石抗壓強度預測沖蝕。 驗證時應繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差，並辨識以下失效情境：連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩節理揚力與抗力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jet pressure can enter joints beneath rock blocks and alter the balance of weight, buoyancy and joint resistance. Submerged weight is only one resisting component and excludes interlock and shear. Investigate joint connectivity, aperture and block geometry; intact compressive strength alone cannot predict plucking or scour. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint uplift and rock resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rockDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; volume=2 m3; submergedWeight=(2650-1000)*9.81*2/1000=32.373 kN.

steps.title: 岩節理揚力與抗力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint uplift and rock resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩節理揚力與抗力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint uplift and rock resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rockDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; volume=2 m3; submergedWeight=(2650-1000)*9.81*2/1000=32.373 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rockDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; volume=2 m3; submergedWeight=(2650-1000)*9.81*2/1000=32.373 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: rockDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; volume=2 m3; submergedWeight=(2650-1000)*9.81*2/1000=32.373 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 岩節理揚力與抗力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint uplift and rock resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩節理揚力與抗力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint uplift and rock resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩節理揚力與抗力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.title: 岩節理揚力與抗力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint uplift and rock resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩節理揚力與抗力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint uplift and rock resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。診斷時應採取以下查核：繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. Diagnose it by the following check: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完整岩石強度高就保證節理岩床不沖蝕」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Strong intact rock guarantees a scour-proof jointed bed" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。診斷時應採取以下查核：繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩節理揚力與抗力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint uplift and rock resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
彈道相似就代表破碎與含氣完全相似
optionsEn: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Similar trajectories guarantee similar breakup and aeration
quiz.explanation: 連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 福祿尺度與表面張力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling and surface tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「福祿尺度與表面張力」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Froude scaling and surface tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 挑流模型常以重力相似重現彈道，但細水舌的破碎與含氣受到表面張力影響，韋伯數可提示這種尺度偏差。相同水質的縮尺模型無法同時保持所有無因次數；應把落點驗證與氣泡破碎驗證分開報告。 驗證時應比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點，並辨識以下失效情境：過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「福祿尺度與表面張力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity similarity can reproduce trajectories while surface tension changes thin-jet breakup and aeration. Weber number highlights this scale effect. A reduced model using the same water cannot preserve every dimensionless group simultaneously; report trajectory validation separately from bubble and breakup fidelity instead of treating all observations as equally scalable. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare breakup length and dimensionless landing position between model scales. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude scaling and surface tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; modelV=2 m/s; modelThickness=0.020 m; surfaceTension=0.072 N/m; Weber=1000*2**2*0.020/0.072=1111.11。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; modelV=2 m/s; modelThickness=0.020 m; surfaceTension=0.072 N/m; Weber=1000*2**2*0.020/0.072=1111.11.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「彈道相似就代表破碎與含氣完全相似」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Similar trajectories guarantee similar breakup and aeration" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「福祿尺度與表面張力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Froude scaling and surface tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 福祿尺度與表面張力
knowledge.text: 挑流模型常以重力相似重現彈道，但細水舌的破碎與含氣受到表面張力影響，韋伯數可提示這種尺度偏差。相同水質的縮尺模型無法同時保持所有無因次數；應把落點驗證與氣泡破碎驗證分開報告。
knowledge.textEn: Gravity similarity can reproduce trajectories while surface tension changes thin-jet breakup and aeration. Weber number highlights this scale effect.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：彈道相似就代表破碎與含氣完全相似 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Similar trajectories guarantee similar breakup and aeration Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「福祿尺度與表面張力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Froude scaling and surface tension" is correct?
options: 彈道相似就代表破碎與含氣完全相似
挑流模型常以重力相似重現彈道，但細水舌的破碎與含氣受到表面張力影響，韋伯數可提示這種尺度偏差。
理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍
optionsEn: Similar trajectories guarantee similar breakup and aeration
Gravity similarity can reproduce trajectories while surface tension changes thin-jet breakup and aeration.
The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint
quiz.explanation: 挑流模型常以重力相似重現彈道，但細水舌的破碎與含氣受到表面張力影響，韋伯數可提示這種尺度偏差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

title: 階梯式溢洪道
summary: 本課以以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能為主線，先用臨界水深與單寬流量與階高與相對尺度界定水力與構造條件，再將自含氣起點判讀、近壁低壓與氣蝕連結到縮尺黏性與可比性。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy through Critical depth and unit discharge and Step height and relative scale, then connects Self-aeration inception identification and Near-wall pressure and cavitation to Scale viscosity and comparability. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
