subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查臨界水深與單寬流量：q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m；再獨立檢查階高與相對尺度：criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless。敏感度：單寬流量由4增至6m2/s時，臨界水深由1.177增為1.542m，增加31.0%；若階高不變，水深階高比隨之提高，但不能用此一比值作通用流態界線。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 將比較槽末清水等效比能與消能池入流工況表作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Critical depth and unit discharge: q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m. Independently examine Step height and relative scale: criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless. Sensitivity: raising unit discharge from4 to6m2/s increases critical depth from1.177 to1.542m, about31.0 percent. At fixed step height the relative depth rises, but this ratio alone is not a universal regime boundary. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. Use the following independent check: Compare terminal clear-water equivalent energy with basin approach-condition tables. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「臨界水深與單寬流量」與「階高與相對尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Critical depth and unit discharge" and "Step height and relative scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 臨界水深與單寬流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and unit discharge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「臨界水深與單寬流量」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical depth and unit discharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階梯流態與流量相對階高有關，先以單寬流量求矩形明渠的臨界水深可建立尺度。此水深不是階面實際平均水深，也不是含氣混合水深；橫向不均流與入口曲率會改變局部條件，需另外量測入口過渡區。 驗證時應以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何，並辨識以下失效情境：把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「臨界水深與單寬流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Critical depth based on unit discharge supplies a reference scale for stepped-flow behavior. It is neither the actual mean depth above a step nor the aerated mixture depth. Transverse nonuniformity and entrance curvature alter local conditions and require measurements through the crest transition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Critical depth and unit discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨界水深就是每一階上的實際水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Critical depth equals actual flow depth on every step" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「臨界水深與單寬流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Critical depth and unit discharge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 臨界水深與單寬流量
knowledge.text: 階梯流態與流量相對階高有關，先以單寬流量求矩形明渠的臨界水深可建立尺度。此水深不是階面實際平均水深，也不是含氣混合水深；橫向不均流與入口曲率會改變局部條件，需另外量測入口過渡區。
knowledge.textEn: Critical depth based on unit discharge supplies a reference scale for stepped-flow behavior. It is neither the actual mean depth above a step nor the aerated mixture depth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨界水深就是每一階上的實際水深 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Critical depth equals actual flow depth on every step Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「臨界水深與單寬流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical depth and unit discharge" is correct?
options: 臨界水深就是每一階上的實際水深
階梯流態與流量相對階高有關，先以單寬流量求矩形明渠的臨界水深可建立尺度。
同一水深階高比保證所有坡度流態相同
optionsEn: Critical depth equals actual flow depth on every step
Critical depth based on unit discharge supplies a reference scale for stepped-flow behavior.
The same relative depth guarantees the same regime on every slope
quiz.explanation: 階梯流態與流量相對階高有關，先以單寬流量求矩形明渠的臨界水深可建立尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Critical depth based on unit discharge supplies a reference scale for stepped-flow behavior. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 臨界水深與單寬流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and unit discharge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨界水深與單寬流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical depth and unit discharge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.

steps.title: 臨界水深與單寬流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and unit discharge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨界水深與單寬流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical depth and unit discharge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度。診斷時應採取以下查核：以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. Diagnose it by the following check: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨界水深就是每一階上的實際水深」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Critical depth equals actual flow depth on every step" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度。診斷時應採取以下查核：以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. Diagnose it by the following check: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「臨界水深與單寬流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Critical depth and unit discharge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

同一水深階高比保證所有坡度流態相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale.
The same relative depth guarantees the same regime on every slope

quiz.explanationEn: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 階高與相對尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Step height and relative scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「階高與相對尺度」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Step height and relative scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階高改變水流是否逐階跌落或掠過階尖，水深階高比可整理試驗但還需陡槽坡度與入口邊界。過渡流態可能出現不規則噴濺與波動；不能把某一試驗的分界數值直接當成所有坡度皆適用的設計限制。 驗證時應在連續變流量試驗中記錄水舌是否撞擊階面及流態轉換，並辨識以下失效情境：只測單一流量會漏掉過渡流態的不規則噴濺。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「階高與相對尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Step height influences whether water cascades between steps or skims over their tips. A relative-depth ratio organizes experiments but slope and entrance conditions also matter. Transitional flow may splash irregularly; a boundary observed in one experiment is not a universal design limit across slopes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record nappe impact and regime transitions during a continuous discharge sweep. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Testing one discharge can miss irregular splashing in transitional flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Step height and relative scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一水深階高比保證所有坡度流態相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same relative depth guarantees the same regime on every slope" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「階高與相對尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Step height and relative scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Step height influences whether water cascades between steps or skims over their tips. A relative-depth ratio organizes experiments but slope and entrance conditions also matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一水深階高比保證所有坡度流態相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same relative depth guarantees the same regime on every slope Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「階高與相對尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 同一水深階高比保證所有坡度流態相同
平均坡度正確就不必檢查個別階梯
階高改變水流是否逐階跌落或掠過階尖，水深階高比可整理試驗但還需陡槽坡度與入口邊界。
optionsEn: The same relative depth guarantees the same regime on every slope
Correct average slope removes the need to inspect individual steps

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「階梯坡度與建造」與「階穴剪切與耗能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Step geometry and construction" and "Cavity shear and dissipation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 階梯坡度與建造：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Step geometry and construction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「階梯坡度與建造」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Step geometry and construction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階梯由水平踏面與垂直階面組成，整體坡角影響重力沿坡分量、回流穴與施工模板。幾何閉合需核對總落差與總水平長度；局部突出或階尖錯台可能破壞原本流場，不能只驗收平均坡度而忽略局部平整性。 驗證時應逐階測量高程與踏面長度並與整體坡線閉合，並辨識以下失效情境：局部突出階尖可能增加低壓與磨耗集中。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「階梯坡度與建造」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal treads and vertical risers define the overall slope, influencing gravity components and recirculation cavities. Check total rise and horizontal run together. Local protrusions or displaced edges disturb the intended flow field, so average slope acceptance does not replace local surface and alignment surveys. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey every riser and tread and close them against the overall slope line. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A projecting step edge can concentrate low pressure and abrasion. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Step geometry and construction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：stepRise=0.5 m; stepRun=1.0 m; slopeAngle=atan(0.5/1.0)=26.5651 degrees。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: stepRise=0.5 m; stepRun=1.0 m; slopeAngle=atan(0.5/1.0)=26.5651 degrees.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均坡度正確就不必檢查個別階梯」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct average slope removes the need to inspect individual steps" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「階梯坡度與建造」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Step geometry and construction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 階梯坡度與建造
knowledge.text: 階梯由水平踏面與垂直階面組成，整體坡角影響重力沿坡分量、回流穴與施工模板。幾何閉合需核對總落差與總水平長度；局部突出或階尖錯台可能破壞原本流場，不能只驗收平均坡度而忽略局部平整性。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal treads and vertical risers define the overall slope, influencing gravity components and recirculation cavities. Check total rise and horizontal run together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均坡度正確就不必檢查個別階梯 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct average slope removes the need to inspect individual steps Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: stepRise=0.5 m; stepRun=1.0 m; slopeAngle=atan(0.5/1.0)=26.5651 degrees. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

steps.instruction: 掠流在階尖連線上形成高速主流，階穴內回流透過剪切交換動量與能量。給定平均剪應力乘界面面積及相對速度可估交換功率，但不是完整耗能模型；相對速度與應力需由試驗取得，不能憑階數直接累加能量損失。 驗證時應比較階穴速度場與界面剪應力並檢查沿程剩餘比能，並辨識以下失效情境：把每階耗能當固定常數會忽略沿程流態演變。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「階穴剪切與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cavity shear and dissipation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把每階耗能當固定常數會忽略沿程流態演變。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較階穴速度場與界面剪應力並檢查沿程剩餘比能，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning constant dissipation to every step ignores evolving flow conditions. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare cavity velocities and interface shear with residual specific energy downstream. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要增加階數總耗能就能無限制線性增加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding steps increases total dissipation linearly without limit" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Diagnose it by the following check: Compare cavity velocities and interface shear with residual specific energy downstream. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「階穴剪切與耗能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cavity shear and dissipation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把每階耗能當固定常數會忽略沿程流態演變。
表面變白就保證底部已獲充分含氣保護
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Assigning constant dissipation to every step ignores evolving flow conditions.
A white surface guarantees adequate air protection at the bed
quiz.explanation: 把每階耗能當固定常數會忽略沿程流態演變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning constant dissipation to every step ignores evolving flow conditions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自含氣起點判讀」與「混合水深與牆高」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Self-aeration inception identification" and "Mixture depth and wall height": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自含氣起點判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Self-aeration inception identification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自含氣起點判讀」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Self-aeration inception identification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 湍流邊界層向自由水面發展後可開始大量捲氣，起點之前的近壁清水區可能更易受氣蝕影響。以觀測座標描述起點位置並不預測其隨流量變化；應結合壓力、含氣與邊界層量測，不能只看表面是否呈白色。 驗證時應沿槽測量近壁含氣率並將其與表面白化起點比較，並辨識以下失效情境：表面含氣但近壁仍清水可能留下局部氣蝕風險。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自含氣起點判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation. An observed inception coordinate does not predict its discharge dependence. Combine pressure, concentration and boundary-layer measurements rather than relying on a white surface appearance alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure near-wall air concentration along the chute and compare surface whitening onset. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An aerated surface with clear water near the wall leaves local cavitation risk. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Self-aeration inception identification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表面變白就保證底部已獲充分含氣保護」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A white surface guarantees adequate air protection at the bed" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自含氣起點判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Self-aeration inception identification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自含氣起點判讀

knowledge.textEn: Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation. An observed inception coordinate does not predict its discharge dependence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表面變白就保證底部已獲充分含氣保護 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

Mixture thickness always equals clear-water equivalent depth
Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation.

steps.title: 自含氣起點判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Self-aeration inception identification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自含氣起點判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Self-aeration inception identification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿槽測量近壁含氣率並將其與表面白化起點比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure near-wall air concentration along the chute and compare surface whitening onset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 自含氣起點判讀：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自含氣起點判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Self-aeration inception identification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿槽測量近壁含氣率並將其與表面白化起點比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「表面含氣但近壁仍清水可能留下局部氣蝕風險」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure near-wall air concentration along the chute and compare surface whitening onset. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An aerated surface with clear water near the wall leaves local cavitation risk. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 近壁低壓與氣蝕：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「近壁低壓與氣蝕」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Near-wall pressure and cavitation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階尖後方流動分離可產生低壓，局部壓力與蒸氣壓的距離比表面含氣外觀更直接。氣蝕指標需用一致的絕對壓力與參考速度；同一指標下表面缺陷與氣核不同仍會改變起始，因此需對實際階面品質驗證。 驗證時應同步量測階尖後低壓與近壁含氣率並記錄表面缺陷，並辨識以下失效情境：把表壓直接代入會錯估距蒸氣壓的餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「近壁低壓與氣蝕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separation behind step edges creates low pressure. Compare local absolute pressure with vapor pressure using a consistent velocity reference. Surface defects and nuclei affect inception even at similar indices; visible aeration does not replace verification of wall conditions and actual near-wall protection. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure downstream-edge pressure and near-wall air together and document surface defects. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：depth=1.1 m; meanV=8 m/s; energyCoefficient=1; specificEnergy=1.1+8**2/(2*9.81)=4.36198 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: depth=1.1 m; meanV=8 m/s; energyCoefficient=1; specificEnergy=1.1+8**2/(2*9.81)=4.36198 m. steps.instruction: 忽略剩餘速度水頭會低估下游沖刷需求。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較槽末清水等效比能與消能池入流工況表，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring residual velocity head understates downstream scour demand. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare terminal clear-water equivalent energy with basin approach-condition tables. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有階梯溢洪道就一定不需要末端消能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every stepped spillway eliminates the need for terminal dissipation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 忽略剩餘速度水頭會低估下游沖刷需求。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較槽末清水等效比能與消能池入流工況表，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

steps.instruction: 階梯混凝土接縫可能將表面動壓傳入底部，反覆升降的底板下壓力影響錨定與接觸。平均淨水頭只給靜態揚力量級，堵塞排水與脈動相關性需另考慮；驗證必須涵蓋接縫、底層與排水出口的連續水路。 驗證時應量測接縫兩側與底板下壓力並核對排水出口流量，並辨識以下失效情境：排水堵塞會讓接縫入水轉成持續底板揚壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫滲壓與穩定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete joints can transmit surface pressure beneath stepped slabs and impose cyclic uplift. Mean differential head provides a static scale only; drain blockage and pressure correlation need separate treatment. Verification must trace the connected route through joints, the underlying layer and drainage outlets. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures across joints and beneath slabs and check drainage outlet flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A blocked drain converts joint inflow into sustained slab uplift. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint pressure and slab stability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：NetUnderSlabHead=1.5 m; slabArea=12 m2; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; uplift=1.5*12*9.81=176.58 kN。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫滲壓與穩定」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale viscosity and comparability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型黏性過強會改變階穴交換與表面擾動。診斷時應採取以下查核：列出原型與模型雷諾數並比較兩種模型尺度的含氣結果，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excessive model viscosity changes cavity exchange and surface disturbance. Diagnose it by the following check: List prototype and model Reynolds numbers and compare aeration at two model scales. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal Froude numbers also guarantee equal Reynolds numbers" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 側槽式溢洪道
summary: 本課以以側向入流動量及沿程水面控制側槽為主線，先用沿程入流與累積與長堰流量與水頭界定水力與構造條件，再將出口臨界控制、波峰餘高與牆頂連結到模型守恆與驗證。側槽具有空間變流，示意分段平均不代替完整三維模型與沿程動量求解。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops controlling side channels through lateral inflow momentum and profiles through Lateral inflow accumulation and Long crest discharge and head, then connects Critical outlet control and Wave allowance and wall crest to Model conservation and validation. Side channels have spatially varied flow; segmented averages do not replace three-dimensional modeling and longitudinal momentum analysis. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查沿程入流與累積：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s；再獨立檢查長堰流量與水頭：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。敏感度：均勻側入流由每公尺2增至3m2/s且側槽長40m時，總流量由80增至120m3/s；若出口面積維持20m2，平均速度由4增為6m/s，動量與能量需求不只增加50%。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。側槽具有空間變流，示意分段平均不代替完整三維模型與沿程動量求解。 將同步量測底板上下水頭並檢查排水出口淹沒時段作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Lateral inflow accumulation: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. Independently examine Long crest discharge and head: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s. Sensitivity: increasing uniform lateral inflow from2 to3m2/s along40m raises discharge from80 to120m3/s. At a fixed20m2 outlet area, velocity rises from4 to6m/s; momentum and energy demands grow faster than the50-percent discharge increase. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Side channels have spatially varied flow; segmented averages do not replace three-dimensional modeling and longitudinal momentum analysis. Use the following independent check: Measure heads above and below the floor together and identify outlet submergence periods. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿程入流與累積」與「長堰流量與水頭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lateral inflow accumulation" and "Long crest discharge and head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿程入流與累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral inflow accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沿程入流與累積」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral inflow accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。先把側入流分布積分，再檢查各段斷面與出口控制；堰上水頭不均或局部淹沒會破壞均勻入流假設。 驗證時應分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對，並辨識以下失效情境：局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沿程入流與累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream. Integrate the inflow distribution before checking sections and outlet control rather than applying one discharge everywhere. Unequal crest heads or local submergence invalidate the uniform-inflow approximation and require segmented measurements. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral inflow accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沿程入流與累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lateral inflow accumulation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沿程入流與累積
knowledge.text: 側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。先把側入流分布積分，再檢查各段斷面與出口控制；堰上水頭不均或局部淹沒會破壞均勻入流假設。
knowledge.textEn: A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream. Integrate the inflow distribution before checking sections and outlet control rather than applying one discharge everywhere.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沿程入流與累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral inflow accumulation" is correct?
options: 側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同
側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。
堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量
optionsEn: Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel
A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream.
Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit
quiz.explanation: 側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沿程入流與累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral inflow accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沿程入流與累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral inflow accumulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沿程入流與累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral inflow accumulation", which statement holds?
options: 連續方程單獨就能求出整條側槽水面線
側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平
原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。
optionsEn: Continuity alone determines the complete side-channel water profile
The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section
Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.instruction: 分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral inflow accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。診斷時應採取以下查核：分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 長堰流量與水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long crest discharge and head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長堰流量與水頭」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long crest discharge and head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。自由堰公式只適用所假設的係數與單位；堰長增加不保證出口通道有足夠容量，應聯合分析槽內回水。 驗證時應比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況，並辨識以下失效情境：只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長堰流量與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important. A free-weir equation applies only to its stated geometry and units. More crest length does not guarantee outlet capacity because channel backwater may suppress the intended inflow. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long crest discharge and head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長堰流量與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long crest discharge and head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長堰流量與水頭
knowledge.text: 側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。自由堰公式只適用所假設的係數與單位；堰長增加不保證出口通道有足夠容量，應聯合分析槽內回水。
knowledge.textEn: A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important. A free-weir equation applies only to its stated geometry and units.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長堰流量與水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long crest discharge and head" is correct?
options: 堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量
側向入流可當作早已沿槽流動的水量
側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。
optionsEn: Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit
Lateral inflow can be treated as water already moving along the channel
A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important.
quiz.explanation: 側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長堰流量與水頭：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長堰流量與水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long crest discharge and head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長堰流量與水頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

平均水面低於牆頂就保證不會越流

Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel
A mean water surface below the wall guarantees no overtopping

steps.instruction: 只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側入動量與轉向」與「斷面速度與水深」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 側入動量與轉向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral momentum and turning: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側入動量與轉向」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral momentum and turning” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 垂直於槽軸的側入流需轉向後才沿槽輸送，其軸向初始動量可能很小，不能使用只含能量損失的普通渠道公式忽略混合作用。控制體應包含各入口速度向量、壁面反力與壓力力，簡化動量差只展示其中一項。 驗證時應以三維速度量測確認側入方向並核對控制體各面動量，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略側向混合會誤判沿程水深與壁面反力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側入動量與轉向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lateral inflow must turn into the channel axis and may carry little initial axial momentum. Ordinary channel calculations that only add an energy-loss coefficient can miss mixing forces. A control volume needs inlet velocity vectors, wall reactions and pressure forces; a simplified momentum difference illustrates only one contribution. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure three-dimensional velocity and reconcile momentum across every control-volume face. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring lateral mixing misstates channel depth and wall reactions. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral momentum and turning” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; axialOutflow=80 m3/s at4 m/s; lateral axial velocity=0; outgoingAxialMomentum=1000*80*4/1000=320 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; axialOutflow=80 m3/s at4 m/s; lateral axial velocity=0; outgoingAxialMomentum=1000*80*4/1000=320 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側向入流可當作早已沿槽流動的水量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lateral inflow can be treated as water already moving along the channel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側入動量與轉向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lateral momentum and turning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral momentum and turning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; axialOutflow=80 m3/s at4 m/s; lateral axial velocity=0; outgoingAxialMomentum=1000*80*4/1000=320 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; axialOutflow=80 m3/s at4 m/s; lateral axial velocity=0; outgoingAxialMomentum=1000*80*4/1000=320 kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Counting recirculation as effective downstream area understates main-stream velocity.
Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel
quiz.explanation: 把回流區算成有效順流面積會低估主流速度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting recirculation as effective downstream area understates main-stream velocity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出口臨界控制」與「橫向水位與彎流」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Critical outlet control" and "Transverse level and curved flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出口臨界控制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Critical outlet control: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出口臨界控制」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical outlet control” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。矩形臨界深度只對指定單寬流量成立；若有含氣、斜交或非矩形斷面，需用適用水力深度及完整模型。 驗證時應量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移，並辨識以下失效情境：漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出口臨界控制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An outlet contraction or drop may impose critical control and send backwater upstream toward the lateral crest. Evaluate the outlet and side weir jointly. Rectangular critical depth applies to a specified unit discharge; aeration, oblique approach or different geometry requires a more suitable formulation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Critical outlet control” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出口臨界控制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Critical outlet control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出口臨界控制
knowledge.text: 出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。矩形臨界深度只對指定單寬流量成立；若有含氣、斜交或非矩形斷面，需用適用水力深度及完整模型。
knowledge.textEn: An outlet contraction or drop may impose critical control and send backwater upstream toward the lateral crest. Evaluate the outlet and side weir jointly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出口臨界控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical outlet control" is correct?
options: 出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游
側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平
出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。
optionsEn: Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel
The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section
An outlet contraction or drop may impose critical control and send backwater upstream toward the lateral crest.
quiz.explanation: 出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An outlet contraction or drop may impose critical control and send backwater upstream toward the lateral crest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出口臨界控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical outlet control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出口臨界控制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical outlet control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出口臨界控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Critical outlet control", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。
排水孔存在就保證底板下沒有揚壓
水量守恆通過就證明整個三維模型完全正確
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m.
The presence of drains guarantees no pressure beneath the floor
Passing mass balance proves that the entire three-dimensional model is correct
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出口臨界控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Critical outlet control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出口臨界控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical outlet control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「出口臨界控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Critical outlet control"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移。
堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge.
Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit
quiz.explanation: 量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 出口臨界控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Critical outlet control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出口臨界控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical outlet control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出口臨界控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Critical outlet control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平
漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section
Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level.
quiz.explanation: 漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 橫向水位與彎流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transverse level and curved flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橫向水位與彎流」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transverse level and curved flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側流轉向與彎道可使橫向水位傾斜，平均縱向水面線不能代表外側牆邊最高水位。曲率平衡簡式以均勻速度和大半徑近似，回流與湍流時只能提供量級；需分別觀測內外側水位與波峰。 驗證時應同步量測內外側水位與波峰並對照轉彎速度場，並辨識以下失效情境：只在內側設水位計會漏掉外側越流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橫向水位與彎流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turning flow can tilt the transverse water surface, so a mean longitudinal profile does not capture the highest wall level. A curvature balance assumes approximately uniform velocity and gentle curvature; recirculating turbulent flow makes it only a scale estimate. Observe both banks and wave crests independently. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure levels and crests at both walls simultaneously alongside turning velocities. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A gauge only at the inner wall can miss outer-wall overtopping. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transverse level and curved flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=4 m/s; width=6 m; curvatureRadius=30 m; levelDifference=4**2*6/(9.81*30)=0.326198 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=4 m/s; width=6 m; curvatureRadius=30 m; levelDifference=4**2*6/(9.81*30)=0.326198 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橫向水位與彎流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transverse level and curved flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橫向水位與彎流
knowledge.text: 側流轉向與彎道可使橫向水位傾斜，平均縱向水面線不能代表外側牆邊最高水位。曲率平衡簡式以均勻速度和大半徑近似，回流與湍流時只能提供量級；需分別觀測內外側水位與波峰。
knowledge.textEn: Turning flow can tilt the transverse water surface, so a mean longitudinal profile does not capture the highest wall level. A curvature balance assumes approximately uniform velocity and gentle curvature; recirculating turbulent flow makes it only a scale estimate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平
平均水面低於牆頂就保證不會越流
optionsEn: Turning flow can tilt the transverse water surface, so a mean longitudinal profile does not capture the highest wall level.
The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section
A mean water surface below the wall guarantees no overtopping

steps.instruction: 同步量測內外側水位與波峰並對照轉彎速度場。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只在內側設水位計會漏掉外側越流」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 橫向水位與彎流：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transverse level and curved flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在內側設水位計會漏掉外側越流。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測內外側水位與波峰並對照轉彎速度場，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gauge only at the inner wall can miss outer-wall overtopping. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 底板排水與回水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floor drainage and backwater: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底板排水與回水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor drainage and backwater” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測底板上下水頭並檢查排水出口淹沒時段。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「下游回水使排水反灌可升高底板下壓力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure heads above and below the floor together and identify outlet submergence periods. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Downstream backwater can reverse drainage and raise subfloor pressure. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Downstream backwater can reverse drainage and raise subfloor pressure. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下游回水使排水反灌可升高底板下壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Downstream backwater can reverse drainage and raise subfloor pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 底板排水與回水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Floor drainage and backwater: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底板排水與回水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor drainage and backwater” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下游回水使排水反灌可升高底板下壓力。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測底板上下水頭並檢查排水出口淹沒時段，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Downstream backwater can reverse drainage and raise subfloor pressure. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure heads above and below the floor together and identify outlet submergence periods. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The presence of drains guarantees no pressure beneath the floor" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
