knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「底板排水與回水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漂流木與有效堰長」與「模型守恆與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Debris and effective crest length" and "Model conservation and validation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漂流木與有效堰長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Debris and effective crest length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漂流木與有效堰長」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Debris and effective crest length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漂流木可能卡在堰口與局部支柱，使有效堰長減少並改變側向入流分布。若暫時假設係數不變，可用堰長比估流量變化，但真實堵塞也會改變接近流與局部水頭；應以不同堵塞位置而非單一比例驗證。 驗證時應以多種堵塞位置觀察槽內水位與入流分配改變，並辨識以下失效情境：相同堵塞比例位於出口附近可能造成更強局部回水。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漂流木與有效堰長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Debris can reduce effective crest length and redistribute lateral inflow. A length-ratio estimate holds the coefficient and head fixed, while real blockage also changes approach flow and local head. Test different blockage locations rather than assuming one percentage completely describes the hydraulic consequence. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Observe level and inflow redistribution for several debris-blockage locations. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: The same blockage fraction near the outlet can produce stronger local backwater. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Debris and effective crest length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堵塞百分比相同就代表水力影響完全相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal blockage percentages always produce identical hydraulic effects" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漂流木與有效堰長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Debris and effective crest length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漂流木與有效堰長
knowledge.text: 漂流木可能卡在堰口與局部支柱，使有效堰長減少並改變側向入流分布。若暫時假設係數不變，可用堰長比估流量變化，但真實堵塞也會改變接近流與局部水頭；應以不同堵塞位置而非單一比例驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Debris can reduce effective crest length and redistribute lateral inflow. A length-ratio estimate holds the coefficient and head fixed, while real blockage also changes approach flow and local head.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：堵塞百分比相同就代表水力影響完全相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal blockage percentages always produce identical hydraulic effects Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漂流木與有效堰長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Debris and effective crest length" is correct?
options: 漂流木可能卡在堰口與局部支柱，使有效堰長減少並改變側向入流分布。
堵塞百分比相同就代表水力影響完全相同
水量守恆通過就證明整個三維模型完全正確
optionsEn: Debris can reduce effective crest length and redistribute lateral inflow.
Equal blockage percentages always produce identical hydraulic effects
Passing mass balance proves that the entire three-dimensional model is correct
quiz.explanation: 漂流木可能卡在堰口與局部支柱，使有效堰長減少並改變側向入流分布。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Debris can reduce effective crest length and redistribute lateral inflow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漂流木與有效堰長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Debris and effective crest length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漂流木與有效堰長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Debris and effective crest length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多種堵塞位置觀察槽內水位與入流分配改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe level and inflow redistribution for several debris-blockage locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漂流木與有效堰長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

原創教學假設：fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75。
連續方程單獨就能求出整條側槽水面線
optionsEn: Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: fixedHeadAndCoefficient; clearLength=40 m; blockedLength=10 m; remainingCapacityFraction=(40-10)/40=0.75. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 三維側槽試驗或數值模型需同時通過水量平衡與水面線比較，單一出口流量吻合不代表流場正確。用控制體殘差可找出量測或網格問題，但小殘差也可能伴隨錯誤的紊流與邊界設定；應另比較局部波動與速度。 驗證時應核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線，並辨識以下失效情境：只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模型守恆與驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 模型守恆與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model conservation and validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型守恆與驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model conservation and validation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水量守恆通過就證明整個三維模型完全正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing mass balance proves that the entire three-dimensional model is correct" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型守恆與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model conservation and validation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。
側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions.
Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel
quiz.explanation: 只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 豎井式溢洪道
summary: 本課以辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換為主線，先用環形堰頂自由流與喉部孔口控制界定水力與構造條件，再將旋渦環流與水頭、下游管流摩阻連結到瞬變量測與取樣。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions through Circular crest free flow and Throat orifice control, then connects Swirl circulation and head and Downstream conduit friction to Transient measurement and sampling. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查環形堰頂自由流：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s；再獨立檢查喉部孔口控制：Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s。敏感度：自由堰流近似下水頭由1增至1.5m，流量比為1.5的1.5次方即1.837；若轉為孔口控制且面積不變，同樣水頭比的流量比只有平方根1.225，因此需要確認控制轉換。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 將用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Circular crest free flow: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. Independently examine Throat orifice control: Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s. Sensitivity: under free-weir control, increasing head from1 to1.5m gives a discharge ratio of1.837. Under fixed-area orifice control the same head ratio gives only1.225. A rating must therefore identify the change in control. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Use the following independent check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環形堰頂自由流」與「喉部孔口控制」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circular crest free flow" and "Throat orifice control": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環形堰頂自由流」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circular crest free flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。接近流旋轉、墩柱與局部淹沒會降低均勻性；示意係數不能跨幾何直接沿用。水頭增加後控制可能移往喉部與隧道，應避免以同一冪次延伸整條率定曲線。 驗證時應沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環形堰頂自由流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. Swirl, piers and submergence reduce uniformity. An illustrative coefficient cannot transfer across geometries, and higher heads may move control to the throat or tunnel rather than preserve one power law. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circular crest free flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環形堰頂自由流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circular crest free flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環形堰頂自由流
knowledge.text: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。接近流旋轉、墩柱與局部淹沒會降低均勻性；示意係數不能跨幾何直接沿用。
knowledge.textEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. Swirl, piers and submergence reduce uniformity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環形堰頂自由流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circular crest free flow" is correct?
options: 環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。
孔口控制的流量仍必定與水頭一點五次方成正比
optionsEn: A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length.
Orifice discharge must remain proportional to head to the three-halves power
quiz.explanation: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環形堰頂自由流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circular crest free flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環形堰頂自由流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circular crest free flow", which statement holds?
options: 通氣管存在就保證任何流量下都能充分補氣
動量變化單項就是井底彎道全部荷載
原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。
optionsEn: A vent pipe guarantees adequate air supply at every water discharge
Momentum change alone equals the entire bottom-bend load
Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環形堰頂自由流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circular crest free flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

steps.instructionEn: Once submerged, the throat may act as an orifice governed by effective area and head difference. Discharge then responds less strongly to head than free-weir flow. steps.title: 旋渦環流與水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Swirl circulation and head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋渦環流與水頭」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Swirl circulation and head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。自由渦近似僅在指定半徑之外有效，靠近渦核不能任意外推至無限速度；抗渦構件應以模型驗證其阻水與導流作用。 驗證時應以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋渦環流與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. Tangential velocity affects central pressure and inlet capacity. A free-vortex model applies only outside a specified core and cannot be extrapolated to infinite center velocity; test antivortex devices for both flow guidance and obstruction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Swirl circulation and head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均入流速度低就不可能形成進水旋渦」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旋渦環流與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Swirl circulation and head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 旋渦環流與水頭
knowledge.text: 不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。自由渦近似僅在指定半徑之外有效，靠近渦核不能任意外推至無限速度；抗渦構件應以模型驗證其阻水與導流作用。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. Tangential velocity affects central pressure and inlet capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均入流速度低就不可能形成進水旋渦 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旋渦環流與水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Swirl circulation and head" is correct?
options: 平均入流速度低就不可能形成進水旋渦
動量變化單項就是井底彎道全部荷載
不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。
optionsEn: Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible
Momentum change alone equals the entire bottom-bend load
Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex.
quiz.explanation: 不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 旋渦環流與水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Swirl circulation and head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旋渦環流與水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Swirl circulation and head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 旋渦環流與水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Swirl circulation and head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旋渦環流與水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Swirl circulation and head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「旋渦環流與水頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Swirl circulation and head"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent.
Orifice discharge must remain proportional to head to the three-halves power
quiz.explanation: 以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 旋渦環流與水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Swirl circulation and head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「旋渦環流與水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Swirl circulation and head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。診斷時應採取以下查核：以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. Diagnose it by the following check: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均入流速度低就不可能形成進水旋渦」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。診斷時應採取以下查核：以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. Diagnose it by the following check: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「旋渦環流與水頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Swirl circulation and head" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
動量變化單項就是井底彎道全部荷載
只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Momentum change alone equals the entire bottom-bend load
Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation.
quiz.explanation: 只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 豎井底彎轉動量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bottom bend momentum change: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「豎井底彎轉動量」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bottom bend momentum change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 落水在井底彎轉為水平流時，方向改變形成明顯作用力，壓力與速度沿彎道分布不均。簡化等速直角轉彎的向量差只計動量項，實際支承作用還含壓力力與水重；不可直接把此單項當成彎道完整設計荷載。 驗證時應以彎道壓力積分及入口出口速度向量核對受力方向，並辨識以下失效情境：漏列壓力力會使支承反力估算不完整。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「豎井底彎轉動量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the shaft bottom, flow turns from vertical to horizontal and generates substantial reaction. An equal-speed right-angle vector difference estimates only momentum change. Real support loads also include pressure forces and water weight, so that single component is not the complete bend design load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check force direction using bend-pressure integration and inlet-outlet velocity vectors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting pressure forces leaves the support-reaction estimate incomplete. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bottom bend momentum change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=60 m3/s; V=10 m/s; rightAngleMomentumMagnitude=sqrt(2)*1000*60*10/1000=848.528 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=60 m3/s; V=10 m/s; rightAngleMomentumMagnitude=sqrt(2)*1000*60*10/1000=848.528 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動量變化單項就是井底彎道全部荷載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Momentum change alone equals the entire bottom-bend load" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「豎井底彎轉動量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bottom bend momentum change”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 下游管流摩阻：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Downstream conduit friction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下游管流摩阻」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Downstream conduit friction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「下游管流摩阻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Downstream conduit friction"?
options: 以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流。

optionsEn: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full.

quiz.explanation: 以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 下游管流摩阻：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Downstream conduit friction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下游管流摩阻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Downstream conduit friction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。診斷時應採取以下查核：以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. Diagnose it by the following check: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「下游管徑夠大就可以忽略全部摩阻」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large downstream pipe permits ignoring all friction losses" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。診斷時應採取以下查核：以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. Diagnose it by the following check: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「下游管流摩阻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Downstream conduit friction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。
靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow.
One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood
quiz.explanation: 在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制轉換與庫容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control transition and reservoir storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制轉換與庫容」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control transition and reservoir storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。定面積短時近似只表示水量差，不含變動庫容曲線與時間相依洩量；完整洪水演算不能靠單一靜態率定點。 驗證時應用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，並辨識以下失效情境：延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制轉換與庫容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. Couple continuity to the spillway control relation. A constant-area short-interval estimate illustrates imbalance but omits changing storage geometry and time-dependent outflow; one static rating point cannot route a flood. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Control transition and reservoir storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「控制轉換與庫容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Control transition and reservoir storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制轉換與庫容
knowledge.text: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。定面積短時近似只表示水量差，不含變動庫容曲線與時間相依洩量；完整洪水演算不能靠單一靜態率定點。
knowledge.textEn: When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. Couple continuity to the spillway control relation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制轉換與庫容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control transition and reservoir storage" is correct?
options: 靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算
堵塞面積減少三成就保證洩量只減三成
豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。
optionsEn: One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood
A thirty-percent area blockage guarantees exactly thirty-percent discharge loss
When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage.
quiz.explanation: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制轉換與庫容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control transition and reservoir storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制轉換與庫容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Control transition and reservoir storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制轉換與庫容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control transition and reservoir storage", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。
環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
整個豎井截面在所有工況都充滿液態水
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m.
A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
The entire shaft section contains liquid water in every operating regime
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。診斷時應採取以下查核：用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 漂流物與局部堵塞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Floating debris and local blockage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漂流物與局部堵塞」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floating debris and local blockage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鐘口附近漂流物可形成環狀或偏心堵塞，既減少有效入口又引入不對稱旋流。單純面積減量只作幾何示意，實際洩量還受堆積形狀與通氣影響；試驗需涵蓋不同漂流物位置以及清除前後的水位反應。 驗證時應以多種堵塞布置觀察偏流旋渦與通氣壓力變化，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心堵塞可能同時削弱洩量與補氣。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漂流物與局部堵塞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Debris around a bellmouth can block the inlet asymmetrically and induce swirl. An area deduction describes geometry only; discharge also depends on accumulation shape and ventilation. Test different positions and examine stage response before and after removal instead of equating blockage area with discharge loss. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Observe asymmetric flow, vortices and ventilation pressures for several blockage layouts. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric blockage may reduce both discharge and ventilation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Floating debris and local blockage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：NominalOpenArea=20 m2; blockedArea=6 m2; openFraction=(20-6)/20=0.70。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: NominalOpenArea=20 m2; blockedArea=6 m2; openFraction=(20-6)/20=0.70.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堵塞面積減少三成就保證洩量只減三成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thirty-percent area blockage guarantees exactly thirty-percent discharge loss" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漂流物與局部堵塞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Floating debris and local blockage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：堵塞面積減少三成就保證洩量只減三成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thirty-percent area blockage guarantees exactly thirty-percent discharge loss Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：NominalOpenArea=20 m2; blockedArea=6 m2; openFraction=(20-6)/20=0.70。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: NominalOpenArea=20 m2; blockedArea=6 m2; openFraction=(20-6)/20=0.70. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「瞬變量測與取樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transient measurement and sampling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。
環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle.
A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
quiz.explanation: 未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 溢洪道氣蝕防治
summary: 本課以由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治為主線，先用絕對壓力與蒸氣壓與氣蝕指標與速度界定水力與構造條件，再將摻氣量與相分率、拋離空腔與再附著連結到運轉曝露與追蹤。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair through Absolute pressure and vapor pressure and Cavitation index and velocity, then connects Air supply and phase fraction and Jet cavity and reattachment to Operating exposure and follow-up. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa；再獨立檢查氣蝕指標與速度：pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885。敏感度：絕對壓力100kPa與蒸氣壓2.3kPa不變，速度由20增至30m/s，氣蝕指標由0.4885降至0.2171；速度增加50%使動壓增加125%，但不能由指標直接預報破壞速率。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 將用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. Independently examine Cavitation index and velocity: pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885. Sensitivity: holding absolute pressure at100kPa and vapor pressure at2.3kPa, increasing speed from20 to30m/s lowers the index from0.4885 to0.2171. Dynamic pressure increases125 percent, but the index alone does not predict damage rate. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. Use the following independent check: Compare repeated three-dimensional pit maps and volumes against operating discharge records. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」與「氣蝕指標與速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure" and "Cavitation index and velocity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。高程與天氣會改變大氣壓，水溫則改變蒸氣壓；把表壓直接相減會嚴重錯估餘量。量測時須記錄壓力校正與溫度，而非只報單一負壓數值。 驗證時應將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，並辨識以下失效情境：混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. Altitude and weather affect atmospheric pressure while temperature affects vapor pressure. Subtracting gauge pressure directly gives the wrong margin; record pressure calibration and temperature instead of reporting only one negative gauge value. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓
knowledge.text: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。高程與天氣會改變大氣壓，水溫則改變蒸氣壓；把表壓直接相減會嚴重錯估餘量。
knowledge.textEn: Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. Altitude and weather affect atmospheric pressure while temperature affects vapor pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure" is correct?
options: 表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓
氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。
氣蝕指標數值可直接換算成混凝土磨損速率
optionsEn: Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure
Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis.
The cavitation index directly converts into a concrete damage rate
quiz.explanation: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure", which statement holds?
options: 平均壓力高於蒸氣壓就排除所有瞬間氣蝕
空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好
原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。
optionsEn: Mean pressure above vapor pressure excludes every transient cavitation event
Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection
Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. quiz.question: 要驗證「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure"?
options: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。診斷時應採取以下查核：將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錯台尺度與流動分離」與「低壓脈動與極值」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Offset scale and separation" and "Low-pressure fluctuations and extremes": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錯台尺度與流動分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Offset scale and separation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錯台尺度與流動分離」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Offset scale and separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 迎流錯台使水流突然偏轉，背後低壓與渦流可能觸發氣蝕；缺陷方向和尖銳程度比單純高度更重要。相對粗糙度可描述尺度但不能提供通用允收值，施工驗收須保留沿流方向的剖面及表面修整紀錄。 驗證時應用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度，並辨識以下失效情境：只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錯台尺度與流動分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An upstream-facing offset abruptly deflects flow and creates low pressure and vortices behind it. Orientation and sharpness matter alongside height. Relative roughness describes scale but is not a universal tolerance; acceptance needs profiles along the flow direction and documented surface finishing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Offset scale and separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同錯台高度不論方向都有相同氣蝕影響」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal offset heights have identical cavitation effects in every orientation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錯台尺度與流動分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Offset scale and separation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錯台尺度與流動分離

knowledge.textEn: An upstream-facing offset abruptly deflects flow and creates low pressure and vortices behind it. Orientation and sharpness matter alongside height.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal offset heights have identical cavitation effects in every orientation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 錯台尺度與流動分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Offset scale and separation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錯台尺度與流動分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Offset scale and separation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
