steps.title: 錯台尺度與流動分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Offset scale and separation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錯台尺度與流動分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Offset scale and separation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錯台尺度與流動分離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Offset scale and separation"?

Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes.

quiz.explanationEn: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錯台尺度與流動分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Offset scale and separation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錯台尺度與流動分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Offset scale and separation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應。診斷時應採取以下查核：用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. Diagnose it by the following check: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal offset heights have identical cavitation effects in every orientation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應。診斷時應採取以下查核：用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. Diagnose it by the following check: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錯台尺度與流動分離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 低壓脈動與極值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low-pressure fluctuations and extremes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低壓脈動與極值」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-pressure fluctuations and extremes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均壓力高於蒸氣壓不表示所有瞬間都安全，紊流脈動可能產生短暫低壓。高斯近似可示範統計尾部但未必適用實際尖峰；應保存原始高頻資料並分析持續時間、空間相關與感測器頻率響應，避免只用平均值判讀。 驗證時應檢查低壓事件的持續時間與相鄰測點是否同步，並辨識以下失效情境：將均值減三倍標準差當絕對下限會漏掉非高斯尖峰。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低壓脈動與極值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A mean above vapor pressure does not exclude brief low-pressure excursions. A Gaussian illustration describes a statistical tail but may not fit actual spikes. Preserve high-rate records and analyze duration, spatial correlation and sensor response rather than judging the condition from the average alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Examine excursion duration and synchronization between neighboring pressure sensors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating mean minus three deviations as a hard minimum misses non-Gaussian spikes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low-pressure fluctuations and extremes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Illustrative meanAbsolutePressure=70 kPa; standardDeviation=15 kPa; meanMinus3SD=70-3*15=25 kPa; no physical minimum implied。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative meanAbsolutePressure=70 kPa; standardDeviation=15 kPa; meanMinus3SD=70-3*15=25 kPa; no physical minimum implied.

steps.instruction: 供氣可緩和氣泡潰滅附近的局部壓力衝擊，但入口總氣量不等於近壁保護濃度。水氣體積比需以相同壓力溫度定義，並區分氣水比與混合物空隙率；氣泡滑移與沿程脫氣使兩者的空間分布更複雜。 驗證時應同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「摻氣量與相分率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 摻氣量與相分率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Air supply and phase fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「摻氣量與相分率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Air supply and phase fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「摻氣量與相分率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Air supply and phase fraction", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10。
一次損傷體積可直接預報未來每年的固定損失
所有運轉一小時造成的氣蝕損傷必定相同
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10.
One damage-volume survey predicts a fixed annual future loss
Every operating hour necessarily causes the same cavitation damage
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 摻氣量與相分率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Air supply and phase fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「摻氣量與相分率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air supply and phase fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「摻氣量與相分率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air supply and phase fraction"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度。
氣蝕指標數值可直接換算成混凝土磨損速率
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature.
The cavitation index directly converts into a concrete damage rate
quiz.explanation: 同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 摻氣量與相分率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air supply and phase fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「摻氣量與相分率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air supply and phase fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總供氣量足夠就保證每個壁面都有足夠含氣」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate total air supply guarantees adequate aeration at every wall" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「摻氣量與相分率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air supply and phase fraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好
總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection
Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed.
quiz.explanation: 總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通氣管損失與負壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vent losses and suction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通氣管損失與負壓」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vent losses and suction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。低馬赫數近似可用局部損失估壓差；若壓差大或接近可壓縮限制，必須改用適當氣體流模型，不可直接照搬不可壓縮公式。 驗證時應量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力，並辨識以下失效情境：通氣入口堵塞可降低供氣並加深空腔負壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通氣管損失與負壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. At low Mach number, a local-loss relation estimates pressure drop. Large pressure differences or compressibility limits require a gas-flow model instead of unconditional use of an incompressible expression. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vent losses and suction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通氣管損失與負壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vent losses and suction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通氣管損失與負壓
knowledge.text: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。低馬赫數近似可用局部損失估壓差；若壓差大或接近可壓縮限制，必須改用適當氣體流模型，不可直接照搬不可壓縮公式。
knowledge.textEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. At low Mach number, a local-loss relation estimates pressure drop.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通氣管損失與負壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vent losses and suction" is correct?
options: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。
空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好
只要有摻氣坎就不可能發生空腔淹沒
optionsEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape.
Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection
The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible
quiz.explanation: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通氣管損失與負壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vent losses and suction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「通氣入口堵塞可降低供氣並加深空腔負壓」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 通氣管損失與負壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vent losses and suction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通氣管損失與負壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vent losses and suction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 通氣入口堵塞可降低供氣並加深空腔負壓。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拋離空腔與再附著」與「損傷盤點與體積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet cavity and reattachment" and "Damage mapping and volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拋離空腔與再附著：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet cavity and reattachment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拋離空腔與再附著」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet cavity and reattachment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摻氣坎讓水流暫時離開底板並在下方形成供氣空腔，水舌再附著位置影響近壁含氣與局部壓力。水平拋射簡式只估無阻力的中心線，不代表含氣分布；設計需同時檢查空腔是否淹沒與再附著後的保護長度。 驗證時應以影像量測空腔長度並檢查再附著後近壁含氣，並辨識以下失效情境：尾水或水深增大可能淹沒空腔並切斷補氣。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拋離空腔與再附著」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An aerator ramp lifts flow from the floor and forms an air cavity. Reattachment affects near-wall air and pressure. A horizontal ballistic estimate gives only a drag-free centerline, not concentration. Check cavity drowning and protection downstream of reattachment as separate performance questions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure cavity length optically and inspect near-wall air downstream of reattachment. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Higher water depth can drown the cavity and interrupt air supply. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet cavity and reattachment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有摻氣坎就不可能發生空腔淹沒」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拋離空腔與再附著」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet cavity and reattachment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拋離空腔與再附著
knowledge.text: 摻氣坎讓水流暫時離開底板並在下方形成供氣空腔，水舌再附著位置影響近壁含氣與局部壓力。水平拋射簡式只估無阻力的中心線，不代表含氣分布；設計需同時檢查空腔是否淹沒與再附著後的保護長度。
knowledge.textEn: An aerator ramp lifts flow from the floor and forms an air cavity. Reattachment affects near-wall air and pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 拋離空腔與再附著：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拋離空腔與再附著」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jet cavity and reattachment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以影像量測空腔長度並檢查再附著後近壁含氣。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure cavity length optically and inspect near-wall air downstream of reattachment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 損傷盤點與體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Damage mapping and volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「損傷盤點與體積」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damage mapping and volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 氣蝕損傷可能由局部凹坑成長並改變後續流場，修補前需建立可重複的地形基準。面積乘平均深度只是體積盤點，不能把它當作未來線性損傷率；磨耗、化學侵蝕與鋼筋剝露需分別辨認並追溯操作歷程。 驗證時應用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄，並辨識以下失效情境：以單次平均損傷量線性外推可能漏掉幾何惡化的加速效應。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「損傷盤點與體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavitation pits can grow and alter subsequent flow. Establish a repeatable surface datum before repair. Area times mean depth estimates lost volume, not a linear future damage rate. Distinguish abrasion, chemical deterioration and exposed reinforcement and relate each to the operating history. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare repeated three-dimensional pit maps and volumes against operating discharge records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Linear extrapolation from one survey misses acceleration caused by worsening geometry. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Damage mapping and volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：damagedArea=12 m2; meanLossDepth=0.025 m; lostVolume=12*0.025=0.30 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: damagedArea=12 m2; meanLossDepth=0.025 m; lostVolume=12*0.025=0.30 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次損傷體積可直接預報未來每年的固定損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One damage-volume survey predicts a fixed annual future loss" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「損傷盤點與體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Damage mapping and volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 損傷盤點與體積
knowledge.text: 氣蝕損傷可能由局部凹坑成長並改變後續流場，修補前需建立可重複的地形基準。面積乘平均深度只是體積盤點，不能把它當作未來線性損傷率；磨耗、化學侵蝕與鋼筋剝露需分別辨認並追溯操作歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Cavitation pits can grow and alter subsequent flow. Establish a repeatable surface datum before repair.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次損傷體積可直接預報未來每年的固定損失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One damage-volume survey predicts a fixed annual future loss Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「損傷盤點與體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

一個拉拔試點合格就證明整片修補完全黏結

One passing pull-off test proves complete bond over the entire repair
Cavitation pits can grow and alter subsequent flow.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：damagedArea=12 m2; meanLossDepth=0.025 m; lostVolume=12*0.025=0.30 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: damagedArea=12 m2; meanLossDepth=0.025 m; lostVolume=12*0.025=0.30 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以單次平均損傷量線性外推可能漏掉幾何惡化的加速效應。診斷時應採取以下查核：用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Linear extrapolation from one survey misses acceleration caused by worsening geometry. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 修補黏結與平整：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repair bond and surface continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「修補黏結與平整」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repair bond and surface continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 修補材料需與基材共同承受水力脈壓及溫度變形，表面平順與黏結完整同樣重要。拉拔試驗只檢查局部黏結樣本，不能證明整片無空鼓；施工記錄應包含基面處理、養護與沿流接縫輪廓，避免修補本身形成新缺陷。 驗證時應結合拉拔位置圖敲測或適用非破壞檢查與表面剖面，並辨識以下失效情境：局部拉拔合格仍可能存在未取樣的空鼓帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「修補黏結與平整」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repairs must transfer hydraulic pulses and thermal deformation to the substrate. Smoothness and bond continuity both matter. Pull-off tests sample local adhesion and cannot prove an entire patch void-free; document preparation, curing and flowwise joint profiles so the repair does not create another initiating defect. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Combine mapped pull-off locations, suitable void detection and surface profiles. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Passing local pull-off tests can coexist with an unsampled debonded strip. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repair bond and surface continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：PullOffLoad=9 kN; testArea=0.003 m2; nominalBondStress=9/0.003/1000=3 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: PullOffLoad=9 kN; testArea=0.003 m2; nominalBondStress=9/0.003/1000=3 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個拉拔試點合格就證明整片修補完全黏結」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One passing pull-off test proves complete bond over the entire repair" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「修補黏結與平整」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repair bond and surface continuity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 修補黏結與平整
knowledge.text: 修補材料需與基材共同承受水力脈壓及溫度變形，表面平順與黏結完整同樣重要。拉拔試驗只檢查局部黏結樣本，不能證明整片無空鼓；施工記錄應包含基面處理、養護與沿流接縫輪廓，避免修補本身形成新缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Repairs must transfer hydraulic pulses and thermal deformation to the substrate. Smoothness and bond continuity both matter.

knowledge.text: 誤解：一個拉拔試點合格就證明整片修補完全黏結 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 修補黏結與平整：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「修補黏結與平整」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repair bond and surface continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：PullOffLoad=9 kN; testArea=0.003 m2; nominalBondStress=9/0.003/1000=3 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: PullOffLoad=9 kN; testArea=0.003 m2; nominalBondStress=9/0.003/1000=3 MPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 局部拉拔合格仍可能存在未取樣的空鼓帶。診斷時應採取以下查核：結合拉拔位置圖敲測或適用非破壞檢查與表面剖面，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Passing local pull-off tests can coexist with an unsampled debonded strip. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One passing pull-off test proves complete bond over the entire repair" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 氣蝕損傷與高風險工況的持續時間有關，但不同流速與壓力不能以相同小時數直接等價。曝露時數可建立追蹤帳，仍須按流量、水位、含氣與缺陷狀態分組；修補後對照試驗應保持工況可比，才能辨識改善。 驗證時應按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測，並辨識以下失效情境：只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「運轉曝露與追蹤」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Damage depends on exposure to adverse conditions, but hours at different pressures and velocities are not equivalent. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Three identified operating intervals=2.5,1.0,3.5 h; totalRecordedExposure=2.5+1.0+3.5=7 h; no linear damage law。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Three identified operating intervals=2.5,1.0,3.5 h; totalRecordedExposure=2.5+1.0+3.5=7 h; no linear damage law. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.text: 只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。診斷時應採取以下查核：按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. Diagnose it by the following check: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運轉曝露與追蹤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Operating exposure and follow-up" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。
表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation.
Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure
quiz.explanation: 只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大口徑輸水管施工
summary: 本課以大口徑輸水管的施工介面為主線，從縱斷面與溝槽量方，進入土管互制、臨時吊點、焊接管殼、彎管推力及接頭位移，再把溫度、試壓和通水交接連成證據鏈。算例分開施工階段與永久狀態，避免用單一壓力或幾何合格推定整體品質。
summaryEn: This course follows construction interfaces in large water mains, moving from alignment and trench quantities to soil-pipe interaction, temporary lifting, welded shells, bend thrust and joint movement. Temperature, pressure testing and commissioning complete the evidence chain. Examples distinguish construction stages from permanent conditions and avoid inferring overall quality from one acceptable pressure or geometric measurement.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度算例採重量100 kN的理想管節，使用兩條對稱吊索。當每腿與鉛直夾角為30°，每腿索力57.74 kN；只把角度增加至60°，重量不變，每腿索力增至100 kN，增加73.2%。這個結果來自鉛直力平衡，不能用來宣稱吊具或起重機具備足夠容量。進一步檢查重心偏移、局部管殼接觸及動態作用，並把製造商吊點要求與完整工程吊裝計畫對照。幾何模型用來揭示角度敏感性，不提供操作指令，所有數字均與列名工程無關。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example uses an ideal 100 kN pipe section and two symmetric slings. With each leg thirty degrees from vertical, tension is 57.74 kN per leg. Changing only the angle to sixty degrees increases tension to 100 kN, a 73.2% rise. This follows vertical equilibrium and does not establish rigging or crane capacity. Examine center-of-mass offset, local shell contact and dynamic effects separately, then compare manufacturer pick-point requirements with a complete engineered lifting plan. The geometry illustrates angle sensitivity rather than providing operating instructions, and none of these values comes from a named project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」與「溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification" and "Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「縱斷面與局部壓力」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment and local pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大口徑輸水管的路線選擇同時改變水力高程、施工通道與後續維修空間。相同起終點的兩條路線仍可有不同低點靜壓及高點負壓風險，管材壓力等級不能只按端點平均水頭決定；道路交叉、地滑帶與重要設施還會限制可接受的支承和接頭變形。靜水壓只由同一連通水體的高程差求得，尚未包含流動損失、泵作用與瞬變；所有標高必須使用同一基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「縱斷面與局部壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A large-main alignment changes hydraulic elevation, construction access and future maintenance space together. Two routes between the same endpoints can still have different low-point static pressure and high-point low-pressure exposure. Pipe pressure classification cannot be selected from endpoint-average head alone, and crossings, unstable slopes and important utilities constrain acceptable support and joint movement. Hydrostatic pressure follows elevation difference within one connected water body. Flow losses, pumps and transients are separate, and all elevations require a common datum. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment and local pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設連通水面高於管線低點h=50 m、水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓p=ρgh=490.5 kPa，為靜止水情境。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a connected water surface h=50 m above the low point, water ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「縱斷面與局部壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment and local pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 大口徑輸水管的路線選擇同時改變水力高程、施工通道與後續維修空間。相同起終點的兩條路線仍可有不同低點靜壓及高點負壓風險，管材壓力等級不能只按端點平均水頭決定；道路交叉、地滑帶與重要設施還會限制可接受的支承和接頭變形。
knowledge.textEn: A large-main alignment changes hydraulic elevation, construction access and future maintenance space together. Two routes between the same endpoints can still have different low-point static pressure and high-point low-pressure exposure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。
大口徑輸水管的路線選擇同時改變水力高程、施工通道與後續維修空間。
土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。
optionsEn: Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them.
A large-main alignment changes hydraulic elevation, construction access and future maintenance space together.
Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly.
quiz.explanation: 大口徑輸水管的路線選擇同時改變水力高程、施工通道與後續維修空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A large-main alignment changes hydraulic elevation, construction access and future maintenance space together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縱斷面與局部壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment and local pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設連通水面高於管線低點h=50 m、水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓p=ρgh=490.5 kPa，為靜止水情境。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a connected water surface h=50 m above the low point, water ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Gauge pressure p=ρgh=490.5 kPa for stationary water. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將測量縱斷面、地質與地下設施圖放在共同坐標內，逐點核對管頂管底及水頭線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place surveyed profiles, geology and utilities in one coordinate system, checking pipe crown, invert and hydraulic grade at key points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設連通水面高於管線低點h=50 m、水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓p=ρgh=490.5 kPa，為靜止水情境。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a connected water surface h=50 m above the low point, water ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Gauge pressure p=ρgh=490.5 kPa for stationary water.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。
錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設連通水面高於管線低點h=50 m、水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓p=ρgh=490.5 kPa，為靜止水情境。
optionsEn: Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each.
More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a connected water surface h=50 m above the low point, water ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設連通水面高於管線低點h=50 m、水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓p=ρgh=490.5 kPa，為靜止水情境。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a connected water surface h=50 m above the low point, water ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「縱斷面與局部壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment and local pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將測量縱斷面、地質與地下設施圖放在共同坐標內，逐點核對管頂管底及水頭線。對關鍵高低點建立正常、停泵與施工隔離情境，記錄使用哪一組水位作比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place surveyed profiles, geology and utilities in one coordinate system, checking pipe crown, invert and hydraulic grade at key points. Define normal, pump-stop and construction-isolation scenarios for significant high and low points, recording the water levels used in each comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條假設路線畫出低點、高點與可維修位置，分別比較靜壓及施工介面；保留尚未調查的地質段落，不以最短距離直接判定最佳路線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw low points, high points and maintenance access for two hypothetical routes, comparing static pressure and construction interfaces separately. Retain unresolved geological reaches rather than declaring the shortest route the best.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部低點被平滑路線圖漏掉時，該段可承受比端點推估更高的壓力；錯誤高程基準還可能讓設計誤判高點仍具有足夠正壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a smoothed alignment misses a local depression, that reach can experience higher pressure than endpoint estimates suggest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將測量縱斷面、地質與地下設施圖放在共同坐標內，逐點核對管頂管底及水頭線。對關鍵高低點建立正常、停泵與施工隔離情境，記錄使用哪一組水位作比較。
knowledge.textEn: Place surveyed profiles, geology and utilities in one coordinate system, checking pipe crown, invert and hydraulic grade at key points. Define normal, pump-stop and construction-isolation scenarios for significant high and low points, recording the water levels used in each comparison.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為兩條假設路線畫出低點、高點與可維修位置，分別比較靜壓及施工介面；保留尚未調查的地質段落，不以最短距離直接判定最佳路線。
knowledge.textEn: Draw low points, high points and maintenance access for two hypothetical routes, comparing static pressure and construction interfaces separately. Retain unresolved geological reaches rather than declaring the shortest route the best.

quiz.question: 要驗證「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification"?
options: 將測量縱斷面、地質與地下設施圖放在共同坐標內，逐點核對管頂管底及水頭線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。
optionsEn: Place surveyed profiles, geology and utilities in one coordinate system, checking pipe crown, invert and hydraulic grade at key points.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action.
quiz.explanation: 將測量縱斷面、地質與地下設施圖放在共同坐標內，逐點核對管頂管底及水頭線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place surveyed profiles, geology and utilities in one coordinate system, checking pipe crown, invert and hydraulic grade at key points. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「縱斷面與局部壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment and local pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部低點被平滑路線圖漏掉時，該段可承受比端點推估更高的壓力；錯誤高程基準還可能讓設計誤判高點仍具有足夠正壓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a smoothed alignment misses a local depression, that reach can experience higher pressure than endpoint estimates suggest. A mistaken elevation datum can also falsely indicate adequate positive pressure at a high point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：靜水壓只由同一連通水體的高程差求得，尚未包含流動損失、泵作用與瞬變；所有標高必須使用同一基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Flow losses, pumps and transients are separate, and all elevations require a common datum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部低點被平滑路線圖漏掉時，該段可承受比端點推估更高的壓力；錯誤高程基準還可能讓設計誤判高點仍具有足夠正壓。
knowledge.textEn: If a smoothed alignment misses a local depression, that reach can experience higher pressure than endpoint estimates suggest. A mistaken elevation datum can also falsely indicate adequate positive pressure at a high point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
局部低點被平滑路線圖漏掉時，該段可承受比端點推估更高的壓力；錯誤高程基準還可能讓設計誤判高點仍具有足夠正壓。
土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If a smoothed alignment misses a local depression, that reach can experience higher pressure than endpoint estimates suggest.
Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly.

quiz.explanationEn: If a smoothed alignment misses a local depression, that reach can experience higher pressure than endpoint estimates suggest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溝槽方量與施工邊界」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trench quantities and construction boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溝槽開挖量不等於成品管體積，工作寬度、接頭位置與支護系統會改變實際斷面。土方運輸還受原狀、鬆方和壓實體積的差異影響，而地下水及鄰近荷載會控制支護與施工分段；單純幾何估算應先定義量方邊界，不能被誤讀為允許的無支撐開挖形狀。矩形體積算例僅供材料帳，忽略放坡、支撐占位與局部工作井；它既不是支護設計，也不決定可同時開挖的長度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溝槽方量與施工邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation volume differs from finished pipe volume because working width, joint locations and temporary support change the section. Transport quantities also depend on differences among in-situ, loose and compacted volumes. Groundwater and nearby loads govern support and staging, so a geometric estimate must define its measurement boundary and must not be interpreted as an allowable unsupported excavation shape. The rectangular volume is a quantity ledger only, omitting slopes, support occupancy and local pits. It neither designs support nor determines how much trench can be open simultaneously. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trench quantities and construction boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設量方寬B=2.5 m、深H=3.0 m、長L=100 m，原狀幾何體積V=BHL=750 m³；不含土方鬆脹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume measured width B=2.5 m, depth H=3.0 m and length L=100 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溝槽方量與施工邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trench quantities and construction boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 溝槽開挖量不等於成品管體積，工作寬度、接頭位置與支護系統會改變實際斷面。土方運輸還受原狀、鬆方和壓實體積的差異影響，而地下水及鄰近荷載會控制支護與施工分段；單純幾何估算應先定義量方邊界，不能被誤讀為允許的無支撐開挖形狀。
knowledge.textEn: Excavation volume differs from finished pipe volume because working width, joint locations and temporary support change the section. Transport quantities also depend on differences among in-situ, loose and compacted volumes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification" is correct?

平均管床承壓很低就能證明管環完全不會變形。

optionsEn: Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly.
Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform.
Excavation volume differs from finished pipe volume because working width, joint locations and temporary support change the section.
quiz.explanation: 溝槽開挖量不等於成品管體積，工作寬度、接頭位置與支護系統會改變實際斷面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation volume differs from finished pipe volume because working width, joint locations and temporary support change the section. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溝槽方量與施工邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trench quantities and construction boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設量方寬B=2.5 m、深H=3.0 m、長L=100 m，原狀幾何體積V=BHL=750 m³；不含土方鬆脹。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume measured width B=2.5 m, depth H=3.0 m and length L=100 m. In-situ geometric volume V=BHL=750 m³, excluding bulking. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工前後斷面測量核對土方帳，將局部加寬、工作井與回填需求分項列示。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile quantity records with before-and-after section surveys, listing local widening, pits and backfill separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設量方寬B=2.5 m、深H=3.0 m、長L=100 m，原狀幾何體積V=BHL=750 m³；不含土方鬆脹。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume measured width B=2.5 m, depth H=3.0 m and length L=100 m. In-situ geometric volume V=BHL=750 m³, excluding bulking.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設量方寬B=2.5 m、深H=3.0 m、長L=100 m，原狀幾何體積V=BHL=750 m³；不含土方鬆脹。
試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。
單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume measured width B=2.5 m, depth H=3.0 m and length L=100 m.
A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist.
One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume measured width B=2.5 m, depth H=3.0 m and length L=100 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溝槽方量與施工邊界機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trench quantities and construction boundaries mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溝槽方量與施工邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trench quantities and construction boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工前後斷面測量核對土方帳，將局部加寬、工作井與回填需求分項列示。支護及地下水方案須另外對照鄰近設施監測，量方相符不能取代開挖穩定的驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile quantity records with before-and-after section surveys, listing local widening, pits and backfill separately. Independently compare support and groundwater provisions with monitoring of nearby assets; agreement in earthwork quantities cannot establish excavation stability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立原狀、鬆方及壓實三種體積欄位，為每次換算註明密度或試驗依據。把計量誤差與地層流失分成兩個待查假說，再選擇能區分它們的測量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create separate in-situ, loose and compacted-volume columns, identifying density or test evidence for each conversion. Treat accounting error and ground loss as different hypotheses and select measurements that distinguish them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把車載鬆方直接當成原狀開挖量會形成虛假超挖，反之忽略工作井又會低估回填需求；兩種偏差都可能掩蓋真實的地層流失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating loose truck volumes as in-situ excavation creates a false overbreak estimate, while omitting pits understates backfill demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
