Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform.
Treating loose truck volumes as in-situ excavation creates a false overbreak estimate, while omitting pits understates backfill demand.
quiz.explanation: 把車載鬆方直接當成原狀開挖量會形成虛假超挖，反之忽略工作井又會低估回填需求；兩種偏差都可能掩蓋真實的地層流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating loose truck volumes as in-situ excavation creates a false overbreak estimate, while omitting pits understates backfill demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證」與「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification" and "Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管床接觸與土管互制」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管床把管重及上覆作用傳入地基，接觸寬度與均勻性會影響局部承壓和管環變形。柔性管依賴兩側回填提供側向拘束，剛性管則對不均勻支承與接頭差異沉陷敏感；因此平均床面平整不足以證明土管共同作用，局部空隙和硬點必須另行辨識。線荷載除以接觸寬度只得到假設平均壓力，沒有包含土拱效應、側向回填剛度或管殼彎曲，不能當成管材強度驗算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管床接觸與土管互制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bedding transfers pipe weight and overlying loads into the ground, with contact width and uniformity controlling local pressure and ring deformation. Flexible pipes depend on sidefill for lateral restraint, while rigid pipes are sensitive to uneven support and differential settlement at joints. Average bed level therefore does not establish soil-pipe performance; voids and hard points need separate identification. Line load divided by contact width gives an assumed mean pressure only. It omits soil arching, sidefill stiffness and shell bending and cannot verify pipe structural capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每米向下荷載w=12 kN/m、有效管床寬b=0.60 m，平均接觸壓q=w/b=20 kPa，假設接觸連續。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume downward line load w=12 kN/m and effective bedding width b=0.60 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均管床承壓很低就能證明管環完全不會變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管床接觸與土管互制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 管床把管重及上覆作用傳入地基，接觸寬度與均勻性會影響局部承壓和管環變形。柔性管依賴兩側回填提供側向拘束，剛性管則對不均勻支承與接頭差異沉陷敏感；因此平均床面平整不足以證明土管共同作用，局部空隙和硬點必須另行辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Bedding transfers pipe weight and overlying loads into the ground, with contact width and uniformity controlling local pressure and ring deformation. Flexible pipes depend on sidefill for lateral restraint, while rigid pipes are sensitive to uneven support and differential settlement at joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均管床承壓很低就能證明管環完全不會變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 管床把管重及上覆作用傳入地基，接觸寬度與均勻性會影響局部承壓和管環變形。
平均管床承壓很低就能證明管環完全不會變形。
兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。
optionsEn: Bedding transfers pipe weight and overlying loads into the ground, with contact width and uniformity controlling local pressure and ring deformation.
Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform.
Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each.
quiz.explanation: 管床把管重及上覆作用傳入地基，接觸寬度與均勻性會影響局部承壓和管環變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bedding transfers pipe weight and overlying loads into the ground, with contact width and uniformity controlling local pressure and ring deformation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管床接觸與土管互制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每米向下荷載w=12 kN/m、有效管床寬b=0.60 m，平均接觸壓q=w/b=20 kPa，假設接觸連續。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume downward line load w=12 kN/m and effective bedding width b=0.60 m. Mean contact pressure q=w/b=20 kPa, assuming continuous contact. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對管床材料、厚度及接觸範圍，將壓實檢測位置與管側回填層位連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check bedding material, thickness and contact extent, linking compaction-test locations to sidefill lifts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每米向下荷載w=12 kN/m、有效管床寬b=0.60 m，平均接觸壓q=w/b=20 kPa，假設接觸連續。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume downward line load w=12 kN/m and effective bedding width b=0.60 m. Mean contact pressure q=w/b=20 kPa, assuming continuous contact.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每米向下荷載w=12 kN/m、有效管床寬b=0.60 m，平均接觸壓q=w/b=20 kPa，假設接觸連續。
看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。
optionsEn: More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume downward line load w=12 kN/m and effective bedding width b=0.60 m.
No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每米向下荷載w=12 kN/m、有效管床寬b=0.60 m，平均接觸壓q=w/b=20 kPa，假設接觸連續。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume downward line load w=12 kN/m and effective bedding width b=0.60 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管床接觸與土管互制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對管床材料、厚度及接觸範圍，將壓實檢測位置與管側回填層位連結。安裝後追蹤管環變形和接頭高差，以不同位置的資料辨識硬點、空隙及回填不均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check bedding material, thickness and contact extent, linking compaction-test locations to sidefill lifts. After installation, track ring deformation and joint level differences, using spatially distributed observations to distinguish hard points, voids and uneven backfill. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出連續管床與中段懸空兩種受力路徑，指出平均壓力公式忽略的彎曲。為每種管材列出對應的變形及回填驗證資料，不用同一指標涵蓋全部失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw load paths for continuous bedding and a central void, identifying bending omitted by the average-pressure formula. List deformation and backfill evidence appropriate to each pipe material instead of using one indicator for every failure mode.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名目床寬足夠但管底懸空時，少數接觸點會集中受力並增加彎曲；柔性管側填不足也可能造成橢圓化，而平均向下承壓仍看似很低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With voids beneath the pipe, nominally adequate bedding width leaves a few contacts carrying concentrated load and bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對管床材料、厚度及接觸範圍，將壓實檢測位置與管側回填層位連結。安裝後追蹤管環變形和接頭高差，以不同位置的資料辨識硬點、空隙及回填不均。
knowledge.textEn: Check bedding material, thickness and contact extent, linking compaction-test locations to sidefill lifts. After installation, track ring deformation and joint level differences, using spatially distributed observations to distinguish hard points, voids and uneven backfill.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出連續管床與中段懸空兩種受力路徑，指出平均壓力公式忽略的彎曲。為每種管材列出對應的變形及回填驗證資料，不用同一指標涵蓋全部失效。
knowledge.textEn: Draw load paths for continuous bedding and a central void, identifying bending omitted by the average-pressure formula. List deformation and backfill evidence appropriate to each pipe material instead of using one indicator for every failure mode.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
達到理論充水體積就能直接證明整條管線可交付使用。
核對管床材料、厚度及接觸範圍，將壓實檢測位置與管側回填層位連結。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Reaching theoretical filling volume proves the entire main is ready for service.
Check bedding material, thickness and contact extent, linking compaction-test locations to sidefill lifts.
quiz.explanation: 核對管床材料、厚度及接觸範圍，將壓實檢測位置與管側回填層位連結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check bedding material, thickness and contact extent, linking compaction-test locations to sidefill lifts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管床接觸與土管互制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名目床寬足夠但管底懸空時，少數接觸點會集中受力並增加彎曲；柔性管側填不足也可能造成橢圓化，而平均向下承壓仍看似很低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With voids beneath the pipe, nominally adequate bedding width leaves a few contacts carrying concentrated load and bending. Inadequate sidefill can also ovalize flexible pipe while the average downward bearing pressure remains apparently small. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線荷載除以接觸寬度只得到假設平均壓力，沒有包含土拱效應、側向回填剛度或管殼彎曲，不能當成管材強度驗算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It omits soil arching, sidefill stiffness and shell bending and cannot verify pipe structural capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均管床承壓很低就能證明管環完全不會變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名目床寬足夠但管底懸空時，少數接觸點會集中受力並增加彎曲；柔性管側填不足也可能造成橢圓化，而平均向下承壓仍看似很低。
knowledge.textEn: With voids beneath the pipe, nominally adequate bedding width leaves a few contacts carrying concentrated load and bending. Inadequate sidefill can also ovalize flexible pipe while the average downward bearing pressure remains apparently small.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管床接觸與土管互制機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bedding contact and soil-pipe interaction mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 名目床寬足夠但管底懸空時，少數接觸點會集中受力並增加彎曲；柔性管側填不足也可能造成橢圓化，而平均向下承壓仍看似很低。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。
optionsEn: With voids beneath the pipe, nominally adequate bedding width leaves a few contacts carrying concentrated load and bending.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each.
quiz.explanation: 名目床寬足夠但管底懸空時，少數接觸點會集中受力並增加彎曲；柔性管側填不足也可能造成橢圓化，而平均向下承壓仍看似很低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With voids beneath the pipe, nominally adequate bedding width leaves a few contacts carrying concentrated load and bending. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift geometry and temporary shell loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型管節吊裝時的支承狀態不同於埋設完成後，吊帶角度會改變索力，吊點間距則影響管身彎曲與局部橢圓化。對稱兩腿吊索的靜力分配只是一個理想比較，真實吊點高差、重心偏移、吊具柔度及動態作用都會破壞等分假設，須由完整吊裝計畫處理。算例中的角度由鉛直方向量起，只求兩腿對稱靜力；不包含動態放大、吊點容量、管殼局部接觸或起重機穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A large pipe section has different support conditions during lifting than after burial. Sling angle changes tension, while pick-point spacing affects longitudinal bending and local ovalization. Symmetric two-leg statics is only an ideal comparison: unequal pick elevations, center-of-mass offset, rigging compliance and dynamic effects disturb equal sharing and require a complete engineered lifting plan. The angle is measured from vertical and the example covers symmetric two-leg statics only. Dynamic amplification, pick capacity, shell contact and crane stability are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lift geometry and temporary shell loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設管節重量W=100 kN、每腿與鉛直夾角θ=30°，T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN；不是吊具額定容量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pipe weight W=100 kN and each leg at θ=30° from vertical.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lift geometry and temporary shell loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 大型管節吊裝時的支承狀態不同於埋設完成後，吊帶角度會改變索力，吊點間距則影響管身彎曲與局部橢圓化。對稱兩腿吊索的靜力分配只是一個理想比較，真實吊點高差、重心偏移、吊具柔度及動態作用都會破壞等分假設，須由完整吊裝計畫處理。
knowledge.textEn: A large pipe section has different support conditions during lifting than after burial. Sling angle changes tension, while pick-point spacing affects longitudinal bending and local ovalization.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。
大型管節吊裝時的支承狀態不同於埋設完成後，吊帶角度會改變索力，吊點間距則影響管身彎曲與局部橢圓化。
試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。
optionsEn: Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each.
A large pipe section has different support conditions during lifting than after burial.
A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist.
quiz.explanation: 大型管節吊裝時的支承狀態不同於埋設完成後，吊帶角度會改變索力，吊點間距則影響管身彎曲與局部橢圓化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A large pipe section has different support conditions during lifting than after burial. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift geometry and temporary shell loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設管節重量W=100 kN、每腿與鉛直夾角θ=30°，T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN；不是吊具額定容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pipe weight W=100 kN and each leg at θ=30° from vertical. T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN, not a rigging capacity rating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對實際重量、重心及吊點圖，確認角度定義與量測一致，再檢查管節製造商對臨時支承的要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify actual weight, center of mass and pick-point drawings, ensuring consistent angle definitions and checking the pipe manufacturer’s temporary-support requirements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設管節重量W=100 kN、每腿與鉛直夾角θ=30°，T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN；不是吊具額定容量。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pipe weight W=100 kN and each leg at θ=30° from vertical. T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN, not a rigging capacity rating.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。
試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設管節重量W=100 kN、每腿與鉛直夾角θ=30°，T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN；不是吊具額定容量。
optionsEn: One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint.
All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pipe weight W=100 kN and each leg at θ=30° from vertical.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設管節重量W=100 kN、每腿與鉛直夾角θ=30°，T=W/(2cosθ)=57.74 kN；不是吊具額定容量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pipe weight W=100 kN and each leg at θ=30° from vertical. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift geometry and temporary shell loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對實際重量、重心及吊點圖，確認角度定義與量測一致，再檢查管節製造商對臨時支承的要求。由負責吊裝工程師檢核整體方案，保留吊具證明與管殼變形觀察紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify actual weight, center of mass and pick-point drawings, ensuring consistent angle definitions and checking the pipe manufacturer’s temporary-support requirements. The responsible lifting engineer evaluates the complete arrangement, retaining rigging documentation and observations of shell deformation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較同一重量下三十度與六十度鉛直夾角的索力，標出水平分力。再列出靜力算例沒有檢查的吊點及管殼問題，避免把算式當成現場吊裝指令。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare tensions at thirty and sixty degrees from vertical for the same weight and mark horizontal components. List pick-point and shell issues omitted by the static example so the calculation is not mistaken for a field lifting instruction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把相對水平的角度誤當相對鉛直，計算索力可能嚴重偏低；吊點局部壓扁也可能損傷襯層，即使吊索本身沒有超過額定荷載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing an angle from horizontal with one from vertical can greatly understate sling tension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對實際重量、重心及吊點圖，確認角度定義與量測一致，再檢查管節製造商對臨時支承的要求。由負責吊裝工程師檢核整體方案，保留吊具證明與管殼變形觀察紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Verify actual weight, center of mass and pick-point drawings, ensuring consistent angle definitions and checking the pipe manufacturer’s temporary-support requirements. The responsible lifting engineer evaluates the complete arrangement, retaining rigging documentation and observations of shell deformation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較同一重量下三十度與六十度鉛直夾角的索力，標出水平分力。再列出靜力算例沒有檢查的吊點及管殼問題，避免把算式當成現場吊裝指令。
knowledge.textEn: Compare tensions at thirty and sixty degrees from vertical for the same weight and mark horizontal components. List pick-point and shell issues omitted by the static example so the calculation is not mistaken for a field lifting instruction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對實際重量、重心及吊點圖，確認角度定義與量測一致，再檢查管節製造商對臨時支承的要求。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。
optionsEn: Verify actual weight, center of mass and pick-point drawings, ensuring consistent angle definitions and checking the pipe manufacturer’s temporary-support requirements.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them.
quiz.explanation: 核對實際重量、重心及吊點圖，確認角度定義與量測一致，再檢查管節製造商對臨時支承的要求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify actual weight, center of mass and pick-point drawings, ensuring consistent angle definitions and checking the pipe manufacturer’s temporary-support requirements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift geometry and temporary shell loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把相對水平的角度誤當相對鉛直，計算索力可能嚴重偏低；吊點局部壓扁也可能損傷襯層，即使吊索本身沒有超過額定荷載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing an angle from horizontal with one from vertical can greatly understate sling tension. Local flattening at a pick can damage the lining even when the sling itself remains below its rated load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：算例中的角度由鉛直方向量起，只求兩腿對稱靜力；不包含動態放大、吊點容量、管殼局部接觸或起重機穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dynamic amplification, pick capacity, shell contact and crane stability are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把相對水平的角度誤當相對鉛直，計算索力可能嚴重偏低；吊點局部壓扁也可能損傷襯層，即使吊索本身沒有超過額定荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing an angle from horizontal with one from vertical can greatly understate sling tension. Local flattening at a pick can damage the lining even when the sling itself remains below its rated load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊點幾何與臨時管殼受力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift geometry and temporary shell loading mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若把相對水平的角度誤當相對鉛直，計算索力可能嚴重偏低；吊點局部壓扁也可能損傷襯層，即使吊索本身沒有超過額定荷載。
試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing an angle from horizontal with one from vertical can greatly understate sling tension.
A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist.
quiz.explanation: 若把相對水平的角度誤當相對鉛直，計算索力可能嚴重偏低；吊點局部壓扁也可能損傷襯層，即使吊索本身沒有超過額定荷載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing an angle from horizontal with one from vertical can greatly understate sling tension. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證」與「彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification" and "Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「焊接管殼與試壓應力」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Welded shells and test-pressure stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內壓在圓形管殼形成環向膜力，薄壁估式可顯示直徑、壁厚與壓力的相互關係。施工焊縫卻可能有幾何不連續、殘餘應力與局部缺陷，襯層也不一定參與承載；因此材料強度、接頭品質與試壓結果是不同證據，不能只看一次無漏水便宣稱所有焊接細節合格。此式適用名目薄壁膜應力，不含焊接效率、腐蝕裕度或局部應力集中；假設壓力只供計算，不代表規範試壓要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「焊接管殼與試壓應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal pressure creates hoop membrane force in a circular shell, and a thin-wall estimate shows how diameter, thickness and pressure interact. Field welds can introduce geometric discontinuity, residual stress and local defects, while a lining may not carry structural load. Material strength, joint quality and pressure-test results are different evidence, so one leak-free test cannot certify every welded detail. The equation estimates nominal thin-wall membrane stress, excluding weld efficiency, corrosion allowance and local concentrations. The assumed pressure is a calculation input, not a prescribed test requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Welded shells and test-pressure stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=1.50 MPa、管徑D=1.20 m、壁厚t=0.012 m，σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa，僅為名目環應力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=1.50 MPa, diameter D=1.20 m and thickness t=0.012 m. σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa is nominal hoop stress only.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「焊接管殼與試壓應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Welded shells and test-pressure stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 內壓在圓形管殼形成環向膜力，薄壁估式可顯示直徑、壁厚與壓力的相互關係。施工焊縫卻可能有幾何不連續、殘餘應力與局部缺陷，襯層也不一定參與承載；因此材料強度、接頭品質與試壓結果是不同證據，不能只看一次無漏水便宣稱所有焊接細節合格。
knowledge.textEn: Internal pressure creates hoop membrane force in a circular shell, and a thin-wall estimate shows how diameter, thickness and pressure interact. Field welds can introduce geometric discontinuity, residual stress and local defects, while a lining may not carry structural load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。
錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。
內壓在圓形管殼形成環向膜力，薄壁估式可顯示直徑、壁厚與壓力的相互關係。
optionsEn: A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist.
More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction.
Internal pressure creates hoop membrane force in a circular shell, and a thin-wall estimate shows how diameter, thickness and pressure interact.
quiz.explanation: 內壓在圓形管殼形成環向膜力，薄壁估式可顯示直徑、壁厚與壓力的相互關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal pressure creates hoop membrane force in a circular shell, and a thin-wall estimate shows how diameter, thickness and pressure interact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊接管殼與試壓應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Welded shells and test-pressure stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=1.50 MPa、管徑D=1.20 m、壁厚t=0.012 m，σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa，僅為名目環應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=1.50 MPa, diameter D=1.20 m and thickness t=0.012 m. σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa is nominal hoop stress only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將材料批號、焊接程序、焊工資格及非破壞檢測位置連到每一接頭，確認壁厚量測涵蓋局部減薄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link material batches, welding procedures, welder qualifications and nondestructive examination locations to each joint, checking local thinning coverage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=1.50 MPa、管徑D=1.20 m、壁厚t=0.012 m，σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa，僅為名目環應力。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=1.50 MPa, diameter D=1.20 m and thickness t=0.012 m. σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa is nominal hoop stress only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=1.50 MPa、管徑D=1.20 m、壁厚t=0.012 m，σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa，僅為名目環應力。
看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。
達到理論充水體積就能直接證明整條管線可交付使用。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=1.50 MPa, diameter D=1.20 m and thickness t=0.012 m. σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa is nominal hoop stress only.
No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action.
Reaching theoretical filling volume proves the entire main is ready for service.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=1.50 MPa、管徑D=1.20 m、壁厚t=0.012 m，σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa，僅為名目環應力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=1.50 MPa, diameter D=1.20 m and thickness t=0.012 m. σθ=pD/(2t)=75.0 MPa is nominal hoop stress only. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊接管殼與試壓應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Welded shells and test-pressure stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將材料批號、焊接程序、焊工資格及非破壞檢測位置連到每一接頭，確認壁厚量測涵蓋局部減薄。試壓紀錄另外保存溫度、壓力基準及隔離範圍，讓漏水與結構品質可分別追溯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link material batches, welding procedures, welder qualifications and nondestructive examination locations to each joint, checking local thinning coverage. Separately retain temperature, pressure datum and isolation limits in test records so leakage and structural quality remain independently traceable. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把同一接頭的材料、尺寸、焊接及試壓資料整理成證據鏈，指出每項檢查能排除與不能排除的缺陷。再比較局部壁厚降低時的名目應力變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assemble material, dimension, weld and pressure-test evidence for one joint, stating defects each check can and cannot exclude. Then compare nominal stress after a local reduction in thickness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以名目壁厚估應力會漏掉施工損傷或局部減薄，未檢出的焊接缺陷又可能在後續循環載重擴展；一次試壓通過不能消除這些長期機制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominal thickness can miss construction damage or local thinning, while undetected weld defects can grow under later cyclic loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將材料批號、焊接程序、焊工資格及非破壞檢測位置連到每一接頭，確認壁厚量測涵蓋局部減薄。試壓紀錄另外保存溫度、壓力基準及隔離範圍，讓漏水與結構品質可分別追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Link material batches, welding procedures, welder qualifications and nondestructive examination locations to each joint, checking local thinning coverage. Separately retain temperature, pressure datum and isolation limits in test records so leakage and structural quality remain independently traceable.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把同一接頭的材料、尺寸、焊接及試壓資料整理成證據鏈，指出每項檢查能排除與不能排除的缺陷。再比較局部壁厚降低時的名目應力變化。
knowledge.textEn: Assemble material, dimension, weld and pressure-test evidence for one joint, stating defects each check can and cannot exclude. Then compare nominal stress after a local reduction in thickness.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將材料批號、焊接程序、焊工資格及非破壞檢測位置連到每一接頭，確認壁厚量測涵蓋局部減薄。
土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Link material batches, welding procedures, welder qualifications and nondestructive examination locations to each joint, checking local thinning coverage.
Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly.
quiz.explanation: 將材料批號、焊接程序、焊工資格及非破壞檢測位置連到每一接頭，確認壁厚量測涵蓋局部減薄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link material batches, welding procedures, welder qualifications and nondestructive examination locations to each joint, checking local thinning coverage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊接管殼與試壓應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Welded shells and test-pressure stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以名目壁厚估應力會漏掉施工損傷或局部減薄，未檢出的焊接缺陷又可能在後續循環載重擴展；一次試壓通過不能消除這些長期機制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal thickness can miss construction damage or local thinning, while undetected weld defects can grow under later cyclic loading. Passing one pressure test does not eliminate these longer-term deterioration mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式適用名目薄壁膜應力，不含焊接效率、腐蝕裕度或局部應力集中；假設壓力只供計算，不代表規範試壓要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The assumed pressure is a calculation input, not a prescribed test requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以名目壁厚估應力會漏掉施工損傷或局部減薄，未檢出的焊接缺陷又可能在後續循環載重擴展；一次試壓通過不能消除這些長期機制。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal thickness can miss construction damage or local thinning, while undetected weld defects can grow under later cyclic loading. Passing one pressure test does not eliminate these longer-term deterioration mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焊接管殼與試壓應力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Welded shells and test-pressure stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。
只以名目壁厚估應力會漏掉施工損傷或局部減薄，未檢出的焊接缺陷又可能在後續循環載重擴展；一次試壓通過不能消除這些長期機制。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction.
Nominal thickness can miss construction damage or local thinning, while undetected weld defects can grow under later cyclic loading.
quiz.explanation: 只以名目壁厚估應力會漏掉施工損傷或局部減薄，未檢出的焊接缺陷又可能在後續循環載重擴展；一次試壓通過不能消除這些長期機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal thickness can miss construction damage or local thinning, while undetected weld defects can grow under later cyclic loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彎管推力與錨定傳力」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bend thrust and anchorage load path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 彎管改變流向，內壓在兩端截面產生不同方向的作用，合力必須經約束接頭、錨定或其他核定構件傳入地層。推力方向由向量平衡決定，不能只把壓力乘單一截面就當全部合力；土體可提供的反力還受開挖擾動、接觸面積與地下水影響。此例為等徑彎管的靜壓合力，忽略動量通量及瞬變；計算得到的是需求，尚未檢核任何錨塊或土體抗力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彎管推力與錨定傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bend redirects flow, so pressure forces on its end sections act in different directions and require a load path through restrained joints, anchors or other approved components into the ground. Vector equilibrium determines resultant direction; pressure times one section is not the complete bend force. Available ground reaction also depends on excavation disturbance, contact area and groundwater. This example gives static pressure thrust for an equal-diameter bend, omitting momentum flux and transients. The result is demand; no anchor-block or soil resistance has been checked. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bend thrust and anchorage load path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=0.80 MPa、D=1.20 m、轉向角θ=90°，A=πD²/4=1.131 m²；F=2pA sin(θ/2)=1.280 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=0.80 MPa, D=1.20 m and deflection θ=90°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彎管推力與錨定傳力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bend thrust and anchorage load path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 彎管改變流向，內壓在兩端截面產生不同方向的作用，合力必須經約束接頭、錨定或其他核定構件傳入地層。推力方向由向量平衡決定，不能只把壓力乘單一截面就當全部合力；土體可提供的反力還受開挖擾動、接觸面積與地下水影響。
knowledge.textEn: A bend redirects flow, so pressure forces on its end sections act in different directions and require a load path through restrained joints, anchors or other approved components into the ground. Vector equilibrium determines resultant direction; pressure times one section is not the complete bend force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 彎管改變流向，內壓在兩端截面產生不同方向的作用，合力必須經約束接頭、錨定或其他核定構件傳入地層。
錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。
單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。
optionsEn: A bend redirects flow, so pressure forces on its end sections act in different directions and require a load path through restrained joints, anchors or other approved components into the ground.
More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction.
One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint.
quiz.explanation: 彎管改變流向，內壓在兩端截面產生不同方向的作用，合力必須經約束接頭、錨定或其他核定構件傳入地層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A bend redirects flow, so pressure forces on its end sections act in different directions and require a load path through restrained joints, anchors or other approved components into the ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彎管推力與錨定傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bend thrust and anchorage load path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=0.80 MPa、D=1.20 m、轉向角θ=90°，A=πD²/4=1.131 m²；F=2pA sin(θ/2)=1.280 MN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=0.80 MPa, D=1.20 m and deflection θ=90°. A=πD²/4=1.131 m² and F=2pA sin(θ/2)=1.280 MN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出彎管兩端壓力向量與錨定反力，核對接頭是否真的具備縱向約束。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw pressure vectors and anchorage reaction, verifying that joints actually provide axial restraint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=0.80 MPa、D=1.20 m、轉向角θ=90°，A=πD²/4=1.131 m²；F=2pA sin(θ/2)=1.280 MN。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=0.80 MPa, D=1.20 m and deflection θ=90°. A=πD²/4=1.131 m² and F=2pA sin(θ/2)=1.280 MN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=0.80 MPa、D=1.20 m、轉向角θ=90°，A=πD²/4=1.131 m²。
管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。
optionsEn: All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=0.80 MPa, D=1.20 m and deflection θ=90°.
Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設p=0.80 MPa、D=1.20 m、轉向角θ=90°，A=πD²/4=1.131 m²；F=2pA sin(θ/2)=1.280 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume p=0.80 MPa, D=1.20 m and deflection θ=90°. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彎管推力與錨定傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bend thrust and anchorage load path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出彎管兩端壓力向量與錨定反力，核對接頭是否真的具備縱向約束。查驗錨定接觸地層與回填狀態，並將正常、試壓及瞬變作用分開組合，避免只以常態壓力驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw pressure vectors and anchorage reaction, verifying that joints actually provide axial restraint. Check the ground contact and backfill condition at the anchorage and distinguish normal, test and transient loading combinations rather than validating against normal pressure alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以相同壓力比較直管端封與九十度彎管的力向量，標示地層反力位置。把需求計算與抗力證據分成兩欄，列出地下水或開挖狀態改變後需重核的項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare force vectors for a closed straight-pipe end and a ninety-degree bend at the same pressure, marking ground reactions. Separate demand calculations from resistance evidence and list checks that change with groundwater or excavation conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把普通可轉動接頭當成抗拉約束會中斷推力傳遞，彎管可能位移並拉開相鄰接頭；錨塊體積很大也不能補救其背後鬆散或懸空的地層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating an ordinary flexible joint as tensile restraint interrupts the thrust path, allowing bend movement and opening nearby joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Draw pressure vectors and anchorage reaction, verifying that joints actually provide axial restraint. Check the ground contact and backfill condition at the anchorage and distinguish normal, test and transient loading combinations rather than validating against normal pressure alone.

knowledge.text: 以相同壓力比較直管端封與九十度彎管的力向量，標示地層反力位置。把需求計算與抗力證據分成兩欄，列出地下水或開挖狀態改變後需重核的項目。
knowledge.textEn: Compare force vectors for a closed straight-pipe end and a ninety-degree bend at the same pressure, marking ground reactions. Separate demand calculations from resistance evidence and list checks that change with groundwater or excavation conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
平均管床承壓很低就能證明管環完全不會變形。
畫出彎管兩端壓力向量與錨定反力，核對接頭是否真的具備縱向約束。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Low average bedding pressure proves that the pipe ring cannot deform.
Draw pressure vectors and anchorage reaction, verifying that joints actually provide axial restraint.
quiz.explanation: 畫出彎管兩端壓力向量與錨定反力，核對接頭是否真的具備縱向約束。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw pressure vectors and anchorage reaction, verifying that joints actually provide axial restraint. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彎管推力與錨定傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bend thrust and anchorage load path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把普通可轉動接頭當成抗拉約束會中斷推力傳遞，彎管可能位移並拉開相鄰接頭；錨塊體積很大也不能補救其背後鬆散或懸空的地層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating an ordinary flexible joint as tensile restraint interrupts the thrust path, allowing bend movement and opening nearby joints. A large anchor block cannot compensate for loose or unsupported ground behind it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此例為等徑彎管的靜壓合力，忽略動量通量及瞬變；計算得到的是需求，尚未檢核任何錨塊或土體抗力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The result is demand; no anchor-block or soil resistance has been checked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨塊混凝土越多就一定能承受任何方向的彎管推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More anchor-block concrete guarantees resistance to bend thrust in any direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把普通可轉動接頭當成抗拉約束會中斷推力傳遞，彎管可能位移並拉開相鄰接頭；錨塊體積很大也不能補救其背後鬆散或懸空的地層。
knowledge.textEn: Treating an ordinary flexible joint as tensile restraint interrupts the thrust path, allowing bend movement and opening nearby joints. A large anchor block cannot compensate for loose or unsupported ground behind it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「彎管推力與錨定傳力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bend thrust and anchorage load path mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把普通可轉動接頭當成抗拉約束會中斷推力傳遞，彎管可能位移並拉開相鄰接頭；錨塊體積很大也不能補救其背後鬆散或懸空的地層。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。
optionsEn: Treating an ordinary flexible joint as tensile restraint interrupts the thrust path, allowing bend movement and opening nearby joints.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint.
quiz.explanation: 把普通可轉動接頭當成抗拉約束會中斷推力傳遞，彎管可能位移並拉開相鄰接頭；錨塊體積很大也不能補救其背後鬆散或懸空的地層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating an ordinary flexible joint as tensile restraint interrupts the thrust path, allowing bend movement and opening nearby joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」與「溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification" and "Thermal movement and restraint mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and joint rotation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管線跨越軟硬地層或結構基礎時，差異沉陷可能集中在少數接頭而非均勻分散。單一管節端點高差只能給出該節弦傾角，真正接頭相對轉角需比較兩側方向；密封需求還包含軸向拔出與剪位移，不能把名目允許角度當成所有位移的共同容量。算例假設管節剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才把單節傾角當相對轉角；忽略管身彎曲和接頭壓縮曲線，不證明水密。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At transitions between soft and stiff ground or structural foundations, differential settlement can concentrate at a few joints. End-level difference gives one pipe section’s chord inclination, whereas relative joint rotation requires both adjacent orientations. Seal demand also includes axial withdrawal and shear, so a nominal angular allowance cannot represent capacity for every combined displacement. Only the assumed rigid section beside a horizontal neighbor makes its chord inclination equal relative rotation. Pipe bending and joint compression curves are omitted, and water tightness is not established. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and joint rotation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設端點差Δs=20 mm、節長L=12 m，θ≈0.020/12=0.001667 rad；D=1.20 m時兩側開度差Dθ=2.0 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume end difference Δs=20 mm and section length L=12 m: θ≈0.020/12=0.001667 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and joint rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 管線跨越軟硬地層或結構基礎時，差異沉陷可能集中在少數接頭而非均勻分散。單一管節端點高差只能給出該節弦傾角，真正接頭相對轉角需比較兩側方向；密封需求還包含軸向拔出與剪位移，不能把名目允許角度當成所有位移的共同容量。
knowledge.textEn: At transitions between soft and stiff ground or structural foundations, differential settlement can concentrate at a few joints. End-level difference gives one pipe section’s chord inclination, whereas relative joint rotation requires both adjacent orientations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。
管線跨越軟硬地層或結構基礎時，差異沉陷可能集中在少數接頭而非均勻分散。
看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。
optionsEn: One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint.
At transitions between soft and stiff ground or structural foundations, differential settlement can concentrate at a few joints.
No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action.
quiz.explanation: 管線跨越軟硬地層或結構基礎時，差異沉陷可能集中在少數接頭而非均勻分散。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At transitions between soft and stiff ground or structural foundations, differential settlement can concentrate at a few joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設端點差Δs=20 mm、節長L=12 m，θ≈0.020/12=0.001667 rad；D=1.20 m時兩側開度差Dθ=2.0 mm。

土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and joint rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在接頭兩側各設高程與方向基準，將管節傾角、軸向位置及密封區觀察對齊。比較施工後與回填後資料，查明變形來自整體傾斜、局部彎曲或接頭集中位移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish level and orientation references on both sides of each joint, aligning section inclination, axial position and seal observations. Compare post-installation and post-backfill records to distinguish rigid tilt, local bending and concentrated joint displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩側同向與反向轉動的接頭示意，分別計算相對角度。將幾何需求交給特定接頭的試驗曲線比較，並保留軸向拔出及剪位移的獨立檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw joints with adjacent sections rotating together and in opposite directions, calculating relative angle separately. Compare geometric demand with the specific joint’s test curves while retaining independent checks for withdrawal and shear.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩側管節共同傾斜卻被當成相對轉角時會高估密封需求；只量其中一側又可能漏掉方向相反的轉動，反而低估接頭邊緣開口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting common tilt of both sections as relative rotation overstates seal demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Establish level and orientation references on both sides of each joint, aligning section inclination, axial position and seal observations. Compare post-installation and post-backfill records to distinguish rigid tilt, local bending and concentrated joint displacement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側同向與反向轉動的接頭示意，分別計算相對角度。將幾何需求交給特定接頭的試驗曲線比較，並保留軸向拔出及剪位移的獨立檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Draw joints with adjacent sections rotating together and in opposite directions, calculating relative angle separately. Compare geometric demand with the specific joint’s test curves while retaining independent checks for withdrawal and shear.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification"?
options: 在接頭兩側各設高程與方向基準，將管節傾角、軸向位置及密封區觀察對齊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。
optionsEn: Establish level and orientation references on both sides of each joint, aligning section inclination, axial position and seal observations.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each.
quiz.explanation: 在接頭兩側各設高程與方向基準，將管節傾角、軸向位置及密封區觀察對齊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish level and orientation references on both sides of each joint, aligning section inclination, axial position and seal observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and joint rotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩側管節共同傾斜卻被當成相對轉角時會高估密封需求；只量其中一側又可能漏掉方向相反的轉動，反而低估接頭邊緣開口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting common tilt of both sections as relative rotation overstates seal demand. Measuring only one side can instead miss opposing rotations and understate opening at the joint edge. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：算例假設管節剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才把單節傾角當相對轉角；忽略管身彎曲和接頭壓縮曲線，不證明水密。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pipe bending and joint compression curves are omitted, and water tightness is not established.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩側管節共同傾斜卻被當成相對轉角時會高估密封需求；只量其中一側又可能漏掉方向相反的轉動，反而低估接頭邊緣開口。
knowledge.textEn: Interpreting common tilt of both sections as relative rotation overstates seal demand. Measuring only one side can instead miss opposing rotations and understate opening at the joint edge.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
兩側管節共同傾斜卻被當成相對轉角時會高估密封需求；只量其中一側又可能漏掉方向相反的轉動，反而低估接頭邊緣開口。
看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Interpreting common tilt of both sections as relative rotation overstates seal demand.
No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action.
quiz.explanation: 兩側管節共同傾斜卻被當成相對轉角時會高估密封需求；只量其中一側又可能漏掉方向相反的轉動，反而低估接頭邊緣開口。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpreting common tilt of both sections as relative rotation overstates seal demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and restraint mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度伸縮與支承約束」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal movement and restraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼管在暴露施工、回填與通水階段會經歷不同溫度，固定點與可滑動支承決定熱伸縮如何分配。自由伸長和完全約束熱應力是兩種相反邊界，實際系統可能兼有接頭滑移、地層摩阻及局部錨定；必須先辨識約束，才能決定把變化當位移或當力。下式先計自由伸長，不可把這個位移同時強加到完全固定模型；實際熱應力需另建相容與受力條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度伸縮與支承約束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel pipe experiences different temperatures during exposed construction, burial and commissioning. Fixed points and sliding supports determine how thermal movement distributes. Free expansion and fully restrained thermal stress are opposite boundary cases, while actual systems combine joint slip, ground friction and local anchors. Restraint must be identified before treating thermal change as displacement or force. The calculation first gives free expansion. That movement cannot simultaneously be imposed on a fully fixed model; actual thermal stress needs separate compatibility and equilibrium conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal movement and restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設鋼α=12×10⁻⁶/K、L=100 m、升溫ΔT=25 K，自由伸長ΔL=αLΔT=0.030 m=30 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steel α=12×10⁻⁶/K, L=100 m and temperature rise ΔT=25 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度伸縮與支承約束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal movement and restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。

All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks.
