steps.title: 溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and restraint mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度伸縮與支承約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal movement and restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對安裝時溫度、固定點與滑動支座位置，將接頭初始間隙和後續溫度紀錄一起保存。量測位移若集中在意料外位置，先檢查支座卡滯與回填摩阻，再修正熱模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check installation temperature and locations of fixed and sliding supports, retaining initial joint gaps with later temperature records across multiple observed temperatures. If movement concentrates unexpectedly, investigate seized supports and backfill friction before revising the thermal model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以同一溫差分別畫出自由與完全約束兩個理想模型，說明哪個輸出是位移、哪個是應力。再加入一個卡滯支座，討論需要新增哪些位移與荷載量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw free and fully restrained idealizations for one temperature change, identifying displacement and stress outputs. Add a seized support and discuss the additional movement and load measurements needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：原本設計可滑動的支座被雜物或施工偏差卡住時，熱位移會轉成額外軸力；只看管線總長變化不大，可能漏掉局部錨定與焊縫的應力增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris or misalignment can seize a support intended to slide, turning thermal movement into additional axial force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對安裝時溫度、固定點與滑動支座位置，將接頭初始間隙和後續溫度紀錄一起保存。量測位移若集中在意料外位置，先檢查支座卡滯與回填摩阻，再修正熱模型。
knowledge.textEn: Check installation temperature and locations of fixed and sliding supports, retaining initial joint gaps with later temperature records across multiple observed temperatures. If movement concentrates unexpectedly, investigate seized supports and backfill friction before revising the thermal model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以同一溫差分別畫出自由與完全約束兩個理想模型，說明哪個輸出是位移、哪個是應力。再加入一個卡滯支座，討論需要新增哪些位移與荷載量測。
knowledge.textEn: Draw free and fully restrained idealizations for one temperature change, identifying displacement and stress outputs. Add a seized support and discuss the additional movement and load measurements needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal movement and restraint mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對安裝時溫度、固定點與滑動支座位置，將接頭初始間隙和後續溫度紀錄一起保存。
試壓沒有漏水就代表焊縫不存在任何結構缺陷。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check installation temperature and locations of fixed and sliding supports, retaining initial joint gaps with later temperature records across multiple observed temperatures.
A leak-free pressure test proves that no structural weld defects exist.
quiz.explanation: 核對安裝時溫度、固定點與滑動支座位置，將接頭初始間隙和後續溫度紀錄一起保存。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check installation temperature and locations of fixed and sliding supports, retaining initial joint gaps with later temperature records across multiple observed temperatures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and restraint mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫度伸縮與支承約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal movement and restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 原本設計可滑動的支座被雜物或施工偏差卡住時，熱位移會轉成額外軸力；只看管線總長變化不大，可能漏掉局部錨定與焊縫的應力增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Debris or misalignment can seize a support intended to slide, turning thermal movement into additional axial force. Small overall length change can therefore conceal increased stress at local anchors and welds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式先計自由伸長，不可把這個位移同時強加到完全固定模型；實際熱應力需另建相容與受力條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That movement cannot simultaneously be imposed on a fully fixed model; actual thermal stress needs separate compatibility and equilibrium conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「看不到管線伸長就表示溫度完全不會造成結構作用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible pipe expansion means temperature causes no structural action." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 原本設計可滑動的支座被雜物或施工偏差卡住時，熱位移會轉成額外軸力；只看管線總長變化不大，可能漏掉局部錨定與焊縫的應力增加。
knowledge.textEn: Debris or misalignment can seize a support intended to slide, turning thermal movement into additional axial force. Small overall length change can therefore conceal increased stress at local anchors and welds.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度伸縮與支承約束機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal movement and restraint mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。
原本設計可滑動的支座被雜物或施工偏差卡住時，熱位移會轉成額外軸力；只看管線總長變化不大，可能漏掉局部錨定與焊縫的應力增加。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks.
Debris or misalignment can seize a support intended to slide, turning thermal movement into additional axial force.
quiz.explanation: 原本設計可滑動的支座被雜物或施工偏差卡住時，熱位移會轉成額外軸力；只看管線總長變化不大，可能漏掉局部錨定與焊縫的應力增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Debris or misalignment can seize a support intended to slide, turning thermal movement into additional axial force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證」與「通水體積與分段交接機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification" and "Filling volume and staged handover mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試壓儲水與漏失判讀」如何影響大口徑輸水管施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 試壓過程的補水量會同時包含水體壓縮、管壁膨脹、氣體壓縮及真正外漏，因此不能把全部補水量都當成漏失。溫度變化也可改變壓力，殘留空氣會使系統儲能與量測反應更複雜；隔離邊界與穩定條件需在試驗前明確建立，壓力曲線須與體積帳共同判讀。本算例只描述水的可壓縮部分，忽略管壁及氣體；它不是完整試壓補水量預測，更不是允許漏水標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試壓儲水與漏失判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Make-up volume during a pressure test includes liquid compression, wall expansion, gas compression and actual leakage, so it cannot all be classified as loss. Temperature also changes pressure, and trapped air complicates stored energy and measured response. Isolation boundaries and stabilization conditions need explicit definition, with pressure history interpreted alongside the volume balance. The example isolates liquid compressibility, excluding wall expansion and gas. It is neither a complete make-up-volume prediction nor an allowable leakage criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水體V=100 m³、體積模數K=2.2 GPa、壓升Δp=1.0 MPa，壓縮體積ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water volume V=100 m³, bulk modulus K=2.2 GPa and rise Δp=1.0 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試壓儲水與漏失判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 試壓過程的補水量會同時包含水體壓縮、管壁膨脹、氣體壓縮及真正外漏，因此不能把全部補水量都當成漏失。溫度變化也可改變壓力，殘留空氣會使系統儲能與量測反應更複雜；隔離邊界與穩定條件需在試驗前明確建立，壓力曲線須與體積帳共同判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Make-up volume during a pressure test includes liquid compression, wall expansion, gas compression and actual leakage, so it cannot all be classified as loss. Temperature also changes pressure, and trapped air complicates stored energy and measured response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 試壓過程的補水量會同時包含水體壓縮、管壁膨脹、氣體壓縮及真正外漏，因此不能把全部補水量都當成漏失。
試壓期間加入多少水就代表管線漏掉多少水。
達到理論充水體積就能直接證明整條管線可交付使用。
optionsEn: Make-up volume during a pressure test includes liquid compression, wall expansion, gas compression and actual leakage, so it cannot all be classified as loss.
All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks.
Reaching theoretical filling volume proves the entire main is ready for service.
quiz.explanation: 試壓過程的補水量會同時包含水體壓縮、管壁膨脹、氣體壓縮及真正外漏，因此不能把全部補水量都當成漏失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Make-up volume during a pressure test includes liquid compression, wall expansion, gas compression and actual leakage, so it cannot all be classified as loss. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試壓儲水與漏失判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水體V=100 m³、體積模數K=2.2 GPa、壓升Δp=1.0 MPa，壓縮體積ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water volume V=100 m³, bulk modulus K=2.2 GPa and rise Δp=1.0 MPa. Compression volume ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對隔離閥、端封及量測表的範圍，連續記錄壓力、溫度和補水體積並標示穩定時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify isolation valves, end closures and instrument ranges, continuously recording pressure, temperature and make-up volume with stabilization periods marked.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水體V=100 m³、體積模數K=2.2 GPa、壓升Δp=1.0 MPa，壓縮體積ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water volume V=100 m³, bulk modulus K=2.2 GPa and rise Δp=1.0 MPa. Compression volume ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 土方車載體積與原狀溝槽體積永遠可以直接相加比較。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水體V=100 m³、體積模數K=2.2 GPa、壓升Δp=1.0 MPa，壓縮體積ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L。
兩條吊索就必定各自承受管節重量的一半。
optionsEn: Truck load volumes and in-situ trench volumes can always be compared directly.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water volume V=100 m³, bulk modulus K=2.2 GPa and rise Δp=1.0 MPa.
Two slings necessarily carry exactly half the pipe weight each.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水體V=100 m³、體積模數K=2.2 GPa、壓升Δp=1.0 MPa，壓縮體積ΔV=VΔp/K=0.04545 m³=45.45 L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water volume V=100 m³, bulk modulus K=2.2 GPa and rise Δp=1.0 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試壓儲水與漏失判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對隔離閥、端封及量測表的範圍，連續記錄壓力、溫度和補水體積並標示穩定時段。將材料與接頭適用的核定試驗程序另附，避免用理論壓縮量自行建立允收門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify isolation valves, end closures and instrument ranges, continuously recording pressure, temperature and make-up volume with stabilization periods marked. Attach the approved procedure for the actual material and joints rather than inventing an acceptance limit from theoretical compression volume. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把總補水量拆成液體、管壁、氣體與外漏四種可能來源，列出各自需要的量測。以資料不足的情境練習保留不確定區間，而非直接宣判合格或失敗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate make-up volume into liquid, wall, gas and leakage contributions, listing measurements for each. Practice retaining uncertainty when data are incomplete instead of immediately declaring the test passed or failed.

steps.title: 試壓儲水與漏失判讀機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試壓儲水與漏失判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-test storage and leakage interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未排除溫度漂移或氣體壓縮便推定漏水，可能導致無效開挖；另一方面以壓縮性解釋所有補水，又可能掩蓋持續外漏及隔離閥內漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring leakage without accounting for temperature drift or gas compression can trigger unnecessary excavation. Conversely, attributing every make-up volume to compressibility can hide ongoing external leakage or internal leakage through an isolation valve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本算例只描述水的可壓縮部分，忽略管壁及氣體；它不是完整試壓補水量預測，更不是允許漏水標準。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All water added during a pressure test is water lost through leaks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 通水體積與分段交接機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filling volume and staged handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter water-main construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 通水交接不只是把空管填滿，還要確認水質、排氣、壓力邊界與資產紀錄均對應實際竣工配置。體積除以流量只給理想充填時間，實際充水會受到排氣能力、分段隔離與水源限制；未記錄的盲端或高點可能留下氣袋，改變後續流量與瞬變行為。本例為連續均勻流量的體積帳，忽略排氣與壓力控制，因此不提供現場充水速率；水質與衛生程序另按適用規定驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通水體積與分段交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Commissioning involves more than filling an empty pipe: water quality, air removal, pressure boundaries and asset records must match the as-built arrangement. Volume divided by flow gives an ideal filling time only. Actual filling depends on air-release capacity, isolation stages and source limits, and undocumented dead ends or high points can retain air that changes later flow and transient behavior. This is a constant-flow volume ledger, omitting venting and pressure control, so it supplies no field filling rate. Water-quality and hygiene procedures require separate applicable verification. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filling volume and staged handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設D=1.20 m、L=1000 m，V=πD²L/4=1131.0 m³；若僅作比較取Q=0.10 m³/s，t=V/Q=3.142 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume D=1.20 m and L=1000 m: V=πD²L/4=1131.0 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「達到理論充水體積就能直接證明整條管線可交付使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching theoretical filling volume proves the entire main is ready for service." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通水體積與分段交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 要驗證「通水體積與分段交接機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filling volume and staged handover mechanism and verification"?
options: 以竣工管徑與長度核對充填體積，記錄分段閥位、氣體排出及壓力歷程，並將水質檢驗連到取樣位置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
單一管節的傾斜角永遠等於相鄰接頭相對轉角。
optionsEn: Reconcile filling volume with as-built diameter and length, recording staged valve positions, air release and pressure history, and linking water-quality results to sampling locations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
One pipe section’s inclination always equals the relative rotation at its joint.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工管徑與長度核對充填體積，記錄分段閥位、氣體排出及壓力歷程，並將水質檢驗連到取樣位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile filling volume with as-built diameter and length, recording staged valve positions, air release and pressure history, and linking water-quality results to sampling locations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通水體積與分段交接機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filling volume and staged handover mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通水體積與分段交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filling volume and staged handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把理想充填時間當成固定工期，可能迫使未完成排氣或水質驗證的管段提前投入；竣工圖漏記閥位又會使後續維修隔離範圍錯誤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating ideal filling time as a fixed schedule can place a reach into service before air removal or water-quality verification is complete. Missing valve-position records can then lead to an incorrect maintenance-isolation boundary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為連續均勻流量的體積帳，忽略排氣與壓力控制，因此不提供現場充水速率；水質與衛生程序另按適用規定驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Water-quality and hygiene procedures require separate applicable verification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「達到理論充水體積就能直接證明整條管線可交付使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching theoretical filling volume proves the entire main is ready for service." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把理想充填時間當成固定工期，可能迫使未完成排氣或水質驗證的管段提前投入；竣工圖漏記閥位又會使後續維修隔離範圍錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Treating ideal filling time as a fixed schedule can place a reach into service before air removal or water-quality verification is complete. Missing valve-position records can then lead to an incorrect maintenance-isolation boundary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通水體積與分段交接機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filling volume and staged handover mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把理想充填時間當成固定工期，可能迫使未完成排氣或水質驗證的管段提前投入；竣工圖漏記閥位又會使後續維修隔離範圍錯誤。
管線兩端高程相同就代表中間各處壓力相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating ideal filling time as a fixed schedule can place a reach into service before air removal or water-quality verification is complete.
Equal endpoint elevations mean equal pressure everywhere between them.
quiz.explanation: 把理想充填時間當成固定工期，可能迫使未完成排氣或水質驗證的管段提前投入；竣工圖漏記閥位又會使後續維修隔離範圍錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating ideal filling time as a fixed schedule can place a reach into service before air removal or water-quality verification is complete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 輸水管線洩漏聲學定位
titleEn: Acoustic leak location in water mains
summary: 本課將漏水聲源、傳播速度、雙點到時差與管內追蹤串成完整定位問題，特別分析同步誤差、取樣、頻帶、衰減及共同干擾。學徒須區分漏水存在、位置與流量三種證據，再以盲測和修復回饋檢查方法的真正成效，不以單一漂亮相關峰作結論。
summaryEn: This course connects leak-sound generation, propagation speed, two-sensor delay and inline tracking into a complete location problem, examining synchronization, sampling, frequency bands, attenuation and shared interference. Learners distinguish evidence of leak presence, location and flow, then use blinded tests and repair feedback to assess actual performance instead of relying on one attractive correlation peak.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度例假設兩感測器沿管相距200 m、延遲定義為tB−tA=0.040 s。採波速1000 m/s得到距A為80 m；僅將速度提高10%至1100 m/s，位置改為78 m，移動2 m。另若時差有正1 ms偏移，在原波速下位置改為79.5 m。這兩種偏差不能靠重複處理相同訊號消除。應以獨立管長、同步測試及另一組感測器縮小搜尋區，再透過現地確認或修復前後證據驗證。此算例未假設真實漏點大小，也沒有將位置區間當成開挖許可。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example has sensors 200 m apart along the pipe and delay tB−tA=0.040 s. Speed 1000 m/s gives a location 80 m from A. Raising only speed by 10% to 1100 m/s moves it to 78 m, a 2 m shift. Separately, a positive 1 ms timing offset at the original speed gives 79.5 m. Reprocessing the same records cannot eliminate either bias. Use independent length, synchronization tests and another sensor arrangement to constrain the search, followed by field confirmation or before-and-after repair evidence. The example assumes no actual leak size and does not turn a location interval into excavation authorization.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」與「雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" and "Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏口能量與聲源形成」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leak energy and acoustic generation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。裂縫形狀、土壤包覆、管材及水壓會同時改變水力與聲學耦合；較大的漏口也可能產生較低頻或較弱的聲音，因此不能按音量直接排序所有漏失量。孔口式只估給定幾何與係數下的流量，不預測聲壓級；裂縫面積隨壓力變動時，固定孔口模型也需重新檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏口能量與聲源形成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. Leakage rate and audible strength are not in a one-to-one relationship. Crack geometry, surrounding soil, pipe material and pressure affect hydraulic and acoustic coupling together. A larger opening can produce lower-frequency or weaker sound, so loudness cannot rank every leak by discharge. The orifice expression estimates flow for specified geometry and coefficient, not acoustic level. If crack area changes with pressure, the fixed-opening model also requires reassessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leak energy and acoustic generation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏口能量與聲源形成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leak energy and acoustic generation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。裂縫形狀、土壤包覆、管材及水壓會同時改變水力與聲學耦合；較大的漏口也可能產生較低頻或較弱的聲音，因此不能按音量直接排序所有漏失量。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. Leakage rate and audible strength are not in a one-to-one relationship.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。
相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。
optionsEn: Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound.
A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏口能量與聲源形成」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leak energy and acoustic generation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s, not an inference from loudness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s, not an inference from loudness.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
optionsEn: Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏口能量與聲源形成」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leak energy and acoustic generation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。以已知訓練漏點或經核准的修復前後資料驗證，不將未校準的麥克風振幅直接當成漏水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions. Validate against known training leaks or approved before-and-after repair observations rather than converting uncalibrated microphone amplitude directly into leakage volume. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同孔口在兩個假設壓差下的流量，另列聲源與傳播尚需哪些資料。要求調查報告分開漏水存在、位置與流量三種結論，不讓聲音證據超出可支持範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare one hypothetical opening at two pressure differences and list additional source and propagation information needed. Keep conclusions about leak presence, location and flow separate so acoustic evidence is not overstated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-sensor delay and location” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一漏聲沿管線往兩端傳播，兩支感測器的到時差可把聲源限制在已知管段內。座標方向與延遲符號必須明確，否則同一數值會得到鏡像位置；管長應沿實際管路量測而不是兩測點的地表直線距離，分支與材質變化則可能使單速模型不再適用。定義x自感測器A量起、Δt=tB−tA，且聲源位於A與B之間；兩側共用相同波速時才有此代數關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙點到時差與定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A leak signal travels toward both ends of a pipe, and its arrival-time difference constrains the source within a known reach. Coordinate direction and delay sign must be explicit or the same number yields a mirrored location. Length follows the actual pipe rather than a straight surface distance, while branches and material transitions can invalidate a single-speed model. Define x from sensor A and Δt=tB−tA, with the source between A and B. The algebraic relation requires the same wave speed on both sides. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two-sensor delay and location” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.040 s，x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m，自A沿管量測；至B為120 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, a=1000 m/s and Δt=0.040 s. x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m along the pipe from A, leaving 120 m to B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙點到時差與定位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.explanation: 在資料檔中固定A、B編號與延遲正負定義，核對實際管路長度及中途閥件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix sensor A and B identifiers and the delay-sign convention in the data file, verifying pipe length and intervening fittings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙點到時差與定位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-sensor delay and location” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. Substituting straight surface distance for a curved pipe route creates systematic bias even when the correlation peak is sharp. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定義x自感測器A量起、Δt=tB−tA，且聲源位於A與B之間；兩側共用相同波速時才有此代數關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The algebraic relation requires the same wave speed on both sides.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。
knowledge.textEn: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. Substituting straight surface distance for a curved pipe route creates systematic bias even when the correlation peak is sharp.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location.
quiz.explanation: 若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」與「速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification" and "Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效傳播速度校準」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective propagation-speed calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。若某一已知聲源位置可提供到時差，便能反推單段有效速度；但管長、感測器時間同步與聲源位置都必須獨立可信，否則校準會把其他誤差吸收到速度參數內。當已知聲源靠近兩感測器中點，延遲趨近零，反算速度會對時間誤差極敏感；不能把這種配置當作高品質校準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效傳播速度校準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. A known source position and delay can calibrate one reach. Pipe length, sensor synchronization and source location must independently be trustworthy, however, or calibration merely absorbs their errors into the speed parameter. For a known source near the sensor midpoint, delay approaches zero and inferred speed becomes highly sensitive to timing error. That geometry is unsuitable as strong calibration evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective propagation-speed calibration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效傳播速度校準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective propagation-speed calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。若某一已知聲源位置可提供到時差，便能反推單段有效速度；但管長、感測器時間同步與聲源位置都必須獨立可信，否則校準會把其他誤差吸收到速度參數內。
knowledge.textEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. A known source position and delay can calibrate one reach.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。
optionsEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias.
quiz.explanation: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效傳播速度校準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective propagation-speed calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用可確認位置的訓練聲源建立速度範圍，保留頻帶、壓力、溫度與管材資訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate a speed range using a training source at a confirmed position, retaining frequency band, pressure, temperature and material information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。
optionsEn: The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.
Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效傳播速度校準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective propagation-speed calibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用可確認位置的訓練聲源建立速度範圍，保留頻帶、壓力、溫度與管材資訊。再用另一個位置或另一組感測器驗證，檢查同一速度是否可跨測段使用，避免只報單次最佳值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate a speed range using a training source at a confirmed position, retaining frequency band, pressure, temperature and material information. Validate with another source position or sensor pair to test transfer between reaches instead of reporting only one best-fit value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較已知聲源位於偏中與正中時的反算條件，說明為何小延遲不利校準。把速度寫成有證據支持的範圍，再觀察位置區間如何隨範圍擴大。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare calibration geometry for an off-center and a centered known source, explaining why small delay is unfavorable. Express speed as an evidence-based range and examine how the inferred location interval expands.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把混合材質管路的校準速度套到全線，可能讓不同測段得到互不相容的位置；若校準聲源位置本身有誤，反算仍可能看似精確卻帶有共同偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying one calibrated speed across mixed materials can produce incompatible locations from different reaches. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用可確認位置的訓練聲源建立速度範圍，保留頻帶、壓力、溫度與管材資訊。再用另一個位置或另一組感測器驗證，檢查同一速度是否可跨測段使用，避免只報單次最佳值。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate a speed range using a training source at a confirmed position, retaining frequency band, pressure, temperature and material information. Validate with another source position or sensor pair to test transfer between reaches instead of reporting only one best-fit value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較已知聲源位於偏中與正中時的反算條件，說明為何小延遲不利校準。把速度寫成有證據支持的範圍，再觀察位置區間如何隨範圍擴大。
knowledge.textEn: Compare calibration geometry for an off-center and a centered known source, explaining why small delay is unfavorable. Express speed as an evidence-based range and examine how the inferred location interval expands.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification"?

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效傳播速度校準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定位公式把管長、速度及延遲誤差一起傳到位置，誤差的來源與相關性必須分開。固定時間偏移會沿同一方向移動全部結果，而隨機雜訊會使重複估計散布；只報演算法相關峰的寬度，不能涵蓋管材速度或儀器時鐘的系統偏差。下式是一階局部敏感度，固定管長與延遲，只改變速度；若多個參數同時變動，需保留交互關係及可能共同偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度與同步誤差傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct. A fixed timing offset shifts all results in one direction, whereas random noise spreads repeated estimates. Correlation-peak width alone cannot cover systematic bias in material wave speed or instrument clocks. The expression is a first-order local sensitivity, holding length and delay fixed while changing speed. Simultaneous parameter changes require their dependence and possible common bias to be retained. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=0.040 s、速度誤差δa=+100 m/s，δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m；另有1 ms時差偏移可造成0.50 m位置偏移。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度與同步誤差傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=0.040 s、速度誤差δa=+100 m/s，δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m；另有1 ms時差偏移可造成0.50 m位置偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=0.040 s and speed error δa=+100 m/s. δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m. A separate 1 ms delay offset at a=1000 m/s produces a 0.50 m shift. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同訊號測試兩通道的相對延遲，再以獨立管長資料約束幾何誤差。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度與同步誤差傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以共同訊號測試兩通道的相對延遲，再以獨立管長資料約束幾何誤差。將速度、時間與路徑各自列成誤差項，對系統偏差採情境比較，對可證明獨立的隨機量才使用統計合成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
