stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」與「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification" and "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣間隔與定位解析」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling interval and location resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。抗混疊濾波、訊號頻寬、感測器耦合及雜訊決定可用資訊，次取樣插值也不能憑空創造遺失頻率；應分開理論格點尺度與經驗證的現地誤差。本例假設均勻波速且只考慮一個取樣間隔的延遲變化，不包含頻寬限制與峰值估計誤差，也不是可保證的定位精度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣間隔與定位解析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy. Anti-alias filtering, signal bandwidth, sensor coupling and noise determine usable information. Subsample interpolation cannot recreate missing frequencies, so theoretical grid resolution must be distinguished from validated field error. The example assumes uniform speed and considers one sample interval of delay only. It excludes bandwidth and peak-estimation error and is not a guaranteed positioning accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling interval and location resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣間隔與定位解析」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling interval and location resolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。抗混疊濾波、訊號頻寬、感測器耦合及雜訊決定可用資訊，次取樣插值也不能憑空創造遺失頻率；應分開理論格點尺度與經驗證的現地誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy. Anti-alias filtering, signal bandwidth, sensor coupling and noise determine usable information.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。
optionsEn: Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣間隔與定位解析」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling interval and location resolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s. At a=1000 m/s, one-sample location scale aΔts/2=0.25 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s. At a=1000 m/s, one-sample location scale aΔts/2=0.25 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s。
平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。
警報中八成是真的就表示所有漏水也都找到八成。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s.
Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location.
Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「取樣間隔與定位解析」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling interval and location resolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。比較原始與適當降採樣資料的定位差異，確認較高取樣率是否真的提供額外有效頻帶。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency. Compare original and appropriately downsampled records to determine whether the higher sampling rate actually adds usable frequency information. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一個取樣間隔換算成位置格點，另列速度與同步誤差作比較。設計可驗證的已知延遲測試，讓報告中的解析度與準確度使用不同欄位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert one sample interval into a position-grid scale and compare it with speed and synchronization errors. Design a known-delay verification so resolution and accuracy appear in separate report fields.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。比較原始與適當降採樣資料的定位差異，確認較高取樣率是否真的提供額外有效頻帶。
knowledge.textEn: Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency. Compare original and appropriately downsampled records to determine whether the higher sampling rate actually adds usable frequency information.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把一個取樣間隔換算成位置格點，另列速度與同步誤差作比較。設計可驗證的已知延遲測試，讓報告中的解析度與準確度使用不同欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Convert one sample interval into a position-grid scale and compare it with speed and synchronization errors. Design a known-delay verification so resolution and accuracy appear in separate report fields.

quiz.question: 要驗證「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。
相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency.
A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「取樣間隔與定位解析」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling interval and location resolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. High-frequency interference lacking anti-alias control can also fold into lower frequencies and create a stable false correlation peak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例假設均勻波速且只考慮一個取樣間隔的延遲變化，不包含頻寬限制與峰值估計誤差，也不是可保證的定位精度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It excludes bandwidth and peak-estimation error and is not a guaranteed positioning accuracy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。
knowledge.textEn: A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. High-frequency interference lacking anti-alias control can also fold into lower frequencies and create a stable false correlation peak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location.
quiz.explanation: 高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頻帶選擇與色散」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Band selection and dispersion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。高頻通常提供較短的時間特徵，但不一定能傳到遠端；濾波選擇若只追求最尖的峰，可能選到機械噪聲或與單速假設不相容的頻段。波長公式只連結某頻率與其對應相速度，不把波長當定位誤差；存在色散時，不同頻帶須使用相容的傳播模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻帶選擇與色散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. Higher frequencies may provide shorter temporal features but may not reach a distant sensor. Selecting filters solely for the sharpest peak can favor machinery noise or a band incompatible with the single-speed assumption. Wavelength links a frequency to its corresponding phase speed and is not a location-error measure. With dispersion, different bands need compatible propagation models. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Band selection and dispersion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻帶選擇與色散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Band selection and dispersion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。高頻通常提供較短的時間特徵，但不一定能傳到遠端；濾波選擇若只追求最尖的峰，可能選到機械噪聲或與單速假設不相容的頻段。
knowledge.textEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. Higher frequencies may provide shorter temporal features but may not reach a distant sensor.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。
optionsEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak.
quiz.explanation: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻帶選擇與色散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Band selection and dispersion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Wavelength λ=a/f=4.0 m; this is not leak-location resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Wavelength λ=a/f=4.0 m; this is not leak-location resolution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
optionsEn: An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz.
Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻帶選擇與色散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Band selection and dispersion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。保留濾波前後資料與相位處理方式，避免後續分析者無法重現延遲估計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Retain records before and after filtering with the phase-processing method so later analysts can reproduce the delay estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一資料的低頻與高頻定位並排，列出速度、衰減與干擾三種可能原因。要求每次濾波選擇都有可重現的依據，避免為得到預期位置反覆挑選頻帶。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place low- and high-band locations side by side and list speed, attenuation and interference as alternative explanations. Require a reproducible reason for each filter choice rather than selecting bands until a desired position appears.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。保留濾波前後資料與相位處理方式，避免後續分析者無法重現延遲估計。
knowledge.textEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Retain records before and after filtering with the phase-processing method so later analysts can reproduce the delay estimate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同一資料的低頻與高頻定位並排，列出速度、衰減與干擾三種可能原因。要求每次濾波選擇都有可重現的依據，避免為得到預期位置反覆挑選頻帶。
knowledge.textEn: Place low- and high-band locations side by side and list speed, attenuation and interference as alternative explanations. Require a reproducible reason for each filter choice rather than selecting bands until a desired position appears.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation.
quiz.explanation: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻帶選擇與色散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Band selection and dispersion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Ignoring dispersion can also create contradictory locations across bands without any obvious instrument malfunction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波長公式只連結某頻率與其對應相速度，不把波長當定位誤差；存在色散時，不同頻帶須使用相容的傳播模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With dispersion, different bands need compatible propagation models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。
knowledge.textEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Ignoring dispersion can also create contradictory locations across bands without any obvious instrument malfunction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。
optionsEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak.
quiz.explanation: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」與「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification" and "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attenuation and sensor coupling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏聲到達感測器前會經過管壁、接頭與地層，傳播損失和接觸耦合都可能降低振幅。兩測點訊號差異不一定代表一端離漏點更遠，鬆動的感測器或不同閥件可造成額外損失；衰減模型應以相同安裝與頻帶比較，不能把單次振幅比直接解成距離。指數衰減是單一頻帶、均勻路徑的教學模型，α為振幅衰減係數；功率比需平方，不能混用二十分貝與十分貝定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before reaching a sensor, leak sound passes through pipe walls, joints and surrounding ground, while both propagation loss and contact coupling reduce amplitude. Unequal signals do not necessarily mean one sensor is farther from the leak: loose attachment or different fittings can add loss. Attenuation comparisons require matched installation and band, rather than interpreting one amplitude ratio directly as distance. Exponential decay is a teaching model for one band and uniform path, with α an amplitude attenuation coefficient. Power ratios are squared, so amplitude and power decibel definitions must not be mixed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attenuation and sensor coupling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設α=0.010 m⁻¹、d=100 m，A/A0=e^(−αd)=0.3679；振幅變化20log10(A/A0)=−8.686 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume α=0.010 m⁻¹ and d=100 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attenuation and sensor coupling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 漏聲到達感測器前會經過管壁、接頭與地層，傳播損失和接觸耦合都可能降低振幅。兩測點訊號差異不一定代表一端離漏點更遠，鬆動的感測器或不同閥件可造成額外損失；衰減模型應以相同安裝與頻帶比較，不能把單次振幅比直接解成距離。
knowledge.textEn: Before reaching a sensor, leak sound passes through pipe walls, joints and surrounding ground, while both propagation loss and contact coupling reduce amplitude. Unequal signals do not necessarily mean one sensor is farther from the leak: loose attachment or different fittings can add loss.

steps.instruction: 先用已知訊號及重複安裝檢查耦合一致性，再比較不同距離的同頻帶振幅。將接頭、管材改變與閥件位置記入路徑圖，判斷指數模型是否只是局部近似而非全線常數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First test coupling repeatability with a known signal and repeated mounting, then compare matched-band amplitude at different distances. Map joints, material changes and fittings to determine whether exponential decay is only a local approximation rather than a network-wide constant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert amplitude and power ratios separately to decibels and confirm consistent physical attenuation. Design a remounting comparison that separates contact loss from propagation loss along the pipe.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器接觸不良可能被誤解成管線高度衰減，導致過早否定聲學方法；反之把良好耦合的單點優勢當成較近漏源，也會使位置判讀偏向錯誤方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor sensor contact can be mistaken for severe pipe attenuation and lead to premature rejection of acoustics. steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Attenuation and sensor coupling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器接觸不良可能被誤解成管線高度衰減，導致過早否定聲學方法；反之把良好耦合的單點優勢當成較近漏源，也會使位置判讀偏向錯誤方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor sensor contact can be mistaken for severe pipe attenuation and lead to premature rejection of acoustics. Conversely, interpreting one well-coupled sensor’s stronger signal as proximity to the leak biases location in the wrong direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：指數衰減是單一頻帶、均勻路徑的教學模型，α為振幅衰減係數；功率比需平方，不能混用二十分貝與十分貝定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Power ratios are squared, so amplitude and power decibel definitions must not be mixed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相干性與共同干擾」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coherence and common interference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩訊號具有共同頻率成分並不證明共同來源就是漏水，泵、交通或電氣干擾也可能同時被兩通道接收。平方相干性衡量線性頻域關聯，可協助篩選可信頻帶，但缺乏來源身分資訊；需要改變測點、比對設備時序與獨立水力證據，才能縮小聲源假說。計算的自譜與互譜須使用相同窗函數、尺度與頻率格點；相干值介於零與一，並不是漏水存在的機率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相干性與共同干擾」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shared frequency content does not prove that the common source is a leak: pumps, traffic and electrical interference can reach both channels. Magnitude-squared coherence measures linear frequency-domain association and can help select useful bands, but it does not identify the source. Changed sensor geometry, equipment timing and independent hydraulic evidence are needed to constrain competing source hypotheses. Auto- and cross-spectra must use compatible windows, scaling and frequency bins. Coherence lies between zero and one but is not the probability that a leak exists. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coherence and common interference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相干性與共同干擾」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification", which statement holds?

漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25.
Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相干性與共同干擾」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Coherence and common interference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢視相干性與相位是否在多段時間窗保持一致，同時比對泵啟停、道路作業及電源雜訊。使用另一組測點或訓練漏點作盲測，避免只以同一資料選頻又驗證方法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect coherence and phase across multiple time windows while comparing pump activity, road work and electrical noise. Use another sensor pair or blinded training leak for validation instead of selecting and validating the method on the same records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立漏水、泵噪聲與電氣干擾三種假說，為每種指定一項可區分的獨立觀察。用相干性選擇分析頻帶，再用幾何與修復證據驗證來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create leak, pump-noise and electrical-interference hypotheses, assigning one independent discriminating observation to each. Use coherence to choose analysis bands, then use geometry and repair evidence to verify the source.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
檢視相干性與相位是否在多段時間窗保持一致，同時比對泵啟停、道路作業及電源雜訊。
取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Inspect coherence and phase across multiple time windows while comparing pump activity, road work and electrical noise.
Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error.

quiz.explanationEn: Inspect coherence and phase across multiple time windows while comparing pump activity, road work and electrical noise. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相干性與共同干擾」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coherence and common interference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability. Short records can also create unstable estimates that are mistakenly read as intermittent leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：計算的自譜與互譜須使用相同窗函數、尺度與頻率格點；相干值介於零與一，並不是漏水存在的機率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coherence lies between zero and one but is not the probability that a leak exists.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。
knowledge.textEn: Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability. Short records can also create unstable estimates that are mistakenly read as intermittent leakage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。
共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking.
Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability.
quiz.explanation: 共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證」與「盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification" and "Blind validation and repair feedback mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inline inspection and position tracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管內感測器接近漏聲來源，可減少部分外部耦合問題，但聲音時間戳仍須轉換成沿管位置。工具速度不必等於斷面平均流速，停留、翻轉與分岔都會影響軌跡；只有把通過已知位置的事件與移動模型連結，才能避免聲音特徵被標在錯誤管段。恆速乘時間只描述已知工具速度的理想區段，不可直接以水流速度代替；實際定位需使用獨立通過標記或其他追蹤資料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An inline sensor approaches the acoustic source and can reduce some external coupling problems, but signal timestamps still require conversion into along-pipe position. Tool speed need not equal section-average water velocity; pauses, rotation and branches affect its trajectory. Linking passages at known locations to the motion model prevents acoustic features from being assigned to the wrong reach. Speed times time describes an ideal reach with known tool speed and cannot substitute water velocity without evidence. Real positioning needs independent passage markers or other tracking data. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inline inspection and position tracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設已校準工具速度vtool=0.80 m/s、兩事件間Δt=50 s，沿程距離Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m，非直接採用管內平均流速。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume calibrated tool speed vtool=0.80 m/s and event interval Δt=50 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inline inspection and position tracking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 管內感測器接近漏聲來源，可減少部分外部耦合問題，但聲音時間戳仍須轉換成沿管位置。工具速度不必等於斷面平均流速，停留、翻轉與分岔都會影響軌跡；只有把通過已知位置的事件與移動模型連結，才能避免聲音特徵被標在錯誤管段。
knowledge.textEn: An inline sensor approaches the acoustic source and can reduce some external coupling problems, but signal timestamps still require conversion into along-pipe position. Tool speed need not equal section-average water velocity; pauses, rotation and branches affect its trajectory.

knowledge.text: 誤解：管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 管內感測器接近漏聲來源，可減少部分外部耦合問題，但聲音時間戳仍須轉換成沿管位置。

警報中八成是真的就表示所有漏水也都找到八成。
optionsEn: An inline sensor approaches the acoustic source and can reduce some external coupling problems, but signal timestamps still require conversion into along-pipe position.
An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking.
Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found.

steps.title: 管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inline inspection and position tracking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設已校準工具速度vtool=0.80 m/s、兩事件間Δt=50 s，沿程距離Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m，非直接採用管內平均流速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume calibrated tool speed vtool=0.80 m/s and event interval Δt=50 s. Along-pipe distance Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m, without equating tool speed to bulk flow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將工具時間、外部通過標記及已知閥件位置對時，對每段檢查行進距離是否閉合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize tool time, external passage markers and known fitting locations, checking distance closure on each reach.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設已校準工具速度vtool=0.80 m/s、兩事件間Δt=50 s，沿程距離Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m，非直接採用管內平均流速。

steps.title: 管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inline inspection and position tracking” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將工具時間、外部通過標記及已知閥件位置對時，對每段檢查行進距離是否閉合。若有停滯或速度改變，分段重建軌跡並擴大位置區間，不用全程平均速度掩蓋局部異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize tool time, external passage markers and known fitting locations, checking distance closure on each reach. Reconstruct motion in segments and widen location intervals where pauses or speed changes occur instead of hiding local anomalies behind an overall average speed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較恆速與中途停留兩種假設軌跡，計算同一聲音時間戳會對應到何處。列出可校正軌跡的通過標記，將聲學辨識誤差與位置追蹤誤差分開報告。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare constant-speed and paused trajectories, locating the same acoustic timestamp under both. List passage markers that can correct motion and report acoustic-classification error separately from tracking error.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用水量計推得的平均流速直接定位工具，可能在停滯後累積很大位置誤差；即使漏聲判識正確，錯誤軌跡仍會把修復目標移到另一支管節。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Locating a tool directly from bulk-meter velocity can accumulate large errors after a pause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inline inspection and position tracking mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inline inspection and position tracking” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用水量計推得的平均流速直接定位工具，可能在停滯後累積很大位置誤差；即使漏聲判識正確，錯誤軌跡仍會把修復目標移到另一支管節。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Locating a tool directly from bulk-meter velocity can accumulate large errors after a pause. Even a correctly identified leak signal then points repair activity toward the wrong pipe section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：恆速乘時間只描述已知工具速度的理想區段，不可直接以水流速度代替；實際定位需使用獨立通過標記或其他追蹤資料。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Real positioning needs independent passage markers or other tracking data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Blind validation and repair feedback mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「盲測驗證與修復回饋」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Blind validation and repair feedback” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 檢測成效需要同時考慮找出的真漏點、假警報及漏掉的漏點，單純命中比例不足以描述整套方法。驗證樣本還必須包含不同管材、背景噪聲與無漏水區段，否則訓練場表現無法代表現場；修復後的壓力正規化水量與聲音改變可提供額外證據，但仍需排除需求改變。精確率以所有警報作分母，召回率以所有已知真漏點作分母；本例的完整真值來自假設盲測，實際未開挖區不能當成已知無漏。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「盲測驗證與修復回饋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Detection performance includes true detections, false alarms and missed leaks, so one hit fraction cannot describe the whole method. Validation also needs different materials, background noise and leak-free reaches; training performance cannot automatically represent field conditions. Pressure-normalized flow and acoustic changes after repair provide additional evidence, while demand changes still need to be excluded. Precision uses all alarms, while recall uses all known real leaks. Complete truth is assumed for this blind-test example; unexcavated field areas cannot simply be labeled leak-free. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Blind validation and repair feedback” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真陽性TP=8、假陽性FP=2、漏檢FN=4，precision=8/(8+2)=80%；recall=8/(8+4)=66.7%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true positives TP=8, false positives FP=2 and missed leaks FN=4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「警報中八成是真的就表示所有漏水也都找到八成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「盲測驗證與修復回饋」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Blind validation and repair feedback”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證

knowledge.text: 檢測成效需要同時考慮找出的真漏點、假警報及漏掉的漏點，單純命中比例不足以描述整套方法。驗證樣本還必須包含不同管材、背景噪聲與無漏水區段，否則訓練場表現無法代表現場；修復後的壓力正規化水量與聲音改變可提供額外證據，但仍需排除需求改變。
knowledge.textEn: Detection performance includes true detections, false alarms and missed leaks, so one hit fraction cannot describe the whole method. Validation also needs different materials, background noise and leak-free reaches; training performance cannot automatically represent field conditions.

knowledge.text: 誤解：警報中八成是真的就表示所有漏水也都找到八成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found.

steps.title: 盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「盲測驗證與修復回饋」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Blind validation and repair feedback” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真陽性TP=8、假陽性FP=2、漏檢FN=4，precision=8/(8+2)=80%；recall=8/(8+4)=66.7%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true positives TP=8, false positives FP=2 and missed leaks FN=4. Precision=8/(8+2)=80%; recall=8/(8+4)=66.7%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以未參與調參的盲測資料建立混淆矩陣，列出樣本管材、漏點大小及噪聲條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a confusion matrix from blinded data withheld from tuning, listing material, leak size and noise conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Blind validation and repair feedback” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以未參與調參的盲測資料建立混淆矩陣，列出樣本管材、漏點大小及噪聲條件。修復後再次量測聲音與水量，將未確認位置保留為未知類別，並報告有限樣本的不確定性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a confusion matrix from blinded data withheld from tuning, listing material, leak size and noise conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一組假設資料分別計算精確率與召回率，說明改善一項可能犧牲另一項。設計含無漏水樣本的盲測表，再為修復前後比較指定可匹配的壓力與需求時段。
