steps.failure: 注意干擾：只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以未參與調參的盲測資料建立混淆矩陣，列出樣本管材、漏點大小及噪聲條件。修復後再次量測聲音與水量，將未確認位置保留為未知類別，並報告有限樣本的不確定性。
knowledge.textEn: Build a confusion matrix from blinded data withheld from tuning, listing material, leak size and noise conditions. Repeat acoustic and flow measurements after repair, keep unconfirmed locations classified as unknown, and report uncertainty from the limited sample size.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用同一組假設資料分別計算精確率與召回率，說明改善一項可能犧牲另一項。設計含無漏水樣本的盲測表，再為修復前後比較指定可匹配的壓力與需求時段。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate precision and recall from the same hypothetical data, explaining how improving one can trade against the other. Design a blinded test including leak-free cases and specify matched pressure and demand periods for repair comparisons.

quiz.question: 要驗證「盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Blind validation and repair feedback mechanism and verification"?
options: 以未參與調參的盲測資料建立混淆矩陣，列出樣本管材、漏點大小及噪聲條件。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。
optionsEn: Build a confusion matrix from blinded data withheld from tuning, listing material, leak size and noise conditions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak.
quiz.explanation: 以未參與調參的盲測資料建立混淆矩陣，列出樣本管材、漏點大小及噪聲條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a confusion matrix from blinded data withheld from tuning, listing material, leak size and noise conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Blind validation and repair feedback mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「盲測驗證與修復回饋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Blind validation and repair feedback” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance. A post-repair flow reduction can also be wrongly credited entirely to repair if demand and pressure changes are ignored. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：精確率以所有警報作分母，召回率以所有已知真漏點作分母；本例的完整真值來自假設盲測，實際未開挖區不能當成已知無漏。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Complete truth is assumed for this blind-test example; unexcavated field areas cannot simply be labeled leak-free.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「警報中八成是真的就表示所有漏水也都找到八成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance. A post-repair flow reduction can also be wrongly credited entirely to repair if demand and pressure changes are ignored.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Blind validation and repair feedback mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。
漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance.
Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
quiz.explanation: 只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 配水系統分區計量
summary: 本課從控制體與雙向邊界開始，逐步建立可追溯的分區水量帳，分析水表偏差、時間積分、夜間合法用水、壓力正規化及水池儲量。最後將遙測缺值和不確定度納入改善成效評估，使學徒能分辨真正漏失、資料錯置與用水改變，而不只讀取單一水損百分比。
summaryEn: Beginning with control volumes and bidirectional boundaries, this course builds a traceable district balance through meter bias, time integration, legitimate night use, pressure normalization and tank storage. It then incorporates telemetry gaps and uncertainty into intervention assessment, distinguishing actual leakage from data misalignment and demand change rather than relying on one loss percentage.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度例採日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³及儲量增加50 m³，殘差為50 m³。僅假設入口表多記1%，其他項目固定，記錄入口變成1010 m³，殘差增為60 m³，表計1%的偏差造成殘差20%的變化。這不是漏水真的增加，而是大體積相減的敏感性。應先確認表計、時間窗與邊界，再用壓力匹配的夜流及獨立調查驗證。若多項誤差相關，不能直接用平方和縮小不確定度；本例也不把殘差全部分類為實漏。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example uses daily inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³, leaving 50 m³. If only the inlet meter over-registers by 1%, recorded inflow becomes 1010 m³ and the residual rises to 60 m³: a 1% meter bias changes the residual by 20%. Physical leakage has not increased; the effect comes from subtracting large quantities. Verify metering, windows and boundaries before checking pressure-matched night flow and independent investigation. Correlated errors cannot automatically be reduced through a root-sum-square calculation, and the example does not classify the entire residual as real leakage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」與「邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification" and "Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區水量平衡邊界」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “District water-balance boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區計量先定義哪些入口、出口、用戶與儲水設施包含在同一控制體，才有可比較的水量帳。入口水量減去出口、合法用水與儲量變化後形成殘差，但殘差仍可能混合實漏、漏計用水及表計誤差；因此水量不平衡是調查線索，不能直接等同地下管線破口流量。本例的出口為輸出到其他區域的水量，儲量增加取正；所有項目必須涵蓋相同時間窗，且不能重複扣除已包含的用水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區水量平衡邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: District metering begins by defining which inlets, outlets, customers and storage assets belong to one control volume. Inflow minus exports, authorized use and storage change produces a residual, but that residual can combine real leakage, unrecorded use and meter errors. Water imbalance is therefore an investigation signal rather than a direct measure of underground opening discharge. Exports leave the district and storage increase is positive in this example. Every term must cover the same time window, without double-counting consumption already included elsewhere. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “District water-balance boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區水量平衡邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “District water-balance boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分區計量先定義哪些入口、出口、用戶與儲水設施包含在同一控制體，才有可比較的水量帳。入口水量減去出口、合法用水與儲量變化後形成殘差，但殘差仍可能混合實漏、漏計用水及表計誤差；因此水量不平衡是調查線索，不能直接等同地下管線破口流量。
knowledge.textEn: District metering begins by defining which inlets, outlets, customers and storage assets belong to one control volume. Inflow minus exports, authorized use and storage change produces a residual, but that residual can combine real leakage, unrecorded use and meter errors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。
分區計量先定義哪些入口、出口、用戶與儲水設施包含在同一控制體，才有可比較的水量帳。
分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。
optionsEn: Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
District metering begins by defining which inlets, outlets, customers and storage assets belong to one control volume.
A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted.
quiz.explanation: 分區計量先定義哪些入口、出口、用戶與儲水設施包含在同一控制體，才有可比較的水量帳。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: District metering begins by defining which inlets, outlets, customers and storage assets belong to one control volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區水量平衡邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “District water-balance boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³. Residual R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check boundary valves, meters and internal tanks individually, matching mapped connectivity with field identification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³. Residual R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要流量曲線看起來平順，任何積分方式都會得到相同水量。
漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。
optionsEn: Any integration method gives the same volume when the flow curve looks smooth.
A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區水量平衡邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “District water-balance boundary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。將水量來源、時間窗與儲量算法寫入資料字典，再以獨立流量紀錄查驗殘差是否只是分類或時間錯置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check boundary valves, meters and internal tanks individually, matching mapped connectivity with field identification. Record data sources, time windows and storage calculations in a dictionary, then use independent flow records to determine whether residuals reflect classification or timing errors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為一個含水池與跨區出口的假設分區畫控制體，標示每筆水量進出方向。再列出殘差可能的三種來源，指定能區分實漏、漏計與儀表偏差的證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a control volume for a district containing storage and an export, marking every flow direction. List three possible residual sources and identify evidence separating real leakage, unrecorded use and instrument bias.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification"?
options: 逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區水量平衡邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “District water-balance boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual. Leak surveys based directly on these mistakes may never find a corresponding defect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例的出口為輸出到其他區域的水量，儲量增加取正；所有項目必須涵蓋相同時間窗，且不能重複扣除已包含的用水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every term must cover the same time window, without double-counting consumption already included elsewhere.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual. Leak surveys based directly on these mistakes may never find a corresponding defect.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。
分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual.
A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted.
quiz.explanation: 漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊界閥與雙向流量」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區管網不必只有單一入口，尖峰需求、泵切換或相鄰水位變化都可能讓邊界管反向流動。水量帳應保留流向符號與實際連通狀態，否則同一支流量計的負值可能被誤刪為異常；邊界閥名義關閉也不等於完全隔離，內漏會讓控制體的假設失效。本式只對同一時刻的有號流量加總，不能拿它代替整日積分；感測器正方向與管網圖的正方向須事先一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界閥與雙向流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A district need not have a single inlet. Peak demand, pump switching and neighboring levels can reverse flow through boundary pipes. The balance must retain direction signs and actual connectivity, or negative meter values may be discarded as anomalies. A nominally closed valve also does not prove isolation: internal leakage can invalidate the assumed control volume. This expression sums signed flows at one instant and does not replace daily integration. Sensor-positive direction must be made consistent with the network map beforehand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inward flow is positive on three boundaries: Q1=32 L/s, Q2=18 L/s and Q3=−7 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界閥與雙向流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分區管網不必只有單一入口，尖峰需求、泵切換或相鄰水位變化都可能讓邊界管反向流動。水量帳應保留流向符號與實際連通狀態，否則同一支流量計的負值可能被誤刪為異常；邊界閥名義關閉也不等於完全隔離，內漏會讓控制體的假設失效。
knowledge.textEn: A district need not have a single inlet. Peak demand, pump switching and neighboring levels can reverse flow through boundary pipes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。
總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。
分區管網不必只有單一入口，尖峰需求、泵切換或相鄰水位變化都可能讓邊界管反向流動。
optionsEn: A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted.
A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased.
A district need not have a single inlet.
quiz.explanation: 分區管網不必只有單一入口，尖峰需求、泵切換或相鄰水位變化都可能讓邊界管反向流動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A district need not have a single inlet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界閥與雙向流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inward flow is positive on three boundaries: Q1=32 L/s, Q2=18 L/s and Q3=−7 L/s. Net inflow Qnet=43 L/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已核准的正常供水狀態比較流量方向與兩側壓力，核對資料庫是否保存負值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare flow direction with pressure on both sides during approved normal supply conditions, checking that the database preserves negative values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inward flow is positive on three boundaries: Q1=32 L/s, Q2=18 L/s and Q3=−7 L/s. Net inflow Qnet=43 L/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。
夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。
水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inward flow is positive on three boundaries: Q1=32 L/s, Q2=18 L/s and Q3=−7 L/s.
The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate.
Calibrated meters do not require checks of their reporting time windows.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inward flow is positive on three boundaries: Q1=32 L/s, Q2=18 L/s and Q3=−7 L/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界閥與雙向流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已核准的正常供水狀態比較流量方向與兩側壓力，核對資料庫是否保存負值。巡查邊界閥狀態並使用適當獨立證據確認隔離，將每次拓樸改變連到計量分析的時間範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare flow direction with pressure on both sides during approved normal supply conditions, checking that the database preserves negative values. Inspect boundary-valve status and verify isolation with suitable independent evidence, linking every topology change to its analysis interval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一條邊界管由輸入改成輸出，重算淨入口並追蹤符號。製作拓樸版本表，說明邊界閥變更後為何不能直接比較前後兩日的原始殘差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reverse one boundary pipe from import to export and recompute net inflow with explicit signs. Build a topology-version table and explain why raw daily residuals cannot be compared blindly across a boundary-valve change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將負流量截成零會高估分區淨輸入，閥門內漏又可能把其他區的需求混進本區；兩者都會產生隨壓力條件改變的假漏失趨勢。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clipping negative flow to zero overstates net input, while valve leakage can mix another district’s demand into the balance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已核准的正常供水狀態比較流量方向與兩側壓力，核對資料庫是否保存負值。巡查邊界閥狀態並使用適當獨立證據確認隔離，將每次拓樸改變連到計量分析的時間範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Compare flow direction with pressure on both sides during approved normal supply conditions, checking that the database preserves negative values. Inspect boundary-valve status and verify isolation with suitable independent evidence, linking every topology change to its analysis interval.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一條邊界管由輸入改成輸出，重算淨入口並追蹤符號。製作拓樸版本表，說明邊界閥變更後為何不能直接比較前後兩日的原始殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Reverse one boundary pipe from import to export and recompute net inflow with explicit signs. Build a topology-version table and explain why raw daily residuals cannot be compared blindly across a boundary-valve change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以已核准的正常供水狀態比較流量方向與兩側壓力，核對資料庫是否保存負值。
資料收到九成五就表示漏水事件也一定能偵測九成五。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare flow direction with pressure on both sides during approved normal supply conditions, checking that the database preserves negative values.
Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks.
quiz.explanation: 以已核准的正常供水狀態比較流量方向與兩側壓力，核對資料庫是否保存負值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare flow direction with pressure on both sides during approved normal supply conditions, checking that the database preserves negative values. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界閥與雙向流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將負流量截成零會高估分區淨輸入，閥門內漏又可能把其他區的需求混進本區；兩者都會產生隨壓力條件改變的假漏失趨勢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clipping negative flow to zero overstates net input, while valve leakage can mix another district’s demand into the balance. Both create apparent leakage trends that change with pressure conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本式只對同一時刻的有號流量加總，不能拿它代替整日積分；感測器正方向與管網圖的正方向須事先一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sensor-positive direction must be made consistent with the network map beforehand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

Clipping negative flow to zero overstates net input, while valve leakage can mix another district’s demand into the balance.

quiz.explanationEn: Clipping negative flow to zero overstates net input, while valve leakage can mix another district’s demand into the balance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證」與「流量積分與採樣時間窗機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification" and "Flow integration and sampling windows mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「表計系統偏差與低流量」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Meter bias and low-flow behavior” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大流量入口表與分散用戶表具有不同量程和使用條件，小百分比系統偏差乘上大基數後可能接近真正水損。低流量、安裝直管段不足、氣泡或老化會影響量測，廠商名目精度不保證所有現場流況；應把校準、安裝與資料處理視為完整計量鏈。誤差百分比的分母在此定義為真實體積，負偏差表示少記；不能把量程百分比與讀值百分比混為同一種精度規格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「表計系統偏差與低流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bulk inlet meter and distributed customer meters operate over different ranges and conditions. A small systematic percentage applied to a large volume can approach the true loss. Low flow, inadequate installation geometry, air and aging affect measurement, and nominal manufacturer accuracy does not guarantee performance in every field condition. Calibration, installation and processing form one measurement chain. The error denominator here is true volume, with negative bias indicating under-registration. Percentage of full scale and percentage of reading are different specifications and cannot be interchanged. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Meter bias and low-flow behavior” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真實體積Vtrue=10000 m³、記錄Vreg=9800 m³，bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%，少記200 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true volume Vtrue=10000 m³ and registered volume Vreg=9800 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「表計系統偏差與低流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Meter bias and low-flow behavior”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 大流量入口表與分散用戶表具有不同量程和使用條件，小百分比系統偏差乘上大基數後可能接近真正水損。低流量、安裝直管段不足、氣泡或老化會影響量測，廠商名目精度不保證所有現場流況；應把校準、安裝與資料處理視為完整計量鏈。
knowledge.textEn: A bulk inlet meter and distributed customer meters operate over different ranges and conditions. A small systematic percentage applied to a large volume can approach the true loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 大流量入口表與分散用戶表具有不同量程和使用條件，小百分比系統偏差乘上大基數後可能接近真正水損。
總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。
只要流量曲線看起來平順，任何積分方式都會得到相同水量。
optionsEn: A bulk inlet meter and distributed customer meters operate over different ranges and conditions.
A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased.
Any integration method gives the same volume when the flow curve looks smooth.
quiz.explanation: 大流量入口表與分散用戶表具有不同量程和使用條件，小百分比系統偏差乘上大基數後可能接近真正水損。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A bulk inlet meter and distributed customer meters operate over different ranges and conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「表計系統偏差與低流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Meter bias and low-flow behavior” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真實體積Vtrue=10000 m³、記錄Vreg=9800 m³，bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%，少記200 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true volume Vtrue=10000 m³ and registered volume Vreg=9800 m³. Bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%, an under-registration of 200 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用具追溯性的參考方法在代表性流量區間查核表計，保存安裝條件、校準不確定度與方向設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the meter against a traceable reference across representative flow ranges, retaining installation conditions, calibration uncertainty and direction settings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真實體積Vtrue=10000 m³、記錄Vreg=9800 m³，bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%，少記200 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true volume Vtrue=10000 m³ and registered volume Vreg=9800 m³. Bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%, an under-registration of 200 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真實體積Vtrue=10000 m³、記錄Vreg=9800 m³，bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%，少記200 m³。
入口流量穩定時就可以把區內所有水池儲量變化忽略。
optionsEn: A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true volume Vtrue=10000 m³ and registered volume Vreg=9800 m³.
Stable inlet flow allows all internal tank-storage changes to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設真實體積Vtrue=10000 m³、記錄Vreg=9800 m³，bias=(Vreg−Vtrue)/Vtrue=−2.0%，少記200 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume true volume Vtrue=10000 m³ and registered volume Vreg=9800 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「表計系統偏差與低流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Meter bias and low-flow behavior” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用具追溯性的參考方法在代表性流量區間查核表計，保存安裝條件、校準不確定度與方向設定。將低流量時段另行分析，避免只在高流量通過比較便宣稱整日水量都沒有偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the meter against a traceable reference across representative flow ranges, retaining installation conditions, calibration uncertainty and direction settings. Analyze low-flow intervals separately rather than assuming that agreement at high flow establishes unbiased daily totals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把同樣百分比偏差分別放在入口與用戶計量端，觀察殘差變化方向。將改表前後資料重新校正到同一基準，再討論是否存在真實漏失改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the same percentage bias separately at inlet and customer metering, observing opposite residual effects. Reconcile pre- and post-replacement records to one basis before discussing a real leakage change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：入口表少記與用戶表少記對殘差的方向可能相反，單看總差值接近零會掩蓋兩種相互抵消的偏差；之後更換一支表反而可能讓帳面水損突然增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Under-registration at inlet and customer meters can affect the residual in opposite directions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用具追溯性的參考方法在代表性流量區間查核表計，保存安裝條件、校準不確定度與方向設定。將低流量時段另行分析，避免只在高流量通過比較便宣稱整日水量都沒有偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Check the meter against a traceable reference across representative flow ranges, retaining installation conditions, calibration uncertainty and direction settings. Analyze low-flow intervals separately rather than assuming that agreement at high flow establishes unbiased daily totals.

knowledge.text: 把同樣百分比偏差分別放在入口與用戶計量端，觀察殘差變化方向。將改表前後資料重新校正到同一基準，再討論是否存在真實漏失改變。

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Meter bias and low-flow behavior” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 入口表少記與用戶表少記對殘差的方向可能相反，單看總差值接近零會掩蓋兩種相互抵消的偏差；之後更換一支表反而可能讓帳面水損突然增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

A near-zero balance may hide compensating biases, and replacing one meter can then make apparent water loss suddenly increase. steps.title: 流量積分與採樣時間窗機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flow integration and sampling windows mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「流量積分與採樣時間窗」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flow integration and sampling windows” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瞬時流量必須對時間積分才能與帳單或水池體積相比，採樣間隔及缺值處理會影響總量。尖峰短於紀錄間隔時可能被平均化或漏掉，使用每十五分鐘瞬間讀值與每十五分鐘平均值也不是同一資料型態；積分方法須對應儀表實際輸出的意義。梯形積分假設相鄰點間線性變化，只適用此假設資料；若輸出已是區間累積量，不能再乘時間而重複積分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流量積分與採樣時間窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Instantaneous flow needs time integration before comparison with bills or tank volumes, and sampling intervals and missing-data treatment affect totals. Peaks shorter than a logging interval may be smoothed or missed. An instantaneous reading every fifteen minutes differs from a fifteen-minute average, so integration must match the instrument’s actual output definition. Trapezoidal integration assumes linear variation between neighboring points. If the output already represents interval volume, multiplying by time again would double-integrate the data. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flow integration and sampling windows” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume flows 10, 20 and 10 L/s at t=0, 900 and 1800 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要流量曲線看起來平順，任何積分方式都會得到相同水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any integration method gives the same volume when the flow curve looks smooth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流量積分與採樣時間窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flow integration and sampling windows”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Instantaneous flow needs time integration before comparison with bills or tank volumes, and sampling intervals and missing-data treatment affect totals. Peaks shorter than a logging interval may be smoothed or missed.

steps.title: 流量積分與採樣時間窗機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flow integration and sampling windows mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流量積分與採樣時間窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flow integration and sampling windows” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設t=0、900、1800 s的流量為10、20、10 L/s，V=[(10+20)/2+(20+10)/2]×900=27000 L=27.0 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume flows 10, 20 and 10 L/s at t=0, 900 and 1800 s. V=[(10+20)/2+(20+10)/2]×900=27000 L=27.0 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查核儀表輸出是瞬時值、區間平均或累積計數，再以原始時間戳進行積分。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify whether outputs are instantaneous values, interval means or cumulative counts, then integrate using original timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume flows 10, 20 and 10 L/s at t=0, 900 and 1800 s. V=[(10+20)/2+(20+10)/2]×900=27000 L=27.0 m³.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.titleEn: Flow integration and sampling windows mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流量積分與採樣時間窗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 查核儀表輸出是瞬時值、區間平均或累積計數，再以原始時間戳進行積分。將計算總量與累積表讀值交叉比較，對缺值、時鐘重設及計數器溢位保留明確處理紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify whether outputs are instantaneous values, interval means or cumulative counts, then integrate using original timestamps. Cross-check calculated volume against totalizer differences and retain explicit handling records for missing data, clock resets and counter rollover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一組資料分別以瞬時值和區間平均值解讀，說明積分所需假設的不同。加入一個不等時間間隔，檢查程式是否仍使用正確時間差而非固定筆數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Interpret one dataset as instantaneous samples and interval means, explaining the different assumptions. Add an irregular interval and verify that calculation uses actual elapsed time rather than a fixed sample count.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把平均流量當累積量或把累積量再次積分會產生量綱錯誤，時間間隔若固定寫死也會漏掉通訊中斷；曲線看似平順仍可能造成很大的日水量偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing mean flow with accumulated volume or integrating a totalizer again creates dimensional errors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
