quiz.explanationEn: Confusing mean flow with accumulated volume or integrating a totalizer again creates dimensional errors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證」與「壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification" and "Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「最小夜流與合法用水」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Minimum night flow and legitimate use” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夜間需求通常較低，讓背景漏失在總流量中的比例較容易辨識，但夜流不等於漏水。工業夜班、公共設施、水池補水與用戶持續用水都可能存在；選取最小值還會受到時間窗及雜訊影響，因此應用合法夜用水與儲量資料解釋剩餘量。此例只計同時段的剩餘流量，不把它自動外推成全天漏失；全天壓力若改變，漏失速率也可能改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「最小夜流與合法用水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Night demand is often lower, making background leakage more visible as a fraction of total flow, but night flow is not leakage itself. Industrial shifts, public facilities, tank filling and continuous customer use can remain active. Selecting a minimum is also sensitive to window length and noise, so authorized night use and storage records must explain the residual. The example calculates a residual for one matched interval and does not automatically extrapolate it through the day. Leakage rate may change as daily pressure changes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Minimum night flow and legitimate use” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設夜間入口5.0 L/s、合法用水1.2 L/s、水池儲量增加等效0.3 L/s，未解釋流量=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume night inflow 5.0 L/s, authorized use 1.2 L/s and storage increase equivalent to 0.3 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「最小夜流與合法用水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Minimum night flow and legitimate use”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 夜間需求通常較低，讓背景漏失在總流量中的比例較容易辨識，但夜流不等於漏水。工業夜班、公共設施、水池補水與用戶持續用水都可能存在；選取最小值還會受到時間窗及雜訊影響，因此應用合法夜用水與儲量資料解釋剩餘量。
knowledge.textEn: Night demand is often lower, making background leakage more visible as a fraction of total flow, but night flow is not leakage itself. Industrial shifts, public facilities, tank filling and continuous customer use can remain active.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。
漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
夜間需求通常較低，讓背景漏失在總流量中的比例較容易辨識，但夜流不等於漏水。
optionsEn: The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate.
A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
Night demand is often lower, making background leakage more visible as a fraction of total flow, but night flow is not leakage itself.
quiz.explanation: 夜間需求通常較低，讓背景漏失在總流量中的比例較容易辨識，但夜流不等於漏水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Night demand is often lower, making background leakage more visible as a fraction of total flow, but night flow is not leakage itself. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「最小夜流與合法用水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Minimum night flow and legitimate use” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設夜間入口5.0 L/s、合法用水1.2 L/s、水池儲量增加等效0.3 L/s，未解釋流量=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume night inflow 5.0 L/s, authorized use 1.2 L/s and storage increase equivalent to 0.3 L/s. Unexplained flow=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將候選夜間時段與大用戶班表、水池水位和邊界壓力配對，排除已知異常操作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match candidate night intervals with large-user schedules, tank levels and boundary pressure, excluding known unusual operations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設夜間入口5.0 L/s、合法用水1.2 L/s、水池儲量增加等效0.3 L/s，未解釋流量=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume night inflow 5.0 L/s, authorized use 1.2 L/s and storage increase equivalent to 0.3 L/s. Unexplained flow=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設夜間入口5.0 L/s、合法用水1.2 L/s、水池儲量增加等效0.3 L/s，未解釋流量=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s。
入口流量穩定時就可以把區內所有水池儲量變化忽略。
修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume night inflow 5.0 L/s, authorized use 1.2 L/s and storage increase equivalent to 0.3 L/s.
Stable inlet flow allows all internal tank-storage changes to be ignored.
Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設夜間入口5.0 L/s、合法用水1.2 L/s、水池儲量增加等效0.3 L/s，未解釋流量=5.0−1.2−0.3=3.5 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume night inflow 5.0 L/s, authorized use 1.2 L/s and storage increase equivalent to 0.3 L/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「最小夜流與合法用水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Minimum night flow and legitimate use” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將候選夜間時段與大用戶班表、水池水位和邊界壓力配對，排除已知異常操作。使用多個相似日比較夜流區間，對合法夜用水的不確定度給出範圍，不只報單一最小值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match candidate night intervals with large-user schedules, tank levels and boundary pressure, excluding known unusual operations. Compare ranges across several similar days and provide uncertainty for legitimate night use instead of reporting only one minimum observation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為同一夜流殘差提出漏水與合法夜用水兩種解釋，列出可分辨的用戶或水池資料。再比較工作日與假日，檢查夜間基線是否可直接共用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Propose leakage and legitimate night demand as alternative explanations for one residual, listing discriminating customer or storage data. Compare working days with holidays to test whether they can share one night-flow baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：工業夜班停工可能讓夜流下降卻沒有任何漏水修復，水池補水時序改變也會造成相同假象；只看最小夜流曲線會把需求變化誤認成漏失改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A factory shutdown can lower night flow without any leak repair, and changed tank-filling schedules can create the same illusion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將候選夜間時段與大用戶班表、水池水位和邊界壓力配對，排除已知異常操作。使用多個相似日比較夜流區間，對合法夜用水的不確定度給出範圍，不只報單一最小值。
knowledge.textEn: Match candidate night intervals with large-user schedules, tank levels and boundary pressure, excluding known unusual operations. Compare ranges across several similar days and provide uncertainty for legitimate night use instead of reporting only one minimum observation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為同一夜流殘差提出漏水與合法夜用水兩種解釋，列出可分辨的用戶或水池資料。再比較工作日與假日，檢查夜間基線是否可直接共用。
knowledge.textEn: Propose leakage and legitimate night demand as alternative explanations for one residual, listing discriminating customer or storage data. Compare working days with holidays to test whether they can share one night-flow baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將候選夜間時段與大用戶班表、水池水位和邊界壓力配對，排除已知異常操作。
分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Match candidate night intervals with large-user schedules, tank levels and boundary pressure, excluding known unusual operations.
A negative inlet-meter value must be an instrument fault and should be deleted.
quiz.explanation: 將候選夜間時段與大用戶班表、水池水位和邊界壓力配對，排除已知異常操作。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match candidate night intervals with large-user schedules, tank levels and boundary pressure, excluding known unusual operations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「最小夜流與合法用水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Minimum night flow and legitimate use” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 工業夜班停工可能讓夜流下降卻沒有任何漏水修復，水池補水時序改變也會造成相同假象；只看最小夜流曲線會把需求變化誤認成漏失改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A factory shutdown can lower night flow without any leak repair, and changed tank-filling schedules can create the same illusion. A minimum-night-flow curve alone can therefore misclassify demand changes as leakage improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此例只計同時段的剩餘流量，不把它自動外推成全天漏失；全天壓力若改變，漏失速率也可能改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Leakage rate may change as daily pressure changes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 工業夜班停工可能讓夜流下降卻沒有任何漏水修復，水池補水時序改變也會造成相同假象；只看最小夜流曲線會把需求變化誤認成漏失改善。
knowledge.textEn: A factory shutdown can lower night flow without any leak repair, and changed tank-filling schedules can create the same illusion. A minimum-night-flow curve alone can therefore misclassify demand changes as leakage improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「最小夜流與合法用水機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Minimum night flow and legitimate use mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
工業夜班停工可能讓夜流下降卻沒有任何漏水修復，水池補水時序改變也會造成相同假象；只看最小夜流曲線會把需求變化誤認成漏失改善。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
A factory shutdown can lower night flow without any leak repair, and changed tank-filling schedules can create the same illusion.
quiz.explanation: 工業夜班停工可能讓夜流下降卻沒有任何漏水修復，水池補水時序改變也會造成相同假象；只看最小夜流曲線會把需求變化誤認成漏失改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A factory shutdown can lower night flow without any leak repair, and changed tank-filling schedules can create the same illusion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力正規化與可比基線」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure normalization and comparable baselines” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏失流量可能隨壓力與裂縫開度改變，直接比較兩天的夜流容易把供水壓力差當成管線健康差。冪次經驗模型可將假設漏失量換到共同壓力，但指數必須由適用資料校準；區內壓力分布、合法用水及多種漏口混合都會限制單一指數的代表性。此關係只用於已分離的漏失分量，不能直接套用總需求；參考壓力與觀測壓力須使用同一代表位置或同一加權定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力正規化與可比基線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Leakage can change with pressure and opening deformation, so comparing raw night flows can confuse pressure differences with pipe-condition changes. A power-law model can normalize an assumed leakage component to common pressure, but the exponent requires relevant calibration. Spatial pressure variation, legitimate use and mixed leak types limit the meaning of one district-wide exponent. Apply the relation only to an isolated leakage component, not total demand. Reference and observed pressure must share the same representative point or weighting definition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure normalization and comparable baselines” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設漏失Qobs=2.5 L/s、Pobs=50 m水頭、Pref=40 m、N=1.2，Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qobs=2.5 L/s, Pobs=50 m head, Pref=40 m and N=1.2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力正規化與可比基線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure normalization and comparable baselines”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 漏失流量可能隨壓力與裂縫開度改變，直接比較兩天的夜流容易把供水壓力差當成管線健康差。冪次經驗模型可將假設漏失量換到共同壓力，但指數必須由適用資料校準；區內壓力分布、合法用水及多種漏口混合都會限制單一指數的代表性。
knowledge.textEn: Leakage can change with pressure and opening deformation, so comparing raw night flows can confuse pressure differences with pipe-condition changes. A power-law model can normalize an assumed leakage component to common pressure, but the exponent requires relevant calibration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 漏失流量可能隨壓力與裂縫開度改變，直接比較兩天的夜流容易把供水壓力差當成管線健康差。
漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。
optionsEn: Leakage can change with pressure and opening deformation, so comparing raw night flows can confuse pressure differences with pipe-condition changes.
A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
Calibrated meters do not require checks of their reporting time windows.
quiz.explanation: 漏失流量可能隨壓力與裂縫開度改變，直接比較兩天的夜流容易把供水壓力差當成管線健康差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Leakage can change with pressure and opening deformation, so comparing raw night flows can confuse pressure differences with pipe-condition changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力正規化與可比基線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure normalization and comparable baselines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設漏失Qobs=2.5 L/s、Pobs=50 m水頭、Pref=40 m、N=1.2，Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qobs=2.5 L/s, Pobs=50 m head, Pref=40 m and N=1.2. Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多個已核准運轉狀態的壓力與漏失估計配對，檢查模型在校準範圍外是否失準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pressure and leakage estimates from several approved operating states, checking behavior beyond the calibration range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設漏失Qobs=2.5 L/s、Pobs=50 m水頭、Pref=40 m、N=1.2，Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qobs=2.5 L/s, Pobs=50 m head, Pref=40 m and N=1.2. Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 資料收到九成五就表示漏水事件也一定能偵測九成五。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設漏失Qobs=2.5 L/s、Pobs=50 m水頭、Pref=40 m、N=1.2，Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s。
入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。
optionsEn: Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qobs=2.5 L/s, Pobs=50 m head, Pref=40 m and N=1.2.
Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設漏失Qobs=2.5 L/s、Pobs=50 m水頭、Pref=40 m、N=1.2，Qref=Qobs(Pref/Pobs)^N=1.913 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qobs=2.5 L/s, Pobs=50 m head, Pref=40 m and N=1.2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力正規化與可比基線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure normalization and comparable baselines” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多個已核准運轉狀態的壓力與漏失估計配對，檢查模型在校準範圍外是否失準。保留區內高低點壓力和合法用水假設，使用未參與擬合的日期驗證正規化後基線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pressure and leakage estimates from several approved operating states, checking behavior beyond the calibration range. Retain pressures at district high and low points and authorized-use assumptions, validating the normalized baseline on dates withheld from fitting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將漏失與合法用水分成兩條曲線，只正規化前者；比較指數改變時的結果範圍。說明需要新增哪些壓力位置與時間資料才能改善可比性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate leakage and authorized use into two curves and normalize only the former. Compare results across plausible exponents and identify pressure locations and timestamps needed to improve comparability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總用水量全按漏失指數正規化會扭曲用戶需求，甚至讓真實漏水變化被抵消；任意挑選指數以使前後數據重合，也會製造不存在的修復成效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Normalizing total consumption with a leakage exponent distorts customer demand and can cancel a real leakage change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多個已核准運轉狀態的壓力與漏失估計配對，檢查模型在校準範圍外是否失準。保留區內高低點壓力和合法用水假設，使用未參與擬合的日期驗證正規化後基線。
knowledge.textEn: Pair pressure and leakage estimates from several approved operating states, checking behavior beyond the calibration range. Retain pressures at district high and low points and authorized-use assumptions, validating the normalized baseline on dates withheld from fitting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將漏失與合法用水分成兩條曲線，只正規化前者；比較指數改變時的結果範圍。說明需要新增哪些壓力位置與時間資料才能改善可比性。
knowledge.textEn: Separate leakage and authorized use into two curves and normalize only the former. Compare results across plausible exponents and identify pressure locations and timestamps needed to improve comparability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。
以多個已核准運轉狀態的壓力與漏失估計配對，檢查模型在校準範圍外是否失準。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased.
Pair pressure and leakage estimates from several approved operating states, checking behavior beyond the calibration range.

quiz.explanationEn: Pair pressure and leakage estimates from several approved operating states, checking behavior beyond the calibration range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力正規化與可比基線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure normalization and comparable baselines” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總用水量全按漏失指數正規化會扭曲用戶需求，甚至讓真實漏水變化被抵消；任意挑選指數以使前後數據重合，也會製造不存在的修復成效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Normalizing total consumption with a leakage exponent distorts customer demand and can cancel a real leakage change. Selecting an exponent merely to align before-and-after data can also fabricate repair performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此關係只用於已分離的漏失分量，不能直接套用總需求；參考壓力與觀測壓力須使用同一代表位置或同一加權定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reference and observed pressure must share the same representative point or weighting definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總用水量全按漏失指數正規化會扭曲用戶需求，甚至讓真實漏水變化被抵消；任意挑選指數以使前後數據重合，也會製造不存在的修復成效。
knowledge.textEn: Normalizing total consumption with a leakage exponent distorts customer demand and can cancel a real leakage change. Selecting an exponent merely to align before-and-after data can also fabricate repair performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力正規化與可比基線機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure normalization and comparable baselines mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把總用水量全按漏失指數正規化會扭曲用戶需求，甚至讓真實漏水變化被抵消；任意挑選指數以使前後數據重合，也會製造不存在的修復成效。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。
optionsEn: Normalizing total consumption with a leakage exponent distorts customer demand and can cancel a real leakage change.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanationEn: Normalizing total consumption with a leakage exponent distorts customer demand and can cancel a real leakage change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多水表時間對齊機理與驗證」與「水池儲量與面積水位關係機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Time alignment across meters mechanism and verification" and "Tank storage and level-area relations mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多水表時間對齊機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time alignment across meters mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多水表時間對齊」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time alignment across meters” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區入口與用戶水表即使都精確，若統計起訖時間不同，仍會產生假的水量殘差。尖峰時段的幾分鐘錯位可能比低需求時更顯著，時區、夏令時間及累積計數重設也會改變每日邊界；時間對齊應在資料彙總之前完成，不能靠事後調整漏失比例補救。算例只估固定流量下的時間窗差異體積，變動流量須對缺少或多出的時間段積分；它不是水表本身的流量誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多水表時間對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Accurate inlet and customer meters can still produce false residuals when their reporting windows differ. A few minutes of mismatch near a demand peak can matter more than during quiet periods, and time zones, daylight-saving transitions and totalizer resets alter daily boundaries. Align timestamps before aggregation instead of correcting the resulting error with an arbitrary leakage factor. The example estimates window-mismatch volume at constant flow. Variable flow requires integration over the missing or extra interval, and this is not intrinsic meter-flow error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time alignment across meters” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設統計窗錯開Δt=5 min、該段流量Q=0.20 m³/min，假殘差ΔV=QΔt=1.0 m³，並無實際漏水增加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a window offset Δt=5 min and interval flow Q=0.20 m³/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calibrated meters do not require checks of their reporting time windows." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多水表時間對齊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Time alignment across meters”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A few minutes of mismatch near a demand peak can matter more than during quiet periods, and time zones, daylight-saving transitions and totalizer resets alter daily boundaries.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設統計窗錯開Δt=5 min、該段流量Q=0.20 m³/min，假殘差ΔV=QΔt=1.0 m³，並無實際漏水增加。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume a window offset Δt=5 min and interval flow Q=0.20 m³/min. Apparent residual ΔV=QΔt=1.0 m³, without increased physical leakage. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 檢查每個資料來源的時區、時間戳代表意義與計數器重設時間，使用共同事件測試相對對時。彙總前保存原始記錄，對跨日、缺值及時間回撥建立可重現的處理規則。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each source’s time zone, timestamp meaning and totalizer-reset time, testing relative alignment against a common event. Preserve raw records before aggregation and establish reproducible rules for day boundaries, missing data and backward clock changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多水表時間對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Time alignment across meters” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把區間結束時間誤當開始時間會讓需求尖峰錯位，兩支表都通過校準仍會出現規律殘差；若以平滑濾波掩蓋，真正爆管的突變也可能一起被削弱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating an interval-end timestamp as its start misaligns demand peaks and creates regular residuals even with calibrated meters. Smoothing the discrepancy can also suppress the sudden signal of a real pipe burst. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：算例只估固定流量下的時間窗差異體積，變動流量須對缺少或多出的時間段積分；它不是水表本身的流量誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Variable flow requires integration over the missing or extra interval, and this is not intrinsic meter-flow error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tank storage and level-area relations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 區內水池在需求與入口流量間形成緩衝，水位上升代表一部分輸入暫存而非立刻成為用水或漏失。儲量變化需依真實水位面積曲線計算，非等截面水池不能一直使用固定面積；液位計零點漂移及池間轉供也可能使日水量帳出現長期偏差。本例假設直壁等截面水池，液位變化與入口計量使用相同時間窗；若水池形狀改變，需積分面積而非固定相乘。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水池儲量與面積水位關係」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage inside a district buffers inflow and demand, so rising water level means some inflow is retained rather than immediately consumed or lost. Volume change follows the actual level-area relation; a nonuniform tank cannot always use constant area. Level-sensor drift and transfers between tanks can also create persistent daily-balance errors. The example assumes a straight-sided tank of constant area and a level interval matching inlet metering. A changing shape requires integration of area rather than constant multiplication. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tank storage and level-area relations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water-surface area A=300 m² and level rise Δh=0.10 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入口流量穩定時就可以把區內所有水池儲量變化忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable inlet flow allows all internal tank-storage changes to be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水池儲量與面積水位關係」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水面面積A=300 m²、水位上升Δh=0.10 m，儲量增加ΔS=AΔh=30 m³，水量帳中應扣除。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water-surface area A=300 m² and level rise Δh=0.10 m. Storage increase ΔS=AΔh=30 m³ and must be deducted in the balance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水池儲量與面積水位關係機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water-surface area A=300 m² and level rise Δh=0.10 m.
Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased.

steps.title: 水池儲量與面積水位關係機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tank storage and level-area relations mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水池儲量與面積水位關係」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tank storage and level-area relations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對水池竣工幾何與水位基準，以獨立水準或容積資料查驗液位計。比較進出流量積分與儲量變化，對溢流、排空及池間連通另列事件，避免被合併到不明漏失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify as-built tank geometry and level datum against independent survey or volume information. Compare integrated inlet and outlet flow with storage change, separately recording overflow, draining and inter-tank connections instead of merging them into unexplained loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一日水位升降分成數個時段，計算各段儲量並與流量帳對照。再換成變截面水池，說明為何需要面積水位曲線以及額外幾何驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Divide one day’s level changes into intervals and reconcile their storage changes with flow records. Then consider a variable-section tank and explain the need for a level-area curve and additional geometric verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉水池上升儲量會高估漏失，液位計漂移則可能產生每天固定方向的偏差；總入口趨勢平穩並不能證明分區內部儲量沒有變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting rising storage overstates loss, while sensor drift can create a daily bias in one direction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水池儲量與面積水位關係機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tank storage and level-area relations mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對水池竣工幾何與水位基準，以獨立水準或容積資料查驗液位計。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Verify as-built tank geometry and level datum against independent survey or volume information.

steps.title: 水池儲量與面積水位關係機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tank storage and level-area relations mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水池儲量與面積水位關係」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tank storage and level-area relations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉水池上升儲量會高估漏失，液位計漂移則可能產生每天固定方向的偏差；總入口趨勢平穩並不能證明分區內部儲量沒有變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting rising storage overstates loss, while sensor drift can create a daily bias in one direction. A stable total inlet trend does not prove that internal district storage remains unchanged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例假設直壁等截面水池，液位變化與入口計量使用相同時間窗；若水池形狀改變，需積分面積而非固定相乘。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A changing shape requires integration of area rather than constant multiplication.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入口流量穩定時就可以把區內所有水池儲量變化忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable inlet flow allows all internal tank-storage changes to be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水池儲量與面積水位關係機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tank storage and level-area relations mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
資料收到九成五就表示漏水事件也一定能偵測九成五。
漏掉水池上升儲量會高估漏失，液位計漂移則可能產生每天固定方向的偏差；總入口趨勢平穩並不能證明分區內部儲量沒有變化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks.
Omitting rising storage overstates loss, while sensor drift can create a daily bias in one direction.
quiz.explanation: 漏掉水池上升儲量會高估漏失，液位計漂移則可能產生每天固定方向的偏差；總入口趨勢平穩並不能證明分區內部儲量沒有變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting rising storage overstates loss, while sensor drift can create a daily bias in one direction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證」與「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification" and "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「遙測缺值與資料完整性」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Telemetry gaps and data completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區資料缺值不一定隨機，暴雨、停電或高需求事件可能同時造成通訊失敗，恰好刪掉最重要的異常時段。收到筆數比例只能描述完整性，不能代表監測可靠度或事件偵測率；補值方式若沿用平常日曲線，可能讓真實爆管在資料中消失。本例只計預期筆數中的收件比例，沒有評估缺值時段長度與重要性；相同百分比可能對應一段連續缺值或零星遺失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「遙測缺值與資料完整性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Missing district data need not be random: storms, outages or high-demand events can interrupt communication precisely during important anomalies. The fraction of received records describes completeness rather than reliability or event-detection probability. Filling gaps with an ordinary-day profile can remove a genuine burst from the reconstructed data. The example counts received records against expected records without assessing gap duration or importance. The same percentage can represent one continuous outage or scattered missing samples. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Telemetry gaps and data completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每日預期96筆、收到92筆，完整率C=92/96=95.83%；遺失4筆不代表漏水偵測率為95.83%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume 96 expected daily records and 92 received.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「資料收到九成五就表示漏水事件也一定能偵測九成五。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「遙測缺值與資料完整性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Telemetry gaps and data completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證

knowledge.textEn: Missing district data need not be random: storms, outages or high-demand events can interrupt communication precisely during important anomalies. The fraction of received records describes completeness rather than reliability or event-detection probability.

knowledge.text: 誤解：資料收到九成五就表示漏水事件也一定能偵測九成五。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 分區資料缺值不一定隨機，暴雨、停電或高需求事件可能同時造成通訊失敗，恰好刪掉最重要的異常時段。

optionsEn: Missing district data need not be random: storms, outages or high-demand events can interrupt communication precisely during important anomalies.
Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks.
Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved.

steps.title: 遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「遙測缺值與資料完整性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Telemetry gaps and data completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設每日預期96筆、收到92筆，完整率C=92/96=95.83%；遺失4筆不代表漏水偵測率為95.83%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume 96 expected daily records and 92 received. Completeness C=92/96=95.83%; four missing records do not imply 95.83% leak-detection probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：除了筆數比例，另報最大連續缺值、事件時段覆蓋及資料延遲，將通訊狀態與供電紀錄對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Report maximum consecutive gap, event-period coverage and latency alongside record count, comparing communications with power logs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「遙測缺值與資料完整性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Telemetry gaps and data completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 除了筆數比例，另報最大連續缺值、事件時段覆蓋及資料延遲，將通訊狀態與供電紀錄對照。保留原值、補值與缺值標記，讓夜流和突變分析能排除不適合的重建資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Report maximum consecutive gap, event-period coverage and latency alongside record count, comparing communications with power logs. Preserve flags for original, imputed and missing values so night-flow and change-detection analyses can exclude unsuitable reconstructed data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較連續四筆缺值與四筆零星缺值對夜流及突變分析的影響，保留相同完整率。為事件偵測設定需要的資料證據，避免只用一個百分比評分系統。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare four consecutive gaps with four scattered gaps for night-flow and change analysis at identical completeness. Specify evidence needed for event detection rather than scoring the system with one percentage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：資料完整率很高仍可能漏掉唯一一次短時爆管，插值又可能將突變平滑成普通需求；若儀表中斷與停電共同發生，缺值還會與真正風險系統相關。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High completeness can still miss the only short burst, and interpolation can smooth its change into ordinary demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Report maximum consecutive gap, event-period coverage and latency alongside record count, comparing communications with power logs. Preserve flags for original, imputed and missing values so night-flow and change-detection analyses can exclude unsuitable reconstructed data.
