quiz.question: 要驗證「遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
除了筆數比例，另報最大連續缺值、事件時段覆蓋及資料延遲，將通訊狀態與供電紀錄對照。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
Report maximum consecutive gap, event-period coverage and latency alongside record count, comparing communications with power logs.
quiz.explanation: 除了筆數比例，另報最大連續缺值、事件時段覆蓋及資料延遲，將通訊狀態與供電紀錄對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Report maximum consecutive gap, event-period coverage and latency alongside record count, comparing communications with power logs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遙測缺值與資料完整性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Telemetry gaps and data completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 資料完整率很高仍可能漏掉唯一一次短時爆管，插值又可能將突變平滑成普通需求；若儀表中斷與停電共同發生，缺值還會與真正風險系統相關。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High completeness can still miss the only short burst, and interpolation can smooth its change into ordinary demand. If meter interruption accompanies a power outage, missingness can also be systematically related to actual risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只計預期筆數中的收件比例，沒有評估缺值時段長度與重要性；相同百分比可能對應一段連續缺值或零星遺失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same percentage can represent one continuous outage or scattered missing samples.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「資料收到九成五就表示漏水事件也一定能偵測九成五。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Receiving ninety-five percent of records guarantees detecting ninety-five percent of leaks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 資料完整率很高仍可能漏掉唯一一次短時爆管，插值又可能將突變平滑成普通需求；若儀表中斷與停電共同發生，缺值還會與真正風險系統相關。
knowledge.textEn: High completeness can still miss the only short burst, and interpolation can smooth its change into ordinary demand. If meter interruption accompanies a power outage, missingness can also be systematically related to actual risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「遙測缺值與資料完整性機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Telemetry gaps and data completeness mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 資料完整率很高仍可能漏掉唯一一次短時爆管，插值又可能將突變平滑成普通需求；若儀表中斷與停電共同發生，缺值還會與真正風險系統相關。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。
optionsEn: High completeness can still miss the only short burst, and interpolation can smooth its change into ordinary demand.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved.
quiz.explanation: 資料完整率很高仍可能漏掉唯一一次短時爆管，插值又可能將突變平滑成普通需求；若儀表中斷與停電共同發生，缺值還會與真正風險系統相關。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High completeness can still miss the only short burst, and interpolation can smooth its change into ordinary demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「改善成效與不確定度」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intervention effect and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水損改善的判斷需要可比的壓力、需求、邊界與表計條件，原始前後差值不能自動歸因於修復。殘差通常是多個大體積相減，單項不確定度即使不大，合成後仍可能接近改善量；系統偏差不能用獨立隨機誤差的平方和公式掩蓋，應另列情境。以下合成式只適用互相獨立的標準不確定度，沒有把結果當成信賴區間；若來源相關，需加入共變異數或使用適當界限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「改善成效與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Assessing loss reduction needs comparable pressure, demand, boundaries and metering, so a raw before-and-after difference cannot automatically be credited to repair. Residuals often subtract large volumes, and combined uncertainty can approach the claimed benefit even when each component seems modest. Systematic biases require separate scenarios rather than being hidden inside an independent random-error sum. The combination applies only to independent standard uncertainties and is not itself a confidence interval. Correlated sources require covariance terms or appropriate bounds. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Intervention effect and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「改善成效與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Intervention effect and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 水損改善的判斷需要可比的壓力、需求、邊界與表計條件，原始前後差值不能自動歸因於修復。殘差通常是多個大體積相減，單項不確定度即使不大，合成後仍可能接近改善量；系統偏差不能用獨立隨機誤差的平方和公式掩蓋，應另列情境。
knowledge.textEn: Assessing loss reduction needs comparable pressure, demand, boundaries and metering, so a raw before-and-after difference cannot automatically be credited to repair. Residuals often subtract large volumes, and combined uncertainty can approach the claimed benefit even when each component seems modest.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。
水損改善的判斷需要可比的壓力、需求、邊界與表計條件，原始前後差值不能自動歸因於修復。
入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。
optionsEn: Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved.
Assessing loss reduction needs comparable pressure, demand, boundaries and metering, so a raw before-and-after difference cannot automatically be credited to repair.
Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
quiz.explanation: 水損改善的判斷需要可比的壓力、需求、邊界與表計條件，原始前後差值不能自動歸因於修復。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Assessing loss reduction needs comparable pressure, demand, boundaries and metering, so a raw before-and-after difference cannot automatically be credited to repair. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改善成效與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Intervention effect and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。
夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。
optionsEn: A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased.
The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改善成效與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Intervention effect and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。使用未受施工影響的比較區或多日重複觀察檢查其他變因，並將共同偏差與統計散布分開呈現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage. Use an unaffected comparison district or repeated days to examine other changes, presenting shared bias separately from statistical scatter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一個假設改善量與合成不確定度並列，再列出壓力及需求不匹配造成的系統情境。說明哪些結論已受資料支持、哪些仍需延長觀察或增加獨立計量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place an assumed improvement beside combined uncertainty, then list systematic scenarios from unmatched pressure and demand. Distinguish supported conclusions from those needing longer observation or additional independent metering.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。使用未受施工影響的比較區或多日重複觀察檢查其他變因，並將共同偏差與統計散布分開呈現。
knowledge.textEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage. Use an unaffected comparison district or repeated days to examine other changes, presenting shared bias separately from statistical scatter.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一個假設改善量與合成不確定度並列，再列出壓力及需求不匹配造成的系統情境。說明哪些結論已受資料支持、哪些仍需延長觀察或增加獨立計量。
knowledge.textEn: Place an assumed improvement beside combined uncertainty, then list systematic scenarios from unmatched pressure and demand. Distinguish supported conclusions from those needing longer observation or additional independent metering.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification"?
options: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。
optionsEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Calibrated meters do not require checks of their reporting time windows.
quiz.explanation: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改善成效與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Intervention effect and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. Shared calibration bias or changed district boundaries can also create an apparently substantial improvement between the two periods. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以下合成式只適用互相獨立的標準不確定度，沒有把結果當成信賴區間；若來源相關，需加入共變異數或使用適當界限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated sources require covariance terms or appropriate bounds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。
knowledge.textEn: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. Shared calibration bias or changed district boundaries can also create an apparently substantial improvement between the two periods.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。
入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions.
Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
quiz.explanation: 若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 沉箱式防波堤施工
summary: 沿製造浮運到基床受力追蹤沉箱防波堤的狀態變化。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Track caisson-breakwater state changes from fabrication and flotation to foundation loading. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。假設混凝土材料體積由1000增10%至1100m³、密度固定2400kg/m³，重量由23544增至25898.4kN；浮體的排水體積和重心必須另行更新，不能宣稱浮穩同步改善10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy. Increasing concrete volume from1000 to1100m³ by10% at fixed2400kg/m³ changes weight from23544 to25898.4kN. Displacement and gravity center require separate updates; stability does not automatically improve by10%. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混凝土量與重量」與「靜態吃水平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concrete volume and weight" and "Static draft equilibrium": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混凝土量與重量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume and weight: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土量與重量」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete volume and weight” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉箱的外包體積、混凝土材料體積與填艙材料量是不同量，浮運和落床分析不能交換使用。重量需要逐項配平，鋼筋、臨時設備和殘留水亦會改變重心；只看外部尺寸並不能得出可靠排水量。 假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。 水下材料重量與浮運排水重量屬不同控制體，列式時必須保持同一受力邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土量與重量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Envelope volume, concrete volume and ballast quantity are different quantities and cannot be exchanged between floating and seated conditions. Weight accounting also includes reinforcement, temporary equipment and retained water, all of which can shift the center of gravity despite unchanged outer dimensions. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy. Submerged material weight and whole-body floating displacement use different control volumes, requiring a consistent force boundary when assembling equilibrium. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete volume and weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混凝土量與重量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Concrete volume and weight”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混凝土量與重量
knowledge.text: 沉箱的外包體積、混凝土材料體積與填艙材料量是不同量，浮運和落床分析不能交換使用。重量需要逐項配平，鋼筋、臨時設備和殘留水亦會改變重心；只看外部尺寸並不能得出可靠排水量。
knowledge.textEn: Envelope volume, concrete volume and ballast quantity are different quantities and cannot be exchanged between floating and seated conditions. Weight accounting also includes reinforcement, temporary equipment and retained water, all of which can shift the center of gravity despite unchanged outer dimensions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土量與重量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concrete volume and weight" is correct?
options: 沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。
沉箱的外包體積、混凝土材料體積與填艙材料量是不同量，浮運和落床分析不能交換使用。
平均吃水吻合就可忽略四角差異與艙口進水可能。
optionsEn: Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass.
Envelope volume, concrete volume and ballast quantity are different quantities and cannot be exchanged between floating and seated conditions.
Matching mean draft makes corner differences and flooding through openings irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 沉箱的外包體積、混凝土材料體積與填艙材料量是不同量，浮運和落床分析不能交換使用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Envelope volume, concrete volume and ballast quantity are different quantities and cannot be exchanged between floating and seated conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混凝土量與重量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume and weight: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土量與重量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete volume and weight” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依竣工尺寸與材料密度建立重量分項表，核對鋼筋、設備和艙水是否重複或遺漏。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a weight schedule from actual geometry and densities, checking reinforcement, equipment and tank water for omission or duplication.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「混凝土量與重量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Concrete volume and weight", which statement holds?
options: 艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。
底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect.
Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混凝土量與重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume and weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土量與重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete volume and weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依竣工尺寸與材料密度建立重量分項表，核對鋼筋、設備和艙水是否重複或遺漏。用吃水及已知海水密度作獨立平衡檢查，追查差異而非調整密度湊合。將重量表各分項回連到量測證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a weight schedule from actual geometry and densities, checking reinforcement, equipment and tank water for omission or duplication. Independently compare draft and water density, investigating discrepancies rather than tuning density to fit. Link each weight-schedule entry to its measurement evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：依竣工尺寸與材料密度建立重量分項表，核對鋼筋、設備和艙水是否重複或遺漏。用吃水及已知海水密度作獨立平衡檢查，追查差異而非調整密度湊合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a weight schedule from actual geometry and densities, checking reinforcement, equipment and tank water for omission or duplication. Independently compare draft and water density, investigating discrepancies rather than tuning density to fit.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Static draft equilibrium” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整密閉浮體在靜水中以排開水的重量平衡自重，矩形水線面才可用常面積直接換算吃水。艙口進水、外形變化和水面傾斜會改變條件，因此初步計算不能取代實際浮運狀態的檢查。 假設總質量2460000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，吃水T=m/(ρA)=6m；側高10m時靜態乾舷4m。 乾舷還須按可能先進水的開口高程判斷，外牆最高點不是唯一相關高度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「靜態吃水平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sealed body at rest balances its weight with displaced water, and a constant rectangular waterplane permits direct draft conversion. Flooding, changing exterior geometry and heel alter the assumptions, so this initial calculation cannot replace verification of the actual floating condition. Assume mass2460000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². Draft T=m/(ρA)=6m; a10m side gives static freeboard4m. Freeboard also depends on openings that can admit water first; the highest exterior wall point is not the only relevant elevation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Static draft equilibrium” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 艙內漏水會使吃水增加並可能降低乾舷，僅讀取一側吃水又會漏掉傾斜。靜態平均值看似符合計算時，另一角仍可能先進水並改變整個浮力邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal flooding increases draft and may reduce freeboard, while one-sided readings miss heel. Even a matching mean draft can conceal an exposed corner that floods first and changes the complete buoyancy boundary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：乾舷還須按可能先進水的開口高程判斷，外牆最高點不是唯一相關高度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Freeboard also depends on openings that can admit water first; the highest exterior wall point is not the only relevant elevation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均吃水吻合就可忽略四角差異與艙口進水可能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching mean draft makes corner differences and flooding through openings irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 艙內漏水會使吃水增加並可能降低乾舷，僅讀取一側吃水又會漏掉傾斜。靜態平均值看似符合計算時，另一角仍可能先進水並改變整個浮力邊界。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「靜態吃水平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Static draft equilibrium" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。
艙內漏水會使吃水增加並可能降低乾舷，僅讀取一側吃水又會漏掉傾斜。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition.
Internal flooding increases draft and may reduce freeboard, while one-sided readings miss heel.
quiz.explanation: 艙內漏水會使吃水增加並可能降低乾舷，僅讀取一側吃水又會漏掉傾斜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal flooding increases draft and may reduce freeboard, while one-sided readings miss heel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「初穩性幾何尺度」與「艙內自由液面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Initial stability geometry" and "Internal free-surface effect": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 初穩性幾何尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Initial stability geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「初穩性幾何尺度」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Initial stability geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小角度浮穩分析以浮心、重心和水線面慣性矩建立初穩心高度，與大角度復原力臂並不相同。水線形狀和轉動軸必須明示，不能用一個正值保證拖航中所有波浪、風力及進水情境都穩定。 假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。 初穩性公式的排水體積必須對應當下吃水，改變配重後不能只更新重心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「初穩性幾何尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small-angle stability uses buoyancy center, gravity center and waterplane second moment to obtain metacentric height, not the full large-angle righting arm. Define the waterplane and rotation axis explicitly; a positive value cannot qualify every towing, wind, wave or flooding case. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m. The displacement volume in initial stability must match current draft; after ballasting, updating gravity center alone is not sufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Initial stability geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「初穩性幾何尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Initial stability geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 初穩性幾何尺度
knowledge.text: 小角度浮穩分析以浮心、重心和水線面慣性矩建立初穩心高度，與大角度復原力臂並不相同。水線形狀和轉動軸必須明示，不能用一個正值保證拖航中所有波浪、風力及進水情境都穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Small-angle stability uses buoyancy center, gravity center and waterplane second moment to obtain metacentric height, not the full large-angle righting arm. Define the waterplane and rotation axis explicitly; a positive value cannot qualify every towing, wind, wave or flooding case.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「初穩性幾何尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Initial stability geometry" is correct?
options: 小角度浮穩分析以浮心、重心和水線面慣性矩建立初穩心高度，與大角度復原力臂並不相同。
初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。
艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。
optionsEn: Small-angle stability uses buoyancy center, gravity center and waterplane second moment to obtain metacentric height, not the full large-angle righting arm.
Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition.
An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect.
quiz.explanation: 小角度浮穩分析以浮心、重心和水線面慣性矩建立初穩心高度，與大角度復原力臂並不相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small-angle stability uses buoyancy center, gravity center and waterplane second moment to obtain metacentric height, not the full large-angle righting arm. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 初穩性幾何尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Initial stability geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「初穩性幾何尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Initial stability geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「初穩性幾何尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Initial stability geometry", which statement holds?
options: 底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。
optionsEn: Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 初穩性幾何尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Initial stability geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「初穩性幾何尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Initial stability geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。再檢查艙內自由液面及可能進水位置，把小角線性結果與完整浮穩需求分開。再以排水質量驗算當下浮力平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Check internal free surfaces and flooding openings separately, distinguishing the small-angle result from complete stability requirements. Recheck current buoyancy against the displacement mass. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。再檢查艙內自由液面及可能進水位置，把小角線性結果與完整浮穩需求分開。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Check internal free surfaces and flooding openings separately, distinguishing the small-angle result from complete stability requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軸向用錯會把長寬差異轉成巨大剛度誤差，重心漏算又會高估復原能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the wrong axis transforms length-width differences into a major stiffness error, while omitted weights overstate righting ability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。再檢查艙內自由液面及可能進水位置，把小角線性結果與完整浮穩需求分開。再以排水質量驗算當下浮力平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Check internal free surfaces and flooding openings separately, distinguishing the small-angle result from complete stability requirements. Recheck current buoyancy against the displacement mass.

knowledge.text: 在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。再檢查艙內自由液面及可能進水位置，把小角線性結果與完整浮穩需求分開。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Check internal free surfaces and flooding openings separately, distinguishing the small-angle result from complete stability requirements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「初穩性幾何尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Initial stability geometry"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。
在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers.
quiz.explanation: 在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 艙內自由液面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal free-surface effect: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「艙內自由液面」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Internal free-surface effect” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 部分裝滿的艙液會隨浮體傾斜移動，等效降低初穩性；全空或全滿的情況不能套同一自由液面修正。液面慣性矩與連通範圍比液體總量更重要，因此分艙完整性是浮穩模型的一部分。 假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。 修正也取決於艙液與外水的密度比，不同液體時不能直接省略該係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「艙內自由液面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Liquid in a partially filled tank shifts with heel and reduces initial stability. Empty and pressed-full tanks do not share this correction. Surface second moment and connected extent matter more than liquid quantity alone, making compartment integrity part of the stability model. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation. The correction also depends on the density ratio between tank liquid and surrounding water, which cannot be omitted for different liquids. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Internal free-surface effect” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「艙內自由液面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Internal free-surface effect”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 艙內自由液面
knowledge.text: 部分裝滿的艙液會隨浮體傾斜移動，等效降低初穩性；全空或全滿的情況不能套同一自由液面修正。液面慣性矩與連通範圍比液體總量更重要，因此分艙完整性是浮穩模型的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Liquid in a partially filled tank shifts with heel and reduces initial stability. Empty and pressed-full tanks do not share this correction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「艙內自由液面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal free-surface effect" is correct?
options: 艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。
部分裝滿的艙液會隨浮體傾斜移動，等效降低初穩性；全空或全滿的情況不能套同一自由液面修正。
計算出平均吃水增量後就能直接指定現場配重操作順序。
optionsEn: An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect.
Liquid in a partially filled tank shifts with heel and reduces initial stability.
A calculated mean draft increment directly determines the field ballasting sequence.
quiz.explanation: 部分裝滿的艙液會隨浮體傾斜移動，等效降低初穩性；全空或全滿的情況不能套同一自由液面修正。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Liquid in a partially filled tank shifts with heel and reduces initial stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 艙內自由液面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal free-surface effect: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「艙內自由液面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Internal free-surface effect” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「艙內自由液面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal free-surface effect", which statement holds?
options: 沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。
兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance.
Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 艙內自由液面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal free-surface effect: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「艙內自由液面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Internal free-surface effect” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。比較隔艙完整與連通的模型，並保存任何配置變更的浮穩再評估紀錄。明列艙水與外水的密度比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Compare isolated and connected compartments and retain the stability reassessment for every configuration change. State the tank-liquid to surrounding-water density ratio explicitly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。比較隔艙完整與連通的模型，並保存任何配置變更的浮穩再評估紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Compare isolated and connected compartments and retain the stability reassessment for every configuration change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隔板開孔造成原先獨立液面連通時，慣性矩可大幅增加；只看總艙水量不變會漏掉穩性下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Openings that connect previously separate tanks can greatly increase surface second moment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。比較隔艙完整與連通的模型，並保存任何配置變更的浮穩再評估紀錄。明列艙水與外水的密度比。
knowledge.textEn: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Compare isolated and connected compartments and retain the stability reassessment for every configuration change. State the tank-liquid to surrounding-water density ratio explicitly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。比較隔艙完整與連通的模型，並保存任何配置變更的浮穩再評估紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Compare isolated and connected compartments and retain the stability reassessment for every configuration change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「艙內自由液面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal free-surface effect"?
options: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。
optionsEn: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass.
quiz.explanation: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 艙內自由液面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal free-surface effect: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「艙內自由液面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Internal free-surface effect” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隔板開孔造成原先獨立液面連通時，慣性矩可大幅增加；只看總艙水量不變會漏掉穩性下降。液位誤判為全滿也可能完全省略實際存在的自由液面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Openings that connect previously separate tanks can greatly increase surface second moment. Unchanged total water volume conceals lost stability, and incorrectly declaring a tank full can omit an existing free surface entirely. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修正也取決於艙液與外水的密度比，不同液體時不能直接省略該係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The correction also depends on the density ratio between tank liquid and surrounding water, which cannot be omitted for different liquids.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隔板開孔造成原先獨立液面連通時，慣性矩可大幅增加；只看總艙水量不變會漏掉穩性下降。液位誤判為全滿也可能完全省略實際存在的自由液面。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「艙內自由液面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal free-surface effect" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
隔板開孔造成原先獨立液面連通時，慣性矩可大幅增加；只看總艙水量不變會漏掉穩性下降。
計算出平均吃水增量後就能直接指定現場配重操作順序。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Openings that connect previously separate tanks can greatly increase surface second moment.
A calculated mean draft increment directly determines the field ballasting sequence.
quiz.explanation: 隔板開孔造成原先獨立液面連通時，慣性矩可大幅增加；只看總艙水量不變會漏掉穩性下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Openings that connect previously separate tanks can greatly increase surface second moment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ballast and draft increment" and "Base-uplift integration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 配重與吃水增量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ballast and draft increment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「配重與吃水增量」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ballast and draft increment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增加配重會增加排水量，但各艙位置也決定傾斜和結構內力。常水線面換算只能估平均吃水增量，不能推定所有角點同步下沉，也不能以這個靜力算式指揮實際沉放程序。 假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。 吃水增量與波浪造成的瞬時角點運動不同，量測比較應採對應的時間平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「配重與吃水增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Added ballast increases displacement while its location changes heel and internal actions. A constant-waterplane conversion estimates mean draft increment only; it does not imply equal movement at every corner or authorize an actual lowering sequence from this static calculation. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition. Draft increment differs from instantaneous corner motion caused by waves, so measurement comparisons require a matching averaging period and definition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ballast and draft increment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A calculated mean draft increment directly determines the field ballasting sequence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ballast and draft increment" is correct?
options: 計算出平均吃水增量後就能直接指定現場配重操作順序。
底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。

Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.

quiz.explanation: 增加配重會增加排水量，但各艙位置也決定傾斜和結構內力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 配重與吃水增量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ballast and draft increment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「配重與吃水增量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ballast and draft increment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「配重與吃水增量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ballast and draft increment", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。
已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact.
Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 配重與吃水增量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ballast and draft increment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「配重與吃水增量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ballast and draft increment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。以受核准的施工控制紀錄比較預測與量測，不用平均吃水掩蓋局部傾斜或設備故障。檢查吃水量測的時間平均窗口。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Use the approved construction-control record to investigate disagreement without hiding heel or equipment faults behind mean draft. Check the averaging window used for draft observations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。以受核准的施工控制紀錄比較預測與量測，不用平均吃水掩蓋局部傾斜或設備故障。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Use the approved construction-control record to investigate disagreement without hiding heel or equipment faults behind mean draft.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一側閥件或量測失效可能使平均增重正確但傾斜快速擴大，艙內自由液面也可能同時改變；若只依總重量完成指標，便會漏掉真正控制過渡狀態的介面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A one-sided valve or measurement fault can produce the correct total added mass while heel grows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。以受核准的施工控制紀錄比較預測與量測，不用平均吃水掩蓋局部傾斜或設備故障。檢查吃水量測的時間平均窗口。
knowledge.textEn: Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Use the approved construction-control record to investigate disagreement without hiding heel or equipment faults behind mean draft. Check the averaging window used for draft observations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。以受核准的施工控制紀錄比較預測與量測，不用平均吃水掩蓋局部傾斜或設備故障。
knowledge.textEn: Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Use the approved construction-control record to investigate disagreement without hiding heel or equipment faults behind mean draft.

quiz.question: 要驗證「配重與吃水增量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ballast and draft increment"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。
平均吃水吻合就可忽略四角差異與艙口進水可能。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels.
Matching mean draft makes corner differences and flooding through openings irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 配重與吃水增量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ballast and draft increment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「配重與吃水增量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ballast and draft increment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一側閥件或量測失效可能使平均增重正確但傾斜快速擴大，艙內自由液面也可能同時改變；若只依總重量完成指標，便會漏掉真正控制過渡狀態的介面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A one-sided valve or measurement fault can produce the correct total added mass while heel grows. Free-surface effects may change simultaneously, so total-weight completion alone misses the interface governing the transition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吃水增量與波浪造成的瞬時角點運動不同，量測比較應採對應的時間平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Draft increment differs from instantaneous corner motion caused by waves, so measurement comparisons require a matching averaging period and definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計算出平均吃水增量後就能直接指定現場配重操作順序。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A calculated mean draft increment directly determines the field ballasting sequence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一側閥件或量測失效可能使平均增重正確但傾斜快速擴大，艙內自由液面也可能同時改變；若只依總重量完成指標，便會漏掉真正控制過渡狀態的介面。
knowledge.textEn: A one-sided valve or measurement fault can produce the correct total added mass while heel grows. Free-surface effects may change simultaneously, so total-weight completion alone misses the interface governing the transition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「配重與吃水增量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ballast and draft increment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。
一側閥件或量測失效可能使平均增重正確但傾斜快速擴大，艙內自由液面也可能同時改變；若只依總重量完成指標，便會漏掉真正控制過渡狀態的介面。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.
A one-sided valve or measurement fault can produce the correct total added mass while heel grows.
quiz.explanation: 一側閥件或量測失效可能使平均增重正確但傾斜快速擴大，艙內自由液面也可能同時改變；若只依總重量完成指標，便會漏掉真正控制過渡狀態的介面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A one-sided valve or measurement fault can produce the correct total added mass while heel grows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 底面揚壓積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-uplift integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底面揚壓積分」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base-uplift integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 落床沉箱底面水壓減少有效壓力接觸，分布取決於滲流、排水與波浪傳遞。兩端線性插值是一個假設，不是所有基床都會呈現的真實形狀；合力與作用點都會影響滑動和偏心。 假設每米堤長、底寬20m，底壓由80線性降至20kPa，U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m；未計時變壓力。 底壓作用點還決定傾覆力矩，相同揚壓總量不代表相同底面接觸狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底面揚壓積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure beneath a seated caisson reduces effective contact and depends on seepage, drainage and wave transmission. Linear interpolation between edges is an assumption rather than a universal foundation pattern. Both resultant and location influence sliding and eccentric response. Assume unit breakwater length,20m base width and linear pressure from80 to20kPa. U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m, excluding time variation. The uplift application point also determines moment, so equal total uplift does not imply an identical foundation contact-pressure distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base-uplift integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「底面揚壓積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base-uplift integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 底面揚壓積分
knowledge.text: 落床沉箱底面水壓減少有效壓力接觸，分布取決於滲流、排水與波浪傳遞。兩端線性插值是一個假設，不是所有基床都會呈現的真實形狀；合力與作用點都會影響滑動和偏心。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure beneath a seated caisson reduces effective contact and depends on seepage, drainage and wave transmission. Linear interpolation between edges is an assumption rather than a universal foundation pattern.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「底面揚壓積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-uplift integration" is correct?
options: 落床沉箱底面水壓減少有效壓力接觸，分布取決於滲流、排水與波浪傳遞。
底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。
沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。
optionsEn: Pressure beneath a seated caisson reduces effective contact and depends on seepage, drainage and wave transmission.
Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.
A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance.
quiz.explanation: 落床沉箱底面水壓減少有效壓力接觸，分布取決於滲流、排水與波浪傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure beneath a seated caisson reduces effective contact and depends on seepage, drainage and wave transmission. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base-uplift integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。將揚壓積分和接觸反力核對，另列波峰與波谷可能不同的傳壓相位。另外積分壓力對底面中心的力矩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity. Compare integrated uplift with contact reaction, documenting different transmission phases at wave crests and troughs rather than mixing them. Integrate the pressure moment about the base center separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。將揚壓積分和接觸反力核對，另列波峰與波谷可能不同的傳壓相位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity. Compare integrated uplift with contact reaction, documenting different transmission phases at wave crests and troughs rather than mixing them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底面中部高壓可能被端點量測漏掉，排水堵塞也會改變分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An internal pressure high can escape edge measurements, and blocked drainage changes the distribution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity. Compare integrated uplift with contact reaction, documenting different transmission phases at wave crests and troughs rather than mixing them. Integrate the pressure moment about the base center separately.

knowledge.text: 用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。將揚壓積分和接觸反力核對，另列波峰與波谷可能不同的傳壓相位。
