quiz.question: 要驗證「底面揚壓積分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base-uplift integration"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。
用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition.
Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity.
quiz.explanation: 用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 底面揚壓積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-uplift integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底面揚壓積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base-uplift integration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 底面中部高壓可能被端點量測漏掉，排水堵塞也會改變分布。把不同時刻的壓力峰值任意拼在一起，則可能製造不存在的合力與偏心，兩種錯誤方向都需查核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An internal pressure high can escape edge measurements, and blocked drainage changes the distribution. Combining unrelated peak times can instead create a nonexistent force and eccentricity; both error directions require investigation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：底壓作用點還決定傾覆力矩，相同揚壓總量不代表相同底面接觸狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The uplift application point also determines moment, so equal total uplift does not imply an identical foundation contact-pressure distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 底面中部高壓可能被端點量測漏掉，排水堵塞也會改變分布。把不同時刻的壓力峰值任意拼在一起，則可能製造不存在的合力與偏心，兩種錯誤方向都需查核。
knowledge.textEn: An internal pressure high can escape edge measurements, and blocked drainage changes the distribution. Combining unrelated peak times can instead create a nonexistent force and eccentricity; both error directions require investigation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「底面揚壓積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-uplift integration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 底面中部高壓可能被端點量測漏掉，排水堵塞也會改變分布。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。
optionsEn: An internal pressure high can escape edge measurements, and blocked drainage changes the distribution.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance.
quiz.explanation: 底面中部高壓可能被端點量測漏掉，排水堵塞也會改變分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An internal pressure high can escape edge measurements, and blocked drainage changes the distribution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「滑動平衡的界限」與「偏心與全接觸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Limits of sliding equilibrium" and "Eccentricity and full contact": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 滑動平衡的界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Limits of sliding equilibrium: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滑動平衡的界限」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Limits of sliding equilibrium” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡化摩擦抵抗以有效法向力為基礎，底面揚壓不能忽略。摩擦係數受材料和接觸狀態影響，動態荷載、搖擺與地基破壞則另有機制；一個比值不能涵蓋所有施工與使用狀態。 假設每米W=4000kN、U=1000kN、μ=0.6、H=1500kN，R=μ(W−U)=1800kN，R/H=1.20；非規範安全係數。 水平與垂直動載若不同相位，摩擦餘裕的最小時刻不一定是最大水平力時刻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滑動平衡的界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A friction estimate depends on effective normal force, including uplift reduction. Interface material and condition govern the coefficient, while dynamic loading, rocking and foundation failure involve additional mechanisms. One equilibrium ratio does not cover every construction and operational state. Assume per-metre W=4000kN, U=1000kN, μ=0.6 and H=1500kN. R=1800kN and R/H=1.20, not a code safety factor. With phase differences between horizontal and vertical dynamics, the minimum friction margin need not occur at the peak horizontal force. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Limits of sliding equilibrium” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滑動平衡的界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Limits of sliding equilibrium”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滑動平衡的界限
knowledge.text: 簡化摩擦抵抗以有效法向力為基礎，底面揚壓不能忽略。摩擦係數受材料和接觸狀態影響，動態荷載、搖擺與地基破壞則另有機制；一個比值不能涵蓋所有施工與使用狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A friction estimate depends on effective normal force, including uplift reduction. Interface material and condition govern the coefficient, while dynamic loading, rocking and foundation failure involve additional mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滑動平衡的界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Limits of sliding equilibrium" is correct?
options: 沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。
簡化摩擦抵抗以有效法向力為基礎，底面揚壓不能忽略。
偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。
optionsEn: A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance.
A friction estimate depends on effective normal force, including uplift reduction.
Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact.
quiz.explanation: 簡化摩擦抵抗以有效法向力為基礎，底面揚壓不能忽略。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A friction estimate depends on effective normal force, including uplift reduction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滑動平衡的界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Limits of sliding equilibrium: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滑動平衡的界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Limits of sliding equilibrium” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米W=4000kN、U=1000kN、μ=0.6、H=1500kN，R=μ(W−U)=1800kN，R/H=1.20；非規範安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre W=4000kN, U=1000kN, μ=0.6 and H=1500kN. R=1800kN and R/H=1.20, not a code safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米W=4000kN、U=1000kN、μ=0.6、H=1500kN，R=μ(W−U)=1800kN，R/H=1.20；非規範安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre W=4000kN, U=1000kN, μ=0.6 and H=1500kN. R=1800kN and R/H=1.20, not a code safety factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「滑動平衡的界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Limits of sliding equilibrium", which statement holds?
options: 已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。
平均吃水吻合就可忽略四角差異與艙口進水可能。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
Matching mean draft makes corner differences and flooding through openings irrelevant.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滑動平衡的界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Limits of sliding equilibrium: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滑動平衡的界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Limits of sliding equilibrium” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。再分別列出地基、傾覆及接觸不完整的檢查，避免用一個比例替代多種失效。檢查同時刻的水平力與底面揚壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Separately assess foundation behavior, overturning and incomplete contact instead of substituting one ratio for multiple mechanisms. Check horizontal load and uplift at matching times. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。再分別列出地基、傾覆及接觸不完整的檢查，避免用一個比例替代多種失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Separately assess foundation behavior, overturning and incomplete contact instead of substituting one ratio for multiple mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：揚壓上升會在外觀重量不變時降低接觸反力，底面細料流失也可能改變摩擦條件；若沿用初期乾接觸係數，計算上的餘裕會比實際系統更樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rising uplift reduces contact while visible weight remains unchanged, and loss of fines changes the interface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。再分別列出地基、傾覆及接觸不完整的檢查，避免用一個比例替代多種失效。檢查同時刻的水平力與底面揚壓。
knowledge.textEn: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Separately assess foundation behavior, overturning and incomplete contact instead of substituting one ratio for multiple mechanisms. Check horizontal load and uplift at matching times.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。再分別列出地基、傾覆及接觸不完整的檢查，避免用一個比例替代多種失效。
knowledge.textEn: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Separately assess foundation behavior, overturning and incomplete contact instead of substituting one ratio for multiple mechanisms.

quiz.question: 要驗證「滑動平衡的界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Limits of sliding equilibrium"?
options: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。
optionsEn: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect.
quiz.explanation: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 滑動平衡的界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Limits of sliding equilibrium: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滑動平衡的界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Limits of sliding equilibrium” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 揚壓上升會在外觀重量不變時降低接觸反力，底面細料流失也可能改變摩擦條件；若沿用初期乾接觸係數，計算上的餘裕會比實際系統更樂觀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rising uplift reduces contact while visible weight remains unchanged, and loss of fines changes the interface. Retaining an initial dry-contact coefficient can therefore overstate the margin of the actual submerged foundation system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水平與垂直動載若不同相位，摩擦餘裕的最小時刻不一定是最大水平力時刻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With phase differences between horizontal and vertical dynamics, the minimum friction margin need not occur at the peak horizontal force.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 揚壓上升會在外觀重量不變時降低接觸反力，底面細料流失也可能改變摩擦條件；若沿用初期乾接觸係數，計算上的餘裕會比實際系統更樂觀。
knowledge.textEn: Rising uplift reduces contact while visible weight remains unchanged, and loss of fines changes the interface. Retaining an initial dry-contact coefficient can therefore overstate the margin of the actual submerged foundation system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滑動平衡的界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Limits of sliding equilibrium" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
揚壓上升會在外觀重量不變時降低接觸反力，底面細料流失也可能改變摩擦條件；若沿用初期乾接觸係數，計算上的餘裕會比實際系統更樂觀。
偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Rising uplift reduces contact while visible weight remains unchanged, and loss of fines changes the interface.
Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact.
quiz.explanation: 揚壓上升會在外觀重量不變時降低接觸反力，底面細料流失也可能改變摩擦條件；若沿用初期乾接觸係數，計算上的餘裕會比實際系統更樂觀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rising uplift reduces contact while visible weight remains unchanged, and loss of fines changes the interface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 偏心與全接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentricity and full contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心與全接觸」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentricity and full contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 垂直合力的偏心會改變底面壓力，矩形底面在線彈性全接觸假設下才有核心界線。邊緣計算壓力降為零表示接觸模型來到界限，超出後應改用不承拉接觸，而非讓地基承受虛構拉力。 假設每米N=2000kN、M=4000kN·m、B=12m，e=M/N=2m=B/6；qmax=333.3kPa、qmin=0，為全接觸邊界。 這個壓力圖只處理接觸分布，不包含基床材料強度或循環退化的判定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心與全接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric vertical force redistributes base pressure. The rectangular kern applies to a linear full-contact model; zero edge pressure marks its boundary. Beyond that point, use no-tension contact rather than allowing a foundation to resist fictitious tensile pressure. Assume per-metre N=2000kN, M=4000kN·m and B=12m. e=2m=B/6; qmax=333.3kPa and qmin=0 at the full-contact boundary. This pressure diagram addresses contact distribution only; it does not establish bedding-material strength or resistance to deterioration under cyclic loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentricity and full contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心與全接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentricity and full contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偏心與全接觸
knowledge.text: 垂直合力的偏心會改變底面壓力，矩形底面在線彈性全接觸假設下才有核心界線。邊緣計算壓力降為零表示接觸模型來到界限，超出後應改用不承拉接觸，而非讓地基承受虛構拉力。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric vertical force redistributes base pressure. The rectangular kern applies to a linear full-contact model; zero edge pressure marks its boundary.

knowledge.text: 誤解：偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偏心與全接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentricity and full contact" is correct?
options: 偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。
兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。
垂直合力的偏心會改變底面壓力，矩形底面在線彈性全接觸假設下才有核心界線。
optionsEn: Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact.
Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation.
Eccentric vertical force redistributes base pressure.
quiz.explanation: 垂直合力的偏心會改變底面壓力，矩形底面在線彈性全接觸假設下才有核心界線。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric vertical force redistributes base pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偏心與全接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentricity and full contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心與全接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentricity and full contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=2000kN、M=4000kN·m、B=12m，e=M/N=2m=B/6；qmax=333.3kPa、qmin=0，為全接觸邊界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre N=2000kN, M=4000kN·m and B=12m. e=2m=B/6; qmax=333.3kPa and qmin=0 at the full-contact boundary. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明示力矩參考點和正負方向，獨立積分壓力分布重建原法向力與力矩。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State the moment reference and signs, independently integrating pressure to recover force and moment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=2000kN、M=4000kN·m、B=12m，e=M/N=2m=B/6；qmax=333.3kPa、qmin=0，為全接觸邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre N=2000kN, M=4000kN·m and B=12m. e=2m=B/6; qmax=333.3kPa and qmin=0 at the full-contact boundary.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「偏心與全接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentricity and full contact", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。
初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass.
Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偏心與全接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Eccentricity and full contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「偏心與全接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentricity and full contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明示力矩參考點和正負方向，獨立積分壓力分布重建原法向力與力矩。檢查底床平整度、接觸缺口及土體承載，不能把幾何核心條件當成完整承載驗算。以壓力圖積分核對合力作用位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State the moment reference and signs, independently integrating pressure to recover force and moment. Check bedding flatness, gaps and ground resistance; the geometric kern condition is not a complete bearing-capacity assessment. Integrate the pressure diagram to verify the resultant location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the moment reference and signs, independently integrating pressure to recover force and moment. Check bedding flatness, gaps and ground resistance; the geometric kern condition is not a complete bearing-capacity assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接接受負接觸壓力會高估有效承壓面積，局部接觸其實可能集中在狹窄邊緣；平均壓力仍小時，局部地基破壞和沉箱轉動已可能開始。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanation: 直接接受負接觸壓力會高估有效承壓面積，局部接觸其實可能集中在狹窄邊緣；平均壓力仍小時，局部地基破壞和沉箱轉動已可能開始。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting negative contact pressure overstates effective bearing area when actual contact is concentrated near an edge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「差異沉陷與轉角」與「雙側水壓與越流」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential settlement and rotation" and "Two-sided pressure and overflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與轉角」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and rotation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰或同一沉箱兩端的差異沉陷會改變接縫、堤頂和上部設施幾何，並不等同平均下沉。小轉角可由兩點高差估算，但沉箱彎曲或局部支承變形會破壞剛體近似，需要多點資料辨識。 假設兩端相距20m、沉陷差20mm，θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573°；只作剛體小角示意。 多點資料還能辨識局部支承沉陷，兩端連線以外的殘差不應直接當量測噪音。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與轉角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Differential movement changes joints, crest and upper facilities and is distinct from mean settlement. Two-point elevation difference estimates a small rigid-body rotation, but flexure or localized support deformation violates that approximation and requires additional observations to distinguish. Assume endpoints20m apart with20mm differential settlement. θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573° is a small rigid-body illustration. Additional points can reveal localized support movement; residuals away from the endpoint line should not automatically be dismissed as measurement noise. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and rotation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與轉角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異沉陷與轉角
knowledge.text: 相鄰或同一沉箱兩端的差異沉陷會改變接縫、堤頂和上部設施幾何，並不等同平均下沉。小轉角可由兩點高差估算，但沉箱彎曲或局部支承變形會破壞剛體近似，需要多點資料辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Differential movement changes joints, crest and upper facilities and is distinct from mean settlement. Two-point elevation difference estimates a small rigid-body rotation, but flexure or localized support deformation violates that approximation and requires additional observations to distinguish.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷與轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and rotation" is correct?
options: 相鄰或同一沉箱兩端的差異沉陷會改變接縫、堤頂和上部設施幾何，並不等同平均下沉。
兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。
已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。
optionsEn: Differential movement changes joints, crest and upper facilities and is distinct from mean settlement.
Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation.
Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰或同一沉箱兩端的差異沉陷會改變接縫、堤頂和上部設施幾何，並不等同平均下沉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Differential movement changes joints, crest and upper facilities and is distinct from mean settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷與轉角」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩端相距20m、沉陷差20mm，θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573°；只作剛體小角示意。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume endpoints20m apart with20mm differential settlement. θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573° is a small rigid-body illustration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩端相距20m、沉陷差20mm，θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573°；只作剛體小角示意。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume endpoints20m apart with20mm differential settlement. θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573° is a small rigid-body illustration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「差異沉陷與轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential settlement and rotation", which statement holds?
options: 平均吃水吻合就可忽略四角差異與艙口進水可能。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。
optionsEn: Matching mean draft makes corner differences and flooding through openings irrelevant.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與轉角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。把接縫張開與基床量測相互對照，保留無法由剛體模型解釋的變形供調查。檢查中間測點相對剛體線的殘差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Compare joint opening with foundation measurements and preserve deformation that the rigid-body model cannot explain for investigation. Check intermediate observations against the rigid-body line residuals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。把接縫張開與基床量測相互對照，保留無法由剛體模型解釋的變形供調查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Compare joint opening with foundation measurements and preserve deformation that the rigid-body model cannot explain for investigation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準點本身移動會讓整體沉陷被抵銷，僅看兩點又可能把彎曲誤認為旋轉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Movement of the reference hides overall settlement, while two points can confuse flexure with rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。把接縫張開與基床量測相互對照，保留無法由剛體模型解釋的變形供調查。檢查中間測點相對剛體線的殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Compare joint opening with foundation measurements and preserve deformation that the rigid-body model cannot explain for investigation. Check intermediate observations against the rigid-body line residuals.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。把接縫張開與基床量測相互對照，保留無法由剛體模型解釋的變形供調查。
knowledge.textEn: Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Compare joint opening with foundation measurements and preserve deformation that the rigid-body model cannot explain for investigation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異沉陷與轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and rotation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。
以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.
Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals.
quiz.explanation: 以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與轉角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and rotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準點本身移動會讓整體沉陷被抵銷，僅看兩點又可能把彎曲誤認為旋轉。若忽略局部接觸變化，後續止水損壞與上部設備偏移便難以追溯原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Movement of the reference hides overall settlement, while two points can confuse flexure with rotation. Ignoring local contact changes then obscures the causes of later joint leakage or misalignment in the facilities above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多點資料還能辨識局部支承沉陷，兩端連線以外的殘差不應直接當量測噪音。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Additional points can reveal localized support movement; residuals away from the endpoint line should not automatically be dismissed as measurement noise.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基準點本身移動會讓整體沉陷被抵銷，僅看兩點又可能把彎曲誤認為旋轉。若忽略局部接觸變化，後續止水損壞與上部設備偏移便難以追溯原因。
knowledge.textEn: Movement of the reference hides overall settlement, while two points can confuse flexure with rotation. Ignoring local contact changes then obscures the causes of later joint leakage or misalignment in the facilities above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷與轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 基準點本身移動會讓整體沉陷被抵銷，僅看兩點又可能把彎曲誤認為旋轉。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。
optionsEn: Movement of the reference hides overall settlement, while two points can confuse flexure with rotation.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
quiz.explanation: 基準點本身移動會讓整體沉陷被抵銷，僅看兩點又可能把彎曲誤認為旋轉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Movement of the reference hides overall settlement, while two points can confuse flexure with rotation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 雙側水壓與越流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Two-sided pressure and overflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙側水壓與越流」如何影響沉箱式防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-sided pressure and overflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Caisson breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜水壓在兩側分別積分後才可相減，單一水位差乘整面積通常會漏掉壓力分布。越流海嘯可能伴隨背面負壓和基床沖刷，已超出靜水模型；不能將正常潮位算式當成極端事件荷載。 假設同底面起算兩側靜水深8與6m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，每米淨力F=γ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN；非海嘯力。 靜水三角形的作用點位於各水深底部以上三分之一，兩側力矩仍須分開計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙側水壓與越流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure is integrated separately on each side before subtraction; one head difference times the entire wall area generally misses the distribution. Tsunami overflow can include rear suction and foundation scour beyond hydrostatics, so ordinary tide calculations cannot establish extreme-event loading. Assume still depths8m and6m from one base and seawater γ=10.05525kN/m³. Net force per metre isγ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN, not tsunami force. Each hydrostatic triangle acts one-third of its depth above the base, requiring separate moment calculation before subtracting the two sides. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two-sided pressure and overflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙側水壓與越流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Two-sided pressure and overflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙側水壓與越流
knowledge.text: 靜水壓在兩側分別積分後才可相減，單一水位差乘整面積通常會漏掉壓力分布。越流海嘯可能伴隨背面負壓和基床沖刷，已超出靜水模型；不能將正常潮位算式當成極端事件荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrostatic pressure is integrated separately on each side before subtraction; one head difference times the entire wall area generally misses the distribution. Tsunami overflow can include rear suction and foundation scour beyond hydrostatics, so ordinary tide calculations cannot establish extreme-event loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙側水壓與越流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Two-sided pressure and overflow" is correct?
options: 已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。
靜水壓在兩側分別積分後才可相減，單一水位差乘整面積通常會漏掉壓力分布。
沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。
optionsEn: Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
Hydrostatic pressure is integrated separately on each side before subtraction; one head difference times the entire wall area generally misses the distribution.
Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass.
quiz.explanation: 靜水壓在兩側分別積分後才可相減，單一水位差乘整面積通常會漏掉壓力分布。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrostatic pressure is integrated separately on each side before subtraction; one head difference times the entire wall area generally misses the distribution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙側水壓與越流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Two-sided pressure and overflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙側水壓與越流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-sided pressure and overflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同底面起算兩側靜水深8與6m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，每米淨力F=γ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN；非海嘯力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume still depths8m and6m from one base and seawater γ=10.05525kN/m³. Net force per metre isγ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN, not tsunami force. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同底面起算兩側靜水深8與6m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，每米淨力F=γ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN；非海嘯力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume still depths8m and6m from one base and seawater γ=10.05525kN/m³. Net force per metre isγ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN, not tsunami force.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙側水壓與越流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Two-sided pressure and overflow", which statement holds?
options: 初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。
計算出平均吃水增量後就能直接指定現場配重操作順序。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition.
A calculated mean draft increment directly determines the field ballasting sequence.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙側水壓與越流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-sided pressure and overflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙側水壓與越流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-sided pressure and overflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。與水工試驗和事件記錄比對，明列哪些附加作用沒有包含在靜水差值中。分別計算兩側水壓對底部的力矩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Compare hydraulic tests or event records and explicitly list additional actions omitted from the static pressure difference. Calculate each side's pressure moment about the base separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。與水工試驗和事件記錄比對，明列哪些附加作用沒有包含在靜水差值中。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Compare hydraulic tests or event records and explicitly list additional actions omitted from the static pressure difference.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：越流背面吸力會在水位差相同時增加水平作用，沖刷又會削弱支承；只放大靜水力而不更新接觸與底床，可能錯過真正導致沉箱移動的組合機制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rear suction increases horizontal action at unchanged head difference, while scour weakens support. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。與水工試驗和事件記錄比對，明列哪些附加作用沒有包含在靜水差值中。分別計算兩側水壓對底部的力矩。
knowledge.textEn: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Compare hydraulic tests or event records and explicitly list additional actions omitted from the static pressure difference. Calculate each side's pressure moment about the base separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。與水工試驗和事件記錄比對，明列哪些附加作用沒有包含在靜水差值中。
knowledge.textEn: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Compare hydraulic tests or event records and explicitly list additional actions omitted from the static pressure difference.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙側水壓與越流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Two-sided pressure and overflow"?
options: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。
optionsEn: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance.
quiz.explanation: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙側水壓與越流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-sided pressure and overflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙側水壓與越流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-sided pressure and overflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 越流背面吸力會在水位差相同時增加水平作用，沖刷又會削弱支承；只放大靜水力而不更新接觸與底床，可能錯過真正導致沉箱移動的組合機制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rear suction increases horizontal action at unchanged head difference, while scour weakens support. Multiplying static force without updating contact and bedding can miss the coupled mechanism that actually initiates caisson displacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：靜水三角形的作用點位於各水深底部以上三分之一，兩側力矩仍須分開計算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each hydrostatic triangle acts one-third of its depth above the base, requiring separate moment calculation before subtracting the two sides.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 越流背面吸力會在水位差相同時增加水平作用，沖刷又會削弱支承；只放大靜水力而不更新接觸與底床，可能錯過真正導致沉箱移動的組合機制。
knowledge.textEn: Rear suction increases horizontal action at unchanged head difference, while scour weakens support. Multiplying static force without updating contact and bedding can miss the coupled mechanism that actually initiates caisson displacement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙側水壓與越流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-sided pressure and overflow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
越流背面吸力會在水位差相同時增加水平作用，沖刷又會削弱支承；只放大靜水力而不更新接觸與底床，可能錯過真正導致沉箱移動的組合機制。
沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Rear suction increases horizontal action at unchanged head difference, while scour weakens support.
Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass.
quiz.explanation: 越流背面吸力會在水位差相同時增加水平作用，沖刷又會削弱支承；只放大靜水力而不更新接觸與底床，可能錯過真正導致沉箱移動的組合機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rear suction increases horizontal action at unchanged head difference, while scour weakens support. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 消波塊製作與安放
summary: 把消波構件的材料品質、形狀與安放接觸連成可追溯驗證。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。假設質量由3000增10%為3300kg、材料密度不變，實體體積由1.25增為1.375m³，海水中有效重量由16.86094增至18.54703kN；不是不同形狀構件可按質量互換的證明。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications. Increasing mass from3000 to3300kg by10% at unchanged density raises solid volume from1.25 to1.375m³ and submerged weight from16.86094 to18.54703kN. This does not justify substituting different unit shapes by mass. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「質量與排水體積」與「有效用水與配比」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mass and displaced volume" and "Effective water accounting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 質量與排水體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mass and displaced volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「質量與排水體積」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mass and displaced volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土消波構件的質量影響水下有效重量，但水工功能還取決於形狀、接觸和孔隙。從密度換算體積只是一致性檢查，不能由相同噸數推定不同專利形狀的穩定性相同，也不能取代裂縫和缺角檢查。 假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。 質量驗證也應保留水下有效重的定義，浸水可達孔隙會影響排水體積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「質量與排水體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete-unit mass influences submerged weight, while hydraulic behavior also depends on shape, contacts and voids. Density-to-volume conversion is a consistency check, not evidence that different proprietary shapes with equal tonnage have equal stability or freedom from cracking and missing corners. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications. Mass checks must retain the submerged-weight definition because water-accessible voids can affect the displaced volume used for buoyancy calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mass and displaced volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「質量與排水體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mass and displaced volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 質量與排水體積
knowledge.text: 混凝土消波構件的質量影響水下有效重量，但水工功能還取決於形狀、接觸和孔隙。從密度換算體積只是一致性檢查，不能由相同噸數推定不同專利形狀的穩定性相同，也不能取代裂縫和缺角檢查。

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設膠材340kg、加入水170kg，其中8kg被乾骨材吸收且無表面水，有效水膠比(170−8)/340=0.4765；非配方建議。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume binder340kg and water170kg, with8kg absorbed by dry aggregate and no surface water. Effective ratio=(170−8)/340=0.4765, not a mix recommendation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效用水與配比」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective water accounting", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效用水與配比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective water accounting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效用水與配比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective water accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。確認加水與骨材試驗的時間相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture. Confirm matching times for water addition and aggregate testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：骨材含水變化未修正會讓相同水表數字對應不同水膠比，局部泌水或離析也可能出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncorrected aggregate moisture gives different effective ratios at identical meter readings and can produce bleeding or segregation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。確認加水與骨材試驗的時間相符。
knowledge.textEn: Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture. Confirm matching times for water addition and aggregate testing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效用水與配比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective water accounting"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。
外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions.
Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold.
quiz.explanation: 分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效用水與配比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective water accounting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效用水與配比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective water accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 骨材含水變化未修正會讓相同水表數字對應不同水膠比，局部泌水或離析也可能出現。只看試體平均強度，仍可能漏掉構件細長部位的弱區。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncorrected aggregate moisture gives different effective ratios at identical meter readings and can produce bleeding or segregation. An acceptable average specimen strength may still conceal weak material in slender portions of the actual unit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：膠材不一定只有水泥，計算分母需要遵循核准配比中對膠材的明確定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Binder need not consist only of cement; the calculation denominator must follow the explicit binder definition in the approved mixture.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每批水表加入相同水量就代表有效水膠比保持不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Identical metered water addition guarantees an unchanged effective water-to-binder ratio." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 骨材含水變化未修正會讓相同水表數字對應不同水膠比，局部泌水或離析也可能出現。只看試體平均強度，仍可能漏掉構件細長部位的弱區。
knowledge.textEn: Uncorrected aggregate moisture gives different effective ratios at identical meter readings and can produce bleeding or segregation. An acceptable average specimen strength may still conceal weak material in slender portions of the actual unit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效用水與配比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective water accounting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。
骨材含水變化未修正會讓相同水表數字對應不同水膠比，局部泌水或離析也可能出現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.
Uncorrected aggregate moisture gives different effective ratios at identical meter readings and can produce bleeding or segregation.
quiz.explanation: 骨材含水變化未修正會讓相同水表數字對應不同水膠比，局部泌水或離析也可能出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncorrected aggregate moisture gives different effective ratios at identical meter readings and can produce bleeding or segregation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由熱變形尺度」與「約束冷卻與裂縫」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free thermal movement scale" and "Restrained cooling and cracking": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由熱變形尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free thermal movement scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由熱變形尺度」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free thermal movement scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型混凝土構件的表面與內部溫度歷程不同，均勻自由伸縮只能提供基礎量級。若存在溫度梯度或模具約束，就會額外產生應力；把自由變形算式誤當成裂縫預測會遺漏養護和形狀的作用。 假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。 膨脹係數也可能因骨材而異，模型固定係數不等於所有混凝土都具有相同熱行為。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由熱變形尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The surface and core of a large unit follow different temperature histories. Uniform free expansion supplies a basic scale only; gradients or mould restraint generate additional stress. Treating free movement as a crack prediction omits curing conditions and geometric effects. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint. Thermal expansion depends on aggregate as well, so a fixed coefficient in the example does not imply identical behavior for every concrete. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free thermal movement scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由熱變形尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free thermal movement scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由熱變形尺度
knowledge.text: 大型混凝土構件的表面與內部溫度歷程不同，均勻自由伸縮只能提供基礎量級。若存在溫度梯度或模具約束，就會額外產生應力；把自由變形算式誤當成裂縫預測會遺漏養護和形狀的作用。
knowledge.textEn: The surface and core of a large unit follow different temperature histories. Uniform free expansion supplies a basic scale only; gradients or mould restraint generate additional stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由熱變形尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free thermal movement scale" is correct?
options: 大型混凝土構件的表面與內部溫度歷程不同，均勻自由伸縮只能提供基礎量級。
整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。
完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。
optionsEn: The surface and core of a large unit follow different temperature histories.
Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.
Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently.
quiz.explanation: 大型混凝土構件的表面與內部溫度歷程不同，均勻自由伸縮只能提供基礎量級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The surface and core of a large unit follow different temperature histories. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由熱變形尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free thermal movement scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由熱變形尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free thermal movement scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在厚部與細臂配置相對應的溫度紀錄，區分均勻降溫與內外梯度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare temperature histories in thick portions and slender arms, separating uniform cooling from gradients.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由熱變形尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free thermal movement scale", which statement holds?
options: 對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
optionsEn: Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由熱變形尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free thermal movement scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由熱變形尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free thermal movement scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在厚部與細臂配置相對應的溫度紀錄，區分均勻降溫與內外梯度。將實測變形和模具接觸狀態一起比較，確認採用自由膨脹假設的區段是否真的未受拘束。用另一組長度或溫差檢查線性換算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare temperature histories in thick portions and slender arms, separating uniform cooling from gradients. Relate measured movement to mould contact and verify that portions modeled as freely expanding actually lack significant restraint. Check the linear conversion using another length or temperature interval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在厚部與細臂配置相對應的溫度紀錄，區分均勻降溫與內外梯度。將實測變形和模具接觸狀態一起比較，確認採用自由膨脹假設的區段是否真的未受拘束。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare temperature histories in thick portions and slender arms, separating uniform cooling from gradients. Relate measured movement to mould contact and verify that portions modeled as freely expanding actually lack significant restraint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面已降溫而核心仍熱時，單一平均溫度會掩蓋內外應變差；局部細臂可能先裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 表面已降溫而核心仍熱時，單一平均溫度會掩蓋內外應變差；局部細臂可能先裂。即使外部總長變化很小，也不能據此排除內部自平衡熱應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A cooled surface with a warm core creates strain differences hidden by average temperature, potentially cracking slender arms first. steps.title: 約束冷卻與裂縫：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「約束冷卻與裂縫」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained cooling and cracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 約束會把熱收縮轉換成拉應力，但混凝土齡期、徐變、開裂和約束鬆弛都使反應隨時間變化。完全約束線彈性式只用來比較量級，不能把固定彈性模數一路套到所有養護階段或實際裂縫寬度。 假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。 抗拉能力也隨齡期改變，應力和抗力需在相同時間比較才有物理意義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「約束冷卻與裂縫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restraint converts thermal contraction into tension, but concrete age, creep, cracking and restraint relaxation change response over time. A fully restrained elastic estimate compares scales only; fixed modulus cannot represent every curing stage or directly predict the resulting crack width. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment. Tensile resistance changes with age too; comparing stress and resistance at the same time is necessary for a physically meaningful interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained cooling and cracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「約束冷卻與裂縫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
