steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained cooling and cracking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄溫度、齡期及模具或基座約束，檢查模型採用的彈性模數與實際時間是否一致。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Arbitrarily removing restraint merely because the theoretical stress seems high instead understates genuine cracking potential. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗拉能力也隨齡期改變，應力和抗力需在相同時間比較才有物理意義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tensile resistance changes with age too; comparing stress and resistance at the same time is necessary for a physically meaningful interpretation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。
knowledge.textEn: Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Arbitrarily removing restraint merely because the theoretical stress seems high instead understates genuine cracking potential.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約束冷卻與裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restrained cooling and cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。
抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation.
Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
quiz.explanation: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試體強度與構件」與「吊運力向分解」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Specimen strength versus unit behavior" and "Resolving handling forces": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試體強度與構件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Specimen strength versus unit behavior: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試體強度與構件」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。試體與構件的溫度歷程、密實度和尺度不同，因此名義抗壓值不能代表全部構造能力。 假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。 試體平均值與特徵值的統計意義不同，樣本數及離散程度需另外明列。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試體強度與構件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. Their temperature histories, consolidation and size differ, so nominal compressive strength cannot describe every structural capacity of the full unit. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength. A specimen mean and a characteristic value have different statistical meanings, requiring separate statements of sample size and observed variability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試體強度與構件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Specimen strength versus unit behavior”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試體強度與構件
knowledge.text: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。試體與構件的溫度歷程、密實度和尺度不同，因此名義抗壓值不能代表全部構造能力。
knowledge.textEn: Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. Their temperature histories, consolidation and size differ, so nominal compressive strength cannot describe every structural capacity of the full unit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試體強度與構件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specimen strength versus unit behavior" is correct?
options: 抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。
抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。
optionsEn: Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion.
Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension.
quiz.explanation: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試體強度與構件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specimen strength versus unit behavior: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試體強度與構件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試體強度與構件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specimen strength versus unit behavior", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試體強度與構件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specimen strength versus unit behavior: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試體強度與構件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。再檢查試體與構件的養護溫度差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification. Check curing-temperature differences between specimens and full units. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試體養護較好時可能高估構件內部品質，局部蜂窩又未必出現在取樣中；平均抗壓值達標仍可能伴隨吊運破裂或安放後接觸臂損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Better specimen curing can overstate actual unit quality, and sampling may miss local honeycombing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification. Check curing-temperature differences between specimens and full units.

steps.title: 吊運力向分解：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Resolving handling forces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊運力向分解」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resolving handling forces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 消波構件的吊點與重心受複雜形狀影響，索力會因夾角增加而上升。理想兩索靜力分析需同時滿足對稱與共同受力，不能取代專用吊具、動載和早齡期材料能力的核准檢查。 假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。 吊點局部作用還取決於嵌件與混凝土的傳力，單一索力不能證明錨定合格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊運力向分解」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Complex geometry affects lifting points and gravity center, and sling force rises with inclination. An ideal two-sling static model requires symmetry and simultaneous engagement; it does not replace approved checks of lifting equipment, dynamics and early-age material capacity. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity. Local attachment behavior depends on force transfer through inserts and concrete; one sling-force result cannot establish adequate anchorage performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resolving handling forces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吊運力向分解」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resolving handling forces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊運力向分解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resolving handling forces" is correct?
options: 消波構件的吊點與重心受複雜形狀影響，索力會因夾角增加而上升。

steps.title: 吊運力向分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolving handling forces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊運力向分解」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resolving handling forces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實際吊點與重心位置畫自由體圖，核對角度基準、各索受力及局部構件應力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊運力向分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resolving handling forces", which statement holds?

Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.

steps.title: 吊運力向分解：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resolving handling forces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊運力向分解」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resolving handling forces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用實際吊點與重心位置畫自由體圖，核對角度基準、各索受力及局部構件應力。保留核准吊裝方案與材料齡期紀錄，確保教學計算沒有被當作設備操作指令。將吊點能力的證據與索力分開歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses. Retain the approved lifting plan and material-age evidence so the teaching calculation is not used as equipment instructions. File attachment-capacity evidence separately from calculated sling forces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用實際吊點與重心位置畫自由體圖，核對角度基準、各索受力及局部構件應力。保留核准吊裝方案與材料齡期紀錄，確保教學計算沒有被當作設備操作指令。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses. Retain the approved lifting plan and material-age evidence so the teaching calculation is not used as equipment instructions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain the approved lifting plan and material-age evidence so the teaching calculation is not used as equipment instructions. File attachment-capacity evidence separately from calculated sling forces.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.textEn: Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses. Retain the approved lifting plan and material-age evidence so the teaching calculation is not used as equipment instructions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊運力向分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Resolving handling forces"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。
用實際吊點與重心位置畫自由體圖，核對角度基準、各索受力及局部構件應力。

Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.

quiz.explanationEn: Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊運力向分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resolving handling forces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊運力向分解」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Resolving handling forces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions. Early cracking in slender arms may appear only after placement, and total lifted weight alone cannot explain the damage history. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊點局部作用還取決於嵌件與混凝土的傳力，單一索力不能證明錨定合格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local attachment behavior depends on force transfer through inserts and concrete; one sling-force result cannot establish adequate anchorage performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。
knowledge.textEn: Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions. Early cracking in slender arms may appear only after placement, and total lifted weight alone cannot explain the damage history.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊運力向分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolving handling forces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。

optionsEn: Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanation: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安放密度與孔隙」與「三維位置與姿態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Placement density and voids" and "Three-dimensional placement geometry": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「安放密度與孔隙」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Placement density and voids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。每平方米的件數不能直接換成孔隙率，也不能只增加件數就期待水工功能改善，過密可能改變透流與局部架空。 假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。 實際斜面和水平面積的選擇會改變名義件數密度，跨專案比較要先統一定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安放密度與孔隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. Units per square metre cannot be directly converted into porosity, and adding more units need not improve performance because overly dense placement can alter flow and create unsupported contacts. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity. Choosing actual slope area versus horizontal projection changes nominal placement density, so comparisons across projects require a consistent denominator first. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Placement density and voids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「安放密度與孔隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Placement density and voids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。每平方米的件數不能直接換成孔隙率，也不能只增加件數就期待水工功能改善，過密可能改變透流與局部架空。
knowledge.textEn: Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. Units per square metre cannot be directly converted into porosity, and adding more units need not improve performance because overly dense placement can alter flow and create unsupported contacts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安放密度與孔隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Placement density and voids" is correct?
options: 總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。
安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
optionsEn: Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area.
Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
quiz.explanation: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安放密度與孔隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Placement density and voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安放密度與孔隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Placement density and voids", which statement holds?
options: 一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。
每批水表加入相同水量就代表有效水膠比保持不變。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
Identical metered water addition guarantees an unchanged effective water-to-binder ratio.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安放密度與孔隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Placement density and voids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。分別檢查坡腳和坡頂的局部覆蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean. Check local coverage at toe and crest separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean. Check local coverage at toe and crest separately.

knowledge.textEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安放密度與孔隙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Placement density and voids"?
options: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。
optionsEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently.
quiz.explanation: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安放密度與孔隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Placement density and voids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。只驗收總數量，不能確認荷載和互鎖已沿斷面連續傳遞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Total quantity alone does not establish continuous contact, load transfer or interlocking along the section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際斜面和水平面積的選擇會改變名義件數密度，跨專案比較要先統一定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Choosing actual slope area versus horizontal projection changes nominal placement density, so comparisons across projects require a consistent denominator first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。只驗收總數量，不能確認荷載和互鎖已沿斷面連續傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Total quantity alone does not establish continuous contact, load transfer or interlocking along the section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安放密度與孔隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Placement density and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
quiz.explanation: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「三維位置與姿態」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 水下安放需把位置誤差與姿態誤差分開，三維坐標偏差小不代表接觸臂方向正確。測量基準、船體姿態和吊具桿臂都會影響重建位置，圖上的點位必須能追溯到構件的特定參考點。 假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。 位置距離是三維向量的長度，不會保留偏移方向，方向仍需另行記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三維位置與姿態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underwater placement separates position error from orientation error; small coordinate deviation does not establish correct contact-arm direction. Survey datum, vessel attitude and rig lever arms affect reconstruction, so each plotted position must refer to a defined point on the actual unit. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error. Position distance is the magnitude of a three-dimensional vector and does not preserve direction, which must therefore remain separately recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Three-dimensional placement geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「三維位置與姿態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 依「三維位置與姿態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Three-dimensional placement geometry", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。
整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.
Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三維位置與姿態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three-dimensional placement geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。比較安放前後的水下影像或測量資料，保留量測不確定度與盲區。同時保存三個方向的原始偏差值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Compare underwater observations before and after placement, retaining uncertainty and blind zones. Preserve the original offsets in all three directions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。比較安放前後的水下影像或測量資料，保留量測不確定度與盲區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Compare underwater observations before and after placement, retaining uncertainty and blind zones.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三維位置與姿態」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Three-dimensional placement geometry"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。
抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately.
Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.

quiz.explanationEn: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三維位置與姿態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three-dimensional placement geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。點位殘差小仍可能對應水工模型從未驗證過的安放方式，影響後續穩定判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Small position residuals can therefore coexist with an arrangement never validated in the hydraulic model used for stability assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：位置距離是三維向量的長度，不會保留偏移方向，方向仍需另行記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Position distance is the magnitude of a three-dimensional vector and does not preserve direction, which must therefore remain separately recorded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。點位殘差小仍可能對應水工模型從未驗證過的安放方式，影響後續穩定判讀。
knowledge.textEn: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Small position residuals can therefore coexist with an arrangement never validated in the hydraulic model used for stability assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三維位置與姿態」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Three-dimensional placement geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。
參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold.
An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms.
quiz.explanation: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模型質量縮尺」與「磨耗試驗與壽命」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Model mass scaling" and "Abrasion testing and service life": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模型質量縮尺：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Model mass scaling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模型質量縮尺」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Model mass scaling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。實體試驗還需維持相對密度、表面粗糙和接觸方式，不能只做外形相似卻讓有效重量與摩擦特性失去對應。 假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。 模型接觸面若相對粗糙過大，摩擦行為可能與原型不同，即使質量縮尺正確。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模型質量縮尺」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio. Physical tests also require appropriate relative density, roughness and contacts; matching the silhouette alone does not preserve submerged weight or interface behavior. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately. Excessive relative roughness at model contacts can alter friction even when the mass scaling is correct for the chosen geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Model mass scaling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模型質量縮尺」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Model mass scaling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模型質量縮尺
knowledge.text: 幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。實體試驗還需維持相對密度、表面粗糙和接觸方式，不能只做外形相似卻讓有效重量與摩擦特性失去對應。
knowledge.textEn: Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio. Physical tests also require appropriate relative density, roughness and contacts; matching the silhouette alone does not preserve submerged weight or interface behavior.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模型質量縮尺」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Model mass scaling" is correct?
options: 幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。
外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。
一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。
optionsEn: Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio.
Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold.
Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
quiz.explanation: 幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模型質量縮尺：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model mass scaling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模型質量縮尺」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Model mass scaling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately.

quiz.question: 依「模型質量縮尺」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Model mass scaling", which statement holds?
options: 每批水表加入相同水量就代表有效水膠比保持不變。

optionsEn: Identical metered water addition guarantees an unchanged effective water-to-binder ratio.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.titleEn: Model mass scaling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模型質量縮尺」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。另以安放照片比對接觸點，說明粗糙尺度不能完全相似的限制。檢查模型接觸面的粗糙與摩擦假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design. Compare contact points through placement images and state limitations where surface roughness cannot be fully scaled. Check assumptions for model contact roughness and friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。另以安放照片比對接觸點，說明粗糙尺度不能完全相似的限制。檢查模型接觸面的粗糙與摩擦假設。
knowledge.textEn: Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design. Compare contact points through placement images and state limitations where surface roughness cannot be fully scaled. Check assumptions for model contact roughness and friction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。另以安放照片比對接觸點，說明粗糙尺度不能完全相似的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design. Compare contact points through placement images and state limitations where surface roughness cannot be fully scaled.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模型質量縮尺」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Model mass scaling"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。
同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion.
Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design.
quiz.explanation: 同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模型質量縮尺：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model mass scaling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型質量縮尺」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model mass scaling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用低密度列印件卻只按長度縮小，模型可能比原型容易移動；額外加重若集中在一點又會改變重心。質量吻合仍不足以證明動態轉動完全相似。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low-density printed units scaled only by length can move more readily than the prototype. Concentrated added weight changes gravity center, so even a matching total mass does not establish dynamically similar rotation of the unit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模型接觸面若相對粗糙過大，摩擦行為可能與原型不同，即使質量縮尺正確。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excessive relative roughness at model contacts can alter friction even when the mass scaling is correct for the chosen geometry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用低密度列印件卻只按長度縮小，模型可能比原型容易移動；額外加重若集中在一點又會改變重心。質量吻合仍不足以證明動態轉動完全相似。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型質量縮尺」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。
optionsEn: Low-density printed units scaled only by length can move more readily than the prototype.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
quiz.explanation: 用低密度列印件卻只按長度縮小，模型可能比原型容易移動；額外加重若集中在一點又會改變重心。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low-density printed units scaled only by length can move more readily than the prototype. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 磨耗試驗與壽命：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abrasion testing and service life: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「磨耗試驗與壽命」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abrasion testing and service life” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 表面磨耗可能改變邊角和接觸粗糙度，試驗質量損失提供材料比較，卻不是直接的年損耗率。試驗介質、撞擊能量和時間與現地不同，必須把可重現的試驗排序與實際耐久機制分開。 假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。 耐久判讀還需要考慮鹽害與濕乾循環，機械磨耗不是唯一材料退化途徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磨耗試驗與壽命」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Abrasion can alter corners and contact roughness. Test mass loss compares material response but is not a direct annual wear rate. Media, impact energy and duration differ from service, so reproducible laboratory ranking must remain separate from the mechanisms governing real durability. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss. Durability interpretation must also consider salt exposure and wet-dry cycling, because mechanical abrasion is not the sole material deterioration mechanism. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abrasion testing and service life” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「磨耗試驗與壽命」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 表面磨耗可能改變邊角和接觸粗糙度，試驗質量損失提供材料比較，卻不是直接的年損耗率。試驗介質、撞擊能量和時間與現地不同，必須把可重現的試驗排序與實際耐久機制分開。
knowledge.textEn: Abrasion can alter corners and contact roughness. Test mass loss compares material response but is not a direct annual wear rate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「磨耗試驗與壽命」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

表面磨耗可能改變邊角和接觸粗糙度，試驗質量損失提供材料比較，卻不是直接的年損耗率。
任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。

Abrasion can alter corners and contact roughness.
Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.

steps.title: 磨耗試驗與壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abrasion testing and service life: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「磨耗試驗與壽命」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abrasion testing and service life” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「磨耗試驗與壽命」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abrasion testing and service life", which statement holds?

抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。

optionsEn: Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.
Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 磨耗試驗與壽命：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「磨耗試驗與壽命」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。將不同批次依同方法比較，另以現地追蹤建立環境與材料反應的關聯。確認兩次秤重使用相同乾燥基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response. Confirm identical drying reference conditions for both weighings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。將不同批次依同方法比較，另以現地追蹤建立環境與材料反應的關聯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response. Confirm identical drying reference conditions for both weighings.

knowledge.textEn: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response.
