steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。
knowledge.textEn: Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. Direct lifetime extrapolation then misses how localized damage to a contact arm disproportionately affects the function of the complete unit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磨耗試驗與壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abrasion testing and service life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。
任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes.
Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.
quiz.explanation: 試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 古里水壩
summary: 古里案例以供應商公開的機組更新紀錄為起點，研究汽蝕、效率試驗、轉矩與對心、冷卻及停機順序。課程要求每項改善主張都有對應量測與比較工況，並把轉輪最大出力、名目出力和全廠供電可靠度分開。學員以故障假說表統整水力與機械證據。
summaryEn: Starting from a supplier record of Guri modernization, study cavitation, efficiency testing, torque, alignment, cooling and outage sequence. Each claimed improvement requires matching measurements and comparable operating conditions. Runner maximum power, nominal output and plant supply reliability remain separate concepts, brought together through a table of hydraulic and mechanical fault hypotheses.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 世界水壩與水庫
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「效率試驗不確定度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「汽蝕可用水頭」及「低速巨型轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981；第二組為 Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Efficiency test uncertainty, then compare the controlling variables in Available cavitation head and Large torque at low speed. The first calculation is uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981; the second is Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「效率試驗不確定度」與「汽蝕可用水頭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Efficiency test uncertainty" and "Available cavitation head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「效率試驗不確定度」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Efficiency test uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。流量、水頭與功率誤差會共同傳到效率；獨立小誤差可用平方和開根近似，但共用校準或同一基準造成的相關誤差必須保留協方差，不能假裝會互相抵消。 標準不確定度與擴充不確定度不能直接相混，若資料給涵蓋因子，應先換成同一層級再進行傳播。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「效率試驗不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. Flow, head and power errors all propagate into efficiency. Independent small errors permit a root-sum-square approximation, while shared calibration or reference errors require covariance and cannot be assumed to cancel. Standard and expanded uncertainties cannot be mixed directly; when a coverage factor is supplied, convert every input to the same uncertainty level before propagation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Efficiency test uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「效率試驗不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Efficiency test uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 效率試驗不確定度
knowledge.text: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。流量、水頭與功率誤差會共同傳到效率；獨立小誤差可用平方和開根近似，但共用校準或同一基準造成的相關誤差必須保留協方差，不能假裝會互相抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. Flow, head and power errors all propagate into efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「效率試驗不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Efficiency test uncertainty" is correct?
options: 重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差
更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。
相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量
optionsEn: Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias.
Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty.
Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
quiz.explanation: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「效率試驗不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Efficiency test uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。模型邊界：各輸入為無因次相對標準不確定度，互相獨立且誤差小；不是擴充信賴區間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Model boundary: dimensionless relative standard uncertainties, mutually independent and small; not an expanded confidence interval. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。模型邊界：各輸入為無因次相對標準不確定度，互相獨立且誤差小；不是擴充信賴區間。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Model boundary: dimensionless relative standard uncertainties, mutually independent and small; not an expanded confidence interval.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「效率試驗不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Efficiency test uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 出現轉頻振動就一定是轉子不平衡
總冷卻流量正常就代表局部熱阻正常
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。
optionsEn: A vibration at rotational frequency always proves rotor unbalance.
Normal total cooling flow proves that local thermal resistance is normal.
Original hypothetical example.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「效率試驗不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Efficiency test uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。若改善幅度與不確定度相近，應報告分辨能力不足，再研究增加樣本能否降低隨機項，而非期待它消除系統偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate. If the claimed improvement is comparable to uncertainty, report limited resolution and assess whether more samples reduce random components rather than expecting them to remove systematic bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為三個量測項建立不確定度表，再加入流量與水頭正相關情境，重算效率不確定度，指出改善哪一項儀表最能提高辨識能力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build an uncertainty budget for the three measurements, add positive correlation between head and flow, and recompute efficiency uncertainty. Identify the instrument improvement that most increases the ability to resolve a performance change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。若改善幅度與不確定度相近，應報告分辨能力不足，再研究增加樣本能否降低隨機項，而非期待它消除系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate. If the claimed improvement is comparable to uncertainty, report limited resolution and assess whether more samples reduce random components rather than expecting them to remove systematic bias.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為三個量測項建立不確定度表，再加入流量與水頭正相關情境，重算效率不確定度，指出改善哪一項儀表最能提高辨識能力。
knowledge.textEn: Build an uncertainty budget for the three measurements, add positive correlation between head and flow, and recompute efficiency uncertainty. Identify the instrument improvement that most increases the ability to resolve a performance change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「效率試驗不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Efficiency test uncertainty"?
options: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
總失重量小就表示局部磨耗無害
optionsEn: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small total mass loss proves that local wear is harmless.
quiz.explanation: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「效率試驗不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Efficiency test uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. Changing instrument ranges between tests may also create an apparent efficiency improvement that is actually a calibration difference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：標準不確定度與擴充不確定度不能直接相混，若資料給涵蓋因子，應先換成同一層級再進行傳播。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Standard and expanded uncertainties cannot be mixed directly; when a coverage factor is supplied, convert every input to the same uncertainty level before propagation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。
knowledge.textEn: Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. Changing instrument ranges between tests may also create an apparent efficiency improvement that is actually a calibration difference.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「效率試驗不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Efficiency test uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。
相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares.
Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
quiz.explanation: 水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 汽蝕可用水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Available cavitation head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「汽蝕可用水頭」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Available cavitation head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 法蘭西斯轉輪低壓區受尾水淹沒、當地大氣壓與水溫蒸氣壓共同影響，不能只由水庫水位判定汽蝕條件。教材把壓力全部換成水頭，再用機組淨水頭標準化，取得可用汽蝕係數。所需係數依轉輪與工況改變，必須另由試驗或經驗資料取得。 轉輪基準高於尾水時吸出高度為正，淹沒時則可能為負，符號定義會直接改變可用水頭帳。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「汽蝕可用水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low pressure around a Francis runner depends on tailwater submergence, atmospheric pressure and temperature-dependent vapor pressure, not reservoir level alone. Convert pressures to head and normalize by net machine head to obtain an available cavitation coefficient. The required coefficient varies with runner and operating point and needs separate test evidence. Runner setting above tailwater is positive under this convention, while submergence can be negative; that sign definition directly changes the available-head account. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Available cavitation head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「汽蝕可用水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Available cavitation head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 汽蝕可用水頭
knowledge.text: 法蘭西斯轉輪低壓區受尾水淹沒、當地大氣壓與水溫蒸氣壓共同影響，不能只由水庫水位判定汽蝕條件。教材把壓力全部換成水頭，再用機組淨水頭標準化，取得可用汽蝕係數。
knowledge.textEn: Low pressure around a Francis runner depends on tailwater submergence, atmospheric pressure and temperature-dependent vapor pressure, not reservoir level alone. Convert pressures to head and normalize by net machine head to obtain an available cavitation coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「汽蝕可用水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Available cavitation head" is correct?
options: 相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量
相同功率的所有機組都具有相同轉矩
法蘭西斯轉輪低壓區受尾水淹沒、當地大氣壓與水溫蒸氣壓共同影響，不能只由水庫水位判定汽蝕條件。
optionsEn: Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
All machines delivering equal power necessarily have equal torque.
Low pressure around a Francis runner depends on tailwater submergence, atmospheric pressure and temperature-dependent vapor pressure, not reservoir level alone.
quiz.explanation: 法蘭西斯轉輪低壓區受尾水淹沒、當地大氣壓與水溫蒸氣壓共同影響，不能只由水庫水位判定汽蝕條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Low pressure around a Francis runner depends on tailwater submergence, atmospheric pressure and temperature-dependent vapor pressure, not reservoir level alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 汽蝕可用水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Available cavitation head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「汽蝕可用水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Available cavitation head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。模型邊界：Hs為轉輪基準高於尾水的正值；只算假想可用係數，未提供所需係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12. Model boundary: Hs is positive when the runner reference is above tailwater; hypothetical available coefficient only, with no required coefficient supplied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測尾水高程、大氣壓與水溫，核對轉輪基準點定義，再將壓力脈動及表面檢查與運轉工況配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure tailwater elevation, atmospheric pressure and water temperature together, checking the runner reference definition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「汽蝕可用水頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Available cavitation head", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。

steps.title: 汽蝕可用水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Available cavitation head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「汽蝕可用水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Available cavitation head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測尾水高程、大氣壓與水溫，核對轉輪基準點定義，再將壓力脈動及表面檢查與運轉工況配對。若水溫上升時問題加重，應檢查蒸氣壓變化，而不只調整淹沒深度假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure tailwater elevation, atmospheric pressure and water temperature together, checking the runner reference definition. Pair pressure pulsation and surface inspection with operating condition. Deterioration at warmer water calls for investigating vapor-pressure changes rather than modifying only the assumed submergence depth. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定機組淨水頭，分別降低大氣壓水頭與提高蒸氣壓水頭，重算可用係數，並說明還缺哪張試驗曲線才能比較所需餘量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At fixed net head, lower atmospheric head and raise vapor-pressure head separately. Recalculate the available coefficient and identify the test curve still required to compare it with the necessary margin.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高海拔較低大氣壓會減少可用壓力餘量，溫水又提高蒸氣壓；若誤用海平面常數及固定水溫，可能在相同淨水頭下錯判汽蝕條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lower atmospheric pressure reduces available margin, and warmer water raises vapor pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低速巨型轉矩」與「轉子不平衡力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Large torque at low speed" and "Rotor unbalance force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低速巨型轉矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Large torque at low speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低速巨型轉矩」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Large torque at low speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型水輪機在低轉速傳遞高功率時，軸系轉矩可非常大，因此功率相同不代表機械尺寸相同。利用功率除以角速度取得平均轉矩，先釐清每分鐘轉數與弧度每秒的換算。軸徑、鍵接與法蘭還受彎矩、疲勞及動態扭振控制，不能只由平均值定尺寸。 平均扭矩對應平均軸功率，電氣輸出還需透過發電機損失換算，兩個邊界不得未經說明直接混合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低速巨型轉矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A large hydro turbine transmitting high power at low speed develops substantial shaft torque, so equal power does not imply equal mechanical dimensions. Divide power by angular speed to obtain mean torque, converting revolutions per minute correctly. Shaft, coupling and flange design also depends on bending, fatigue and torsional dynamics. Mean torque corresponds to shaft power; electrical output requires conversion through generator losses, and the two measurement boundaries cannot be silently interchanged in the calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Large torque at low speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同功率的所有機組都具有相同轉矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All machines delivering equal power necessarily have equal torque." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低速巨型轉矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Large torque at low speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A large hydro turbine transmitting high power at low speed develops substantial shaft torque, so equal power does not imply equal mechanical dimensions. Divide power by angular speed to obtain mean torque, converting revolutions per minute correctly.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All machines delivering equal power necessarily have equal torque. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 低速巨型轉矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Large torque at low speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低速巨型轉矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Large torque at low speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m。模型邊界：恆速平均機械功率，不含電效率換算及動態扭矩峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m. Model boundary: constant-speed mean mechanical power, excluding electrical efficiency conversion and dynamic torque peaks. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊機械功率估計、軸速與扭振量測，確認電端功率是否已換算到軸端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align shaft-power estimates, speed and torsional measurements, checking conversion from terminal electrical power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 低速巨型轉矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Large torque at low speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低速巨型轉矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Large torque at low speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊機械功率估計、軸速與扭振量測，確認電端功率是否已換算到軸端。用不同負載下的平均轉矩趨勢檢查模型，若振動峰值增加而平均值正常，應研究動態扭振而非只增加靜態安全係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align shaft-power estimates, speed and torsional measurements, checking conversion from terminal electrical power. Compare mean torque over several loads. Increasing oscillatory peaks with a normal mean calls for dynamic investigation rather than simply raising a static factor in the calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在功率不變下比較兩種轉速的轉矩，畫出反比例曲線，再指出軸系強度評估仍需的彎矩、疲勞循環與接頭幾何資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare torque at two speeds while holding power constant and plot the inverse relationship. Identify bending, fatigue-cycle and connection-geometry data still needed to assess the shaft system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把每分鐘轉數直接當角速度會造成嚴重單位錯誤，並低估低速傳動需求；負載拒絕時轉速與轉矩同時變動，穩態公式也不能描述整個暫態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using revolutions per minute directly as angular speed creates a major unit error and misrepresents low-speed transmission demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊機械功率估計、軸速與扭振量測，確認電端功率是否已換算到軸端。用不同負載下的平均轉矩趨勢檢查模型，若振動峰值增加而平均值正常，應研究動態扭振而非只增加靜態安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Align shaft-power estimates, speed and torsional measurements, checking conversion from terminal electrical power. Compare mean torque over several loads. Increasing oscillatory peaks with a normal mean calls for dynamic investigation rather than simply raising a static factor in the calculation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在功率不變下比較兩種轉速的轉矩，畫出反比例曲線，再指出軸系強度評估仍需的彎矩、疲勞循環與接頭幾何資料。
knowledge.textEn: Compare torque at two speeds while holding power constant and plot the inverse relationship. Identify bending, fatigue-cycle and connection-geometry data still needed to assess the shaft system.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低速巨型轉矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Large torque at low speed"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Outage hours times rated power always equal unavoidable lost generation.

quiz.explanation: 對齊機械功率估計、軸速與扭振量測，確認電端功率是否已換算到軸端。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align shaft-power estimates, speed and torsional measurements, checking conversion from terminal electrical power. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 低速巨型轉矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large torque at low speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低速巨型轉矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Large torque at low speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把每分鐘轉數直接當角速度會造成嚴重單位錯誤，並低估低速傳動需求；負載拒絕時轉速與轉矩同時變動，穩態公式也不能描述整個暫態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using revolutions per minute directly as angular speed creates a major unit error and misrepresents low-speed transmission demand. Speed and torque change together during load rejection, which a constant-speed mean calculation cannot describe over the complete transient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均扭矩對應平均軸功率，電氣輸出還需透過發電機損失換算，兩個邊界不得未經說明直接混合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean torque corresponds to shaft power; electrical output requires conversion through generator losses, and the two measurement boundaries cannot be silently interchanged in the calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同功率的所有機組都具有相同轉矩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All machines delivering equal power necessarily have equal torque." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把每分鐘轉數直接當角速度會造成嚴重單位錯誤，並低估低速傳動需求；負載拒絕時轉速與轉矩同時變動，穩態公式也不能描述整個暫態。
knowledge.textEn: Using revolutions per minute directly as angular speed creates a major unit error and misrepresents low-speed transmission demand. Speed and torque change together during load rejection, which a constant-speed mean calculation cannot describe over the complete transient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Large torque at low speed" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把每分鐘轉數直接當角速度會造成嚴重單位錯誤，並低估低速傳動需求；負載拒絕時轉速與轉矩同時變動，穩態公式也不能描述整個暫態。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanationEn: Using revolutions per minute directly as angular speed creates a major unit error and misrepresents low-speed transmission demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉子不平衡力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotor unbalance force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉子不平衡力」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor unbalance force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉子不平衡量可用質量乘偏心距表示，旋轉時產生隨角速度平方增加的週期力。平衡修正需知道相位與支承反應，而不是只測振幅。教材估算激振力尺度後，要求區分軸彎曲、對心偏差與水力不對稱，因它們也可能在轉頻附近產生訊號。 不平衡力是隨軸旋轉的向量，固定方向感測器看到其投影，量測相位可提供配重位置而振幅單獨不能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉子不平衡力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rotor unbalance is expressed as mass times eccentricity and generates a periodic force proportional to angular speed squared. Correction requires phase and support response, not amplitude alone. After estimating excitation scale, distinguish bent shafts, misalignment and hydraulic asymmetry, which can also produce signals near rotational frequency. Unbalance force rotates as a vector; a fixed sensor observes its projection, making phase information essential for locating a correction mass rather than amplitude alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotor unbalance force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：U=500 kg*m; n=100 rpm; F=U*(2*pi*n/60)**2=54831.13556 N。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：U=500 kg*m; n=100 rpm; F=U*(2*pi*n/60)**2=54831.13556 N。模型邊界：剛性轉子單一不平衡量的力幅，未含支承傳遞與共振放大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: U=500 kg*m; n=100 rpm; F=U*(2*pi*n/60)**2=54831.13556 N. Model boundary: force amplitude from one rigid-rotor unbalance, without support transmission or resonant amplification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 轉子不平衡力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotor unbalance force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉子不平衡力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotor unbalance force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測鍵相信號與軸承兩方向振動，比較空轉及帶水負載的相位穩定性。若相位隨水頭大幅改變，應檢查水力激振；若試重後反應不符線性比例，需研究支承非線性或轉子柔性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure phase reference and two bearing-vibration directions, comparing unloaded and hydraulic-load phase stability. Strong head-dependent phase changes suggest hydraulic excitation. A trial-weight response inconsistent with linear proportionality calls for investigating support nonlinearity or rotor flexibility before applying a simple balance correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將轉速提高一成，重算不平衡力並與線性增加的錯誤預測比較，再列出平衡試驗必須保存的相位、方向及試重位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed by ten percent, recompute unbalance force and compare it with an incorrect linear prediction. List the phase, direction and trial-weight positions that a balance experiment must preserve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將所有轉頻振動都當成不平衡，可能加上錯誤配重而增加軸承負荷；感測器方向或相位基準反轉也會把修正位置推到錯誤角度，必須先確認座標。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating every rotational-frequency vibration as unbalance can lead to an incorrect correction mass and greater bearing load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉子不平衡力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rotor unbalance force"?

steps.title: 轉子不平衡力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotor unbalance force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉子不平衡力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotor unbalance force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將所有轉頻振動都當成不平衡，可能加上錯誤配重而增加軸承負荷；感測器方向或相位基準反轉也會把修正位置推到錯誤角度，必須先確認座標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating every rotational-frequency vibration as unbalance can lead to an incorrect correction mass and greater bearing load. Reversed sensor orientation or phase reference can also place a correction at the wrong angle, making coordinate verification essential. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不平衡力是隨軸旋轉的向量，固定方向感測器看到其投影，量測相位可提供配重位置而振幅單獨不能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unbalance force rotates as a vector; a fixed sensor observes its projection, making phase information essential for locating a correction mass rather than amplitude alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出現轉頻振動就一定是轉子不平衡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 冷態安裝時的軸線對心不一定等於運轉熱態對心，支承座與基礎的溫升差可能改變相對位置。教材以一支承構件的自由熱伸長估算偏移來源，再要求把方向與約束列明。實際軸承中心移動需同時考慮連接件與溫度場，不能只量外殼表面。 相對對心取決於兩支承位移之差，共同熱膨脹可能不改變相對偏移，卻仍影響管路或外部連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱態軸線對心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 熱態軸線對心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal operating alignment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱態軸線對心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal operating alignment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測支承內外溫度及軸承中心熱態位置，與冷態基線使用同一座標系比較。若偏移隨負載穩定重現，支持熱變形解釋；若卸載後不回復，應查接合滑移、墊片或基礎沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure internal and external support temperatures and the hot bearing-center position on the same coordinate system as the cold baseline. Repeatable load-dependent movement supports thermal deformation. Movement that remains after cooling requires investigation of connection slip, shims or foundation settlement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較兩個不同長度及溫升的支承自由伸長，求相對偏移，再畫出受約束時可能不同的變形方向，提出熱態對心所需測點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare free expansion of two supports with different lengths and temperature rises, calculate relative offset, and draw how restraint could change movement directions. Propose measurement points for hot alignment verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以冷態對心合格作結論，可能漏掉運轉中接頭偏角與軸承附加力；但熱態量測基座若同時伸長，也會混入儀器效應，應設獨立基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting cold alignment alone can overlook operating coupling angles and additional bearing force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 熱態軸線對心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal operating alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱態軸線對心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal operating alignment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以冷態對心合格作結論，可能漏掉運轉中接頭偏角與軸承附加力；但熱態量測基座若同時伸長，也會混入儀器效應，應設獨立基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting cold alignment alone can overlook operating coupling angles and additional bearing force. A measurement mounting that expands simultaneously can also contaminate the apparent movement, requiring an independent reference before attributing the entire offset to the machine. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相對對心取決於兩支承位移之差，共同熱膨脹可能不改變相對偏移，卻仍影響管路或外部連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Relative alignment depends on the difference between support movements; common expansion may leave alignment unchanged while still affecting piping or other external connections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「冷態對心合格就保證熱態對心不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acceptable cold alignment guarantees unchanged alignment during hot operation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Normal total cooling flow proves that local thermal resistance is normal.
Accepting cold alignment alone can overlook operating coupling angles and additional bearing force.

quiz.explanationEn: Accepting cold alignment alone can overlook operating coupling angles and additional bearing force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 局部熱阻與熱點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local thermal resistance and hotspots: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部熱阻與熱點」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local thermal resistance and hotspots” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電機繞組或軸承熱點由熱源與散熱路徑共同控制，總冷卻流量正常不代表局部熱阻正常。等效熱阻乘熱流可估算兩節點溫差，但接觸、導熱與對流應按實際路徑串並聯。教材把單一路徑作基準，再要求辨認旁路及熱容量造成的暫態。 串聯熱阻相加而並聯導熱能力相加，選錯連接方式會錯判熱流方向及熱點，應先畫熱路圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部熱阻與熱點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A winding or bearing hotspot depends on heat generation and its removal path, so normal total cooling flow does not establish normal local thermal resistance. Heat flow times equivalent resistance estimates a two-node temperature difference. Contact, conduction and convection must be connected according to the real path, including bypasses and thermal storage. Series thermal resistances add, while parallel conductances add; choosing the wrong connection misrepresents heat paths and hotspots, so draw the thermal network first. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local thermal resistance and hotspots” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總冷卻流量正常就代表局部熱阻正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal total cooling flow proves that local thermal resistance is normal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部熱阻與熱點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K.
Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部熱阻與熱點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local thermal resistance and hotspots: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部熱阻與熱點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local thermal resistance and hotspots” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在熱源附近與冷卻端同時量溫，透過不同負載下的溫差斜率估算熱阻，再比較停機冷卻曲線。若穩態溫差增大但熱源功率未變，應研究接觸劣化或結垢；若只有時間常數改變，需另查熱容量與流量分配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure temperatures near the source and cooling end, infer resistance from temperature difference over several loads, and compare cooldown curves. A larger steady difference at unchanged heat load suggests contact degradation or fouling, while changed response time also requires considering thermal capacity and flow distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把等效熱阻增加一半並保持熱負荷，計算新溫差，再建立兩條並聯散熱路徑，說明新增旁路如何改變局部熱流而非只改變總流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase resistance by half at fixed heat load and calculate the new temperature difference. Then build two parallel heat paths and explain how a bypass changes local heat flow rather than only total coolant flow.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸面鬆動會增加熱阻並形成局部高溫，平均出口水溫可能仍正常；若感測器離熱點太遠，訊號會被導熱平滑，延後發現絕緣或潤滑問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A loose contact increases thermal resistance and local temperature while average outlet water can remain normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A larger steady difference at unchanged heat load suggests contact degradation or fouling, while changed response time also requires considering thermal capacity and flow distribution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部熱阻與熱點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local thermal resistance and hotspots"?

steps.title: 局部熱阻與熱點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local thermal resistance and hotspots: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部熱阻與熱點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local thermal resistance and hotspots” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸面鬆動會增加熱阻並形成局部高溫，平均出口水溫可能仍正常；若感測器離熱點太遠，訊號會被導熱平滑，延後發現絕緣或潤滑問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A loose contact increases thermal resistance and local temperature while average outlet water can remain normal. A sensor far from the hotspot smooths the signal through conduction and can delay recognition of insulation or lubrication deterioration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：串聯熱阻相加而並聯導熱能力相加，選錯連接方式會錯判熱流方向及熱點，應先畫熱路圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Series thermal resistances add, while parallel conductances add; choosing the wrong connection misrepresents heat paths and hotspots, so draw the thermal network first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總冷卻流量正常就代表局部熱阻正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal total cooling flow proves that local thermal resistance is normal." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部熱阻與熱點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

相同平均功率就保證相同疲勞壽命

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanationEn: A loose contact increases thermal resistance and local temperature while average outlet water can remain normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疲勞循環累積」與「表面磨耗質量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fatigue cycle accumulation" and "Surface wear mass loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疲勞循環累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue cycle accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「疲勞循環累積」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fatigue cycle accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉輪與軸系承受的交變荷載需要按幅值及循環次數整理，平均功率相同可能具有不同疲勞歷程。線性損傷和可作教材尺度分析，但材料曲線、平均應力與荷載先後次序會影響真實壽命。計算值不能直接當成剩餘年限，尤其缺少裂紋狀態時。 每一組疲勞壽命必須對應同一應力幅定義，範圍與振幅差一倍，混用會嚴重改變材料曲線取值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「疲勞循環累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Alternating runner and shaft loads require cycle counts by amplitude; equal mean power can hide different fatigue histories. A linear damage sum provides a teaching scale, while material curves, mean stress and sequence affect actual life. The calculated fraction cannot directly be converted into remaining years, particularly without crack-state information. Every fatigue life must use the same stress definition; stress range and amplitude differ by a factor of two, strongly affecting the selected material-curve value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fatigue cycle accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同平均功率就保證相同疲勞壽命」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mean power guarantees equal fatigue life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「疲勞循環累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fatigue cycle accumulation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疲勞循環累積
knowledge.text: 轉輪與軸系承受的交變荷載需要按幅值及循環次數整理，平均功率相同可能具有不同疲勞歷程。線性損傷和可作教材尺度分析，但材料曲線、平均應力與荷載先後次序會影響真實壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Alternating runner and shaft loads require cycle counts by amplitude; equal mean power can hide different fatigue histories. A linear damage sum provides a teaching scale, while material curves, mean stress and sequence affect actual life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同平均功率就保證相同疲勞壽命 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mean power guarantees equal fatigue life. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疲勞循環累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue cycle accumulation" is correct?
options: 相同平均功率就保證相同疲勞壽命
轉輪與軸系承受的交變荷載需要按幅值及循環次數整理，平均功率相同可能具有不同疲勞歷程。
總失重量小就表示局部磨耗無害
optionsEn: Equal mean power guarantees equal fatigue life.
Alternating runner and shaft loads require cycle counts by amplitude; equal mean power can hide different fatigue histories.
Small total mass loss proves that local wear is harmless.
quiz.explanation: 轉輪與軸系承受的交變荷載需要按幅值及循環次數整理，平均功率相同可能具有不同疲勞歷程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Alternating runner and shaft loads require cycle counts by amplitude; equal mean power can hide different fatigue histories. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疲勞循環累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue cycle accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疲勞循環累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fatigue cycle accumulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4。模型邊界：假設已給定兩級疲勞壽命與線性累積，非現場壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4. Model boundary: two assumed fatigue lives and linear accumulation, not a field life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對應變時序進行循環計數，核對高低幅值分類與材料試驗的應力定義一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count cycles from strain histories and ensure amplitude definitions match the material test data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4。模型邊界：假設已給定兩級疲勞壽命與線性累積，非現場壽命保證。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4. Model boundary: two assumed fatigue lives and linear accumulation, not a field life guarantee.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疲勞循環累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fatigue cycle accumulation", which statement holds?
options: 停機時數乘額定功率就是必然損失電量
相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量

optionsEn: Outage hours times rated power always equal unavoidable lost generation.
Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
Original hypothetical example.

steps.title: 疲勞循環累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue cycle accumulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「疲勞循環累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fatigue cycle accumulation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對應變時序進行循環計數，核對高低幅值分類與材料試驗的應力定義一致。再以非破壞檢查追蹤裂紋或缺陷；若累積指標低而裂紋成長，應查局部集中及模型遺漏，而不是否定檢查結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count cycles from strain histories and ensure amplitude definitions match the material test data. Track cracks or defects with nondestructive inspection. Crack growth despite a low damage index calls for investigating local concentration and omitted mechanisms rather than dismissing the inspection evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持總循環數，將一部分低幅循環改為高幅循環，重算損傷和，再列出平均應力與腐蝕環境會如何限制這個簡化比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep total cycle count fixed while replacing some low-amplitude cycles with high-amplitude cycles. Recalculate the damage sum and explain how mean stress and corrosion constrain the simplified comparison.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fatigue cycle accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少量高幅值事件可能主導疲勞，低頻平均紀錄會把它們抹平；若將不同應力集中位置混成一張循環表，也會使線性損傷值失去物理意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A few high-amplitude events can dominate fatigue and disappear in low-frequency averages. Combining histories from different stress-concentration locations into one cycle table can also remove the physical meaning of a nominal linear damage sum. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一組疲勞壽命必須對應同一應力幅定義，範圍與振幅差一倍，混用會嚴重改變材料曲線取值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every fatigue life must use the same stress definition; stress range and amplitude differ by a factor of two, strongly affecting the selected material-curve value.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同平均功率就保證相同疲勞壽命」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal mean power guarantees equal fatigue life." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface wear mass loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉輪表面損失的體積可由面積與平均厚度變化估算，再用材料密度換成質量，但磨耗通常高度不均勻。局部坑蝕深度對應力集中及水力形狀的影響，可能比總失重更重要。量測必須追蹤同一坐標區域，修補材料也需從原材損失中分開。 平均厚度須按面積加權，不能把不同大小區塊的厚度直接算術平均，否則質量帳會與表面幾何不一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「表面磨耗質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surface loss can be estimated from area and mean thickness change and converted to mass with density, but wear is rarely uniform. Local pit depth may matter more than total mass for stress concentration and hydraulic shape. Repeat measurements must track the same coordinates and distinguish repair material from original material loss. Mean thickness requires area weighting; a simple mean of unequal patch sizes gives a mass account inconsistent with the measured surface geometry and affected area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Surface wear mass loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總失重量小就表示局部磨耗無害」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small total mass loss proves that local wear is harmless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「表面磨耗質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Surface wear mass loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg。模型邊界：平均均勻厚度損失的體積近似，未描述局部坑蝕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg. Model boundary: volume approximation for mean uniform thickness loss, without describing local pitting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 掃描對位誤差可在整片表面製造假磨耗，修補塗層又可能掩蓋下方缺陷；如果只以總重量驗收，會漏掉局部形狀造成的水力性能及疲勞問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Registration error can create apparent wear over a large surface, while a repair layer can conceal underlying defects. Acceptance based only on total weight can miss local geometry effects on hydraulic performance and fatigue behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均厚度須按面積加權，不能把不同大小區塊的厚度直接算術平均，否則質量帳會與表面幾何不一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean thickness requires area weighting; a simple mean of unequal patch sizes gives a mass account inconsistent with the measured surface geometry and affected area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總失重量小就表示局部磨耗無害」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small total mass loss proves that local wear is harmless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢測陽性與基率」與「更新停機能量機會」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inspection positives and base rates" and "Renewal outage energy opportunity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢測陽性與基率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection positives and base rates: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢測陽性與基率」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inspection positives and base rates” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非破壞檢測的陽性訊號不等於缺陷已被確認，解讀還需要靈敏度、特異度與受檢群的缺陷基率。貝氏帳可把真陽性與假陽性分開，說明低基率時為何需要第二種方法確認。教材機率均為假設，不代表任何現場檢測程序的認證能力。 陽性預測值回答已出現訊號後的缺陷機率，靈敏度回答已知有缺陷時能否檢出，兩者條件方向相反。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢測陽性與基率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A positive nondestructive indication is not a confirmed defect; interpretation also requires sensitivity, specificity and defect prevalence in the inspected population. A Bayesian account separates true and false positives and explains the value of a second confirmation method at low prevalence. Teaching probabilities do not certify any actual inspection procedure. Positive predictive value asks about a defect after an indication, while sensitivity asks about detection given a defect; the conditioning direction is different in these questions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inspection positives and base rates” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「檢測靈敏度就是陽性結果的確診機率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Inspection sensitivity equals the probability that a positive result is a true defect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢測陽性與基率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inspection positives and base rates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A positive nondestructive indication is not a confirmed defect; interpretation also requires sensitivity, specificity and defect prevalence in the inspected population. A Bayesian account separates true and false positives and explains the value of a second confirmation method at low prevalence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：檢測靈敏度就是陽性結果的確診機率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Inspection sensitivity equals the probability that a positive result is a true defect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Inspection sensitivity equals the probability that a positive result is a true defect.
Outage hours times rated power always equal unavoidable lost generation.

steps.title: 檢測陽性與基率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspection positives and base rates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢測陽性與基率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inspection positives and base rates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164。模型邊界：無因次機率且適用同一受檢群，假設靈敏度與特異度已知。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164. Model boundary: dimensionless probabilities for the same inspected population, with sensitivity and specificity assumed known. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知缺陷試件與盲測樣本估計混淆矩陣，區分操作者、材料厚度與表面條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate a confusion matrix using known-defect specimens and blind samples, separating operator, thickness and surface conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164。模型邊界：無因次機率且適用同一受檢群，假設靈敏度與特異度已知。
